name: 12ks of Christmas
description:
Celebrate the Season at the 12Ks of Christmas!

Gather your family, friends, coworkers, and running buddies for a festive holiday adventure at Redmond Town Center!

The 12Ks of Christmas features a 12K, 5K, and Little Elf Run, offering a distance for everyone—from experienced runners to families participating together. Holiday costumes, cheerful music, and plenty of seasonal spirit will make this much more than an ordinary race.

Both the start and finish will be located at Redmond Town Center, creating a lively and convenient holiday gathering place for runners, walkers, families, and spectators. The 5K and 12K courses will take participants from Redmond Town Center onto the scenic trails surrounding downtown Redmond before bringing everyone back for a festive finish.

Whether you are chasing a personal best, walking with friends, introducing a young runner to the sport, or simply looking for a fun way to celebrate the season, the 12Ks of Christmas is the perfect way to get moving during the holidays.

Little Elf Run

The Little Elf Run is a special holiday race created just for younger runners. This short, noncompetitive event will take place at Redmond Town Center, allowing children to experience the excitement of race day in a fun, encouraging, and festive environment.

Bring the whole family, wear your favorite holiday outfit, and join us at Redmond Town Center—the starting line, finish line, and center of the celebration—for the 12Ks of Christmas!

name: 14th Annual Race to Feed Our Veterans 5K
description:
Annual Race to Feed Our Veterans 

Looking for a way to pay tribute to Veterans of the past and present this Veteran’s Day? 

Meals on Wheels Spokane and Fairmount Memorial Association are partnering up again for the 14th Annual Race to Feed Our Veterans 5K on Sunday November 8th.  This course winds through the beautiful grounds of Fairmount's Riverside Memorial and up into the tree lined hills of Greenwood Memorial Terrace.  All proceeds will benefit Meals on Wheels Spokane to make sure no Senior Veteran goes hungry this year. 

Pay tribute to our Veteran’s by joining the race to fight senior hungry. Sign-up today and your $25 registration will provide five meals for our Spokane seniors and Veterans. Adults, children and dogs of all ages and fitness level are welcome. Run/walk through the park with no worries about crossing traffic.  At the end of the race enjoy complimentary beer and chili.

name: 2026 CMMS Booster Club Turkey Trot 5K Fun Run
description:
You can do it at a trot, you can do it at a wobble, so your heart won't palpitate.... Just don't be late.... DO THE TURKEY TROT!!!

Get ready to trot or wobble for a cause! Join us for our 3rd Annual CMMS Booster Club Turkey Trot, a 5k Community Fundraiser & Food Drive. This event is more than just a race—it’s a chance to give back to our Cougars. Proceeds from the 5K support our Booster Club’s general fund, helping us provide resources and opportunities for our school community that school funds alone can't cover.

In addition, we’re hosting a food drive alongside our CMMS Counseling Team to provide Thanksgiving meal support within our CMMS community. Participants are encouraged to bring non-perishable food items to donate on race day. Together, we can make a meaningful difference while celebrating the season of giving!

This is a non timed walk/run 5k event on the grounds of Cougar Mountain Middle School in Graham, WA with a "choose your own adventure" approach: stick to the track (stroller friendly) or run the Turkey Trot course!

 

Entry Fee: $15 (Early Registration), $20 (Week of Event)  Kids 5 & under free

Check-in: 8:30am     Race starts: 9am

 

DONATION CHALLENGE: The top 3 students to receive donations made in their name will win prizes! During the donation process, simply choose "other" in the "in support of" and enter your student's name!

 

Best Dressed Costume Contest: Wear your most festive Thanksgiving attire—let’s see those turkey hats, pumpkin costumes, blow up turkey costumes and autumn colors! 

 

Food Donation Drive: Please bring non-perishable food items to donate that are appropriate for a Thanksgiving meal, such as boxed, canned, or jarred goods options of stuffing, gravy, olives, beans, cranberry sauce, mac & cheese, pasta, and rice. Your generosity will help ensure everyone has a warm meal this holiday season.

 

Strollers, Dogs & Bikes

We encourage the use of jogging strollers along the track route of this family-friendly 5K, as the 5K all-terrain course may involve stairs. Additionally, out of consideration for other participants, dogs will not be allowed on the course (with the exception of service dogs). For the safety and convenience of all participants, bikes are NOT permitted. 

 

Concessions will be available for purchase including water, coffee, doughnuts & pastries!

 

Bring your friends, family, and community spirit! We can't wait to see you! (All ages welcome however this is a no drop off event, meaning all students must be accompanied by an adult.)

name: 2026 Green Lake 5K & Wellness Festival
description:
Saturday, October 24, 2026 · Green Lake Arch, Seattle

Run. Move. Recover. Connect. Celebrate.

Join us at Green Lake for a community-wide celebration of movement and wellness: the Green Lake 5K plus a free, all-day Wellness Festival (9:00 AM–3:30 PM) with outdoor workshops, music, recovery experiences, local wellness brands, and healthy food and drinks presented by Yerbana & Kid Friendly Seattle. 

The Race

Start your day with an energizing group warm-up led by former UW Husky and NBA player Bobby Ray Jones Jr. (aka Yoga Bob) of Grow Unwind Connect (GUC), getting you loose, motivated, and ready to run your best 5K on a flat, fast loop around the iconic Green Lake.

The race is professionally produced by Snohomish Running Company, so whether you're chasing a PR or out for a fun run, you're in great hands. This is a race for everyone, runners and walkers alike. Official pacers will lead groups from 17:00 to 24:00. High school and middle school teams compete for team awards.

Registration includes: race bib, chip timing, a custom race shirt, a finisher medal, race photos, and post-race programming.

Race Day Info

Packet pickup: 7:30–8:45 AM. Bring your ID and registration confirmation.
First wave starts: 9:00 AM, with multiple waves through the morning.
Location: Everything happens at the Green Lake Arch, between the Community Center and E Green Lake Dr N.
Parking: 7351 East Green Lake Dr N.

Stay for the Wellness Festival (free)

After you cross the finish line, stick around for free outdoor wellness workshops:
11 AM – Yoga · 12 PM – Tai Chi · 1 PM – Pilates / HIIT · 2 PM – Silent Disco Party! (headsets provided, limited availability) · 3 PM – Live Music & Celebration

Please RSVP for the free Wellness Festival here. It's separate from your race registration, and it helps us plan for everyone joining us after the race.

Wellness Village + Kids & Family Zone

Explore local wellness businesses, practitioners, recovery experiences, hydration partners, and healthy eats. The Kids & Family Zone is next to the Green Lake Park playground. Not running? You don't need to register for the 5K to attend the festival. Come cheer on friends, bring the family, and enjoy the day.

DJ + Music all day

Music runs throughout the event, before and after the race and between classes.

Bring your running crew, your yoga community, or come solo. Come for the run, stay for the whole experience.

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, a wellness enthusiast, or just looking for a fun and uplifting way to spend your day, the Green Lake 5K & Wellness Festival is perfect for you.

Run. Recover. Connect. Celebrate!

name: 2026 Holiday on the Bay 5K and Kids Dash
description:
Holiday on the Bay 5K Run or Walk and Kids Dash

Sunday, December 6th

Start Time: 9:00 AM

You’re invited to join us at Port of Everett’s Waterfront Place for the 4th Annual Holiday on the Bay 5K and Kids Dash! We encourage runners and walkers of all skill levels to join in on the fun! Participants will enjoy a picturesque flat route with sweeping views of the Port of Everett Marina, Port Gardner Bay, and the Olympic Mountains. You don’t want to miss this wintertime run at the waterfront! Register today and prepare to don your best blue and white winter-themed garb on Sunday, Dec. 6th.

name: 2026 Jingle Bell Run - Bellingham, WA
description:
Be There with Bells On!

Help keep the tradition going strong by jingling with your family and friends at the Arthritis Foundation's Jingle Bell Run.  

Wear your favorite holiday costume and spread good cheer for a great cause. We’re raising awareness and funds to support arthritis research for better treatments and a cure. We’re also helping the Arthritis Foundation develop tools, resources, and opportunities to connect with each other. Together, we’re committed to conquering arthritis for good. Please join us!

name: 2026 Jingle Bell Run - Seattle, WA
description:
Get ready for this year’s Jingle Bell Run, the original festive race for charity brought to you by the Arthritis Foundation. Wear your favorite holiday gear, and let's jingle all the way toward a cure!

Whether you're running, walking, or strolling, bring your friends, family, and coworkers along for the ride. Together, we're spreading joy and making strides towards a brighter future — saying "YES" to life, despite arthritis.

Don't miss out on this special occasion to make a real difference while celebrating four decades of impact with the Jingle Bell Run. Let's lace up, hit the pavement, and jingle our way toward victory over arthritis!

For help or more information about Jingle Bell Run Seattle, visit the event website HERE

name: 2026 Seattle Ghost Marathon, Half & 50K
description:
November 28, 2026, will be the 41st running of the Seattle Ghost Marathon.  It started in 1985 when the Seattle Marathon changed courses and moved from Saturday to Sunday of Thanksgiving weekend.

The course is a very flat and fast certified Boston Marathon qualifier.  The marathon is comprised of two 13.1-mile loops run on streets and sidewalks along scenic Lake Washington in Seattle, WA.

The race start/finish is at the Ferdinand St Boat Launch (47.557338, -122.262188) 5018 Lake Washington Blvd. S, Seattle, WA 98118.  It runs south with a clockwise loop of scenic Seward Park and back north to the start/finish area.  It continues north along Lake Washington through Leschi.  The north turnaround is just past the Madrona Drive intersection (47.613496, -122.281265) then you run south back to the start/finish.  There are aid stations every 3.1 miles on each loop.

The race is managed and supported by the non-profit NW Ultras which has been the driving force behind the event since 2004.  Green Lake Crew has supported the event since 2013.  The race is limited to 450 total participants regardless of which event they run.  

Packet pickup is on race day.

No dogs are strollers are permitted on the course due to the sidewalk sections.

See more details on www.nwultras.com

name: 2026 The Snohomish River Run Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K and 5K
description:
Snohomish River Run – Sunday, October 11th

Experience the magic of fall in the Pacific Northwest at the Snohomish River Run-where crisp autumn air, vibrant colors, and scenic river views come together for an unforgettable race day.

Set in the heart of the historic Snohomish Valley, this course takes you along the winding Snohomish River, surrounded by golden farmland, towering evergreens, and the quiet beauty that makes this region so special. Whether you’re chasing a personal best or simply soaking in the scenery, every mile offers a perfect blend of serenity and energy.

Feel the rhythm of your stride as the morning fog lifts off the river, the sun breaks through the trees, and the community comes alive to cheer you on. This is more than just a race—it’s a celebration of movement, connection, and the changing seasons.

With a fast, runner-friendly course and a welcoming, small-town atmosphere, the Snohomish River Run is perfect for seasoned racers and first-timers alike.

Come run where the river flows, the leaves turn, and the miles feel a little more meaningful.

Sunday, October 11th
 
 Marathon Start Time - 7:30AM

Half Marathon Start Time - 8:00AM

10K Start Time - 9:00AM

5K Start Time - 9:30AM

name: 2027 Centennial 100
description:
The Centennial Relay & Ultra Run isn’t just another race. It’s an unforgettable 100K adventure through the heart of the Pacific Northwest!

Covering 100KM (62 miles) along the Centennial Trail, this epic journey starts at Space 802 in Historic Downtown Snohomish, takes runners all the way north to the Nakashima Barn in Arlington, and back to Snohomish for the finish.

Take on the entire 100K solo or build your crew and share the miles with a team of 2, 4, or 6 runners. Whether you're an ultra runner ready to tackle all 62 miles or looking for an unforgettable relay experience with friends, there’s a way to take on the Centennial.

Expect a full day of running, team support, relay exchanges, beautiful Pacific Northwest scenery, and plenty of opportunities to cheer each other on along the way.

Collect the Cowbells 🔔
There are 6 legs to conquer and 7 cowbells to collect!

At the end of each leg, the runner who completed that leg will receive a Centennial cowbell to celebrate the miles they just conquered. Keep collecting them throughout the day as your team makes its way up the Centennial Trail and back.

Your 7th and final cowbell will be waiting at Space 802, where you’ll complete the 100K journey and celebrate at the finish!

For relay teams, the cowbell belongs to the runner who completed that leg, so divide up the miles, collect your cowbells, and see your team’s 100K adventure come together one leg at a time.

Event Details
Distance: 100KM / 62 Miles
Date: Saturday, June 19, 2027
Start & Finish: Space 802, Historic Downtown Snohomish
Course: Centennial Trail to Nakashima Barn in Arlington and back

Race Options:

100K Solo
2-Person Relay
4-Person Relay
6-Person Relay
One trail. 100 kilometers. 7 cowbells. Your challenge, your way.

Grab your crew or take it on solo and get ready for an unforgettable day on the Centennial Trail!

description:
Join the Snohomish Running Company on Sunday, May 31st for the fastest paved half marathon in the Northwest: The Evergreen Half. The Evergreen Half is a point to point half marathon from Getchell Trailhead to Averill Field in Snohomish, WA, along the Centennial Trail. It is a USATF Certified Half and is fully paved. name: 2027 Fort Steilacoom Resolution Series
description:
EVENT CALENDAR

January 9, 2027 – 5K and 10K 
February 6, 2027 – 5K, 10K, 15K 
March 6, 2027 – 5K, 10K, 20K

 

PRE-REGISTRATION: Available through Weds prior to Event

Individual Events:  5K - $30, All Other Distances -  $35
Age Group Discount (19 and under): 5K - $10, all other distances - $15

Series Bundles: 

Participants may bundle their registration as a 5K series (5K-5K-5K) , 10K Series (10K-10K-10K) , or a Progression Series (10K-15K-20K),   Participants can also receive a $10 discount when bundling 3 individual events.  This allows you to design your own series at a discounted rate from individual entries. 
Purchase peace of mind with Event Insurance available at checkout through a third-party entity.  This entitles you to a full refund of your pre-registration costs for 18 covered reasons including injury, illness, weather, mechanical breakdowns, layoffs etc...
 

DAY OF RACE REGISTRATION: Available starting 1 hour prior

5K - $38 
All Other Distances - $43
19 and under: $15 for 5K, $20 for all other distances
Series bundle registration also available on Jan 9 from 8-9AM starting at $90 for the 5K Series and $105 for the longer series.
 

AGE GROUPS

0-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-85, 85-90, 90-94
 

PARKING AND PACKET PICKUP

Plenty of parking is available on site within the park. Signage will direct participants to parking and packet pickup.  
 

COURSE DESCRIPTION

All events utilize a flat and fast 5K loop within Fort Steilacoom Park.  The course is 95% paved with 5% packed trail.  Participants will have access to our aid station (water, electrolytes and restrooms) at the conclusion of each 5K loop.  Participants of the 10K, 15K, and 20K events will repeat the 5K loop.  Each mile will be clearly marked on the 5K loop.  Course map can be found here. 
 

RACE DAY SCHEDULE 

08:00 — Packet Pickup & Day of Race Registration open
08:55 — Registration and Packet Pickup Ends 
09:00 — Combined event start 
 

RESULTS

All events are chip-timed by Peak Performance Timing, and results will be available to finishers at our results kiosk and published to our RunSignup Results page.  
 

PHOTOS

All events will be photographed.   Event Photos are expected to be uploaded to our website by Sunday 6PM and can be downloaded for free. 
 

AWARDS

Each participant who completes 2 or more of our events will receive a custom finishers medal. Medals will be available to pick-up after you complete your second event.
Age group ribbons for each event will be awarded to top 3 in each age group. These will be available at our results kiosk near the finish line.
Overall awards will be provided to men’s and women’s winners in each distance, courtesy of our sponsor: Fleet Feet. 
 

FACILITIES

Restrooms will be available near the start, and at the conclusion of each 5k loop.  Our finish line will include numerous refreshments
 

ADVERSE WEATHER

This is a winter race series, and we are frequently confronted with cold, rain, wind and snow.  In the rare event that inclement weather forces a cancellation or postponement of the event, participants will receive an email by 7AM.  We will also make every effort to update our website and other social media resources. 
 

REGISTRATION DETAILS

Registrants are welcome to switch events on race day (for example 10K to 5K).   This can be done at packet pickup.
 
Dogs (and other leashed animals) are NOT allowed on our course.  Thank you!
Strollers are allowed. 
 

CONTACT INFORMATION

Darrin Hatcher/darrinhatcher.fsrc@gmail.com/253-720-0168

AGE GROUPS

0-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-85, 85-90, 90-94
 

PARKING AND PACKET PICKUP

Plenty of parking is available on site within the park. Signage will direct participants to parking and packet pickup.  
 

COURSE DESCRIPTION

All events utilize a flat and fast 5K loop within Fort Steilacoom Park.  The course is 95% paved with 5% packed trail.  Participants will have access to our aid station (water, electrolytes and restrooms) at the conclusion of each 5K loop.  Participants of the 10K, 15K, and 20K events will repeat the 5K loop.  Each mile will be clearly marked on the 5K loop.  Course map can be found here. 
 

RACE DAY SCHEDULE 

08:00 — Packet Pickup & Day of Race Registration open
08:55 — Registration and Packet Pickup Ends 
09:00 — Combined event start 
 

RESULTS

All events are chip-timed by Peak Performance Timing, and results will be available to finishers at our results kiosk and published to our RunSignup Results page.  
 

PHOTOS

All events will be photographed.   Event Photos are expected to be uploaded to our website by Sunday 6PM and can be downloaded for free. 
 

AWARDS

Each participant who completes 2 or more of our events will receive a custom finishers medal. Medals will be available to pick-up after you complete your second event.
Age group ribbons for each event will be awarded to top 3 in each age group. These will be available at our results kiosk near the finish line.
Overall awards will be provided to men’s and women’s winners in each distance, courtesy of our sponsor: Fleet Feet. 
 

FACILITIES

Restrooms will be available near the start, and at the conclusion of each 5k loop.  Our finish line will include numerous refreshments
 

ADVERSE WEATHER

This is a winter race series, and we are frequently confronted with cold, rain, wind and snow.  In the rare event that inclement weather forces a cancellation or postponement of the event, participants will receive an email by 7AM.  We will also make every effort to update our website and other social media resources. 
 

REGISTRATION DETAILS

Registrants are welcome to switch events on race day (for example 10K to 5K).   This can be done at packet pickup.
 
Dogs (and other leashed animals) are NOT allowed on our course.  Thank you!
Strollers are allowed.

name: 2027 Kirk-Wood Half Marathon
description:
The Kirk-Wood Half Marathon
Saturday, July 24th, 2027

Get ready to experience one of the fastest half marathons in the Pacific Northwest, right in the heart of King County.

The Kirk-Wood Half Marathon is a beautiful point-to-point journey that starts at Northwest University in Kirkland, WA and carries you all the way to the finish line at Wilmot Gateway Park in Woodinville, WA. From start to finish, you’ll cruise along some of the region’s most iconic pedestrian trails, including the Kirkland Cross Corridor Trail, Eastrail, and the Sammamish River Trail.

This course was built for rhythm and flow. With a net downhill of over 300 feet, runners can expect a smooth, fast profile that’s perfect for chasing a personal best, or simply soaking in the miles at a comfortable, confidence-boosting pace.

Whether you're aiming to set a PR or looking for an approachable, well-supported half marathon with incredible vibes, the Kirk-Wood Half delivers.

Fast. Scenic. Effortless.
From Kirkland to Woodinville, this is your run.

Course Cutoff Time - 3 hour and 30 minutes (16 minute per mile pace)

Start times will be waves of 250 runners at 6:30AM, 6:35AM, 6:40AM and 6:45AM. 

Shuttles from the finish to the start line will be available.

name: 2027 Mill Town Half Marathon, 10K and 5K
description:
Mill Town Half

Half Marathon, 10K and 5K

Saturday, March 2027

Port of Everett, Everett, WA

Experience the Beauty. Embrace the Challenge.

Join the Snohomish Running Company for one of the most breathtaking race experiences in the Pacific Northwest! Whether you choose the Half Marathon, 10K, or 5K, you’ll be treated to sweeping views of the Puget Sound, the majestic Olympic Mountains, and a stunning canopy of cherry blossoms along Grand Avenue.

Each course starts and finishes at the scenic Port of Everett, with roads fully closed to traffic for your safety and enjoyment. Expect a well-marked route, enthusiastic support, and an unforgettable atmosphere from start to finish.

As part of our tradition, we proudly offer a discounted military rate to all active-duty service members and veterans - thank you for your service.

name: 2027 SRC Season Pass and Multi-Race Passes
description:
Make 2027 Your Year of Running!

Join Snohomish Running Company with a Season Pass, 5-Race Pass, or 4-Race Pass and save big all year long. The more races you run, the more you save per event!

As a Pass Holder, you’ll unlock exclusive perks:

Bonus Race Shirt at the end of the season (on top of all your event swag).

Flexible Race Switching — only pass holders can move between events if plans change.

Priority Savings on every race you enter.

Lock in your spot, your savings, and your best running year yet!

Those who purchase a race pass will get a unique code which will be eligible to use on all Snohomish Running Company events. The code will be good all year long so no need to sign up right away. Save the code and use it when you're ready to register.

 

The events currently available for pass usage are as follows:

Woodinville Half and 10K - Saturday, February 27th

Mill Town Half, 10K and 5K - Saturday, March 27th

Washington State Marathon - Sunday, April 18th**

Evergreen Half and 5 Mile - Sunday, May 23rd

Centennial 100 (Solo Ultra Run Only) - Saturday, June 19th

Snohomish 4th of July 5K - Sunday, July 4th

Kirk-Wood Half - TBD (Targeting July 24th)

Snohomish River Run - Sunday, October 17th

Greenlake 5K - TBD

Mukilteo Turkey Trot - Thanksgiving Day

Holiday on the Bay 5K - Sunday, December 5th

**If you would like to include the Washington State Marathon as one of your events with the 5-Race or 4-Race Pass there will be an additional $50 add-on fee. It will be included in the Season Pass.

After purchasing the pass, you will receive a coupon code that will allow you to register for the individual races. This code will be active within 7 days of purchasing the code. You do not have to use the code immediately. Make sure to keep track of your code so you can register once you are ready. Codes will work on any of the distances that are offered for each race.

Pass holders receive bonus swag at the end of the year!

name: 24 Hours of Riverside
description: The 24 Hours of Riverside is a 24 Hour Mountain Bike Race taking place Memorial Day Weekend 2027 at Riverside State Park in Spokane WA.  But there's so much more!  It will be a weekend of riding and camping and fun that you will never forget!  Race starts at High Noon on Saturday.  There will be food and beverage options on-site at different times throughout weekend. Camping on-site as well.  And don't forget the Kid's Bike Parade Saturday Night!  So much fun in 24 hours, you'll be sad it's only 24 hours!

name: 40th Annual Bay View Women's Run
description:
The Bay View Women’s Run is a beloved Skagit County tradition returning for its milestone 40th year, Saturday May 15th, reviving a community tradition that celebrates movement, connection, and resilience.  Featuring 2 Mile, 5K, and 10K distances, this event brings together runners, families, and community partners to support survivors and strengthen access to critical services across our region.

Early registrations are encouraged with early bird discounts in effect.

Join us in bringing this meaningful tradition back to life.

Race is managed by Skagit Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Services. 

Questions?  Please contact Jen: jenh@skagitdvsas.org.

Route map and parking details coming soon.

Can't run? Volunteers are needed.  Check out our sign up link here: volunteersignup.org for race support volunteer roles. Exact volunteer shifts/times will be updated soon.

Learn more about Skagit DVSAS here: skagitdvsas.org

name: 8th Annual Maple Valley Turkey Trot: Thanksgiving Day 5K
description:
Join us for the 8th Annual Maple Valley Turkey Trot 5K benefiting the Maple Valley Food Bank! This year's free race t-shirts, supplied by our generous sponsors, are optional. All t-shirt requests must be submitted by November 1st.

The Maple Valley Turkey Trot is a FUN walk or trot Thanksgiving morning through Lake Wilderness Park organized with the intention of coming together as a community during the Thanksgiving holiday to help those in need.

Children in strollers are not required to register (but will not receive shirts). All proceeds raised will go to fund Maple Valley Food Bank Programs as we enter into our organization's busiest season. All ages are welcome! We encourage Thanksgiving costumes & accessories!
___

Thank you to all of our sponsors, for making this great community event possible!

Interested in Sponsoring the Turkey Trot? Email development@maplevalleyfoodbank.org

___

Advanced Packet Pickup
TBD!

Day-Of Schedule
- Packet pick-up will begin at 7:30 AM on race day. Come early to grab coffee and snacks, and take photos in our photo booth (and with our giant turkey)! There's plenty to do and we'll have music keep up the energy!
- The race will begin at the Beach House at Lake Wilderness Park promptly at 9:00.
- Race route: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6296717431

Parking
Please utilize the lower parking lots at the Lake Wilderness Lodge, nearest the arboretum, or the park parking lots specifically. Upper lots near the lodge will be closed off for safety on the route.

Chip Timing
This event will NOT be timed. A fun-run in its fullest form!

Strollers, Dogs, Bikes, and Water
We encourage the use of jogging strollers along the route of this family-friendly 5K. However, out of consideration for other participants, dogs will not be allowed on the course (with the exception of service dogs). For the safety and convenience of all participants, bikes are NOT permitted, as this is a fairly narrow out and back course. We will have water stations near the beach house before and after the race.

Accessibility
Please note that, while generally flat, this race course may not be suitable for all abilities, as the terrain is both paved and gravel. There is a slight incline to access the Green to Cedar River Trail from the arboretum. We will have volunteers stationed at these points to assist on an as-needed basis.

___
Race Contact Info
If you have any additional questions about this race, please contact Carl Dodd at info@maplevalleyfoodbank.org 

Tickets are non-transferable and non-refundable.

name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅
Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.

Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.

Hit the road, Huskies! Lace up your sneakers and soak in the fall campus beauty for our annual 10K run and 5K run/walk in support of students. All Dawgs (and dogs) are invited, and UWAA members save on registration. From race start to the Post-Dash Bash finish, it’s a day of fun for the whole Husky pack.

name: Alexander's Hope Valentine's Day Dash
description:
The Alexander's Hope Valentine's Day Dash 5k run/walk is back for the 8th year! 

Dogs & strollers are both welcome at the race! Our race will start & finish at Downtown Bellevue Park & run along the streets of Bellevue!

All funds raised will go to support the local 501(c)(3) nonprofit - Alexander's Hope which advocates for organ donation awareness and helps fund local, lifesaving youth heart screenings.

For more information visit our race website: https://www.alexandershope.org/valentines-day-dash-2027

name: Always Hope Easter Run SEATTLE
description:
🐣🏃‍♀️Hop Into Action at the Always Hope Easter Run! 

Spring into the season with purpose, community, and fun! Whether you're chasing a personal best, strolling with family, or hunting for a reason to get moving, the Always Hope Easter Run has a place for you on the starting line.

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.

name: Amazon 2026 Pro Bono Wellness Distance Challenge
description:
We're excited to bring back the 2026 Pro Bono Wellness Distance Challenge! Compete individually and as DZ-direct teams to rack up miles through running, walking, biking, or swimming, plus earn mile equivalents through meditation, yoga, team sports, or gym workouts. The challenge runs October 26-30, with daily activity tracking through our challenge dashboard. All activities count equally toward team standings - whether you're hitting the trails or the yoga mat.

Running/Walking/Hiking: 1 mile = 1 mile
Biking: 4 miles = 1 mile equivalent
Swimming: 1/4 mile = 1 mile equivalent
Yoga/Meditation/Stretching: 15 minutes = 1 mile equivalent
Gym Workout: 15 minutes = 1 mile equivalent
Team Sports: 15 minutes = 1 mile equivalent
Mental Health Break: 15 minutes = 1 mile equivalent
Daily Water Goal: 8 glasses = 1 mile equivalent


All hands are welcome to join, and participation is free and voluntary. Sign up here to track your distance, and remember that this is an honor-system challenge. Please participate in good faith. Good luck!

name: Anacortes Santa Run
description:
Every runner receives a full Santa Suit for the run!   Yes, that's right. EVERYONE will run in a Santa Suit. 

Join other runners all dressed as Santa and run a 5k in beautiful Anacortes WA.

Family Discount!!! Register 3 or more runners on same account and save $5.00 per runner!!!!

December 12, 2026 9am Start

 

Pick Up Bibs and Santa Suits in Anacortes:

Dec 10 and 11 from 5-7pm at the Anacortes Rockfish Grill beer garden!! Enjoy the happy hour from 3-6. Rockfish Address is 320 Commercial Ave, Anacortes WA 98221 (beer garden is the tent behind the restaurant)

 

Race Day Pick up ($3) is for out of the area runners. (You can pick up your Bib and Santa suit from 7-8am day of race.) If you can make the pick up on the 10th and 11th, we'd love it.

 

Every registration will help fund the Anacortes High School Cross Country Team!!!


5k Run of Santas in Anacortes WA. 

  • Group start-with Christmas Carols
  • Cookies, Coffee, Hot Cocoa and treats
  • timed
  • finishers medal
  • Prize!!!!- 1 Gallon of delicious Eggnog for first male and female across the finish line
  • Beat the Elves. Compete against two elves (Anacortes High School XC runners) staring 5 minutes after you. Every elf beating Santa gets a sticker. 

The Course is a beautiful flat 5k around Cap Sante Marina.

name: Anacortes Santa Run

name: Badger South Prediction 5K
description:
This 5K run will begin and end at the Country Mercantile, 5015 Ava Way, Richland, WA.  This is a paved course using sidewalks and paved trails.

What is a prediction run? - This means you pick your own start time and aim to finish at 10:00 am.  For example, if you plan to run a 30-minute 5K, start at 9:30.

The $25 registration fee includes a t-shirt.

name: Bainbridge Island Parks & Trails Foundation Trillium Trail Run
description:
Bainbridge Island's beloved spring running event is back!

Join Bainbridge Island Parks & Trails Foundation in running or walking a 10K or 5K on a scenic wooded course from Battle Point Park, along the Forest to Sky Trail, and looping among the towering firs of the Grand Forest. An early Kids Fun Run course is within Battle Point Park.

Run for the Trails

Trillium Trail Run supports our Trails Connect Bainbridge Island campaign, to build new trails around the island. All race proceeds benefit trail development. 
Race packets, including timing chip-integrated bib, will be distributed the morning of the event.

name: Bainbridge Youth Services Fun Run 2026
description:
Join us this Fourth of July for the Bainbridge Youth Services Fun Run, a beloved community tradition that brings people together in support of youth mental health.

Whether you’re racing in the 5K, walking the 1-mile route, or cheering on our youngest runners in the Kids Dash, this event is all about connection, community, and showing up for our youth.

Set against the beauty of Bainbridge Island and the energy of Independence Day, the Fun Run is more than just a race, it’s a celebration. Every step taken helps provide free, confidential mental health services, tutoring, and support programs for local youth.

Expect a festive atmosphere with community spirit, family-friendly fun, and a meaningful cause at the heart of it all. Runners of all ages and abilities are welcome.

Come run or walk to support youth mental health all year long. 💙

name: Bethlehem Lutheran Fall Fest
description:
The Bethlehem Lutheran Fall Fest was started in 2000 by a group of parents, teachers, and school supporters. It is the main fundraising event for Bethlehem Lutheran School. Fall Fest has quickly grown into an annual community event with hundreds of runners (kids and adults) enjoying the fall weather and participating in Fest activities that include bounce houses, games, and local food vendors. Fall Fest is a celebration of Bethlehem Lutheran School’s involvement in the Tri-Cities’ community as well as welcoming in the new school year.

Together, our goal is to raise $40,000 for new improvements to our school! This year, we are adding locking storage to our lockers and a new fun addition to our playground. Please join us for our one-mile and 5k races along the river at Howard Amon Park in Richland, WA!

name: Big River Race
description:
Come join us at Chiawana Park in Pasco, Washington for the 4th Annual Big River Race

 

 Saturday, May 29th, 2027 for a Half Marathon, 10k, 5k & FREE Fun 1 Mile. Run along one of Eastern Washington's biggest landmarks, the Columbia River. Enjoy a scenic route on paved riverfront trail. This race offers you four different options; a distance for everyone in the family, group of friends or coworkers.
 
The course will be flat & fast! Perfect for your first time to achieve one of these distances or set a new personal goal. The race will start & end at the west end of the park. All race distances are on a paved path and along the riverfront.  Chiawana is a Native word for “Big River”

 
The Columbia River has provided this region's culture and economy for thousands of years. It is the largest river in the Pacific Northwest. The river forms in the Rocky Mountains of British Columbia, Canada and flows through Washington. This Big River irrigates more than 6,000,000 acres of agricultural land. Agriculture is huge part of our community and is possible because of this valuable water source.
 
The race course will have fun, themed aid-stations, cheer squads & music along the way. You run the miles, we bring the entertainment and support! We believe your achievements should be celebrated. Invite all the friends and family to come watch you cross the finish line! Chiawana Park as beautiful shade trees, a big grassy park and a gorgeous view of the river. After the race sit, relax, enjoy some post race treats and listen to a live band!!

name: Birch Bay Road Race
description:
Run along the beautiful shores of Birch Bay at the Birch Bay Road Race! You’ll spot eagles and herons as you run or walk along our USATF certified courses. Birch Bay is a seaside village close to the Canadian border, just two hours from Seattle and an hour and a half from Vancouver, BC. Stay at Semiahmoo Resort and make a weekend out of it! Running groups and teams are invited to sign up for the Club Challenge. Walkers are welcome.

Race Website: https://orcarunning.com/birchbay/

name: Bodie's Light 5k Fun Run/Walk
description:
Join us for the fourth annual Bodie's Light 5k Fun Run during Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month! This will be an untimed fun run/walk benefiting Bodie's Light. 

The fun run will begin at Heritage Park in Olympia, WA and circle around Capitol Lake twice. Capitol Lake is stroller friendly. There are two parking lots on Water Street (the address listed) and on Simmons Street NW. Street parking and parking lot across 5th Ave are also available.

Bodie's Light is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization founded in honor of our son, Bodie Trace Gagnon. Our mission is to provide resources and support to families who have lost their babies to stillbirth. Bodie's Light provides boxes of items and resources to help these families make memories with their child in the hospital and beyond. So far we have donated boxes to three local hospitals. All registration fees and donations will be used toward our mission. 

In person fun run is on October 11, 2026.

Check in: 8:45 am

Run/walk begins: 10 am

Register by September 26 to receive a shirt!

Day of registration will be accepted this year for $40.

name: Bound for Boston Marathon & Half Marathon - Seattle
description:
Have you been dreaming of running the Boston Marathon? Need to shave a few minutes off your qualifying time? Or maybe you're just looking for the perfect course to set a new PR? Whether Boston is your goal or not, the Bound for Boston Marathon & Half Marathon is for you.

We are racing around Olympia High School and the course features a 1-mile, super flat and super fast loop, making it ideal for consistent pacing and record-setting performances. The Full Marathon is USATF certified, making it a Boston Qualifier.

This event is uniquely designed for serious runners. We will have water and an electrolyte drink at the aid table. Participants are welcome to bring their own personalized aid to place on the aid tables, allowing you to grab exactly what you need each time you pass. Many runners even bring a cheer crew to help hand out fuel and keep the motivation high throughout the race.

To maintain the best possible experience, this is intentionally a small, focused event, capped at just 75 participants.

We will have a great race shirt and finisher medals for all participants. Awards for both distances are in the usual 5-year age groups.

Fast course, flexible support, and a chance to chase your goals—this is the race that lets you run your perfect day.

Many runners even bring a cheer crew to help hand out fuel and keep the motivation high throughout the race.

To maintain the best possible experience, this is intentionally a small, focused event, capped at just 75 participants.

We will have a great race shirt and finisher medals for all participants. Awards for both distances are in the usual 5-year age groups.

Fast course, flexible support, and a chance to chase your goals—this is the race that lets you run your perfect day.

name: Bridge to Brunch 5k
description:
Running or walking on the sunny side up!  Join us Saturday, October 10th for a brunchy morning 5k.  And, of course, there will be the collectable B2B beanie hats, after race waffles, music, vendors and for those 21+ a mimosa bar.  And we highly encourage high-fives and victory laps after your race.

Having fun on a fall morning, because let's be honest - food, fitness and friends have always been best friends.

name: Brooks Lake Sammamish Half Marathon presented by REI
description:
The Brooks Lake Sammamish Half Marathon presented by REI is a point to point race from Redmond to Sammamish. You will run along the East Lake Sammamish Trail that is fully paved. We also offer a half-marathon walk category with a generous 4 hour time limit. This flat run is perfect for a half-marathon personal best whether you’re running or walking! 

The race is chip-timed, and each participant will receive a chip-timed bib, participant shirt, and a finisher medal. Aid stations are provided every few miles (see course map).

The Lake Sammamish Half is cupless, so you either need to bring a handheld bottle, wear a hydration pack, or we can provide you with a re-useable cup at the start line.

VIRTUAL RACE INFO - We have 30 spots for virtual runners. Once they sell out there are no more available. You can run the distance all at once or break it up into chunks and run it on the date of your choosing. You will receive a shirt and medal that will be mailed after the in person race.

Check out all the details on our website.

name: BRRC St. Paddy’s Five Miler
description:
Come and race, ye lads and lasses! The 2027 BRRC 44th St. Paddy's 5 Miler will be a jig of a time.  By popular demand, the St. Paddy's 5 Miler is back again at Spokane Community College on March 7, 2027. The same out & back route as last year 2026. This is an official qualifying race for 2nd SEEDING at BLOOMSDAY 2027.  Qualifying times: Women 37:00 and Men 31:00. At 10:30 am there will be a FREE  "Lucky Leprechaun Jig" for kids 6 years old and under. All runners in the Leprechaun Jig will receive a Ribbon.  At 11:00 am there will be an Awards ceremony; Overall Male & Female, Masters (40+) Top Male & Female. Top 3 Male & Female in age groups 0-10,11-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+.  At 11:15 am there will be prize drawings including a $250 cash prize plus other prizes. MUST be present to WIN!

Normal Registration:

  • $35 registration with unisex shirt through February 20th ($3 extra for 2XL & 3XL)
  • $20 for run only with no shirt option
  • $20 after February 19th with NO Shirt option, must be received by March 5th or at SCC on Race Day
  • $30 Day of Race Registration NO SHIRT
  • All Mail-in entries must be received by February 19th to receive a shirt or March 5th with no shirt

Leprechaun Jig Registration:

  • Event is free for the Lucky Leprechaun Jig for those 6 years old and younger
  • Youth shirts can be ordered separately for $13 through February 19th
  • All Mail-in entries must be received by February 19th to receive a shirt or March 5th with no shirt

Packet Pickup

  • Saturday, March 7, 2026 from 10-2:00 PM at MUV Fitness, 14927 E. Sprague
  • Sunday, March 8th, 2026 day of race, at 8:00 am at SCC. 

The Start

  • Rest rooms provided in the gymnasium building
  • The race will offer a gun start at 9:00 am. 
  • Kids, 6 years and under, can run the Lucky Leprechaun Jig (approx. 50 meters) that will start at 10:30 am.

The Finish

  • There will be water at the finish line and at the turn around
  • Top Male and Female, Top Masters (40+) Male and Female awards
  • Top 3 in Age Groups Male & Female: 0-10, 11-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+
  • Stay around for $250 Cash Prize plus other drawings at 11:15 am. Must be present to WIN!

name: BRRC Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
description:
Happy Thanksgiving 2026 Manito Park

Continue the Spirit and Tradition of the BRRC Family Friendly Thanksgiving Fun Run/Walk by participating in the Annual BRRC Turkey Trot on Thanksgiving Day at Manito Park Duck Pond (https://my.spokanecity.org/parks/major/manito/).  We want to continue the tradition of the giving season. 

There is no entry fee to participate in the Turkey Trot.  Registration process is only for donations with all donations going to 2nd Harvest Food Bank in Spokane. 

There will be prize Drawing at 10:00 AM that morning.

Cash donations are accepted on Run Sign Up.  Sign-on to the website ( https://runsignup.com/Race/WA/Spokane/BRRCAnnualTurkeyTrot ), click on DONATION and complete the information.  Cash donations or food donations to the 2ND Harvest Food Bank will be accepted at the event on Thanksgiving morning.  The food bank has seven times the buying power than we do. (A$5.00 donation will buy $35.00 worth of food). 

We are Thankful for You and Your Family this Holiday season, so don’t delay, join BRRC and all your friends.  In addition to registering and donating on line, you can also register for this year's BRRC Turkey Trot in-person at Manito Park.  Carpooling is strongly advised due to limited parking at Manito Park.  Arrive early to sign the waiver prior to the event.  For the safety of the participants, please have your dogs on a leash.

name: Bulldog 5K Sleigh Ride Fun Run/Walk
description:
This is a community event where every participant will run and/or walk a full 5K around the Del Trail (Skagit Playfields), named for MVHS's long time distance coach, Jess del Bosque. Each participant will receive a *T-shirt and Santa's hat. All the "Santas" will be led by a team of "reindeer" (MVHS XC runners) at the start. Ornament medals will be handed out to top finishers in each age group Water and hot drinks will be provided after the race. 

 

Registration check-in can be done the morning of the run/walk on Saturday, December 19th at 9am (run starts at 10am). 

 

All proceeds will go the the Non-School District Mount Vernon Athletic Fund and will benefit runners attending XC Summer Camp. Donations are gladly accepted. Thank you for your support!!!

name: Candy Land Run
description:
Take a magical journey through a life-sized Candy Land! Walk, hike, or run as you relive one of your favorite childhood games as a real-life adventure. Enjoy some of Tri-Cities' local trails, visit the candy-themed stations for a variety of treats, and meet special Candy Land characters. 

This event is a fundraiser for Mirror Ministries. All proceeds and entry fees will go directly to support Mirror Ministries, an organization of people who embrace a vision of hope for victims and survivors of sex trafficking. We work toward this vision knowing God’s grace is reflected in each one of us as we pray, serve, and give to show survivors their true worth.

For more information visit https://www.mirror-ministries.org/

 

Walk - Run - Hike - Ruck Details:  

This sweet adventure will start and end in the parking lot of Candy Mountain in Richland, WA. We offer two different routes depending on your ability and how long you want to stay in Candy Land. All routes will be on trails. You will be given a fun map for each route, and the stations will be marked on it. The longer you participate, the more treats you get! Service animals only; must be leashed at all times
Each finisher will get a wooden finisher medal. Awards will be given to the Top Overall male and female (1st, 2nd, 3rd place) in the 3.5 mile distance. RUCK finishers will get a special ruck patch. 
3.5 mile will be chip-timed by Eastern Oregon Sports Timing. 1.25 is not timed and is just for fun! 

There will be two start times for the Chocolate Route 3.5 mile: 

9:00 a.m. for runners who plan to finish in under 1 hour.

10:30 a.m. for hikers/runners who plan to finish in over 1 hour. 

 

Prices:

Gumdrop Loop 1.25 mile:       $25 until 10/01 then $35 until race day 
Chocolate Route 3.5 mile:      $35 until 10/01 then $45 until race day

Chocolate Route 3.5 mile RUCK:      $35 until 10/01 then $45 until race day

2 years old and younger are free 

 

Parking:

To be announced. 

Online Registration Dates:

Online registration will be open until the start of each distance on race day or until registration is full. There will be NO IN-PERSON REGISTRATION.

Bib Pick-up:

To be announced.

name: Capital City Marathon
description: Welcome to Capital City Marathon, one of the best marathons in the Northwest. Located in fun and friendly Olympia, Washington, we feature a beautiful course with rolling hills, enthusiastic volunteers, a festive post-race event with food, music, massage and swag.  We are a Boston Marathon qualifier with a loyal following of marathon veterans, newcomers and everyone in between.

name: Captain Jack's Treasure Run
description:
Pre-game Halloween with your best pirate costume while running up a storm on your home turf! Captain Jack’s Treasure Run has been bringing you oodles of swash-buckling running fun for 8 years in a row.  We’ve got three distances, 5K, 8K and 12K for you to choose from.  All participants will receive a finisher’s medal, Captain Jack’s race shirt, race bib, and chip timing.

name: Carnation Turkey Trot 2026
description: Gather your flock and join us for our 4th Annual Carnation Turkey Trot at the beautiful Remlinger Farms in Carnation, Washington. You will be joining fellow runners, joggers and walkers in some lighthearted fun while supporting the Carnation Chamber's mission of supporting the businesses of Carnation, and strengthening the community! The 5k course will take you all along the country roads and paths on the farm. No cars will be on the course. The kids dash is about 100 yards and will be held right before the 5k so everyone can be there to cheer on the little Gobblers! See you on Saturday November 21st! (before Turkey Day) Register by November 1st to be guaranteed a shirt! On the day of the event please bring non-perishable food items to benefit the HopeLink Snoqualmie Valley Food Bank in Carnation!

name: CBHA 5k Color Run | Run For A Cause
description:
SUPPORTING OVERALL CHILDHOOD HEALTH AND WELL BEING

Columbia Basin Health Association (CBHA) is organizing the CBHA 5k Color Run | Run For A Cause, which is set for an in-person fun run or walk! This event increases awareness of childhood health and well being along with supporting families and improving education to maintain wellness for children.  For more information on our cause and where the money goes, please visit CBHA Run For A Cause

THIS ISN'T JUST ANOTHER RUN

The CBHA 5k Color Run | Run for a Cause is less about making record time and more about having the time or your life. It’s a family-friendly event where runners, walkers, strollers, and wagons are all welcome! We anticipate more than 500 participants of all ages running or walking the 5k course on the last Saturday of August. Stay tuned for more details during the coming months!

WHO IS CBHA

Being the local solution to local needs, CBHA clinics in Connell, Mattawa, Royal City, Pasco and Othello are the premier providers of full-suite services to patients in the Columbia Basin. CBHA is the foremost healthcare provider in the greater Adams, Franklin and Grant counties for Medical, Dental, Vision, Mental Health and more! We look forward to a great event in August!

name: Celebrate Veterans 5K
description:
RUN WITH PURPOSE. HONOR WITH PRIDE.
 
Every Step Matters
Join us for the Celebrate Veterans 5K as we come together to honor and recognize the brave men and women who have served our country.

This meaningful run/walk is more than just miles — it's about gratitude, remembrance, and community.

Remember Those Who Are Still Missing
We are proud to partner once again with Project Recover, an organization dedicated to locating and bringing home American service members still missing in action.

~81,000 SERVICE MEMBERS REMAIN UNACCOUNTED FOR
Together, we can help raise awareness and support efforts to bring them home.

name: Celebrate Women 5K & 10K
description:
Join us in Celebrating Women! Women in history to those women who are leaders in our community. All registrations include bib, medal and race day snacks!  Both races are limited to 100 people combined.

Long sleeve commemorative shirts are available for purchase for $25.  Shirts are guaranteed until February 17.  Add $5 for 2XL and 3XL sizes.

description:

name: Christmas Eve Ugly Sweater
description:
Ugly Sweater & Elf Dash – Christmas Eve 5K Run/Walk 

Join us for the 8th Annual Christmas Eve Ugly Sweater & Elf Dash 5K Run/Walk at Bradley Lake Park in Puyallup, WA—the most festive Christmas Eve run/walk in Pierce County! Kick off your holiday with a bang at this fun, family-friendly tradition set in Puyallup, a true Hallmark community.

Break out your ugliest sweater, dress as your favorite holiday elf, and soak in the Christmas cheer. With holiday inflatables, Santa’s house, and the much-anticipated arrival of Jolly Ol’ St. Nick, this event has become a can’t-miss tradition for families year after year.  Whether you’re running, walking, or simply enjoying the magic of Christmas Eve, this event is all about joy, community, and holiday spirit.

Event highlights:

  • Christmas Eve 5K Run/Walk
  • Elf Dash (ages 3–9) — about 1K through the magical inflatable lane
  • Family-friendly and festive atmosphere
  • Holiday inflatables & Santa’s house
  • A true Puyallup holiday tradition

Registration includes:
- 5K Run/Walk: Event bib, finisher medal, and after-race goodies
- Elf Dash: Event bib, goodie bag and commemorative Elf Dash button


⚠️ Disclaimer:
Children under the age of 16 must participate in the 5K with a parent or guardian.

Make memories, start a tradition, and celebrate Christmas Eve the best way possible—running (or walking) into the holidays together! 🎅🎄

name: Christmas Rush
description:
The Christmas Rush will celebrate 44 years on December 12.  The race features a 5k run/walk and a 10k run. along the scenic Green River. 

NEW 10k Course!  The 10k will start on the west side of the Green River, will cross over and finish on the east side.  Both the 5k and 10k will finish in the same location. 

Participants age 13 and under are FREE courtesy of Taylor Farms!

Awards will be given to top five winners in each age group following the race.  

Shirt order deadline:  Thursday, November 12th at 11:59 p.m.  

Look for the garage sale table following the race and pick up a shirt from a previous race for just $5!  Cash or Card.

Packet pick up at Road Runner Sports, Thursday, December 10th, 4-7 p.m. or on race day starting at 8 a.m.

Parking located at Hogan Park, 24400 Russell Road, Kent

name: Cirque Series - Crystal Mountain, WA
description:
Join us at Cirque Series at Crystal Mountain.  7.9 miles featuring 2,614' ft vert.

Prizes
Prizes will be distributed at the end of each race and for the overall series winners. There are three categories in which the prizes will be given out: Sport, Expert and Pro.  Prizes for each race are as follows:

Pro 
1st place - $1000 cash each race
2nd place - $250 cash each race
3rd place - $150 cash each race

Expert 
1st - $400 in Gear each race
2nd - $250 in Gear each race
3rd - $150 in Gear each race

Sport 
1st - $300 in Gear each race
2nd - $200 in Gear each race
3rd - $100 in Gear each race

Grom Award - youngest competitor will be recognized.

OG Award - wisest competitor will be recognized.

Lexie Award - the "unofficial MVP" of the race will be recognized.

Middle of the Pack Award - the person that finished exactly middle will be recognized.

TRAINING Plans with TRAINING PEAKS

Registration
We are capping the race at 500 entries, we encourage to sign up right away.

LODGING - LOGE Alta Crystal is located 15 minutes down the road from the mountain. Heated pool, hot tub, & free shuttle service. LOGE Alta Crystal is more than a place to stay, it's basecamp for adventure & connection. Inspired by the surf, climbing, & camping culture of the 70s, & the laid-back energy of a road trip with friends. BOOK: LOGE ALTA CRYSTAL

Looking to stay right at the base of the mountain, all Cirque Series participants are invited to stay at LOGE’s sister property Crystal Mountain Hotels, offering comfort and convenience, just 5 minute walk to the mountain and onsite food options. Crystal Mountain Hotels BOOK: CRYSTAL MT. HOTELS

Bibs / Timing Chips
Cirque Series will utilize Competitive timing to time the event with a disposable chip placed on the back of your bib. Please do not fold, crush or remove the chip from the bib. You may dispose of the chip/bib after the race is over.

Rules / Guidelines
Please help us preserve the beauty of our mountains and assist in maintaining an enjoyable, safe event for everyone involved.

Please respect private property near the trails. Do not trespass.
No littering: Participants are encouraged to carry water and food during the event.
Please dispose of all waste and recyclables in the proper containers.
Please be respectful of all Forest Service officials.
Do not impede another runner.
Leave no trace: Pack-in pack-out.

We will provide SKRATCH hydration at aid stations & finish line.

Any Q's, please email:

steve@cirqueseries.com

julian@cirqueseries.com 

Overall 2027 Season Winner + Points
The racers with the most points at the end of all races will be declared the overall 2027 winner.  The top 20 racers of each event will obtain points. The following is the per stage breakdown as a function of place:

1 - 50pt    6 - 30pt    11 - 20pt 16 - 10pt 
2 - 40pt    7 - 28pt    12 - 18pt 17 - 8pt
3 - 36pt    8 - 26pt    13 - 16pt 18 - 6pt
4 - 34pt    9 - 24pt    14 - 14pt 19 - 4pt
5 - 32pt    10 - 22pt    15 - 12pt 20 - 2pt

PRIZE MONEY 2027 OVERALL SEASON STANDINGS   **Men's & Women's
PRO
PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season
PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season
PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season

EXPERT
1ST - PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season 
2ND- PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season 
3RD- PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season

3RD- PEAK FREAK Belt Buckle - Overall 2027 season

Inspired by the surf, climbing, & camping culture of the 70s, & the laid-back energy of a road trip with friends. BOOK: LOGE ALTA CRYSTAL

Looking to stay right at the base of the mountain, all Cirque Series participants are invited to stay at LOGE’s sister property Crystal Mountain Hotels, offering comfort and convenience, just 5 minute walk to the mountain and onsite food options. Crystal Mountain Hotels BOOK: CRYSTAL MT. HOTELS

Please help us preserve the beauty of our mountains and assist in maintaining an enjoyable, safe event for everyone involved.

Please be respectful of all Forest Service officials.

name: Clallam County Turkey Trot
description:
Clallam County Turkey Trot – Run, Walk, and Gobble!
Kick off your Thanksgiving with a fun and festive tradition for all ages! Run the Peninsula is delighted to host this year’s Clallam County Turkey Trot, offering both 5K and 10K options for runners, walkers, friends, and families.
Proceeds supports the all three food banks across Clallam Count - Sequim, Port Angeles and Forks Food Banks, so you’re doing good while feeling great!
  • $200+ Donation Gives you a FREE Entry to the 5K or 10K Clallam County Turkey Trot
  • $100 Donation Gives you a $20 off Entry to the 5K or 10K Clallam County Turkey Trot
  • $50 Donation Give you $10 off Entry to the 5K or 10K Clallam County Turkey Trot
Event Details:
Date: Thanksgiving Morning - Thursday, November 26th
Time: Race starts at 9:00 AM
Location: Hollywood Beach, Port Angeles
Distances: 5K & 10K — both are out-and-back courses on the Olympic Discovery Trail
Who Can Join: All ages and paces welcome—strollers and festive outfits encouraged!
Race Bib Pick-Up: THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 26TH- 8:00 AM - 9:00 AM - Pick up your bib at the starting line (Hollywood Beach, Port Angeles) the morning of the race at the starting area. 
Your Registration Includes:
  • Commemorative Clallam County Turkey Trot Medal
  • Long-sleeve race t-shirt
  • Plenty of Thanksgiving fun and good cheer!
Gather your flock and make memories before the feast—come trot with us at Hollywood Beach!
Bag Check:
Bring your own bag or use one of ours! Write your bib number on it, drop it before the race, and pick it up afterward with ease.
This Event is produced by the Port Angeles Marathon Association the same Non-Profit 501c3 Organization that puts on the North Olympic Discovery Marathon and the Run the Peninsula Series. 
For questions please click on the question box below or call 585-451-0014

name: Climb for The Cure 2027
description:
Climb for the Cure is a timed Gravel race to the summit of Mt. Spokane.

The race aims to raise money and awareness about the life-changing work being conducted at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute.

Race Details
Start: Big Barn Brewery
Summit Mt. Spokane
Ends: Big Barn Brewery
‍
Same Routes: View Here


TENTATIVE Race Day: June 13th, 2026 <- DATE SUBJECT TO CHANGE
Start Times: 7:00 AM - 9:00 AM
Race is on: rain or shine
‍
Official chip-timed race.
‍A Routes Recommended for:
‍A Route: Intermediate - Intermediate to Expert MTB/Gravel ride.
B Route: Moderate to Intermediate riders
E-Bike is an open class

name: Coffee Lover Run SEATTLE
description:
☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ 
For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon!  😊 

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: Coffee Lovers and Chocolate Lovers 5K & 10K
description:
Chocolate. Coffee. Miles. What’s not to love?

Join us for a uniquely Upper Left of the PNW experience combining two of life’s greatest pleasures — chocolate and coffee!

Run or walk the 5K or 10K, then celebrate your finish with handcrafted treats from Puyallup Chocolates and coffee sampling from our friends at Keurig. It’s the perfect blend of movement, flavor, fun, and community on a crisp PNW winter morning.

name: Cold for a Cause 5k
description:
Bundle up and join us for the Cold for a Cause 5K, a winter race with a warm mission!

On February 27, runners and walkers of all ages and abilities will gather at Sarg Hubbard Park to brave the cold, get moving, and make a difference in the lives of our neighbors experiencing homelessness.

Whether you're a seasoned runner chasing a new personal best, a casual walker looking for a fun Saturday morning activity, or somewhere in between, there's a place for you at the Cold for a Cause 5K. Come race, walk, laugh, and maybe shiver a little—all while supporting Yakima Union Gospel Mission and its work to help people move from homelessness toward wholeness.

Bring your friends. Bring your family. Bring your warmest gear.

Because when we come together, we can turn a cold day into an opportunity to bring hope, shelter, and care to our community.

Are you ready to get cold for a cause?

name: Columbia River Classic Run
description:
The 51st Columbia River Classic 10Mile & 2 Mile Run

Presented by:  3 Rivers Road Runners

Sponsored by: FotoRuby, Atomic Ale, Eastern Oregon timing, SunWest Sportswear

 

Races:  We have a 2-mile fun run and a 10-mile competitive run on the docket for you.

Where:  The races will begin and end at the USS Triton Submarine Memorial off the intersection of 11th Avenue and George Washington Way.

When:  Saturday, November 14, 2026.  2-mile race starts at 9:00 am and the 10-miler at 10:00 am.

Packet Pick Up and Late Registration – Friday, November 13th from 4:00-7:00 Atomic Ale Brewpub & Eatery 1015 Lee Blvd, Richland, WA 99352

 

Day of Packet Pick Up & Late Registration – At the USS Triton Submarine Park 3240 Richardson Road starting at 8:30am (North on George Washington, East on 11th Avenue).

The 2 Mile Dash is free for children 15 years old and younger.  Let's get the kids out there enjoying a healthy habit!

Fees:

Free - 2 Mile Dash for kids 15 years old and younger

$10.00 - 2 Mile Dash for runners 16 and older

$20.00 - 10 Mile Run

Shirts cost an additional $15.

3 Rivers Road Runner members can claim their $2 discount if they register by the pre-registration deadline of October 29, 2026 by 8:00 pm and carefully choose the correct option in the "Choose an Option" drop down box at the beginning of online registration.

A late fee of $5 applies (except 2-milers that are 15 & under) after the pre-registration deadline of October 29, 2026 at 8:00 pm.

Shirts:  Long Sleeve, tech style men’s sizes XS-XXXL (run small)): $15.00 (If registered by October 22nd) 

On Line Registration Deadline: To be pre-registered for The Columbia River Classic and get the t-shirt, you must enter by October 22, 2026 at 8:00 pm. Registration fee increases $5.00 after that. On line registration ends on November 10th.

There will be aid stations for runners at the Snyder Street entrance to Leslie Groves Park and at the turnaround. Stations will have water and the turnaround will have energy gel.

Awards: For the 2 mile fun run, finishers will receive a keepsake as they cross the finish line.  For the 10 mile competitive run, special awards will be given to the top 3 men and women finishers in the 10 mile and awards will be bestowed upon the top 3 men and women in each of the following age groups:  15 & under, 16-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, and 80- 89.

REGISTRATION TIP:  PLEASE PAY CAREFUL ATTENTION TO THE VARIOUS CHOICES IN THE "CHOOSE AN OPTION" DROP DOWN BOX AT THE START OF REGISTRATION.  THIS IS WHERE YOU WILL ORDER AND PAY FOR A SHIRT (OR NOT) AND CLAIM YOUR 3RRR DISCOUNT IF YOU ARE A MEMBER.  AND IF YOU ARE NOT A MEMBER...WHY NOT!!!  SEE THE MEMBERSHIP INFO ON THIS WEBSITE TO GET SIGNED UP IN THE 3 RIVERS ROAD RUNNERS CLUB.

A portion of the proceeds from the event will be given to Camp Patriot, a non-profit organization that takes disables Veterans on outdoor adventures.

Have fun & thank you!

Janet@camppatriot.org
