name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀
Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 
Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

Choose between a half marathon and a 5K, each thoughtfully planned to highlight the area's natural charm while providing an excellent racing experience. With supportive volunteers, clear signage, and a welcoming race community, this event is ideal for runners of all levels.

And keep an eye out—you might just spot a mischievous race gnome along the course! Rumor has it, he's been training for months, but given his tiny stride, he’s still working on that first mile. If you happen to see him, give him a cheer—gnome support is just as important as runner support!

Get ready to push your limits—or simply enjoy the journey. Lace up and join us for an unforgettable race day in Maple Valley!



Run for the Gnomes – Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the Run for the Gnomes?
The Run for the Gnomes is a community Half Marathon and 5K organized by the Maple Valley Rotary Club to support local charitable causes. This year’s proceeds benefit The More We Love.  https://www.themorewelove.org/

When and where is the event?
The event takes place in Maple Valley on the October 3, 2026. Both the start and finish line are in Lake Wilderness Park.

What distances are offered?
• Half Marathon
• 5K Run/Walk

What time do the races start?
The Half Marathon starts at 8 AM and the 5K will start at 8:30 AM.

Is the race timed?
Yes. Both the Half Marathon and 5K are chip‑timed for accurate results.

Is there a medal?
Yes. All finishers will receive a medal.

What is the trail surface like?
The course is mostly gravel. Participants should be prepared for uneven surfaces typical of a gravel trail.

Are dogs allowed?

We love dogs, but unfortunately, they are not allowed in this event.  

Are strollers allowed?
Yes, strollers are allowed in both the Half Marathon and the 5K.
However, because the trail is primarily gravel, stroller users should exercise caution and be aware of varying surface conditions. You will be asked to start at the back of the pack.

Can I walk the 5K?
Absolutely! Walkers, runners, families, and strollers are all welcome. (See stroller question above).

Where do I pick up my race packet?
Packet pickup details, including locations and times, will be emailed to participants and posted online.

Will there be aid stations?
Yes. Aid stations with water and refreshments will be located along the Half Marathon course. Water will be available at the 5K start/finish area.

Is there a cutoff time?
5K: No cutoff time.
Half Marathon: The cutoff time is 4 hours. If you expect to take longer than 4 hours, you may start early with prior approval from race organizers.

Is there a race shirt?
All participants signed up before September 15 are guaranteed a t shirt.

Where do the race proceeds go?
This year’s race supports The More We Love, helping fund the filling of their pool and the construction of a playground for children in their care.

Are there volunteer opportunities?
Yes! Volunteers are vital to making this event successful. Please contact us through the RunSignUp page if you are interested in volunteering.  Run for the Gnomes Half Marathon & 5K

What happens if it rains?
The Run for the Gnomes takes place rain or shine. Please dress for the weather.

Can businesses sponsor or participate?
Yes! We offer multiple sponsorship levels and welcome business teams or volunteers. Contact us through the RunSignUp pate for more details. Run for the Gnomes Half Marathon & 5K

name: Run for Your Life
description:
Run for Your Life (R4YL) is an annual charity Fun Run/Walk & Community Fair organized by the students of Pacific Northwest University of Health Sciences (PNWU). First launched in 2011 on the university’s Terrace Heights campus, RFYL has grown into a cherished tradition that brings together students, families, and the greater Yakima community.

As future health professionals, PNWU students are committed to promoting healthy lifestyles and fostering community well-being. RFYL offers a flat, easy course that’s accessible to all ages and fitness levels, making it a fun and inclusive event for everyone.

More than just a run, RFYL is a family-friendly, safe, and health-focused celebration that allows students to give back to the region they hope to serve. All proceeds support PNWU scholarships, helping students from rural and medically underserved areas receive the education and training needed to return and care for their communities.

 

Run For Your Life 5k/10k – Yakima, WA

Start/Finish Location: PNWU Campus - MultiCare Learning Center 
Date: April 3, 2027
Check-in Time: 8:00-9:15am
Race Start: 9:30am

Kids 11 and Under Run for Free! (Runners' Bib and Giveaway Not Included)

If your kiddo isn’t quite ready to complete a 5K or 10K, let them join in on the fun with our NEW Pony Race! 🐴🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

Kids will get to race down Inspiration Dr. alongside other kids their age in this fun, short-distance race made just for them!

name: Run Forest Run 5k
description:
🏃‍♂️ Run Forest Run 5K — A Forrest Gump-Inspired Fun Run! 🌲

If you’ve ever watched Forrest Gump and thought, “Hey, I could run across America too… or at least a few miles,” then the Run Forrest Run 5K is calling your name louder than Jenny yelling from a school bus window.


Join us for a race where the only rule is to keep moving—because once you start running, who knows when you’ll stop? (Hopefully at the finish line. We do not provide cross-country escort vehicles.)


Expect a course sprinkled with Forrest-approved surprises: a white feather start line, a Bubba-Gump-style finish, and mile markers that remind you just how long Jenny kept Forrest waiting. You might even be overtaken by someone in a ping-pong outfit or a full shrimp costume. It's fine. It’s all part of the experience.
Costumes are highly encouraged—so grow out that majestic running beard, throw on your brightest yellow “happy face” T-shirt, and don’t forget the classic red hat. If anyone asks why you’re dressed like that, just say, “I just felt like running!”


So tie those shoes tight and come join the fun. After all… life is like a 5K—you never know what you’re gonna get.


“That day, for no particular reason, I decided to go for a little run...” — and so can you! See you at the starting line!

name: Run Juneteenth Day 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
On Juneteenth, we remember resilience, honor progress, and run toward a brighter future.
Join the Juneteenth Day Run — an event that celebrates freedom, community, and the unbreakable human spirit.
Let’s make every mile matter.

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: Run or Wine 5K Series - December 2026
description:
Whether you’re racing for a personal best or strolling for the wine, this event is for you! Join us for the Run or Wine 5K & 10K, a fun and scenic race that blends fitness, fresh air, and a well-earned pour at the end.

Choose between a 5K or challenge yourself with the 10K route. 

Perfect for runners, walkers, and wine lovers alike—this is a race where everyone wins. Run hard, walk proud, or just come for the wine. 🍷🏃‍♀️

Registration includes run/walk and wine tasting (beer, cider & some non-alcoholic options as well).

Go to our website for more information about the event: https://run2befit.com/run-or-wine-series

name: Run Scared
description:
Earn your candy at the 18th annual Run Scared, benefiting Blood Cancer United (formerly The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society) Choose from 10K, 5K or 2 mile walk or run. 

 

Celebrate Halloween with a scary dash in Seward Park. Registration includes long sleeve race shirt, a surprise finisher's item and Halloween treats.  All while benefiting a great cause! 

 

Virtual option for those who want to join us from across the country. 

 

Free kids dash

 

In an effort to be more friendly on the environment, you can choose the "Trees not Tees" option and we will donate your shirt costs to an organization that will plant a tree in your name. You will get a certificate, GPS coordinates and a picture of your planted tree. 

 

Schedule

October 24, 2026

 

1:00pm - Packet pickup at West Seattle Runner opens

5:00pm - Packet pickup at West Seattle Runner closes

 

West Seattle Runner - 2743 California Ave SW Seattle, WA 98116

 

October 25, 2026

 

8:00am - Registration and packet pickup open

8:15am - Treasure Hunt

8:45am - Kids Dash

9:00am - Costume Contest

9:45am - 10K Start

10:00am - 5K and 2 Mile start

10:45am - Awards

name: Run the Bay
description:
Loops will be an incredibly enjoyable experience while simultaneously basking in the breathtaking panoramic views of the magnificent Bay! This sensational running trail allows participants to relish every single moment, as they traverse the stunning Chambers Bay in University Place, Washington. Immerse yourself in the invigorating atmosphere as you navigate the wide, impeccably paved loop that seamlessly encompasses a mixture of flat sections, inclines, and enticing switchbacks that add an exhilarating element to the journey. Delight in the notion that these mesmerizing vistas seem infinite, inviting you to indulge in a visual feast that is unparalleled. It is no wonder that the prestigious US Open was held at this remarkable location, and now, the time has come for enthusiastic individuals like yourself to intimately experience the splendor that is held within the bounds of this extraordinary destination. Whether you prefer to gracefully run, leisurely walk, or implement a combination of both, we are absolutely thrilled to introduce our newest additions to the esteemed Run Super Series portfolio: the captivating 5k, the exhilarating 10k, and the awe-inspiring half marathon. Don't miss out on the chance to be a part of this unforgettable event! Each loop is about 220' of gain. 

Visit the official race website for full race details, course maps, and race weekend information: Run the Bay

name: Run the River
description:
Come join us for the 5th annual Run the River Marathon and Relay, starting at Columbia Park in Kennewick, WA.  

This road race features a scenic course that travels through the towns of Kennewick, Richland, and Pasco all while staying next to the mighty Columbia River.  This classic road marathon follows paved paths and roadways the entire time and offers participants with great views of 3 beautifully landscaped parks, the meandering Columbia River, as well as the rugged surrounding mountains.  The flat course and cool spring weather will provide runners with a prime opportunity for a fast finish time if that is their goal.  Likewise, the course lends itself well to runners of all abilities as well as walkers... which tend to have the best time out there!

This road race features a scenic course that travels through the towns of Kennewick, Richland, and Pasco all while staying next to the mighty Columbia River.  This classic road marathon follows paved paths and roadways the entire time and offers participants with great views of 3 beautifully landscaped parks, the meandering Columbia River, as well as the rugged surrounding mountains.  The flat course and cool spring weather will provide runners with a prime opportunity for a fast finish time if that is their goal.  Likewise, the course lends itself well to runners of all abilities as well as walkers... which tend to have the best time out there!

name: Run to END Weekend Hunger 5K
description:
Join us at the Run to END Weekend Hunger 5K to support Backpack Brigade, the largest weekend-hunger relief organization for schoolchildren in Washington state. Backpack Brigade provides food for children in our communities who rely on their schools for breakfast and lunch and often have little to no food on the weekends. Your participation helps further Backpack Brigade’s mission to END weekend hunger for more than 5,000 students a week in 107 schools (and counting) in King County.

COSTUMES ARE ENCOURAGED! We’re inviting all participants to don their most imaginative costumes. Whether you’re a superhero duo, a dynamic Disney pair, or a family who loves to sparkle, we want to see your best costume ideas come to life.

When the race is over, enjoy coffee, snacks, vendors, and more!

name: Run Together Against Breast Cancer SEATTLE
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀
Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 
Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.

Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.

Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.

Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.

name: Run-Your-Turkey-Off Trot
description:
2 miles of post-Thanksgiving fun! The race starts at the Depot in downtown Naches, WA. The course stays on the Yakima greenway, turns around at Allan Brothers Fruit, and comes back to the Depot to finish. Participants registered before November 15th will receive a free t-shirt. If registered after the 15th, there will be a limited supply of t-shirts for purchase at the race. Be sure to get signed up before the deadline!

All proceeds go toward supporting Naches Valley High School Cross Country Booster Club. We greatly appreciate your support! 

Participant Info: Check in before the race at the Naches Depot starting at 9:00. We recommend arriving to the race location by at least 9:30 to park, check in, and warm up. The race will begin promptly at 10:00. Parking will be available at the Depot parking lot and downtown Naches. Day of sign ups will be available up until the race starts.

name: Running Scared 5K/13K - Portland (Washougal)
description:
Get ready for a spine-tingling race experience at the Running Scared 5K & 13K—where thrills, chills, and fast times collide!
Whether you’re brave enough to tackle the 5K or daring enough to conquer the 13K, this Halloween-themed event delivers a fun and festive atmosphere perfect for runners of all levels. Costumes are encouraged, so come dressed to impress (or frighten) as you take on a course filled with seasonal spirit.

We will gather at Captain William Clark Park in Washougal, WA.

All athletes will receive a long-sleeve race shirt—perfect for those crisp fall mornings—and a custom finisher medal to commemorate their accomplishment.

For those looking to push their limits, take on the Deadly Double by completing both the 5K and the 13K. It’s the ultimate test of endurance and Halloween courage!

Competitive runners will have plenty to race for. Awards will be presented to the Top Three Male and Female Overall finishers in both the 5K and 13K, as well as the Top Three in Masters, Grand Masters, and Senior Masters Overall categories. In addition, the top three athletes in each of the traditional five-year age groups will receive awards in both race distances. For those taking on the Deadly Double, special recognition will be given to the Top Three Male and Female finishers who complete both races.

Whether you’re running for fun, fitness, or a frightfully good challenge, the Running Scared 5K & 13K is sure to be a hauntingly good time you won’t want to miss!

name: Salt Creek 24
description:
Salt Creek 24 Registration is OPEN!

Peninsula Adventure Sports is thrilled to announce a new partnership with Rain Bear Running Club to bring you this year's Salt Creek 24. We couldn’t be more excited to partner with Rain Bear Running Club, a group known for its passion, expertise, and dedication to fostering a vibrant running community. The Salt Creek 24 has always been about celebrating endurance, adventure, and the stunning beauty of the Olympic Peninsula, and this partnership will take it to the next level.

With three event options, this all-day, all-night event has so much opportunity to get you on your feet, challenge you and provide you with scenery you won’t find anywhere else! Located at the Salt Creek Recreation Area in Port Angeles, Washington, runners and/or walkers will circle the park on a 1.3 mile route for 24 hours either solo, part of a relay team or as a Last Runner Standing (see event details for description of each event). While racing, individuals will be treated to expansive views of the Strait of Juan de Fuca, towering evergreens, vivid green moss and ferns, along with a bit of World War II history! 

While the clock will be running for 24 hours, this event is designed to allow athletes to challenge themselves by their own design – they can lap the course when they want, as many times as they like. Run or walk the whole 24 hours? That’s fine. Any other number of hours is fine too, in any configuration. You can go on and off the course as you please. Have a certain mileage goal? Just do that! You may stop at any time if you decide you have had enough fun. Training for another race? Awesome!

What’s included in your race registration?

1. A fully stocked aide station, including special featured treats during the toughest night hours! Food to fill your belly and volunteers to cheer you on and fill your soul!
2. A first come, first serve area for runners who plan to circle the park continuously to set up their own aide station/canopy. (This area will be LIMITED and is intended only for those racers planning to take breaks of less than 1 hour.)
3. What is a race without SWAG?! We’ve got that part in the bag. Let us surprise you!

THERE WILL BE PRICE INCREASES AUGUST 1 AND OCTOBER 1, SO DON'T DELAY!

CAMPING

We recommend reserving a campsite at Salt Creek Recreation Area as soon as possible. If the campsites sell out, don't worry! We will be working with the park that all racers that want to come will get one of the First Come First Serve campsites, or an alternative camping space for the event. Also, if you do plan to be on the course for the entirety of the race (stops no more than an hour) - you do not need a campsite, you can stage out of your vehicle or set up a 10x10 pop up canopy to have as your staging area.

How to participate in Salt Creek 24 as a Fundraiser

Fundraising as a part of Salt Creek 24 is OPTIONAL, but we are excited to offer this opportunity for anyone who wants to participate. How does it work? Take a look at our Step-by-Step Guide to becoming a fundraiser. We have a number of established Charity Partners that you can choose from, or you can choose your own charity. If you want to choose your own charity, please contact us at rainbearrunning@gmail.com with the contact name and email address of your charity (you will need to contact them to see if they are interested first!) and we can get them set up as a choice before your register.

REFUND POLICY
* There are no refunds allowed and no deferrals to future years races.
* Transfers are allowed until 3 days before the race.
* If we are forced to cancel for any reason, runners will get a free transfer to the next year, or an 80% refund
* During the registration process, you will have the chance to purchase refund insurance (unavailable for Canadian racers
- rules of the insurance company and not us or RunSignUp), which will allow a full refund if you are unable to attend the event due to several covered reasons including accident, illness and family emergency. Full insurance information at: https://help.runsignup.com/support/solutions/articles/17000133083-what-is-protecht-regshield-

name: Santa Runs Tacoma
description:
Get ready for the most RUNderful time of the year!

The half marathon is a gorgeous out-and-back course starting in downtown Tacoma, with a few rolling hills to keep those legs awake and working. You’ll run along the waterfront until it connects to the Ruston Way Path, where you’ll head towards the Point Ruston Waterwalk and Tacoma’s Dune Peninsula Park.  Before turning around, you’ll go up the Wilson Way Bridge for a bird’s eye view of the area, and then make your way back down the waterfront to finish downtown.

The 10K is an out-and-back following along the half marathon route, starting in downtown Tacoma and running along the waterfront.

The 5K is an annual tradition and fun for the whole family, runners and walkers are welcome to join in this 3.1 mile event.

All finishers will receive one of our famous Santa Runs Tacoma medals.

name: Santa Sleighs 5K
description:
Join us for a jolly good time and kick off the holiday season for the 3rd annual South Kitsap Rotary Santa Sleighs 5K. This festive event will have participants dressing up as their favorite holiday character. The first 200 entrants will receive a free SANTA COSTUME to wear during the race. 

Kids "Reindeer Run" will take place right before the race. The McCormick Woods golf course route will be lined with holiday decorations and music to keep spirits high. After the race participants can enjoy hot cocoa and cookies while mingling with other holiday enthusiasts.

All proceeds from the event will benefit the South Kitsap community. 

Lace up your sneakers, don your Santa hat and spread some holiday cheer at the 3rd Annual South Kitsap Rotary Santa Sleighs 5K.

description:
RUN FOR YOUR LIFE!

Join us for our 11th Annual Scary Run- on October 24th, 2026. ALL NEW RACE TIME (SATURDAY EVENING)

name: Seabrook Turkey Trot
description:
Join us on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, November 26, from 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM for the Seabrook Turkey Trot, a family-friendly 3K run or walk through town. Starting at Town Hall, this unofficially timed town tradition is the perfect way to enjoy some fresh coastal air, connect with friends and neighbors, and kick off the holiday before gathering around the Thanksgiving table.

Walk, jog, run, push a stroller, or simply enjoy the festive atmosphere as the course winds through Seabrook's walkable neighborhoods. Costumes are encouraged, so break out your turkey hats, holiday sweaters, and festive flair to add even more fun to the morning.

Cross the Finish Line and Celebrate

After completing the 3K course, warm up at the finish line with complimentary hot chocolate, cider, and grab-and-go snacks.

Registered participants will also receive a commemorative Seabrook Turkey Trot keepsake mug, a fun reminder of your Thanksgiving morning tradition on the coast.

Registration & Packet Pickup

Participants are encouraged to register in advance. Packet pickup will be available prior to Thanksgiving at Guest Services.

*Children 5-years-old and under may participate for free. Please note, participants who do not purchase tickets are not eligible to receive a commemorative mug.

name: Seattle Atatürk Unity Run
description:
TACAWA proudly presents the first annual Seattle Atatürk Unity Run.

Join us for a scenic and inspiring 5K and 10K at Gas Works Park and along the Burke-Gilman Trail as we celebrate unity, legacy, and health. With stunning views of Lake Union and Seattle’s skyline, this event brings runners, families, and community members together for a meaningful day of movement, connection, and celebration.

The Seattle Atatürk Unity Run honors May 19, a historic day marking the beginning of the movement led by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk that helped shape modern Turkey. The event commemorates Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day while celebrating the 145th birthday of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, founder of the Republic of Turkey.

More than a race, the Seattle Atatürk Unity Run is a celebration of the values that unite us: youth, democracy, freedom, equality, science, reason, and community. Participants run to support future generations, strengthen connections across cultures, and celebrate the power of coming together through sport.

Atatürk believed deeply in the strength and promise of young generations. This event honors that vision by bringing people together with hope, energy, and a shared commitment to the future.

Whether you are chasing a personal record, enjoying a beautiful Seattle run, or simply looking for a meaningful way to connect with community, we invite you to be part of the inaugural Seattle Atatürk Unity Run.

Register today and be part of the first chapter of this new Seattle tradition.

name: Silverdale Rotary Turkey Trot 2026
description:
Please join us for our 9th Annual Silverdale Rotary Turkey Trot!

For the fifth straight year we're going free-range with our wild Turkey Trot at Newberry Hill Heritage Park. All events are run in the woods -- away from streets, sidewalks, and cars.  The park offers a scenic 2.7 mile loop fire road which offers a great course for our 1-Mile, 5K and 10K events.   

"Protect My Race " option in sign-up process.  During the sign-up process you will be asked if you want to buy "insurance" on your sign-up.  YOU DO NOT NEED THIS!  The Silverdale Rotary Club will happily return any registration fee, for any reason, upon request.  You do not need insurance to secure this.

NOTE:  There will not be day-of-race registration available. 

Changes in 2026:  

  • We will NOT have race-day registration in 2026.  We will, however, have last-minutes sign-ups in the week of the event.  Please check back for details!
  • Medals will be presented to the top male and female finisher in each of th 1-Mile, 5K, and 10K events.  Ribbons will be awarded for 1st - 5th place by event and age category for the 1-Mile, 5K, and 10K.  As in the past a commemorative ribbon will be presented to all Kids-Dash participans.
  • In 2025 we increased the numbers of port-a-potties to alleviate the lines we had in 2024.
  • Since 2022, this has been a chip-timed event.  
  • Since 2023, we have initiated a "Family Registration" (discount!) package.  Please see below for instructions. 

 

All proceeds from this event will benefit non-profit organizations and causes to fight hunger in our community.

 

Additional Information

- Parking is available on the property of Klahowya Secondary School.  Please enter off of Newberry Hill and follow signs to the parking area.   Staging, registration, and kids' dashes will occur on an access road to the Heritage Park.  From the parking lot this access road will be clearly marked.

- Race packets will be distributed at multiple events during the week preceding the race.  Packets will also be available on race day.

- The 1-mile, 5K, and 10K events will be run on a wide fire road consisting of compact dirt and rock.  The 10K course makes a small detour onto a narrow side trail to supplement the distance needed.  10K racers will run the fire road loop twice.  The course will be marked, and staffed for clarity.  See link below for a course map.

- Strollers are permitted on the course.  For 10K participants there is a detour off the fire road onto a path to add the necessary distance for the race.  Unlike the fire road this stretch will require your attention as it gets narrow in a couple of places.  However, the restricted area is only over about 100 feet in total.  And durable strollers will be fine through this area.

- Well behaved, leashed dogs are permitted (and welcome!).

- Total elevation gain/loss for the course is about 200 feet per lap for the 5K and 10K (2 laps).

- Visit the following link to see the course layout:  CLICK HERE FOR COURSE LAYOUTS

- Each event will only be run once at the start time listed above.  The estimated end time is not intended to suggest there will be a second running of the same event.

- Please contact the race director, Ed Hamilton, with any questions or concerns.  Email:  silverdalerotaryclub@gmail.com, cell:  360-649-3004.

 

Race Packet Pick-up and In Person Registration Details

Packet Pickups are at the following two events or on Thanksgiving morning at the event.  In-person registration can be made the following events as well:

Sunday, November 22rd, 3:00 - 5:00 pm at the inside entrance to Dick's Sporting Goods inside the Kitsap Mall.

Tuesday, November 24th, 5:00 - 7:00 pm at the  inside entrance to Dick's Sporting Goods inside the Kitsap Mall.  This is the last opportunity to register for the event.

Please note there will be no registration available on the day of the event.

 

We want to thank our sponsors for making the Turkey Trot happen.  Please visit the links to sponsors on this page.

name: Sloth Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🥯🏃‍♂️ Run for the carbs. Stay for the bagels.

Love running? Love bagels? This one’s for you.

Whether you’re chasing a workout or just here for the carbs, this run is all about balance, fun, and community.

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers

name: Snohomish Women's Run
description:
What is the Snohomish Women’s Run?

Join us for the Snohomish Women’s Run—a fun, welcoming celebration of movement, community, and strength.

Set along the scenic Snohomish River, this event features flat, fast, and well-supported courses for all abilities. Choose from the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon—whether you’re chasing a PR or just showing up for a great day with friends.

⸻

Why You’ll Love It

    •    Flat, fast courses (great for first-timers or PRs)
    •    Beautiful riverfront scenery
    •    Supportive, non-intimidating atmosphere
    •    Chip-timed race with high-quality swag
    •    A fun, community-driven experience

⸻

All Paces Welcome

Walk, jog, or run—this race is for everyone.

Bring your friends, set a goal, and enjoy a day that’s uplifting, empowering, and genuinely fun.

name: Snoqualmie Valley Half
description:
The Snoqualmie Valley Trail meanders through one of the area’s most beautiful agricultural areas, the Snoqualmie Valley Half showcases this natural gem. This race is flat and fast and the surface is smooth and non-technical and showcases old-growth forest and farmland. You’ll have a spectacular and fast finish in the shadow of the historic big red barn at King County’s Tolt MacDonald Park! The course is USATF certified!

Race Website: https://www.orcarunning.com/snoqualmie-valley-half/

Interested in signing up for more than one Orca Running race? Check out the Orca Running Bundle/Save.

name: Snoqualmie Valley Harvest Run
description:
Celebrate fall in the Snoqualmie Valley! 🍂

Join us Sunday, October 25 at Centennial Fields Park for the Snoqualmie Valley Harvest Run, a family-friendly fall event featuring a 5K, 10K, and Kids Dash with beautiful views of Mt. Si and the surrounding Snoqualmie Valley.

Whether you're racing, walking with family and friends, or bringing the kids out for some fall fun, there's something for everyone.

Event Highlights:

🍂 Scenic 5K & 10K courses with views of Mt. Si
🍬 Kids Dash with trick-or-treat stops along the course
🎃 Harvest Costume Contest for kids, adults, and families
🏅 Finisher medals
🏆 5K & 10K overall and age-group awards
❤️ Proudly supporting our nonprofit partner, the Snoqualmie Valley Food Bank

🥫 FILL THE VAN! The Snoqualmie Valley Food Bank truck will be onsite on race morning, and we’d love your help filling it!

Bring your nonperishable food donations with you and drop them off directly at the truck when you arrive. Whether it’s a few items from your pantry or donations collected from friends, family, coworkers, or your neighborhood, every contribution helps.

 

Run. Celebrate. Give Back. 🍂

Run. Celebrate. Give Back. 🍂

name: Snoqualmie Valley St. Patrick's Day Fun Run
description:
Join us for the Snoqualmie Valley St. Patrick's Day Fun Run!🍀


Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with this festive, family-friendly 5K walk/run and Kids Dash. The 5K walk/run is open to everyone, while the Kids Dash features a 200 yard run designed especially for little runners ages 5 and under.

Costumes and green gear are highly encouraged, so bring your Irish spirit! Snoqualmie Running, Pineapple Life and The Weekend Coffee have sham-rocked our prize table with awesome gift cards!  Prizes will be awarded to the top 5K finishers in each gender category, plus a special award for the runner rocking the most legendary leprechaun-worthy costume!

Our event will be hosted by Sound to Summit Running Company with a portion of the proceeds and 100% of the sponsorship dollars going to the Snoqualmie Valley Food Bank.

Whether you’re chasing a personal best, enjoying a casual walk, or cheering from the sidelines, the St. Patrick's Day Fun Run is a fun way to get moving and celebrate the season with family and friends.

name: Spokane River Run 2027
description:
Spokane River Run returns April 25, 2027!

Back again and better than ever, Spokane River Run features a 5K, 10K, 25K, 25K Challenge, 50K, 50K Relay, and 25K Tag Team (two-person relay). SRR is one of the oldest trail runs in the Pacific Northwest and has been recognized in the Trail Runner’s Trophy Series.

Spokane River Run is 100% volunteer-organized, funding the Garfield Elementary A.P.P.L.E. program and partner organizations: Garfield Elementary, Active4Youth, On Track Academy, and North Central High School Cross Country.

name: Spring - Mud Mountain Dam Marathon & Half Marathon
description:
Start Planning Now for Your Next Boston Qualifier!

Take on a beautiful, fully paved downhill course with no tunnel, no dirt, and no BQ downhill penalty.

Full Marathon
The Marathon starts at Mud Mountain Dam, high above the Carbon River at an elevation of approximately 1,400 feet.

From there, runners will follow a fully paved downhill route through picturesque farmland and forest, tracing the scenic Carbon River before finishing at the McMillin Farm Collective at approximately 128 feet.

That's a net elevation loss of about 1,200 feet—a fast, scenic course built for a memorable Boston Qualifier!

Half Marathon
The Half Marathon starts in the scenic town of South Prairie at approximately 467 feet and follows a gradual downhill route along the paved Foothills Rail Trail.

Runners will wind through farmland and forest alongside the Carbon River before finishing at the McMillin Farm Collective, at approximately 128 feet.

The course features a net elevation loss of 339 feet.

A Finish Line Worth Celebrating!
We've got a brand-new finish line just down the road from the McMillin Bridge, and we're making it a destination!

After crossing the finish line, stick around and celebrate with:

Brewhouse
Food trucks
Hot & Cold plunge pools

It's going to be a finish line to remember!

Beautiful course. Fast downhill miles. Fully paved. No tunnel. No dirt. No BQ penalty.

There’s no excuse not to do the dam thing!

name: Spring Classic Duathlon, Half, 10k & 5k
description:
RUN, WALK & WHEN ONE SPORT IS NOT ENOUGH, JUST DU IT!

Time to dust off the cobwebs and start the multi-sport racing season with the 43rd Annual Spring Classic Duathlon, Half Marathon, 10K & 5K! It's time to see who stayed in shape all winter!

Choose the Duathlon or any of the 3 different running distances, and let's Spring into Action!

DUATHLON - 5K RUN / 12.91 MILE BIKE / 5K RUN

The Spring Classic Duathlon is a great opportunity for triathletes to shake off the winter-season rust and for the duathletes to get in an early-season race.

It will be a flat & fast course...perfect for those new to the sport of Duathlon and Triathlon! And for you veterans, this will be a fabulous opportunity to go all out and see who stayed in good condition this winter!

There are no railroad tracks on the bike route – just 12.91 miles of smooth pavement ideally suited for fast times. The course is virtually flat, and for the novice athlete, the sense of safety from not having to be overly concerned with vehicle traffic makes this event an ideal introduction to the world of multi-sport racing.

Spring Classic Half Marathon, 10K & 5K - This beautiful, flat and fast course along the pancake flats of the Vancouver Lake Regional Park is a wonderful event to set as a goal to keep your conditioning strong through the winter and spring cold and rainy seasons!

Our start/finish location at the Vancouver Lake Regional Park will allow us to relax and share our racing stories once we all finish! We will have high-energy music, fun vendors, food, and who is ordering the sunshine?!

Enough Hibernating! Wake up, Get out & Race at the Spring Classic!

(PARKING IS INCLUDED WITH REGISRATION FEES)

name: St. Paddy's Day Lucky Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🍀 St. Paddy's Day Run: Luck, Laughs, and Laces! 🍀
Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with a fun and festive run that’s as much about the spirit of the holiday as it is about the finish line! Whether you're running, walking, or just along for the ride, this 5K/10K/13.1 is the perfect way to enjoy the day with friends, family, and fellow revelers.
Dress up in your favorite green gear—shamrocks, leprechaun hats, and everything in between—and join us for a race full of fun and good cheer!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: St. Paddy's Day Run Tacoma
description:
The half marathon is a gorgeous out-and-back course starting in downtown Tacoma, with a few rolling hills to keep those legs awake and working. You'll run along the waterfront until it connects to the Ruston Way Path, where you'll head towards the Point Ruston Waterwalk and Tacoma's Dune Peninsula Park.  Before turning around, you'll go up the Wilson Way Bridge for a bird's eye view of the area, and then make your way back down the waterfront to finish downtown.

The 10K is an out-and-back following along the half marathon route, starting in downtown Tacoma and running along the waterfront.

The 5K is an annual tradition and fun for the whole family, runners and walkers are welcome to join in this 3.1 mile event.

All finishers will receive one of our famous St. Paddy's Day Run medals.

name: Stevenson Turkey Trot 5k
description:
Come be part of the tradition! Begin your Thanksgiving Day with friends and family as we run-walk-jog through Stevenson! 

Event begins at the Skamania Fairground Exhibit Hall.  Arrive before 8am to register, or better yet, sign up ahead of time.  It's free!  

The event is free, but please bring donations of non-perishable food or cash that we will gather and take to the food bank.  In the past, we've proudly been able to drop off hundreds of pounds of food and money because of everyone's generosity.

name: Sun City Barry James Memorial 5K and Half Marathon
description:
The Sun City Barry James Memorial 5K and Half Marathon are put on every year by the Hard Core Running Club of Central Washington. They take place on the second Sunday of October at Volution Fitness, 650 University Parkway in Terrace Heights, Washington, just east of Yakima. The 5K and half marathon both start and end at Volution. There will be aid stations at miles 3.5, 7, and 10. The half marathon is a favorite race of many participants with rolling hills alongside orchards.

Race fee is $15 for Hard Core Runner Members, $20 for non-members, and youth under age 12 are free.  Costs go up to $22 on October 1st. Day of race entries will be $25.

name: Super Hyak Marathon and Half
description:
Chasing a Boston Qualifier? 

1 in 5 Runners BQ here.

Ranked the #22 Fastest Boston Qualifier Course in the United States by FindMyMarathon

Designed for PRs. Built for Boston Qualifiers.

Super Hyak is one of the nation’s fastest downhill marathons—engineered for runners chasing a personal best or a Boston Qualifier on a proven, high-performing course.

DOWNHILL SUPER SERIES:

Part of the Downhill Super Series—featuring some of the fastest Boston Qualifier courses in the United States.

COURSE:

A controlled early pace followed by sustained downhill creates ideal conditions for negative splits and strong finishes.

Pacers are available to help you stay on target and execute your race plan.

The point-to-point course follows the Palouse to Cascades Trail with a smooth, consistent downhill profile ideal for sustained pacing and fast finishes.

  • Total downhill: 1,414 ft
  • Net downhill: 1,247 ft
  • No Boston Marathon time penalty

WHY RUNNERS CHOOSE SUPER HYAK:

   ✔️ Smooth, runnable downhill (no steep drops)
   ✔️ Proven Boston Qualifier course
   ✔️ USATF-certified & accurately measured
   ✔️ Scenic Cascade views + iconic Snoqualmie Tunnel section
   ✔️ Fully supported (aid stations, shuttles, drop bags)

WHAT OUR RUNNERS SAY:

"10 min PR from my Boston Time, so it was very successful! Was a really fun race and loved the finish line!! Such a great atmosphere!" Joe

"I am recommending everyone in Reddit to come and run the Super marathon/Cascade Express for BQ"

“I needed 3 minutes for my BQ and ran a 6-minute PR at Super. The downhill is smooth, not reckless — it lets you race.”
- Matt, Boston Qualifier, 2025

“Well-organized, fast course, incredible pacing support. This is where I finally got my BQ.”
- Chris-First Time Boston Qualifier

“Perfect early-season race. I settled in early and opened up after mile 10. Locked in my BQ comfortably.”- Sarah, Marathon Finisher

EXPERIENCE:

A professionally produced, runner-focused race—from seamless transportation logistics to reliable on-course support and a fast, fair racing environment.

WHAT’S INCLUDED:

  • Chip timing with live results & splits
  • Finisher medal + technical race shirt
  • Fully stocked aid stations
  • Ample parking near the race start
  • Shuttle transportation from finish to start 
  • Drop bag service
  • Experienced race management & medical support

CERTIFICATION:

Marathon (Boston Qualifier) – USATF WA25021RMB
Half Marathon – USATF WA25023RMB

Register now and lock in your BQ attempt.

Race Details & Logistics:

Full course details, schedules, packet pickup information, transportation logistics, and FAQs are provided below to help you plan your race weekend.

Visit the official race website for full race details, course maps, and race weekend information: SUPER HYAK MARATHON

name: Super Seattle 5K
description:
**** Please Read in Entirety ****

Super Seattle 5K - Produced by Hi5K

Calling all Super Bowl Fans to run (or walk) in the Super Seattle 5K!!! 

This is an Awesome way to get ready for the Super Bowl a day before!!! Yes come and run a 5K in Seattle on Super Bowl Sunday.

Come sporting your  SEAHAWK  colors!!! If you are not a Seahawk, sport your own team's colors!!! Or, wear anything you want - we just want you to come out and have fun AND receive an official 5K chip-timed result.

Event Information

The event will be held at Green Lake Park in Seattle. The course is a 5K on the paved loop around Green Lake with the final stretch coming around the ball fields (see course links below). From a runners perspective - this course is legit, dope, sick, wicked, 'da bomb - 'ya feel me!!!  And it is flat and fast if you are after a PR.
We look forward to you joining us in this exceptionally high quality event. 
If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must register you and sign the waiver that will be presented during the registration process, otherwise if you are 18 you may register yourself.

Race Day (Super Bowl Sunday) Schedule:

7:45AM - 9:10AM:
Bib Pickup at Green Lake softball fields (East side of Green Lake - Look for Hi5K Tents).  You may also drop off any canned food items you'd like to donate at this time. Day-Of-Race registration available at this time as well.
9:30AM:
 5K Race Start 
9:50 AM:
Podium Awards Begin - Top 3 in each age category (Male/Female awarded separately).
Age categories are as follows 1-11, 12-15, 16-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+
9:50AM - 10:40AM:
Post-Race Hydration and Nutrition available

Scholarships:

If you are experiencing any financial hardship, and would still like to participate, please email the race director at:
racedirector@hi5k.com

OR you can send us a message by clicking the  Questions?  button below.

We will get you signed up - no questions asked.

Bib Pickup:

There is no bib pickup prior to race day. Please pick up your bib between 7:45AM and 9:10AM at the starting line tent on race day.

Course Info:

Start/Finish area is at the Greenlake Community Center basketball courts on the East side of Greenlake.  From the start, the race will head west toward the lake and then make an immediate right-hand turn to begin a counter-clockwise loop around the Green Lake on the inner paved path. At approximately mile 2.8 there will be a right hand-turn to exit the inner path and begin a counter-clockwise lap around the play fields (softball / soccer area). The final turn (at "Turn and Burn" corner) will be a left-hand turn with 200 meters remaining to the finish (time to kick! - it's slightly downhill too). 
Timing: This is a chip-timed event. Timing is provided by Bell Lap Productions. 
Weather: Prepare for cold or inclement weather (It's February).
Course Links:
  • https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/2805350536
  • https://ridewithgps.com/routes/31541051
Strava Segments: 
  • https://www.strava.com/segments/22375594 (Full 3.1 Mile Segment)
  • https://www.strava.com/segments/22375610 (200 Meter "Turn and Burn" Finish)
  • https://www.strava.com/segments/16058817 (Mile Somewhere in the Middle)

Donations:

Did you know that the Super Bowl is the 2nd biggest food day of the year!  This race is helps support local food shelters in their efforts to fight hunger in Washington State. If you can, please bring any non-perishable or canned food item to the race and we'll happily drop it to one of the local food shelters we support.

FAQs:

Can I participate with a stroller? 
Absolutely - we are stroller friendly.
Can I run with my dog?
Unfortunately no, USATF (USA Track & Field) will no longer insure or sanction events that allows dogs.

 We can't wait to see you!!! 
 This is going to be so Awesome!!!
 Bring it! Send it!! YEEEET!!!

Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.

Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.

name: Swing the Gates 5k and 10k
description:
Swing the Gates is back for a 4th year! And this time we are CLOSING the Park on Halloween!

This year will include the popular 10k Team Scavenger Hunt and the classic 5k Fun Run-costumes encouraged.

Come hang out with an amazing community of nature lovers, runners, walkers, and their K-9 companions while exploring the beauty of Deception Pass State Park

5K Fun Run

The 5K fun run will kick off at 9:00 AM, but we recommend coming early to cheer on the 10K team scavenger hunt participants as they complete their first challenge as soon as they cross the start line at 8:00 AM.  

The course will be run primarily on paved surfaces, however does include 400 ft elevation gain with a steep incline at the beginning of the race. Strollers, small children, and dogs are welcome! The race aid station is cup-less again, so be sure to bring your own water bottle or cup.

Course will close at 11:00AM.

10K Team Scavenger Hunt

Challenge yourself and your friends to a unique race experience. Teams will set off along the trails and roads of the Park to solve various challenges along the way which will help them uncover the racecourse as they go. Scavenger hunts are more fun with friends, so find three other people to join you at 8:00 AM on race day. Distances and elevation will vary based on your team’s ability to navigate the trails of Deception Pass State Park. 

*Race will NOT cross the Deception Pass Bridge

This is a difficult course run primarily along unpaved trails and roads within the park. If your team is able to navigate the trails efficiently, we expect the 10:30 AM to allow park staff to CLOSE the gates to the Park for the season.  If you are still running at this time, we ask that you head to the finish line and check in. This is an unsupported 10K race. Plan to carry your own water and snacks. 

*The first participant will pay the initial fee and then all other teammates are free. Be sure to share your team’s name and password with your teammates so they join the correct team and aren’t paying another fee. If your teammate(s) does/do not register, they will not be allowed on the course for safety reasons.

**For safety reasons, substitutions are not allowed for any races after October 28, 2026 including the 10K team scavenger hunt.

Prices (processing fees not included)

5K Fun Run
$30

10K Team Scavenger Hunt
$120.00

(No matter the day, or number of people on your team, the 10K Scavenger Hunt is the same price. The first participant will pay the initial fee and then all other teammates are free. Be sure to share your team’s name and password with your teammates so they join the correct team and aren’t paying another fee.)

A Discover Pass is required to park in the lot for the race and can be purchased online at www. discoverpass.wa.gov or at the entrance booth on the day of the event.

Prizes

The top three finishers of each race category in 5K Fun Run and the first place team in the 10K Scavenger Hunt will win a special prize!

Volunteering

Volunteers are critical to make this race successful. We need people managing different 10K clues, aiding the check-in process, manning our water station, and much more. If you are interested in volunteering, please email volunteer@deceptionpassfoundation.org to get more information or sign up on this link:  https://volunteersignup.org/TQYFQ

name: Tacky Turkey Sweater 5k
description:
Gobble, Jog, and Strut Your Stuff!

Get ready to hit the pavement in style—questionable style, that is! Join us for the most hilariously festive run of the season at Green Lake Park: the Tacky Turkey Sweater 5K.

Dig out your most outrageous, over-the-top, turkey or holiday-themed sweater (the tackier, the better!) and jog, waddle, or strut your way through a 5K course filled with laughter, fall vibes, and questionable fashion choices. 

Bring your friends, your family, and maybe even your weird uncle who actually owns a turkey sweater collection. (Leave your pet turkey at home—trust us on this one.)

Expect:
Festive photo ops
Fabulous prizes for the tackiest sweaters
A fun and inclusive community vibe

So lace up, layer up, and let your turkey flag fly. Let’s make this the most unforgettable (and eye-watering) sweater parade Green Lake Park has ever seen!

name: Tacoma City Marathon / Half / Ghost / 10K / 5K / 1K
description:
Join us for the return of the Ghost of Tacoma on Saturday and the Tacoma City Marathon on Sunday with Marathon Relay, Half Marathon, 5K, 10K and Kids 1K options also available.

Run 3 races in 2 days! Kick off Saturday morning with the 5K or 10K (8:00 am start) and afterwards, run the Ghost of Tacoma Marathon or Half Marathon (9:00 am start). Kids 1K race will be on Saturday at 9:30 am. Then complete the weekend with the Tacoma City Marathon or Half Marathon on Sunday. PLUS receive a $40 Discount on the Ghost of Tacoma if you register for the Sunday Marathon or Sunday Half Marathon. Discount will be automatically applied to your cart when you add both races (must be the same registrant for both races).

Sunday’s Marathon and Half Marathon are point-to-point courses running across the iconic Narrows Bridge and finishing at Tacoma’s beautiful Dune Peninsula Park, the Northwest’s premier waterfront neighborhood. This picturesque entertainment and recreation hub is situated along Commencement Bay with panoramic views of the Puget Sound, the Olympic and Cascade Mountain ranges.

Runners will enjoy a scenic, USATF-Certified and Boston Qualifying course that passes through Point Defiance Park, with over 700 acres of beautiful gardens and old growth forests. After exiting Pt. Defiance, the Marathon and Half Marathon runners will cross over the Wilson Way Bridge with a sweet half mile downhill to the Puget Sound and Dune Peninsula Park where the Half Marathon will finish. The Marathon will continue down the flat and fast waterfront with views of Mt. Rainier and the Puget Sound. The Marathon turnaround is along the Thea Foss Waterway Esplanade and the beautiful Museum of Glass.

description:
It’s a family affair! The Tacoma City Turkey Trot offers a 5K Run/Walk and a 1K Kids Run in Tacoma’s beautiful Proctor District.

Gobble gobble! The Tacoma City Turkey Trot is a fun 5K Run and Walk on Thanksgiving morning starting at Fleet Feet Tacoma! Whether you are a runner looking for a new PR or you are a walker, there’s no greater way to start your Thanksgiving holiday by coming together with the community and earning that pumpkin pie! We encourage Thanksgiving costumes & accessories!

The Tacoma City Turkey Trot Kids 1K on Thanksgiving morning is a fun way to get the kids (12 and under) to participate! Grown-ups can run with their kids and do not have to register for this distance. We encourage Thanksgiving costumes & accessories!

name: TCMA Yoga Events
description:
Join us for our first-ever Yoga in the Park event, hosted by 5-time Boston Marathoner and certified yoga instructor Joleen Pereira!

Come enjoy an energizing morning at beautiful Dune Peninsula Park, surrounded by fresh air, sunshine, and sweeping views of the Puget Sound.

Joleen will lead a fun, welcoming session designed for all levels—from experienced yogis to complete beginners!

Whether you’re a runner, walker, or simply looking for a great way to move and recharge, yoga is the perfect complement to an active lifestyle. Improve your strength, flexibility, balance, and mobility, support recovery, and give your mind and body a chance to reset.

Come stretch, breathe, move, and start your day feeling amazing!

No experience necessary. Just bring your mat, your energy, and a willingness to have some fun!

name: Ten Trails Active Club 5k Training Program
description:
Join the Club!

Our 5K training program is designed to help both true beginners and returning athletes gradually build up their running ability over the course of several weeks. Our training program typically spans 6 to 8 weeks, allowing participants to go from little or no running experience, to completing a 5K (3.1 miles) with confidence!

Training Program Overview

Our training program consists of a mix of walking and running intervals, gradually increasing the running time while decreasing the walking time. We'll have three groups to ensure everyone participating feels challenged but not overwhelmed. The more advanced groups will move into some more advanced running workouts by the end of the training program.

  • Group 1 will be for those who are starting from very little to no experience or are coming back to the sport after a long time off. Group 1 members will likely have to deal with Coach Dalty the most... so choose wisely!
  • Group 2 will be geared toward slightly more advanced runners who are already confident they can finish a mile or more without stopping.
  • Group 3 will be for even more experienced runners and will likely operate with little supervision or guidance during workouts. Group 3 members should feel confident they can run at least a mile and be able to independently execute prescribed workouts without oversight.
    Throughout the course of the training program, we will try to hold a few Special Topic Talks aimed at providing new runners the guidance they need on the best gear, fuel, hydration, and recovery techniques to help them avoid common social media woes.

Details

Our 5k training program will kick-off at 6:00PM on Wednesday April 29 @ Civic Park in Ten Trails. Once the training program starts, the group will meet every Wednesday at 6:00pm at Civic Park, and every Sunday at 8:30AM at Civic Park. Everyone will get a copy of the schedule on the first day. We will use the first race of our Summer Series as our target 5k! Our target 5k race will be held on June 17.

Tips for Success (We will cover these in detail in Special Topic Talks)

  • Stay consistent: Show up to our group meetings and do you best to run at least once a week on your own.
  • Listen to your body: If you feel pain, talk to a coach. discomfort is normal and we should work through it. A coach can help new runners tell the difference between pain and discomfort and whether we need to get stronger or take a break.
  • Stay hydrated and fueled: Come hydrated and properly fueled. Ask a coach for suggestions if you are unsure.
  • Wear proper running gear but don't be fooled into thinking you need all the most expensive gear!
  • Track your progress: download Strava and join the Ten Trails Active Club's Strava Club!

Conclusion

Our 5K training program is a great way to kickstart your running journey. With dedication and consistency, your goal to finish a 5K race could be just the beginning!

 

Sponsorship Note:

We (a very small group of individuals) love hosting this free program for the community and have no plans on stopping! With that said, we have no large or consistent sponsors - so this program and other club activities are not free for us to host! If you are in a position to donate and help keep all our events going in the future, we would greatly appreciate it. Donations can be made during registration or directly to Coach Dalty in person. Every contribution is much appreciated!

Pulse Brewed Coffee (owned by Coach Dalty) also contributes a portion of his sales to funding Ten Trails Active Club events, so if you'd like to try some great coffee, give Pulse Brewed a try! You won't be disappointed!

name: Ten Trails Active Club 5k Turkey Trot
description:
Join the Club!

PLEASE READ ALL OF THIS

New this year: We're a $10 charge on non-club members. This is to reinforce that donations go a long way! And to help ensure members and local residents have a spot. Club members should see a 100% discount applied at checkout, please still consider a small donation, even if its snacks or cups to help refuel the runners. 🙂 Let me know if you have any questions! 

We're back at it again for our 4th year! Given that we had over 250 people register for last year's race; you heard that right... 250! We are asking that everyone register as soon as possible so that we can have our ducks in a row come race day!

Registration will be capped at ~250 people and I will NOT accept race day signups like we have in the past. I'm also asking this year that we do not register kids in strollers, on bikes, or anyone/thing not planning to complete the entire 5k course on their own. This is to help ensure that we leave as many spots open for other racers as possible. Kids in strollers are of course still welcome on the course :)

As we've mentioned before, these events are organized and hosted by a very small group of people (less than 5) who pay out-of-pocket and donate their time to ensure these community events continue. During the registration process, you will be asked to donate - please consider a $5 minimum donation to the club to help ensure we can continue to afford and host these events in the future. We will also be selling enamel race/club pins and Pulse Brewed Coffee at the event. Sales of which will go to funding our ongoing club activities. We appreciate your support and understanding!

Onto the race details! We will be continuing to use the same course as last year and will be providing snacks at the end as usual. I will try to have some Pulse Brewed Coffee our there too!! Remember, the race will be hand-timed on an open course, so please be safe out there and comply with the finish line rules to help ensure the event runs smoothly and we're able to quickly compile results at the end :) Remember, we ask everyone to show up 20-30 minutes prior to the start of the race so that everyone gets checked in for a prompt 8:30am race start.

The event is open to folks of all skill levels. There will be prize categories for both walkers and runners, and if you're lucky, you may even get to bring home one of our Thanksgiving Day desserts that will be raffled off after the event!

Lastly, in the spirit of thanksgiving, we will again be collecting food donations for a local food bank during the event. If you are able, all donations are greatly appreciated.

See you out there!

~Coach Dalty
