name: Ten Trails Active Club Heartfelt Hustle
description:
Join the Club!

PLEASE READ ALL OF THIS

Is it race season yet?!?!... Not quite. But the holiday season isn't over for the Ten Trails Active Club, and there is no better way to celebrate than to RACE! So, please help us celebrate Valentine's Day by joining us for our 3rd annual Ten Trails Active Club Heartfelt Hustle 5K!

Registration will be capped at ~100 people and I will NOT accept race day signups like we have in the past. I'm also asking this year that we do not register kids in strollers our anyone/thing not planning to complete the entire 5k course on their own. This is to help ensure that we leave as many spots open for other racers as possible. Kids in strollers are of course still welcome on the course :) Well behaved dogs are also welcome... but know your friend's limit. There will be a lot of people and potentially other dogs. Be smart. 

As we've mentioned before, these events are organized and hosted by a very small group of people (less than 5) who pay out-of-pocket and donate their time to ensure these community events continue. This year we are encouraging everyone who registers to make a donation to the club to help ensure we can continue to afford and host these events in the future. Even a small $5 donation is a big help and can cover the cost snacks for you and a few follow racers. We will also be selling Pulse Brewed Coffee at the event. Sales of which will go to funding the clubs ongoing activities. We appreciate your support and understanding!

Onto the race details!  Remember, we ask everyone to show up 25-30 minutes prior to the start of the race so that everyone gets checked in for a prompt 8:00am race start. There will be very limited restroom access (one at the park) so plan accordingly. Much like our other events, this is a free and open to folks of all skill levels. We encourage EVERYONE to participate whether from Black Diamond or not! The race will be hand-timed on an open course, and post-race snacks will be provided as usual. Course details can be found here: COURSE MAPS | TenTrailsActiveClub

In the spirit of Valentine's Day, the prize categories for this race will come with a twist and be based on 2-person teams! Don't worry, your teammate can be whoever you'd like (Max the Dog I'm looking at you!). If you'd prefer to race solo, that's cool too, but you'll need a partner to be eligible for prizes. See the list below for the official prize categories:

  • Fastest Co-Ed Adult 2-person Team
  • 2nd Fastest Co-Ed  Adult 2-person Team
  • 3rd Fastest Co-Ed Adult 2-person Team
  • Fastest Walking 2-person Team
  • Fastest Female Adult 2-person Team
  • Fastest Male Adult 2-person Team
  • Fastest Father/Daughter Team
  • Fastest Father/Son Team
  • Fastest Mother/Daughter Team
  • Fastest Mother/Son team
  • Fastest Youth (under 18) 2-person Team
  • Best Team Costume

Given the nature of these prize categories, we will not be processing the results immediately after the race as we will need some time to sort out our winners. Scoring will be cross country style and based on place (not time), so get into a good position and hold it! We will post the results as soon as possible and reach out to the winners regarding the best way to get them their prizes! Even though prizes will be delayed, we still ask that everyone please stick around when finished to cheer on the other racers.

IMPORTANT NOTE: We will again NOT be accepting day-of registration, signing up early helps us immensely in ensuring race-day check-in goes as smoothly as possible. We ask that folks try to show up 25-30 minutes prior to the start time so that we can get everyone checked in and can start the race promptly at 8:00am.

Excited to see you all out there!

 

~Coach Dalty

name: Ten Trails Active Club Trot n' Treat Relay Scramble
description:
Join the Club!

PLEASE READ ALL OF THIS

Ghosts are running amuck in Ten Trails!!! Do you and your team of Ghost Chasers have what it takes to capture and return the ghosts to their resting place a save Halloween before it's too late?!

Come join the Ten Trails Active Club in their first Relay Scramble... If you dare! This is a race, but not your typical running race. Here are the rules and objectives:

Objective:

  • You and your team must retrieve the rogue ghosts and return them to their gravestones in Civic Park
  • The first team to return all six ghosts and hit the finish button wins
  • Keep any eye out for an extra spooky ghost and win a bonus prize for its safe return
  • Awards for Best Team Name and Best Team Costume also up for grabs

Rules:

  • Your team size shall be either one, two, or three (ONLY the Team Leader needs to register!)
  • There is only one division, so teams of one are competing against teams of two and three
  • The six ghosts may be captured in any order
  • Teams may only capture and return one ghost at a time
  • With the exception of teams of one, teammates must alternate between ghost hunts (relay legs)
  • All teammates must capture an equal number of ghosts
  • Any route may be taken to capture and return the ghosts to their resting place
    • Distances shown on the map are approximations based on a reasonable path

Important Safety Notes:

  • There is no marked course for this race, runners are free to take whatever route they choose to and from the ghost locations. BE SAFE when crossing streets and when choosing the route less travelled. Look at the ghost locations beforehand and plan your routes and legs wisely!
  • It will be dark. Headlamps and flashlights are STRONGLY encouraged!
  • Kids are encouraged to participate with parents' permission. Younger kids should be accompanied by an adult during their legs of the relay.


A note from your hosts: We love hosting these free events for the community and have no plans on stopping! With that said, these events are not free to us! If you are able to donate to help keep these events going in the future, we would greatly appreciate it! Pulse Brewed Coffee contributes a portion of their sales to funding the Ten Trails Active Club, so if you'd like to support another way and love coffee, try a bag of their coffee! We promise you won't be disappointed :) 

-------

IMPORTANT: Registration for this event closes early to ensure we have time to get materials ready for each team, so please register early.

name: Thanksgiving Day Apple Cup 5K
description:
**** Please Read in Entirety ****

Thanksgiving Day Apple Cup 5K - Produced by Hi5K

Calling all Turkey Trotters to run (or walk) in the 8th Annual Thanksgiving Day Apple Cup 5K!!!

This is an Awesome way to celebrate both Thanksgiving AND Apple Cup at the same time!!!

Come sporting your  Husky  or  Cougar  colors!!! If you are not a Husky or Coug, sport your own colors!!! Or, if you want to, dress up like a Turkey - we just want you to come out and have fun AND receive an official 5K chip-timed result.

Event Information

The event will be held at Green Lake Park in Seattle. The course is a 5K on the paved loop around Green Lake with the final stretch coming around the ball fields (see course links below). From a runners perspective - this course is legit, dope, sick, wicked, 'da bomb - 'ya feel me!!! And it is flat and fast if you are after a PR.
We look forward to you joining us in this exceptionally high quality event. 
If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must register you and sign the waiver that will be presented during the registration process, otherwise if you are 18 you may register yourself.

Race Day (Thanksgiving Day) Schedule:

7:45AM - 9:10AM:
Bib Pickup at Green Lake softball fields (East side of Green Lake - Look for Hi5K Tents).  You may also drop off any canned food items you'd like to donate at this time. Day-Of-Race registration available at this time as well.
9:30AM:
 5K Race Start 
10:15 AM:
Podium Awards Begin - Top 3 in each age category (Male/Female awarded separately).
Age categories are as follows 1-11, 12-15, 16-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+
9:50AM - 10:40AM:
Post-Race Hydration and Nutrition available

Scholarships:

If you are experiencing any financial hardship, and would still like to participate, please email the race director at:
racedirector@hi5k.com

OR you can send us a message by clicking the  Questions?  button below.

We will get you signed up - no questions asked.

Bib Pickup:

Before-Race-Day:
TUE NOV 25, 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM 
Super Jock N Jill
7210 E Green Lake Dr N
Seattle, WA 98115 
WED NOV 26, 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM 
Super Jock N Jill
7210 E Green Lake Dr N
Seattle, WA 98115 
Race-Day
7:45AM - 9:10AM
Green Lake Park - START / FINISH at Green Lake Basketball Courts
7201 East Green Lake Dr N
Seattle, WA 98115

Course Info:

Start/Finish area is at the Greenlake Community Center basketball courts on the East side of Greenlake.  From the start, the race will head west toward the lake and then make an immediate right-hand turn to begin a counter-clockwise loop around the Green Lake on the inner paved path. At approximately mile 2.8 there will be a right hand-turn to exit the inner path and begin a counter-clockwise lap around the play fields (softball / soccer area). The final turn (at "Turn and Burn" corner) will be a left-hand turn with 200 meters remaining to the finish (time to kick! - it's slightly downhill too). 
Timing: This is a chip-timed event. Timing is provided by Bell Lap Productions. 
Weather: Prepare for cold or inclement weather (It's November).
Course Links:
  • https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/2805350536
  • https://ridewithgps.com/routes/31541051
Strava Segments: 
  • https://www.strava.com/segments/22375594 (Full 3.1 Mile Segment)
  • https://www.strava.com/segments/22375610 (200 Meter "Turn and Burn" Finish)
  • https://www.strava.com/segments/16058817 (Mile Somewhere in the Middle)

Donations:

Did you know that Thanksgiving is the biggest food day of the year!  This race is helps support local food shelters in their efforts to fight hunger in Washington State. If you can, please bring any non-perishable or canned food item to the race and we'll happily drop it to one of the local food shelters we support.

FAQs:

Can I participate with a stroller? 
Absolutely - we are stroller friendly.
Can I run with my dog?
Unfortunately no, USATF (USA Track & Field) will no longer insure or sanction events that allows dogs.

 We can't wait to see you!!!

name: Thanksgiving Gobble Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
Get Ready to Wobble Before You Gobble! 🦃

Join us for the annual Thanksgiving Gobble Trot! Before you dive into the turkey and stuffing, enjoy the holiday with your family, friends, and fellow runners. 🏃‍♂️💨

It’s the perfect way to burn calories and make lasting memories to balance out the big feast, before and after!
Don’t wait—spots fill up faster than the Thanksgiving table! 🍽️✨

 
Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 
Smaller Races, Warm Memories, Always Ready for You

name: The Big Cross Frozen Tundra
description:
A wintertime race to remember! There are two races to choose from: the 2.5 Mile Run/Walk and the 5 Mile Run. The Big Cross Frozen Tundra race is open to all, but we especially invite past current and future members of Tri-Cities area high schools' Cross Country and Track Teams. Represent your school and even create your own teams (i.e. Bulldogs of the 2000s, etc). During registration you will even have the chance to donate to and benefit your current local high school cross country program.  

 

FORMAT: Both Races will start at 9:30am and will take up to 120 participants each. Race bibs and giveaways will be available at the starting line at approximately 9:00am (30 minutes before start time). Race bibs will be according to race. The course is 2.5 miles in length on the woodchip/dirt/gravel trails at Big Cross in Pasco. Participants in the 5-mile run will complete two circuits of the course. 

 

TEAMS: We encourage participants to create teams and your own unique team uniforms to add to the atmosphere of the event. This is for camaraderie and adding to the spirit of the event only. Team scores will not be tracked.

 

SPECTATORS: Spectators may view the race from the designated spectator areas and/or along the course. They must however stay out of the start & finish area and avoid crossing over the race path when runners are visible on the course.

 

VOLUNTEERS: Volunteers are needed, if interested in helping as a volunteer for set-up, course monitoring, or at the start/finish line please contact galveza@pasco-wa.gov  

 

SICKNESS: All runners, spectators and volunteers should stay home if sick. 

 

RACE LOGO RUNNERS BELT: This year all participants will receive a race logo runners belt.

 

IN-PERSON REGISTRATION: Available at the Recreation Services offices in Pasco City Hall, 525 N. 3rd Ave., Pasco, until 4:00pm Thursday, January 29.

name: The Brooks Orca Half Marathon presented by REI
description:
The Brooks Orca Half is a half marathon along the shores of West Seattle, starting at Lincoln Park and finishing at Don Armeni Boat Launch. The half course is point to point, with two small out and back sections in the beginning and a longer one towards the end.  The 8-miler course is point to point, with two small out and back sections in the beginning. 

See all of race details on our website here!

VIRTUAL RACE INFO - We have 100 spots for virtual runners. Once they sell out there are no more available. You can run the distance all at once or break it up into chunks and run it on the date of your choosing. You will receive a shirt and medal that will be mailed after the in person race.

name: The Electric Cookie Run
description:
Justify your holiday cookie consumption in style at the Electric Cookie Run! It couldn't be any simpler:
Dress up in some fun holiday regalia, including some lights!

  1. Run one lap (2.8 miles) or 2 laps (5.6 miles) around Green Lake in your most festive holiday attire! Lights are encouraged! 
  2. Collect your medal.
  3. Celebrate your achievement by dining on the finest cookies from Seattle's bakeries. 
  4. Accept compliments regarding said medal on social media. Wear it to work on Monday.

Okay, so maybe it could be simpler. 
The Electric Cookie Run is professionally chip timed and USATF sanctioned.

Check out the website here!

name: The Great Ferry Race
description:
The Great Ferry Race is unlike any other race you’ve ever done. Participants will board the ferry in downtown Seattle by walking on, enjoy the scenic 35 minute crossing to Bainbridge Island, and then assemble on the car deck and walk off.  This half marathon race will start on the ferry dock and take runners all around scenic Bainbridge Island.  The course is approximately 2/3rds road and 1/3rd groomed trail.  After the run, enjoy the post-race festival before picking a return ferry of your choosing back to Seattle.

Please note that this is a hilly course, compared to most Orca Running events, and that approximately 1/3 of the course is on Bainbridge Island trails. The trails are not technical and do not require trail running experience, but runners that experience difficulty while running on trails should probably not run this race.

Bainbridge Island and Kitsap County residents who don’t need to take the ferry are welcome to attend–please select the Bainbridge resident option when registering.

Bainbridge Island residents - save $8 on your race registration (by choosing this option at checkout, you are agreeing that you live on Bainbridge Island and your registration will not include riding the ferry to the start line). 

Interested in signing up for more than one Orca Running race? Check out the Orca Running Bundle Options.

name: The Pretty Mike 5k Challenge Virtual w/meetups
description:
If you follow BeastNet, Pretty Mike, or anything OCR related you may know this challenge.  

For completing this challenge you will receive an awesome patch featuring the logo of the event.  If you choose there is an option to cover your shipping and increase the donation amounts  

This year we are opening up the Pretty Mike challenge that imitates a weight loss journey of up to 100# over the course of a 5k. In 2020 Mike lost over 100# and his friends decided to create a challenge 5k that year on Black Friday.  It was a fun event and has been hosted in two states over the past five years.  

We want to take this global and help raise funds to send The Teddy Bear Crawl Foundation and Dealers of Hope USA build funds for their 2026 Mt Kilimanjaro climb to raise awareness for childhood suicide and foster children’s struggles.

name: The Runner Stumbles
description:
The 43rd Runner Stumbles will be held at Suncadia Resort based out of Nelson Farm. The 5K run/walk and 10K run will be on paved pathways and single-track trails in a forested setting. There will be free kids races!

Logistics

Fees and Registration Dates:

    • Details coming winter 2027

Start Time for both races: 8:00 AM 
Directions: From I-90 take Exit 80 (Roslyn/Salmon La Sac).  Go two miles north and turn left into Suncadia.  Follow the signs to Nelson Farm.

Awards and Post Race Ceremony
Awards ceremony immediately following race at Nelson Farm at 9:30. 

Course Map and Information
Both the 5k and 10k distances and routes can be viewed on this map: https://caltopo.com/m/BFP2Q0N
Courses will be marked and staffed with volunteers to aid in directions. 

Course Notes: The 10k does two laps around Nelson Lakes. Once you finish your second lap, there will be a volunteer there to hand you a bracelet to indicate you have finished your first lap. Once you have finished your second lap continue on to meet back up with the 5k course. The bracelet is yours to keep!

name: The Salty Half and 10K too!
description:
Join us for a Fun Fall Run!
The 18th Annual Salty Half  and 10k too!

Saturday, October 17th, 2026 8:30am Don Armeni Boat Ramp 1222 Harbor Ave SW,  Seattle, WA 98116

 

Beautiful views of the Puget Sound and Seattle’s skyline. The best scenic run in West Seattle for only $39! If you register by September 19th.

 

The Half Marathon course is out and back from the Don Armeni Boat Ramp along Alki’s boardwalk and into Lincoln Park. You will be running on the Alki boardwalk and on the sidewalk. We will not have police stopping any traffic so please stay on the sidewalk. Runners must be able to complete the 13.1 miles in 3 hours. Support will be closed based on an 13:30 mile pace. There are several bathrooms along the boardwalk portion and in Lincoln Park. 

The 10K course is out and back from the Don Armeni Boat Ramp along Alki’s boardwalk. 

Street parking available and also a few spots in the Armeni Boat Ramp parking lot. However if you park in the boat trailer section you may be ticketed. Carpooling with another runner is encouraged. 

 

Half Marathon Awards for the top 5 male and top 5 female finishers overall. Everyone receives a custom glass Finishers' Fish designed by Bedrock Industries.

 

$39 (plus registration fee) Can't beat that price! Includes: race support, gels, electrolyte, water stations, race bid, finish line food and a hand crafted glass fish. 

Registration increases:

The 18th Annual Salty Half  and 10k too!

Saturday, October 17th, 2026 8:30am Don Armeni Boat Ramp 1222 Harbor Ave SW,  Seattle, WA 98116

 

Beautiful views of the Puget Sound and Seattle’s skyline. The best scenic run in West Seattle for only $39! If you register by September 19th.

name: The Stein Dash
description:
The Stein Dash - Brought to you by the Washington State Fair Foundation

 

5Ks are fun. Beer is fun. 5Ks & Beer are typically not a natural pairing….typically. However, on Sunday, October 11th, the best of both worlds collide for the second annual STEIN DASH – and this year will again be EXCITING, for sure! (How you ask? Keep reading…).

 

So, here's the plan. You and your bestest friends are going to meet us at the start line Sunday morning. You're going to wander over to packet pickup where you will receive a pretty sweet Commemorative Stein, an awesome event shirt, a bib number, and a high-five. Then we shoot off our gun and you get running.

 

3.1 miles is no marathon but it still requires a pit stop (or three) and honestly water at on-course stops are a thing of the past. Grab your Stein, fill it up with a different beer at each of our three Beer Zones and chug, sip, sample, taste, pound – however you want to do it – just drink that beer and get back on the course because the clock still runs as you drink.

 

We are all going to be super proud of you when you finish the race, so we'd like to celebrate with a free entry into Oktoberfest! All you have to do is keep walking….the Finish Line is going to aim you right into the amazing Festhalle at Oktoberfest NW. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy. The beer will be flowing, there's football on TVs, huge selection of awesome beer, food, WEINER DOG RACES, and of course… MORE BEER.

 

Returning This Year – The Kids Root Beer Run! Now there's a race for the under 21s! Kids 10 and under can register now for the Root Beer Run. A 1/2 Mile Kids Run with the same premise as the adults. Run, Chug Run! At the halfway mark, kids will be greeted with a root beer to chug before racing to the finish line. All registered kids will receive an awesome kids root beer run shirt, stein, and root beer inside Oktoberfest!

 

There isn't a lot more to tell you about – so just go ahead and click that "register" button at the top of the page and get signed up before we sell out

 

To allow beer stop volunteers a better opportunity to keep the beer flowing, we're asking participants to select a starting corral. Choices will be 10:00am, 10:20am, 10:40am - select your start time, tell your friends and get ready to Stein Dash!

 

ALL participants will receive:
A Sweet Stein Dash Race Shirt
A Commemorative Tasting Stein
3 On Course Beer Stops
Free Entry Into Oktoberfest (This year, a post-run beer is NOT included, but we'll hook you up on course)

 


Any questions? Shoot us an email, we'll make sure to get you answers and promise you'll still have a blast!

name: Tri-Cities Marathon
description:
Join us as we celebrate another exciting year of endurance, community, and achievement at the 43rd annual Tri-Cities Marathon! Runners of all levels are invited to take part in this long-standing tradition, bringing together athletes, families, and supporters from across the region for an unforgettable race day experience. 

New for 2026 

  • The marathon course is returning to the previous route that includes the iconic Blue Bridge and is USATF Certified.
  • And that’s not all — we’re thrilled to introduce the Tri-Cities Spooktacular 5K. If you’ve always wanted to run in this celebrated race but weren’t quite ready for the longer course, now’s your moment! Costumes welcome

 

 

Remembering Richard "Keith" Fuller. 1957-2025
1980 Tri-Cities Marathon Champion

name: Valentine's Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
💘 Celebrate love and fitness this Valentine’s Day with our charming Valentine's Run! Whether you’re running solo, with a partner, or with friends, this event is all about spreading love and joy.  Let’s make this Valentine’s unforgettable! Sign up today and let the love run wild!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: Vashon Dock to Dock Run - 15 mile Run and Relay
description:
Vashon Dock to Dock - 15 Mile Run
Sunday, August 9, 2026 | Vashon Island, WA

Online Registration closes at 9pm tonight. You can also register at the start line and pay via Venmo or Paypal. 

Race Start 9:00am at the Tahlequah Ferry. Registration on site after 7:30am

One island. Two ferries. One unforgettable challenge.

Join us for the Vashon Dock to Dock 15 Mile Run, a point-to-point adventure across the length of Vashon Island. Starting at the South End Ferry Dock in Tahlequah and finishing at the North End Ferry Dock, runners will traverse scenic island roads, rolling hills, towering forests, and breathtaking Puget Sound views.

The route follows Vashon’s picturesque west side highway and features the legendary Burma Hill Climb, a challenging ascent that rewards runners with some of the most spectacular scenery on the island. The Vashon Dock to Dock Run offers a memorable test of endurance and grit, while experiencing Vashon Island from top to bottom. 

Not ready to tackle all 15 miles yourself? Grab some friends and sign up for the 3-Person Team Relay, with each runner covering approximately five miles. The team member who volunteers to run the Burma Hill segment will receive a special Burma Hill Climb patch to commemorate their effort!

Race Highlights

15-mile point-to-point course
Start at Tahlequah Ferry Dock
Finish at North End Ferry Dock
Scenic west-side island route
The iconic Burma Hill Climb
3-Person Team Relay option
Fully supported aid stations
Finisher celebration at the finish line
All paces welcome.
Run it solo. Relay it with friends. Experience Vashon Island from dock to dock.

To sign up for a relay, have each individual register themselves and then you can form up as a team on race day. 

Flostate Running and sponsors will provide prizes for the top finishers (both individuals and teams) along with raffles, giveaways, and swag from some of your favorite brands in the world of running! Swing by Flostate Running in downtown Vashon for last minute needs. All participants get 10% off the weekend of the event!

Optional shuttles will be provided to bring runners from the north end to the start line at the Tahlequah ferry, to bring finishers back to the south end for the tacoma ferry, and to bring relay runners to/from checkpoints. 

Route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3500250186340609018

More information and registration:
www.flostaterunning.com

name: Washington State Marathon
description:
Finally!  A flat, fast full marathon in the Seattle area, the inaugural Washington State Marathon promises to deliver a stunning point-to-point race. Starting at Marymoor Park along the Sammamish River and Burke-Gilman Trails, explore Redmond, Woodinville, Bothell, Kenmore and Lake Forest Park before arriving to in Seattle Gas Works Park. Soak in all the scenery as you wind through river corridors and wooded paths before delivering you to a finish line framed by the Seattle skyline. 

Whether you're chasing a personal record, an elusive Boston qualifier, or a first-time finish, this race allows you to achieve your true potential. The well supported, flat, paved trail surface makes it one of the most PR-friendly courses in the Pacific Northwest, while the natural beauty of the route makes every mile worth savoring. Come run the most scenic 26.2 miles in Washington State.

name: Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Race Series #1
description:
2027 is the first year of our 3rd decade of racing!!!!.  22 years running of racing on Wednesday Nights in May and June.   Thanks to all who have raced with us over the years!  If you are new to our Series of Wednesday night fun, welcome!!

This is a race series for EVERYONE! As long as you have a bicycle worthy of being ridden on dirt, and can pedal it, you can do this! If you are a pro, it’s great for training. If you are new to Mountain Biking and/or Riverside State Park, it’s a great way to learn the trails and make new friends.

We use the term “race” loosely. We are all about fun and keeping it simple! Come out on Wednesday Nights and ride your bike. Pedal as hard as you want or casually if you want. If pedaling casually, do keep in mind that it will eventually get dark! New course every week. Random prize drawings and cold drinks will be waiting for you at the Finish Line.

name: Where's Bigfoot 5k
description:
Bigfoot has been spotted in Ravenna Park.


The question is...


Can you find him?


Run or walk through one of Seattle’s most wooded parks while keeping your eyes open for Bigfoot sightings, footprints, clues and a few surprises along the way.


All ages and paces are welcome.

name: Wicked Fast 5K & 10K
description:
Continuing the Halloween 5K tradition here in Tacoma we have added a 10k distance to the event! The Wicked Fast 5K & 10k registration will include t-shirts and Halloween themed medals that are sure to scare the daylights out of you!

This flat and fast 5K & 10K course features Tacoma's beautiful waterfront with 1 out and back. So you’ll get lots of opportunities to scare your friends. Once you turn back on to the Water Walk at the Giant Octopus Mural you’ll have a frightfully flat and fast jaunt back to Dune Peninsula Park where Frank Herberts Spice Worm statue art will be waiting for you. ~ Dune the Movie

The Kids 1K Run will begin at the sane start finish as the 5K & 10k and run around Dune Peninsula Park and back through the finish line!

Halloween costumes are not required, but STRONGLY encouraged!

name: Wilridge Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, June 12, 2027 at 6:00pm for an exciting annual event that features the amazing scenery and landscape of Wilridge Vineyard, Winery & Distillery! Wilridge Winery is the "Greenest Winery" in Washington and is proud to be the first certified Organic, Biodynamic and Salmon Safe vineyard and winery in the state. Whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience!  This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing. name: Woodinville Turkey Trot 5K
description:
The Annual Woodinville Turkey Trot is ready to roll this year!     We are planning of having the Kids Parade again this year led by the Woodinville HS Marching band.  At our Kids Dash the kids 6 and under will run a short course of about 200 yards on the trail and finish under the start/finish arch.   The morning should be a great way to get your Thanksgiving Day off to a great start before that all important turkey dinner.  

This year we will have 2 different events including:

1.      5K at Wilmot Park 

2.      Virtual 5K

3.       Kid's Dash

Our event continues to be hosted by Woodinville Running Company with a portion of the proceeds and 100% of the sponsorship dollars going to the Woodinville HS Boosters Wrestling Team.    Look for the t-shirt reveal soon.  

As for the events

5K at Wilmot Park

The 5K will begin run after we complete the Kids Dash which should be approximately 9:15am.  The course is a flat, fast out and back course on the Sammamish River trail.  Runners will organized by running pace so please seat yourself accordingly.  Your official time won't begin until you've reached the timing mats under the arch.

Virtual 5k

The Virtual 5k is the same as last year and this allows you to pick your own course and run or walk 3.1 miles and then submit your time.  This is a great option for those who want to social distance, but still have a goal to shoot for and get a great running shirt!  This category is not eligible for the age group 

This year’s Turkey Trot is going to be a great event.  We are excited to be Wilmot Park and being together in beautiful downtown Woodinville with friends and family on Thanksgiving morning.  So, let’s have fun, stay safe and be thankful for the many blessings of what went well this year.

name: Woolley Trail Runs
description:
Woolley Trail Runs are a 50k, Marathon, and Half Marathon located in Sedro Woolley Washington. All three runs are out and back with a few road crossings. Participants will heed traffic while crossing all roads, there will be NO crossing guards. As with all NW Ultra events these are meant to be fun runs with limited aid. Any diversion from the trail will be marked as well as all turnaround points. All three courses are out and back on railroad grade gravel path. The course has a slight (unnoticeable) uphill grade on the way out, with of course the same downhill grade on the return. There will be an aid station at each of the turnaround points (6.6 miles, 13.15 miles, 15.7 miles) and mile 4. Plan on carrying water and aid.  This is not a USATF certified course and you can’t qualify for Boston, but it is at least the advertised distance.

COURSE INFORMATION:
The course starts a quarter of a mile west of the trail head off Fruitdale Rd & SR 20. It continues east along the Cascade Trail. For a full map of the Cascade Trail please visit the Skagit County Parks & Recreation’s website here.

DROP BAGS:
Drop bags can be dropped off at the start the morning of the race.  Drop bags will be allowed at all aid stations.  Please mark on your drop bags your bib #, which aid station it goes to (mile marker) and your name.  They will not be returned until after the last runner has left each aid station, or participants may drive out to retrieve their bags.  If participants do not retrieve their drop bags they will be donated, we will not mail them to you.

START TIMES:
The official start time is 9:00 am.  All runners starting at the official time will be eligible for awards. 
The early start time is 8:00.  Runners opting to start early will not be eligible for awards.  Runners starting early are doing so because they expect to finish after the course closure time, if they start at the official time.
Minimum finish times will be given to all early start runners running faster the following times.  If you plan on running faster than these times you need to start at 9:00 am! 
1/2 Marathon – 2:30 minimum time 
Marathon – 5:00 minimum time 
50k – 6:00 minimum time 

DIRECTIONS TO EVENT:
Add your starting point to the following google map to find detailed directions.(Google Map) From Interstate 5 (I-5) take exit #232/Cook Road towards Sedro Woolley.  Drive east on Cook road 4.3 miles and take a left onto North Cascades Highway.  Drive 1.1 miles along North Cascades Highway until you reach Township Street.  Take a right on Township Street and drive 0.2 miles to Polte Road.  Take a left onto Polte Road.  Parking can be found 0.2 miles later at the Central United Methodist Church (1012 Polte Rd, Sedro Woolley, WA) just across the street from the trail head.

name: Yakima River Canyon Marathon and Half-Marathon
description:
Join us for one of the Pacific Northwest's most scenic Boston Qualifiers. Our marathon and half marathon point to point courses travel through the spectacular Yakima River Canyon on a USATF Certified course along paved Washington State Route 821 between Ellensburg and Selah, WA. 

 

Awards: We will offer overall and age-group awards this year. Awards will be distributed in real time at the finish line -- check for results at nsplit.com/results.  Details below.

 

Cutoff Times: We will enforce cut-off times this year. Those who feel that cannot complete the race comfortably in seven hours are urged to contact the race director and ask for the early start, which is two hours before the 8 a.m. regular start. We offer the early start for those anticipating they will be on the course for six-and-a-half hours or more, and the race director must approve your participation in the early start. Early starters are not eligible for age-group awards, which are handed out in real time at the finish line. Thank you for your understanding.

 

Price Increase: Marathon and Half Marathon prices increase by $10 on after Feb 27. Sign up early! Registration is online only, and there is no in person registration on race day or the day before.

 

Race Deferrals: If you decide to defer your entry to next year, the deadline for informing us is March 27.

 

Half Marathon Limited to 250 Runners: Good news! We are raising the entry cap to 250 in the half-marathon; entries are limited due to logistics involving bus transportation. At this point, we have no limit on marathon participants.

 

RACE HEADQUARTERS: Selah Civic Center, 216 South First Street, Selah, Washington.

 

Entry Includes: The (Non-Refundable) Entry includes T-shirt, race-day transportation (if needed), finisher medal, and a finisher’s certificate.

 

WEEKEND SCHEDULE

  • FRIDAY, April 2:
    • Packet pickup for the Marathon and Half-Marathon from 3-8 p.m. at the Selah Civic Center..
  • SATURDAY, April 3 (Race Day):
    • Marathon packet pickup Saturday morning at the Ellensburg Days Inn, near the intersection of Berry Road and Canyon Road from 6-7:45 a.m.
    • Half-Marathon packet pickup Saturday morning at the Selah Civic Center from 6-7:45 a.m.

COURSE RECORDS, MAPS & DESCRIPTIONS:

  • COURSE RECORDS (Marathon & Half Marathon) – Click Here

    START MAP – Click Here

    FINISH MAP – Click Here

 

MARATHON RACE START 
Use Exit 109 from I-90. Go south past the Buzz Inn and Flying J Truck Plaza. Take the first left onto Berry Road…to the race start headquarters at the Days Inn, 901 Berry Road. The starting line is on Canyon Road .2 mile south of the Berry Road intersection. (see map)  For safety reasons running in the right lane is recommended, but not mandatory.

 

MARATHON COURSE DESCRIPTION: This point-to-point Marathon course is exceptionally scenic as it offers spectacular views of the Yakima River Canyon. It starts on Canyon Road .2 mile south of the Berry Road intersection in Ellensburg, Wash. After two loops, it proceeds directly south to the canyon. There are two major hills and many curves as the course follows the Yakima River downstream on the asphalt surfaced highway. The long downhill just before the finish in rural Selah, Washington, near the canyon’s mouth contributes to the net elevation loss of a few hundred feet as it brings the runners to the Yakima Valley orchard and ranch country.

 

PERSONAL GEAR:
Drop bags to go to the Finish Area may be left at the designated vehicle in front of the Days Inn on race morning before 7:45 a.m. Do not place cash or expensive items in the bags. The bags will be supervised, but we will not be responsible for lost or stolen items.

 

COURSE SUPPORT:
Aid stations will be located every 2-3 miles to provide water, Powerade, and medical aid of band-aids and petroleum jelly. Medical personnel and restrooms will be available throughout the race.

 

RACE FINISH:
Use exit 26 from I-82. Take Highway 821 north about 3 miles. (see map)
There will be bus transportation from the finish area to the Selah Civic Center and to the Best Western Ahtanum Inn.

 

COURSE CLOSURE:
The course will be open for 7 hours. Runners and walkers who have not finished by 3:00 p.m. will be given rides to the finish area. Early starts are allowed only with special permission. Only official and local vehicles are allowed on the race course. Spectators may view the race at the start, finish, and Thrall Road intersection with Canyon Road. There are no accessible intersections in the canyon. No bicycles or baby joggers are allowed on the course.

 

HALF-MARATHON INFORMATION

COURSE MAP – Click Here

HALF MARATHON RACE START TIME & LOCATION:
The 9:30 a.m. start is at the 13.1 mile marker of the Marathon. All participants will be bused to the start. At 8:00 a.m. three buses will leave the Selah Civic Center, 216 South First Street, Selah, WA and one will leave from the Best Western Ahtanum Inn, 2408 Rudkin Road, Yakima, WA. There will be no early starts.

 

HALF MARATHON COURSE DESCRIPTION: This Half-Marathon course will start at the 13.1-Mile mark of the Marathon Course for a point-to-point. The course is exceptionally scenic as it offers spectacular views of the Yakima River Canyon. The Half Marathon Participants will be bused to the start (no need to reserve bus). Three buses will leave the Civic Center at 8:00 a.m. for the starting area, and one bus will leave the Best Western Ahtanum Inn (2408 Rudkin Road, Yakima) at 8:00 a.m.  SPECIAL NOTE:  NO EARLY START

 

Personal Gear to be taken to the Finish Area: 
Drop bags may be left on a designated bus at the start.

 

Course Closure:
The course will close at 3:00 p.m.

 

BUS SERVICE

  • MARATHON – Buses will leave at 6:00 a.m. from the Selah Civic Center and the Best Western Ahtanum Inn to take participants to the Days Inn gathering area in Ellensburg.
  • HALF MARATHON – Buses will leave at 8:00 a.m. from the Selah Civic Center and the Best Western Ahtanum Inn for the starting line at the 13.1 mile marker of the half marathon.

 
 
AWARDS & DIVISIONS:
Awards will be presented to the top three male and female finishers and to the first three finishers in the age divisions (male & female 19 and under, then five year increments to 85+). Awards will be distributed in real time at the finish line -- check for results at nsplit.com/results. All entrants will receive a T-shirt, and all finishers will receive a finishers medal.

name: Yakima River Canyon Marathon and Half-Marathon
description:
Join us for one of the Pacific Northwest's most scenic Boston Qualifiers. Our marathon and half marathon point to point courses travel through the spectacular Yakima River Canyon on a USATF Certified course along paved Washington State Route 821 between Ellensburg and Selah, WA. 

 

Awards: We will offer overall and age-group awards this year. Awards will be distributed in real time at the finish line -- check for results at nsplit.com/results.  Details below.

 

Cutoff Times: We will enforce cut-off times this year. Those who feel that cannot complete the race comfortably in seven hours are urged to contact the race director and ask for the early start, which is two hours before the 8 a.m. regular start. We offer the early start for those anticipating they will be on the course for six-and-a-half hours or more, and the race director must approve your participation in the early start. Early starters are not eligible for age-group awards, which are handed out in real time at the finish line. Thank you for your understanding.

 

Price Increase: Marathon and Half Marathon prices increase by $10 on after Feb 27. Sign up early! Registration is online only, and there is no in person registration on race day or the day before.

 

Race Deferrals: If you decide to defer your entry to next year, the deadline for informing us is March 27.

 

Half Marathon Limited to 250 Runners: Good news! We are raising the entry cap to 250 in the half-marathon; entries are limited due to logistics involving bus transportation. At this point, we have no limit on marathon participants.

 

RACE HEADQUARTERS: Selah Civic Center, 216 South First Street, Selah, Washington.

 

Entry Includes: The (Non-Refundable) Entry includes T-shirt, race-day transportation (if needed), finisher medal, and a finisher’s certificate.

name: 2026 Ashland Monster Dash Run for Education
description:
The 18th Annual Monster Dash Run for Education can be run either IN-PERSON OR VIRTUALLY!

Either way, it's going to be awesome. This race support grants in Ashland Public Schools through the Ashland Schools Foundation (ASF). In 2025-26, ASF funded over 125 grant requests from local teachers and administrators. Now, we're counting on YOU (and your family, and friends, and neighbors...) to register for this year's Monster Dash and ensure it's bigger than ever!

See the event website for details on both the in-person and virtual events: www.ashlandmonsterdash.com 

 
How to register...

STEP 1: Decide if you'll be racing in-person (at Lithia Park on Saturday, Oct 24th), or doing your own virtual race between Oct 20th and 31st. Prices are the same for either option. Youth 18 and under are ALWAYS just $10 per race!

STEP 2: Decide which distance you'll be registering for (1-Mile, 5K, 10K).
10K start time:  8:45am
5K start time: 9:00am
1-MILE start time: 10:45am

STEP 3: Click Sign Up button at the top of the page to register yourself AND your family members all at one time (you'll save money on fees). NOTE: Signup for in-person races will end at 8am on Race Day. There will not be registration available at the race on race day. 

STEP 4: Don't forget the extras during registration! Order race t-shirts (must pre-order by Oct 10th) or make a donation to our school grants fund!

STEP 5: Follow the directions in your follow-up email regarding Packet Pickup (for all runners), and uploading your race time (for virtual runners). 

STEP 6: Show up and run your race! Whether you're running on race day in Lithia Park, or with friends and family for your own personal Monster Dash, HAVE FUN! 

And don't forget to enter our contests for prizes!

Plus, anyone can bid on our online auction items (open Oct 1st through 31st) so check it out and spread the word!

name: 2026 Happy Girls Sisters
description:
Enjoy some bonding time with women of all ages and levels in the appropriately named town of Sisters, Oregon. Choose between the all-women’s trail half marathon featuring single-track in the Deschutes National Forest (on the Peterson Ridge Trail system) with some pretty stellar views or take part in the 5K and 10K road race that winds through scenic downtown Sisters. All races cross the same finish line, welcoming all to enjoy the beautiful FivePine campus under the towering Ponderosa pines.

**Make sure to register early – the half marathon is limited to 500 runners and sells out every year.

name: 2026 Miller Woods 10K & 5K - Supporting Yamhill County CASA
description:
The Miller Woods 10K & 5K is back! Presented in collaboration with the Yamhill Soil and Water Conservation District, this event brings together trail running, nature, and community support at one of Yamhill County’s most beautiful outdoor spaces.

Choose the 10K trail run or the 5K run/walk and experience Miller Woods as the course takes you through wooded trails and open meadows. The 5K welcomes both runners and walkers, making this an event for experienced racers, first-time participants, and anyone who wants to enjoy time outdoors while supporting a meaningful local cause.

Proceeds benefit Yamhill County CASA and its work to provide trained volunteer advocates for children in foster care throughout Yamhill County. Every registration helps move us closer to ensuring that every child who needs a CASA has someone consistently advocating for their needs, safety, and future.

Event T-shirts will be available for purchase during registration, and every registered participant will receive a native plant to take home.

Race Day Schedule

10K Trail Run

7:30 am: Check-in and bib pickup begin
8:30 am: 10K starts

5K Run/Walk

11:00 am: Check-in and bib pickup begin
12:00 pm: 5K starts

Race Routes

10K Route

5K Route

Kids Outdoor Camp
We’re excited to partner with Outdoor Education Adventures to offer a Kids Outdoor Camp during both races!

The camp is available for children ages 5–12 whose parent or guardian is participating in the race. While you’re out on the trails, kids will spend time near the Miller Woods house and barn enjoying outdoor activities led by Outdoor Education Adventures.

Space is limited to 20 children per race.

Kids Camp can be added during race registration at no additional cost. Parents/guardians will need to complete a waiver on race day before dropping their child off.

Already registered? You can return to your registration to add Kids Camp while space is available.

Timing
Both races will be professionally chip timed by Huber Timing, with official results available after each race.

Awards

Awards will be presented for both the 10K and 5K to the top overall male and female finishers, as well as the top male and female finisher in four age groups.

19 and under

20–34

35–49

50+

Parking

Parking at Miller Woods is extremely limited. A $5 parking pass is required for each vehicle and must be purchased in advance. Parking pass proceeds go directly to Miller Woods. Only 60 parking passes are available for each event, so participants are strongly encouraged to carpool. Additional parking and arrival information will be shared with registered participants before race day.

name: 2026 Rogue Gorge
description:
Welcome to the Rogue Gorge, offering incredibly beautiful and challenging 50K, Half Marathon & 12K trail races and NEW for 2025, a point-to-point, downriver 50 miler, all entirely along the iconic Upper Rogue Wild & Scenic River in the Southern Oregon Cascades! The Rogue Gorge Trail and Upper Rogue River Trail (a National Recreation Trail) provide miles of enchanting singletrack trails through the most vibrant fall foliage unmatched anywhere in Oregon, hugging tightly to the old growth forested bluffs above the famous river as it churns its way through collapsed lava tube chasms, cascading waterfalls and underground tunnels. We love hosting this event on the awe-inspiring Upper Rogue River!

The cataclysmic volcanic eruption of Mt. Mazama that created Crater Lake 7,700 years ago forever changed the lands we now know as Oregon. The legacy of the eruption can be found throughout Southern Oregon, and nowhere is it more evident than on the Upper Rogue River, just 20 miles west of Crater Lake National Park. Once buried by hundreds of feet of pumice, ash and lava after the eruption, the Rogue River has freed itself over the millennia through the relentless erosive power of its waters, creating a series of fascinating features in the process. The river thunders and boils through hard basalt lava and pumice canyons at Rogue Gorge and Takelma Gorge, disappears underground through ancient lava tubes at Natural Bridge and drops off numerous waterfalls in a lush, sweet-scented old growth forest of colossal Douglas fir, ponderosa pine and sugar pine.

Land Acknowledgement: We honor and recognize that we gather for this event on the traditional lands of the Takelma, Southern Molalla and Klamath peoples, who have occupied and stewarded these lands for countless generations. We respect their right to self-determination and their sacred connection to these lands and waters.

name: 2026 Run for Health Justice
description:
🏆 Why Join? Not only is this going to be a fantastic and fun-filled morning, but it's also for a great cause. By participating in our Fun Run, you'll be supporting OHJC's mission of improving health outcomes through trauma-informed legal interventions.

🎉 Fun for Everyone: This event isn't just for seasoned runners; it's a day of celebration for the whole community! Walk, jog, or run—it's all about participation. No timing chips or bibs, just community and fun. We will have a raffle at the event with a variety of goodies from our community sponsors. Come dressed in your favorite Halloween attire, whether festive colors or a full costume- we want to get spooky!!

🌟 We can't wait to see all your smiling faces at the starting line! Let's run (or walk), have fun, and make a real difference in the lives of those who need it most. Together, we can achieve great things! 

IF YOU CHOOSE TO 'BECOME A FUNDRAISER' AND YOU RAISE $250, YOUR REGISTRATION COST WILL BE REFUNDED!

name: 2027 Conquer the Canyon
description:
Join us June 5, 2027 for Conquer the Canyon - HALF MARATHON (13.1 miles), 10K, and 5K! And the 5K Doggie Dash!

Cruise through Redmond’s Dry Canyon Trail which boasts stunning high desert geological features and peaceful scenic surroundings. The majority of the Dry Canyon is a nature preserve with steep rocky walls - a tribute to the area’s volcanic past. The course also weaves through Redmond's town center. Catch impressive natural views and traditional city scenes featuring pavilions and historic landmarks.

Choose your distance: 5K, 10K or 1/2 marathon.

Each race is professionally chip-timed by Eclectic Edge Racing and supported by outstanding event staff and medical personnel who are there for you at every turn. Meet friends and family at the post-race party with music, food and drink! Beautiful custom-designed medals await every runner at the finish line.

RACE SCHEDULE

Packet Pickup: Friday, June 4 from 2-6pm at SCP Redmond Hotel (Downtown Redmond). You may also pick up your packet one hour before your race time at the race.

RACE START TIMES

  • Half Marathon - 9am
  • 10K - 9:15am
  • 5K - 9:30am
  • 5K Doggie Dash - 9:33am

Starting line and finish and after party is in Centennial Park in Redmond.

All finishers receive a custom-made medal, food and drink at the after-party!

name: 2027 Happy Girls Bend Run
description:
Calling all Happy Girls!!

The 17th Annual Happy Girls Run series returns to Central Oregon with its first race of the season in Bend, Oregon. Participants of all abilities can choose from the all-women’s Half Marathon, 10K, or 5K races.

name: 2027 Hot Cocoa Run
description:
Join us on Sunday, Feb 14 for the return of the Hot Cocoa Run!

⭐️ Race entry includes admission to all three days of WinterFest! ⭐️

 

Early registration will close on Thursday, February 11 at midnight. Any latecomers can sign up on-site on Sunday morning starting at 11 am.

RACE STARTS AT NOON

🚨 Check-In Details 🚨
WinterFest entry is included with your registration! All Hot Cocoa Run attendees will receive an emailed WinterFest ticket to your email on file for the run. You will use this ticket to gain entry to WinterFest NOT your registration. Our volunteers at the entry gates can also look up your name if you can not find your WinterFest ticket.

Don't forget to check in! Your QR code will be scanned to get your registration information. Print your QR code or have it available on your phone when you arrive. 

Check-In Options

Bib pickup will be available at the Pavilion on race morning, Sunday February 14
Location: SEE COURSE MAP FOR EXACT LOCATION. We will do our best to have signage to direct you to the start area.
Date: Sunday, February 14
Check In Time: 11 am -12 pm

Race starts promptly at noon.

A fun 5K with a full Hot Cocoa bar at the finish with toppings and Crater Lake spirits.

This will be an untimed 5K loop on Sunday at noon during the Northwest’s biggest festival. A full hot cocoa bar with all the toppings and Crater Lake spirits, including espresso vodka, await one and all at the finish line. Costumes are encouraged!

name: 2027 Salmon Run
description:
Join us for the 39th annual Salmon Run which returns to Bend, Oregon on April 17, 2027.

Distances include the HALF MARATHON (13.1 miles), 10K, and 5K races. All courses weave along the beautiful Deschutes River on trails and some pavement.

Taking place in the spring, the Salmon Run is one of the first running events of the season and the essential tip-off to the local racing scene in Central Oregon. Traversing beautiful dirt and paved trails amongst junipers and pines, the race course winds through some of the most scenic natural areas in Bend and finishes on the lawn Riverbend Park. Make a weekend of it!

Course Details  

The Salmon Run course takes runners along the beautiful and picturesque Deschutes River.  The half marathon course is 75% paved sidewalks and 25% trail.  The 10K course is 80% paved sidewalks and 20% trail.  The 5K is 65% paved sidewalks and 35% trail.  All courses will be marked with a combination of mile markers and directional arrows.

Finish Line Festivities

Enjoy a post-race party with delicious food and beverages (beer!) and music. We’ve got gift bags and awards for the top three male and female finishers in both open and master’s categories! 1st, 2nd & 3rd place ribbons for top age-group finishers.

Parking for Race Day

There is limited parking at Riverbend Park on race day. We highly recommend carpooling. Parking attendants will direct you as you arrive. Additional parking is available on City streets. 

For full details regarding the Salmon Run, click here.

name: 20th Annual - 2026 Give n' Gobble Turkey Trot
description:
The Sherwood Turkey Trot tradition continues for its 20th year!

A family discount is available when you register multiple people together. The family discount is only available if all members live in the same household.
To get the family discount, select "Family Package" under Multi-Person Pricing on the 1st registration step

There is also a team discount if you join a team with more than 10 people on it. 

This registration page is for all types of registration: Family, Team, and Individual.

The race will take place in Sherwood on Thanksgiving morning. 
The race's location this year will likely be Sherwood High School rather than Sherwood Middle School. Please check back closer to event for final confirmation.
The 5K Walk starts at 9:00am and the 5K Run and 10K Run starts at 9:05am.

Bib Pick Up and Food Donation Dropoff Times:
There are two bib pick up options:
1) Recommended: Saturday before Thanksgiving (11/21) at Sherwood YMCA
🕓 Time: 12pm to 2pm
📍Address: 
Sherwood Regional Family YMCA
23000 SW Pacific Highway
Sherwood, OR 97140

You must register by end of day Thursday 11/29 to pick up at the Saturday packet pickup

2) Before the event starting at 8am Sherwood High School. Make sure to arrive early if you wish to do this option.

At both locations you can bring a bag of nonperishable food (or 3 cans or a box of cereal - or more!) to receive your shirt

If you are a family or team, all of your family or team's bibs will be in one packet. One person should pick up the packet and distribute to the rest of the family or team At the Saturday bib pickup or race, you can bring a bag of nonperishable food (or 3 cans or a box of cereal - or more!) to receive your shirt

If you are registering with a sponsor code, your bib and shirt will only be available on race day in our VIP area.

name: 4th Annual Turkey Trot- Robert Frost PTC
description:
Before you dive into the pumpkin pie and all the trimmings come participate in the 4th Annual Turkey Trot hosted by the Robert Frost Parent Teacher Club.  Whether you're a serious athlete, a walk-and-talk kind of person, looking for an activity to get the kiddos out of the house, or avoiding your in-laws (we won't tell), the Turkey Trot is the place to be on Thanksgiving morning. 

The PTC is excited to be working with the Silverton Runners Club this year.  They helped us design a brand new 5K-course and a separate 1-mile fun run/walk.  Also new this year, participants will have the option to purchase additional raffle tickets.

The 5K Course will start at 8:30 am and is $25 for adults, $10 for students age 6-18, and free for kids 0-5 with a paid adult.  This pricing will be calculated based on birthdate entered during registration.  No extra coupon code is required. 

Please note that the 5-K Course is not a closed course. Event route is on public sidewalks along streets with vehicle traffic and does cross commercial driveways.  Walkers are allowed on the 5-K course, we ask that you consider congregating towards the rear of the starting area to allow runners plenty of space to get started.

The 1-mile Fun Run/Walk will start at 8:40 am and is $10 for adults, $5 for students age 6-18, and free for kids 0-5 with a paid adult.  This pricing will be calculated based on birthdate entered during registration.  No extra coupon code is required.  

Accessibility note: the 1-mile fun run/walk will take place on the wood chip/gravel path behind the school and the Silverton Baptist Church.  Please be aware that there may be uneven surfaces on the course.  Jogger strollers and multi-terrain accessibility aids may be able to navigate this area, but umbrella strollers and standard wheelchairs may have be limited in their use.  Please use personal discretion.    

Pricing and registration are live until 11/25/26 at 11:59pm.  Same day registration will be available but is $5 more per runner/per event so save a few dollars and register today! 

Really want to participate but the price feels a little steep?  Please reach out to us at info@robertfrost.org and let us problem solve with you- we don't want anyone to miss out!

All participants will receive a raffle ticket to enter into a prize basket of choice.  Prizes donated so far include items and gift certificates from:

Betsy and Iya, Langer's, McMenamins, Museum of Natural History, Wanderlust Tours, Maverick's league, Portland Nursery, Burgerville, Owl Crate Books, Ankeny Vineyard, EZ Orchard, Silverton Farmers Market, Fluffy Butt Alpacas, Top Golf.

We'd love as many Robert Frost Bears as possible to participate; students and staff of RF will receive an extra raffle ticket!

Check-in/Post-race: Please check in for your race in front of Robert Frost Elementary.  Tables will be set up to check-in, get your race bib, and take a look at raffle prizes.  The 5K will start just up the sidewalk at the Silverton 55+ plus/Pickleball area.  This turn-in will be closed off from 8-9am so please park elsewhere.  The Fun-Run will start from Robert Frost Elementary.  Both races will finish in front of the school.  Raffle tickets will be drawn at 9am and posted for participants to see winning numbers.  Raffle winners must check the winning numbers and present their ticket prior to the conclusion of the event.  Items not picked up will be used as prizes at a different fundraiser and/or at next years event.

Parking: Every year parking is snug so please allow extra time to park and get to the check-in area.  The Robert Frost Parking Lot and the Silverton 55+ Center lots will be closed off and not available for participant parking.  There will be a small amount of spots available at the Silverton First Baptist Church but car-pooling, neighborhood street parking, or getting dropped off (your driver can hit up one of several coffee places near the school) are highly encouraged!

Donations: Don't want to roll out of bed early on Thanksgiving?  Braving the airport or I5 and won't be around?  The Robert Frost Parent Teacher Club is a registered non-profit and we support the students of Robert Frost through donations.  Please consider making a contribution to the PTC via the Donation page.  We greatly appreciate it!

The fine details: The following things are welcomed at this event: all-ages, festive costumes, strollers, and headphones/ear buds.  Please no bikes, scooters, or skateboards. Tobacco products, weapons, and controlled substances are not permitted on the RF school campus.  There will be no aid station or event restrooms along the route. Restrooms, water, and snacks will be available at the start/finish locations. Event photos may be captured along the route, but no professional photography is offered.

name: ADFK 5k Trick or Trot!
description:
Join Acorn Dentistry For Kids for our third annual 5k Fun Run & Walk at Riverfront City Park as we come together to raise money for Acorn Kids International Charities and Every Child. This year's event falls on Halloween, and we're excited to turn it into a spooktacular celebration! Whether you run, walk, push a stroller, or simply come to cheer, everyone is welcome.

Your registration helps:

🌍 Acorn Kids International
Helping children in Kenya receive education, care, and support. Learn more here: https://acorndentistryforkids.com/acorn-kids-international-charities/

🏡 Every Child Oregon
Supporting children and families impacted by foster care right here in Oregon. Learn more about Every Child here: https://everychildoregon.org/

100% of proceeds benefit these organizations.

name: AMIGOS 5K
description:
Saturday, May 22, 2027 | Rood Bridge Park, Hillsboro, OR

Join us for the first annual AMIGOS 5K, a family-friendly morning of running, community, and fun in support of Organización de Amigos (AMIGOS). Every dollar raised helps provide free after-school CrossFit and mentorship programming to elementary-age students across the Beaverton and Hillsboro School Districts.

The morning kicks off with a Youth Fun Run for kids 12 and under, followed by a Teen 1K for ages 13-15, then the adult 5K along the scenic paved trails of Rood Bridge Park, winding past the Tualatin River, Woodland Pond, and the Rhododendron Garden. Whether you run, jog, or walk the course, everyone is welcome. You can be a seasoned runner or joining us for your very first 5K, this event is about showing up for the kids and families who make AMIGOS possible.

Bring your crew, register as a group, and help us cross the finish line toward a stronger community.

Event Details:

  • Youth Fun Run (12 & under): Free, Woodland Pond + East Side Loop (~0.54 mi)
  • Teen 1K (13-15): Free, Lake Side Loop (~0.68 mi)
  • Adult 5K: $35 individual / $125 for a group of 5, 2 laps of paved perimeter trail (~3.1 mi)
  • Location: Rood Bridge Park, 4000 SE Rood Bridge Rd, Hillsboro, OR 97123
  • Walkers welcome, all paces and abilities encouraged

All proceeds benefit AMIGOS's free youth programming

name: Annual All Abilities Turkey Trot
description:
Annual All Abilities Turkey Trot!

Hosted by the Intellectual & Developmental Disabilities Program (CCMH), Columbia County I/DD Advisory Council, ISN this inclusive event invites people of all ages and abilities to participate. The fun takes place on Saturday, August 16th, at the Scappoose High School Track.

Check-in begins at 10:00 AM, Turkey Trot begins at 11:00 AM. How many laps can you complete in 1-hour? 

Funds raised will support your local Community Developmental Disabilities Programs. Join in for a day of fun, fitness, and community spirit!

description:
Welcome to the Bend Marathon, Half Marathon, 10k and 5k. With local ownership the 2027 events will be the best mountain town races anywhere. name: Best in the West Triathlon Festival
description:
Best in the West Triathlon Festival - Designed by athletes, for athletes!

Nestled in the foothills of the Cascades and fed by the Santiam River, Foster Reservoir offers premier recreation facilities to the outdoor enthusiast and an excellent location for a triathlon festival.

name: Cascade Half Marathon & 10K
description:
The races will be held on Sunday, January 17, 2027. The Half Marathon, 10K, and 2-mile races run on a flat course on country roads, surrounded by scenic farmland. There are water stations and toilets on the course. There is an early option for those expecting to take longer than 2.5 hours to run the Half Marathon. Day of race registration is an option, cash or check is preferred, but we will have an option for credit card.

Race start times below - 

      Half Marathon: 9 AM
      Half Marathon - early start: 8:30 AM
      10k: 9:15 AM
      2-mil: 9:15 AM

All finishers will receive a medal as they finish. Awards will be given to the male and female overall and masters winners in the Half Marathon and 10K, as well as three-deep for age group winners, per 10-year age category. No awards will be given for the 2-mile race. Early starters' results in the Half Marathon will not be considered for overall or age group awards. There will also be many random prize giveaways from our generous sponsors! To become a sponsor, please contact us below.

 

Packet pickup is in the junior high school gym starting at 7:00 AM, where race participants can relax, stretch, and stay warm. Families and friends can hang out in the gym, too. We will have a coffee cart on site, courtesy of I-Jive coffee. Since the race starts and finishes right in front of the gym, you can stay inside until the last minute! Afterward, you can celebrate your accomplishments in the school's cafeteria with hot soup!

 

Proceeds from the race will benefit Cascade High School's track & field program, as well as provide scholarships to graduating high school seniors from the mid-Willamette Valley who wish to continue their education.

*Day of race registration will be $5 more and can be paid with cash/check/credit card.

**Day of registration is not guaranteed a finisher medal, as a limit has been ordered. Instead, a finisher ribbon will be awarded. 

***Dogs are not allowed on the race course.

name: Dallas Glow Run
description: The Dallas Glow Run/Walk is a family‑friendly nighttime 5K that starts and ends at the historic Academy Building in Downtown Dallas, featuring a mix of trail and road surfaces, a glow‑in‑the‑dark theme, and plenty of community spirit; half of all proceeds support Christmas Cheer, a local nonprofit serving families in need, while the other half goes to an additional Dallas‑area nonprofit. name: Day of the Dead Race 12
description:
The streets of Talent, OR are calling and they want YOU.

Every year, the Day of the Dead Race brings our community alive with runners, walkers, families, and friends of all ages, all backgrounds, all paces. This isn't just a race. It's a celebration of Latin culture, of life, of the people we carry with us.

Expect the beat of music that moves you, food that feeds your soul, dance that spills into the streets, and art that stops you in your tracks. Come run. Come walk. Come belong. Because when we share our culture, we don't just build community we build understanding, joy, and something worth showing up for year after year.

Lace up. Show up. Celebrate.

name: Eola Hills "No Hills" 5K/10K
description:
Proceeds from the Eola Hills "No Hills" run will be shared by the Track and field and cross-country programs at Dallas HS and Central HS.

This is a very fun and popular event that is capped at 350 racers.

New for 2026: Race is chip timed and you get a souvenir wine glass.

***IMPORTANT PARKING NOTE*** Parking at the event location fills fast, and parking is NOT be available at the Polk County Fairgrounds. Please carpool if possible. We have overflow parking about 1/4 mile south of Eola in a field.

There will be race day registration (exact cash amount is requested) and we can take credit/debit. Please arrive early to get your information on the roster.

Day of Race 10k=$60, 5k=$55

Check-in on race morning will open at 7:00am. The 10K run will set off from Eola Hills Wine Cellars at 9:00am.  At 9:15am the 5K run/walk will begin. This is a flat, fast, out-and-back course. It is chip-timed this year. Ensure your bib is on your front and visible, especially at the finish. We will pull bib tabs for place and timing verification. After your run enjoy the company of fellow runners and walkers in the wine cellar. You will get  pizza from Yeasty Beasty and a glass of wine, beer, or soda with thanks to Eola Hills.

Following the race end there will be ribbons handed out to the top finishers of each age group for both male and female racers.

 

**We ask that all participants finish their events within 90 minutes of the start time.

The top 3 male and female finishers of each race will receive prizes.  The top 3 in each 10-year age division, male/female, for each race will receive ribbons.

**No dogs are allowed on the course. Strollers are permitted but we ask you please not crowd the front of the start line.
