name: 16th Annual Reindeer Run/Walk
description:
The 16th Annual Reindeer Run will be here December 5th!

Come one, come all! There is something for everyone at the Reindeer Run. We welcome runners and walkers of every level to American Canyon on December 5th, beginning with pre-race festivities at 8am, and a staggered race start (10K at 9am, 5K at 9:05am for runners and 9:10am for walkers).  

This is a fun event for the whole family: kids 6-17 are $30 and youth 5 and under are just $5 and include a finisher's medal and souvenir antlers! Early bird registration begins June 1st, so be ready to register to join in the fun!

*This event is contingent upon the requirements of Napa County Health Guidelines. If deemed necessary by the county, all registrations will be switched to a virtual race.

*Registration fees are non-refundable. Unused race fees are considered a donation to ACParks.

Need a race before the Reindeer Run? Be sure to check out these fantastic races on Thanksgiving Morning, November 26th:

Solano Turkey Trot, by Fleet Feet Vacaville

Napa Valley Turkey Chase, by Athletic Feat

name: 17th Annual BEACHFRONT RUN
description:
Hello Runners & Walkers!

We’re excited to invite you to City Impact's 17th Annual Beachfront Run on Saturday, May 22nd, 2027, at the beautiful Ventura Promenade.

Enjoy a race course with stunning views of Ventura’s coastline while participating in one of our exciting race options: Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or the Kids 1K Run. The event will also feature a variety of exhibitors, lively music, and a festive awards ceremony.

Each participant will receive a custom event shirt and a finisher’s medal. Please note that if you register after March 12th, 2027, we cannot guarantee your preferred shirt size.

Awards will be given to the top 3 finishers in each 10-year age category (10-19, 20-29, etc.), so everyone has a chance to shine!  Whether you’re racing or cheering, this is a perfect event for friends, family, and colleagues to come together and enjoy the day.

All proceeds from the event will benefit City Impact’s programs supporting at-promise youth and families. Your participation makes a difference, and we thank you for your support!        


If you should have any questions, please email info@cityimpact.com 

Much appreciation,


Suki Sir
Development Lead

name: 17th Annual Mardi Gras Madness 5K/10K!
description:
About the Event

Join us on Sunday, February 28th, 2027, as the Junior Chamber International of Santa Clarita (JCI) and the Santa Clarita Track Club proudly present the 17th Annual Mardi Gras Madness 5K/10K and Mini Madness 1K — benefiting JCI Santa Clarita and Students Off And Running (SOAR).

SOAR provides local youth ages 14–18 with a fully supported Los Angeles Marathon training experience — completely free for participants and their families — and is an Official Featured Charity of the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon.

What to Expect

Mardi Gras Madness is Santa Clarita’s premier family-friendly run/walk event, offering fun and fitness for all ages! Participants will enjoy a scenic USATF-certified 5K/10K course, chip timing, custom finisher medals, marathon-quality tech shirts, and a vibrant Health & Fitness Expo.

The festivities continue with a beer garden, great food, costume contest, games and giveaways, silent auction, celebrity hosts, and live entertainment. Whether you’re a seasoned runner, a stroller-pusher, or bringing your furry friend, Mardi Gras Madness welcomes everyone!

 
🏃‍♀️ COURSE INFORMATION
The MGM course is a USATF-certified, rolling 5K/10K circuit featuring scenic paseos, bridge overpasses, and sections along the beautiful South Fork River Trail.

Note: The 10K route includes a dirt equestrian trail from Mile 3.25 to Mile 4.85.
 
🎟 EARLY PACKET PICKUP
Skip the lines and pick up your race materials early!

📍 Saturday, February 27th | 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Location: Canyon Club Courtyard (rear entrance near H&M), Valencia Town Center

Please bring a valid ID to receive your 2027 Beer Garden wristband. No exceptions.

Due to overwhelming demand, onsite registration cannot be guaranteed this year.
 
🕗 RACE DAY SCHEDULE

6:30 – 8:00 AM - Check-In and Pre-Registration
7:25 AM - 1K Warm-Up
7:30 AM - 1K Start
7:55 AM - 5K/10K Warm-Up
8:00 AM - 5K/10K Start
9:30 AM - Awards Ceremony & Prize Drawings
 
🏅 AWARDS
Top 3 Overall Men & Women (5K & 10K)
Top 3 per Age Group:

  • 10 & Under
  • 11–14
  • 15–18
  • 19–29
  • 30–39
  • 40–49
  • 50–59
  • 60+
  • Top 3 Team Finishes
  • All 5K/10K finishers receive a custom medal, t-shirt, and goodie bag!

 
📍 EVENT DETAILS
Date: Sunday, February 28, 2027
Time: 7:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Location: Valencia Town Center, Valencia, CA 91355

name: 1st Annual Lake Los Angeles Desert Sunrise 5k
description:
Welcome,

Thank you for visiting the event website. You are looking at the 1st Annual Lake Los Angeles Desert Sunrise Event and we hope you can join us on October 24th , 2026.

The sun is expected to rise a little after 7am.  Whether you're walking or running you’ll make your way through Lake Los Angeles surrounded by desert buttes, wide-open landscapes, local landmarks, and sweeping views of the Mojave Desert sunrise. The mostly paved, out-and-back course features mild elevation changes and welcomes experienced runners, casual runners, walkers, families, and community members of all abilities.

After the race, you can expect community activities and vibes. Folks and their families can enjoy the live music experience from our local DJ under amazing desert views. Folks can also connect with local organization support, discover vendor products, take pictures at the official photo booth and face paint. Spend the day in Lake Los Angeles!

Stay tuned, we will announce more information such as, race logistics, course map, medal designs, perks, give-aways and more as they become official.

If you have any questions now, please feel free to contact us (310-696-3322 or cbaltazar@sbaycenter.com).

After the race, you can expect community activities and vibes. Folks and their families can enjoy the live music experience from our local DJ under amazing desert views. Folks can also connect with local organization support, discover vendor products, take pictures at the official photo booth and face paint. Spend the day in Lake Los Angeles!

Stay tuned, we will announce more information such as, race logistics, course map, medal designs, perks, give-aways and more as they become official.

If you have any questions now, please feel free to contact us (310-696-3322 or cbaltazar@sbaycenter.com).

name: 2026 - City to the Sea Half Marathon & 5K
description:
CUESTA COLLEGE'S - CITY TO THE SEA HALF MARATHON & 5K

RUNNING WAREHOUSE - HALF MARATHON (13.1 MILES)

Start with the sunrise at historic Mission Plaza for this one of a kind race. The City to the Sea Half Marathon, presented by Running Warehouse, is a breathtaking point-to-point race beginning in San Luis Obispo. The course guides runners past iconic local landmarks, through scenic country backroads, and along the picturesque Bob Jones Trail, culminating at the edge of the Pacific Ocean in the charming coastal community of Avila Beach.

This beautiful course delivers a truly unique Central Coast experience - from the charm of downtown SLO to the relaxing vibes of the Pacific shoreline.

Half Marathon Start Time: October 18th, 2026, 7:00AM

Location: 989 Chorro Street, San Luis Obispo, Ca 93401 ¦ Mission Plaza

The events top 100 men & women will take home a commemorative 2026 City to the Sea mug. All half marathon participants will receive a finisher’s medal and a custom event t-shirt to commemorate their accomplishment. After crossing the finish line, runners can enjoy savory provisions and beverages for purchase—cheers to those 21 and over—a celebratory beer on us!

 

AVILA - SEASIDE 5K (3.1 MILES)

Begin and end your run at the Pacific Ocean. The Avila-Seaside 5K is an out-and-back, with a loop, course with roughly 60% of the route showcasing breathtaking views of the beach, harbor, and "The Peaceful Sea". Keep a keen eye open for sea lions, otters and whales along the route. The course joins the scenic Bob Jones Trail before finishing at beautiful Avila Beach Resort.

5K Start Time: October 18th, 2026, 7:00AM

Location: 6464 Ana Bay Rd, Avila Beach, CA 93424 ¦ Avila Beach Resort

All 5K participants will receive a 2026 finisher’s medal and a custom t-shirt to commemorate their accomplishment. After crossing the finish line, runners can enjoy savory provisions and beverages for purchase—cheers to those 21 and over—a celebratory beer on us!

More Information

After crossing the finish line explore a vibrant selection of community vendors while taking in live music from a local band. You’ll have the option to purchase a variety of meal options from Mulligan’s, or venture into the charming coastal village of Avila Beach to bask in the sun, savor a wine tasting, or stroll the iconic Avila Beach Promenade and Pier. For half marathoners, buses will take you back to the start-line in San Luis Obispo. You may also arrange for your own private transportation if you prefer.

Refund Policy

Please note that entry fees are non-refundable and non-deferrable. However, we understand that unexpected circumstances can arise. You may transfer your registration with a fee. If you can't attend the event please let us know. We will add someone from our waitlist. Our goal is to provide flexible options while continuing to deliver a high-quality experience year after year.

Questions? Please visit www.citytothesearun.com or email us at city2thesea@gmail.com

name: 2026 Brentwood Turkey Trot for Schools
description:
Welcome to the 13th annual Brentwood Turkey Trot for Schools.  This 5K event benefits both the Brentwood Union School District and Liberty Union High School District athletic programs. We are proud to host this community event to promote health, athletics, and education. 

 

In Person & Virtual Race Options

Participants can choose between an in-person or virtual run. For the in-person run,  the race will be at the Streets of Brentwood on Thanksgiving morning at 8:00 AM.  For the virtual run, you can run whenever and wherever you want starting on Wednesday, November 25 through Sunday, December 6.  All participants will receive a 2026 race t-shirt and finisher medal.  

 

Race Fees*:

Children ages 3 and under are welcome to participate, no registration necessary.

August 8 - October 31, 2026

  • Ages 4-9 - $20
  • Ages 10-18 - $25
  • Ages 19 and up - $40

November 1 - November 25, 2026

  • Ages 4-9 - $20
  • Ages 10-18 - $30
  • Ages 19 and up - $45

Race Day Registration - November 26, 2026 (Only available if we have not sold out)

  • Ages 4-9 - $30
  • Ages 10-18 - $35
  • Ages 19 and up - $55

If you register on or after November 1st, you WILL NOT be asked to for a t-shirt size.  You will be able to select a t-shirt from a variety of sizes at packet pickup or on race day.  

*Processing fees will be added to your race fee.

Course Information:

For the safety of our trotters DOGS ARE NOT ALLOWED ON THE COURSE.
Strollers are allowed on the course if they are pushed by an adult.  Bikes, scooters, and skateboards are also NOT ALLOWED on the course.

 

Packet Pickup:

Participants can check-in and pick up their race bibs and t-shirt at packet pick up, scheduled for Wednesday, November 25 from 3:00 - 7:00 PM at Pioneer Elementary School located on Shady Willow Lane in Brentwood. *Please note virtual racers will need to pick up their shirt, bib, and medal at packet pickup or race day by 7:50 AM.  We are not able to ship out race swag. In-person racers with guaranteed shirts sizes will need to pick up their shirts by 7:50 AM on race day or shirts will be released for shirt exchange.

name: 2026 Cal Tri LA - 10.18.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri LA - 10.18.26 Playa del Rey, a coastal neighborhood, is known for its more laid-back atmosphere, making it a great destination for those seeking a quieter beach experience in the Los Angeles area. Playa del Rey has a variety of restaurants and cafes, offering diverse culinary experiences. Some establishments feature outdoor seating with ocean views. Dockweiler State Beach, the race venue, offers a beachfront RV park, fire pits for bonfires, and a hang-gliding practice area. It's a great spot for a beach picnic.

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Check out the course maps for more detailed information. 

TO DO. The Getty Center, Venice Canals Walkway, Skirball Cultural Center.

AIRPORT. Los Angeles (LAX)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 55 F / 81 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 66 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

2026 Cal Tri LA - 10.18.26 Playa del Rey, a coastal neighborhood, is known for its more laid-back atmosphere, making it a great destination for those seeking a quieter beach experience in the Los Angeles area. Playa del Rey has a variety of restaurants and cafes, offering diverse culinary experiences. Some establishments feature outdoor seating with ocean views. Dockweiler State Beach, the race venue, offers a beachfront RV park, fire pits for bonfires, and a hang-gliding practice area. It's a great spot for a beach picnic.

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Check out the course maps for more detailed information. 

TO DO. The Getty Center, Venice Canals Walkway, Skirball Cultural Center.

AIRPORT. Los Angeles (LAX)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 55 F / 81 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 66 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 Cayucos Turkey Trot
description:
Thanksgiving Day Family 5k Fun Run / Walk

Check-in and bib pick-up will start Wednesday, November 25th at the Cayucos Pier from 2-4pm.  Each registered participant will have an assigned bib number and Thanksgiving-themed running socks, while supplies last.

On race day, check-in will begin at 7:15am.  We are set to start at 8:30am so be sure to give yourself enough time.  Dogs, strollers, and kiddos on scooters are all welcome.  

All proceeds will equally benefit Cayucos Elementary School and the California Association of Highway Patrolman Widows & Orphans' Trust Fund.

Thank you for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to see on race day!

name: 2026 First Responders 1M 5K 10K 13.1 26.2
description:
🚨 First Responders Virtual Race – 2026
Distances: 1 Mile • 5K • 10K • 13.1 • 26.2
In Honor of National First Responders Day – October 28, 2026
Complete Anytime in 2026

Every day, our first responders stand on the front lines — protecting, serving, healing, and answering the call when we need them most. In honor of National First Responders Day, we invite you to join our First Responders Virtual Race, a meaningful way to show gratitude and support for these heroes.

Choose your distance and complete your miles anywhere, anytime throughout 2026. Run or walk in honor of EMS, firefighters, nurses, dispatchers, police, and military members who sacrifice so much for our communities.

 
🏅 Your Finisher Medal
This powerful medal features bold, symbolic colors representing each first responder field, along with a stylized American flag to honor their service and courage. Display it proudly as a tribute to the men and women who put others first every day.

 
❤️ Running With Purpose
We are honored to donate 15% of every registration to charity. 

👟 Event Highlights
Complete anytime in 2026
Distances for all fitness levels: 1M, 5K, 10K, 13.1, 26.2
A heartfelt way to honor first responders

Medal and bib ship out within 2 to 5 days of signing up.

 
🚓🚑🚒 Run with gratitude. Walk with purpose. Honor the heroes among us.
👉 Join the First Responders Virtual Race today.

 

*Charity Disclaimer:
We are not a nonprofit organization — we simply believe in supporting great causes whenever we can. A portion of your race registration is donated to a charitable organization. Over the last 13 years we have donated more than $1 million to charities around the world. 

Due to certain legal restrictions, we're unable to publicly list specific charities associated with each event. However, you're welcome to email us at support@virtualrunevent.com for more information on which charity this race benefits and to get a list of our charity donations throughout the years. 

 What is a Virtual Race?                             

A virtual race is a race that can be run (or walked) from any location you choose. You can run, jog, or walk on the road, on the trail, on the treadmill, at the gym or on the track (or ev en at another race). You get to run your own race, at your own pace, and time it yourself. Running and walking on your own, or with friends! And your medal will be shipped directly to you. Complete a virtual 5Ks, 10K, half marathon and more! 

Each race benefits a difference charity

For each of our virtual races, we choose a charity to donate a portion of each registration to. We’ve already raised more than $1,00,000 for charities from races here at Virtual Run Events!  Our goal is to continue to help different charities around the world.

name: 2026 Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, Half Marathon, 5K
description:
We'll forgive you if you have trouble concentrating on the road ahead of you while running The Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, half or 5K. After all, you'll probably be looking up at the old-growth redwood trees which tower over the course! This race is in Humboldt Redwoods State Park and the Half Marathon follows the second half of the iconic Avenue of the Giants Marathon course.

All courses are USATF Certified. The Marathon is a Boston qualifier. The race starts and finishes at the Dyerville Bridge.

name: 2026 Jingle Bell Run - Los Angeles, CA
description:
Get ready for this year’s Jingle Bell Run, the original festive race for charity brought to you by the Arthritis Foundation. Wear your favorite holiday gear, and let's jingle all the way toward a cure!

Whether you're running, walking, or strolling, bring your friends, family, and coworkers along for the ride. Together, we're spreading joy and making strides towards a brighter future — saying "YES" to life, despite arthritis.

Don't miss out on this special occasion to make a real difference while celebrating four decades of impact with the Jingle Bell Run. Let's lace up, hit the pavement, and jingle our way toward victory over arthritis!

Whether you're running, walking, or strolling, bring your friends, family, and coworkers along for the ride. Together, we're spreading joy and making strides towards a brighter future — saying "YES" to life, despite arthritis.

Don't miss out on this special occasion to make a real difference while celebrating four decades of impact with the Jingle Bell Run. Let's lace up, hit the pavement, and jingle our way toward victory over arthritis!

name: 2026 Kaiser Permanente Get Fit Festival
description:
Not a runner or a biker… no problem!  Join the fun with lots of activities to choose from, including:

  • Food trucks – sample some of OC’s finest food trucks. Available from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
  • Thrive Apparel Blowout Sale – grab a workout shirt, shorts, hat, etc. at a great price (cash or check only) 
  • The Thrive Zone – try your luck at one of the challenging carnival games
  • The Fitness Zone – try Zumba, yoga, or line dancing.
  • The Kid’s Zone – bounce and blast your way through the kid’s zone (activities for ages 4-12)
  • Fitness and Health Expo – check out a new product or service from a select group of fitness and health professionals
  • Live music – hear the great sounds of Soul3Sixty playing live on the main stage

name: 2026 Kindness Matters Walk
description:
We are excited to invite you to join us for the 10th Annual Kindness Matters Walk (KM Walk) - a milestone year for a community tradition built on hope, gratitude, and action.  In 2026, participants can join us in person on Thanksgiving morning in Fullerton, CA, or participate virtually from wherever you are.  However you choose to take part, every step helps carry Katie's legacy forward.  All participants are encouraged to register online in advance of the walk.

The virtual walk makes it easy for friends, families, companies, and community groups to participate on their own schedule, anytime, anywhere.  Participants can complete their own 5K by walking, running, rollerblading, biking, kayaking, pushing a stroller - or choosing any activity that moves you.  On Thanksgiving morning, participants can also join virtually as we kick off the holiday with a live-streamed celebration featuring giveaways, contests, speakers, and more.

Post pictures of you/your group as you do your activity virtually or in person, and post to Facebook and Instagram with the hashtag "#KMWalk2026" - we would love to see you!

Registration is simple - just click the "Sign Up" button to start your registration process.  Register yourself or others in your family/group - and please create or join an existing team if you'd like.  Registration is $20 per person ($10 for ages 0-18).  Each participant will have the option during the registration process to select an "add on" walk shirt.  The add-on purchase options will only be available until: 10/31/2026.

You also have the option to make a donation directly to the KM Legacy Fund at the Orange County Community Foundation - another great way to support the KM Legacy Foundation! (optional)

Kindness is cool ... and so are our sponsors!  You will see our event sponsors on the screens during registration.  Please help support these companies/groups as they have so generously supported the KM Legacy Foundation.  Thank you sponsors!

Proceeds from the KM Walk support brain tumor research at a national level, and young adult leadership development opportunities locally in the Fullerton Joint Union High School District.

name: 2026 Lake Casitas Short Course Championships (Middle School Racer Sign Ups ONLY)
description:
Lake Casitas Short Course Championships is a high school level meet, home of the Ventura County Championship on the beautiful Lake Casitas Cross Country Course where many legends of the sport have run over the last 30 years. The middle school level race will return in 2026. This will be one middle school race with all genders and grades. If registrations are over 200 runners, we may increase to two races. 

Important race information: 

  1. Course Map Link HERE
  2. Middle School Race Time:  4:15pm
    1. High School races will follow at 4:45pm and 5:15pm. Stick around to watch the "big kids" race!
  3. Awards: Top 30 boys and Top 30 girls will receive medals in the finish chute. 
  4. Cost: $5 goes towards timing with live chip timing and awards. Paid here, on RunSignUp. Parents can register their athletes. 
  5. Directions: 11311 Santa Ana Rd, Ventura, CA 93001. From the main Lake Casitas gate, turn right and drive about 2 miles to the cross country course and boat launch ramp
  6. Parking: NO BUSSES OR CARS WILL BE ALLOWED PAST THE LAST GATE AFTER 3:45pm. If you get to the course early, park in the group campsite area before the last gate. There will be people there to help direct you. Busses should park along the top road before the gate. However, if you park down on the course level you will not be able to leave until the final race is completed for the day and the runners have left the finish area (usually about 6:00pm). It is a ¼ mile walk from the parking area down to the starting line/check in area. After drop off, some bus drivers may prefer to park in the paved lot to the left (south) of the entrance station of the park and then return to pick the team up. There is a charge per vehicle entering the park. Please be sure parents and friends aware of this charge so that they may plan carpools. 
  7. Water: Please provide water for your teams and make sure your runners pre-hydrate. Faucets are available to refill your containers around the Spectator Hill, by the restrooms, and in the camping areas. We will have water in cups at the finish line for athletes. YOU MAY PROVIDE WATER TO ATHLETES DURING THE RACE. 
  8. T-shirts and snack bar: We will have custom Lake Casitas Short Course Championships t-shirts for sale as well as a light snack bar. Halloween themed, get yours before we sell out!

Questions? Contact Garrett at garrett.reynolds@oxnardunion.org 

IF YOU MISS THE SIGN UP WINDOW AND YOU ARRIVE AT THE LAKE WITHOUT SIGN UP, YOUR PARENT/GAURDIAN CAN DO RACE DAY SIGN UP FOR $25.

name: 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26
description:
2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot
description:
The annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot celebrates its 12th Year on Thanksgiving Day 2026! Please come be part of the family fun...

REGISTER TODAY and join us at The Palisades Charter High School on Thanksgiving morning -- November 26th -- to get your holiday season off to a running start!

Race Day Information:

  1. Parking is available in and around the Alphabet Streets. 
  2. If you live near downtown Pacific Palisades, please walk. Less cars makes a better experience for everyone involved
  3. Head directly to Palisades Charter High School (Dolphin Stadium) Football Field and look for the Registration Area
  4. Festivities start at 7:00 AM -- the earlier you come, the more fun your day will be
  5. Both the 5K and 10K start at 8:00 AM. The race program will conclude by 11:00 AM
  6. Fast runners to the front. Slower runners, walkers and strollers please move to the back of the field
  7. Medals and Water will be available at the Finish Line
  8. No Dogs Allowed on the football field
  9. Medical Staff will be on-site

REGISTER TODAY and join us at The Palisades Charter High School on Thanksgiving morning -- November 26th -- to get your holiday season off to a running start!

Race Day Information:

  1. Parking is available in and around the Alphabet Streets. 
  2. If you live near downtown Pacific Palisades, please walk. Less cars makes a better experience for everyone involved
  3. Head directly to Palisades Charter High School (Dolphin Stadium) Football Field and look for the Registration Area
  4. Festivities start at 7:00 AM -- the earlier you come, the more fun your day will be
  5. Both the 5K and 10K start at 8:00 AM. The race program will conclude by 11:00 AM
  6. Fast runners to the front. Slower runners, walkers and strollers please move to the back of the field
  7. Medals and Water will be available at the Finish Line
  8. No Dogs Allowed on the football field
  9. Medical Staff will be on-site

name: 2026 RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM - "Together we can Peace-Out DM"
description:
☮️ PEACE, LOVE & DM AWARENESS! 💜🐾

Join Shade Out DM Foundation for our annual RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM, November 14-22, 2026!

This is a VIRTUAL RACE, so you can participate from anywhere. Walk, run, roll, ride, hike, swim or simply choose your own way to get involved. With your dog or without one. By yourself or with a team.

Registration is FREE!

Our RACE isn't just about miles. It's about raising awareness, raising funds and getting people talking about Degenerative Myelopathy (DM).

Some pups can't. But WE CAN!

Register. Fundraise. Move your way. Share your RACE. And help us spread Peace, Love & DM Awareness while we RACE to #ShadeOutDM!

****************************************************** 

🧬 About Degenerative Myelopathy (DM)

DM is often called the canine version of ALS (Lou Gehrig’s Disease). It’s a progressive, genetic disease affecting the spinal cord and over 100 dog breeds (& mixed breeds now too). Symptoms usually appear between ages 8-14, starting with ONE hind-leg weakness & loss of coordination, eventually leading to full paralysis, incontinence, organ failure, and respiratory failure all while their mind is still fully aware.

The tragedy?

  • Many vets still don’t know about DM
  • It’s often misdiagnosed
  • It’s entirely preventable with genetic testing

DM is on the rise - NOW is the time to speak up for the pups!

******************************************************

💜 About Shade Out DM Foundation

Shade Out DM Foundation is a 100% volunteer-run, registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We are dedicated to:
📚 Educating ~ 💬 Supporting ~ ♿ Loaning ~ 📣 Advocating

Our Mission:
To improve the health and well-being of dogs affected by DM while preventing future cases through awareness and education.

Your Support Helps:

  • Fund KC’s Kruisers Loaner Cart Program for dogs in need
  • Attend veterinary and breed-specific conferences
  • Contribute to DM research
  • Provide awareness materials and educational outreach

All proceeds go directly toward these efforts.
🌐 Donate at: www.shadeoutdm.org

 
Let’s RACE to #ShadeOutDM - because no dog should suffer needlessly!
Together, we can make a difference. 💜🐾

name: 2026 SHAY 5K Run/Walk
description:
Spreading Help Around You is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that was founded in 2014 in honor of Shaylyn Anela Pinoliar, who tragically passed away on November 14, 2012. Our mission is to help and support families who have lost a loved one, educate them on the importance of being prepared during such a time of loss, and provide active service to the community.  As well as promoting Pedestrian Safety Awareness. This year, we proudly launched the SHAY Scholarship Program, marking an exciting new chapter in our commitment to supporting education and empowering future leaders. 

Each year, since Shaylyn’s passing, family, friends, and community members gather to honor her memory with an Annual 5k Run/Walk on Thanksgiving morning. Last year, we moved the event to Saturday after Thanksgiving. It was a great success, and we look forward to continuing the tradition this year to honor her memory.

Run or Walk a 5K and receive an Event Shirt and a Custom Finisher's Medal.

Join or Create a Team!

Children 10 and under receive a special rate automatically during registration.

name: 2026 XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon & San Diego 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for event #3 of the San Diego Triathlon Series & the Triple Crown of Triathlon
📅 Sunday, October 11, 2026
📍 San Diego, CA – Mission Bay

Proud Host of the 2026 USAT State Championships 🏆
The XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon is proud to once again host the 2026 USA Triathlon State Championships — featuring Age Group, High School, and Club Championships!

Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance / Duathlon / Aquabike / Aquathlon

What This Means for Racers:
🥇 State Champion Titles
Compete for the honor of being crowned California State Champion in your triathlon division (Sprint or International), as well as in High School and Club categories. Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance 
🎽 Coveted State Champion Jersey
1st place winners in each age group, high school, and special category earn the exclusive right to purchase and wear the official California State Championship jersey.
🚩 Club State Championships
All State Championships also serve as the Club State Championships. Clubs (age group & high school) can earn the designation of Top Club in California and win a Club State Champion banner from USA Triathlon.

🎟️ Qualification for Nationals

Sprint Triathlon → Qualifies you for Sprint Nationals
International Triathlon → Qualifies you for Olympic-Distance Nationals
Top 35% of finishers or top 5 athletes (whichever is greater) qualify.
State Championships after June 1, 2026, qualify athletes for both 2026 AND 2027 Nationals.

🎓 High School Championships

Eligibility: Any student currently enrolled in high school and up to six (6) months post-graduation.
Exemption: All athletes who finish a State High School Championship race will automatically qualify for Sprint Nationals, provided they are age 15 or older by December 31, 2026.
🌍 Open to all athletes — residency in California is not required.

Why Race Mission Bay?
Race in San Diego’s iconic Mission Bay, claim your place on the podium, and showcase your achievement in the California State Championship Jersey. 🚴‍♂️🏊‍♀️🏃‍♀️

👉 Don’t miss your moment to race, win, and represent — Register today!

Join us at the birthplace of the sport for the XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon!

2026 is the 38th annual XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon benefitting Life Sports Foundation. San Diego is the Birthplace of Triathlon! In 1974, the first Mission Bay Triathlon was as a run-bike-swim-run event on Fiesta Island by the San Diego Track Club. Every year competitors from around the country and from around the world, come to Mission Bay to celebrate the birthplace triathlon.  We invite you to become part of this wonderful legacy event and become part of history!

The event offers races for adults and kids,  from complete beginners to seasoned Professionals. There are many different races going on simultaneously, and while a traditional Triathlon is Swim / Bike / Run, KOZ Events, the organizer of the San Diego Triathlon Series,  offers more of a Multisport Race. Our race is very inclusive and we make triathlon accessible to as many people as possible. We have the traditional Swim/bike/ Run Triathlon but we offer so much more. If you do not like swimming, we have the Duathlon which is a Run/ Bike/ Run, if you don’t want to bike then choose the Aquathlon Swim / Run, or if you don’t want to run choose the Aquabike  Swim/Bike. We even have a Mini Distance Triathlon for beginners that want to try out the sport. We even offer free training groups every week to help people get started, train, and get connected to the San Diego Triathlon Community.

📅 Sunday, October 11, 2026
📍 San Diego, CA – Mission Bay

Proud Host of the 2026 USAT State Championships 🏆
The XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon is proud to once again host the 2026 USA Triathlon State Championships — featuring Age Group, High School, and Club Championships!

Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance / Duathlon / Aquabike / Aquathlon

What This Means for Racers:
🥇 State Champion Titles
Compete for the honor of being crowned California State Champion in your triathlon division (Sprint or International), as well as in High School and Club categories. Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance 
🎽 Coveted State Champion Jersey
1st place winners in each age group, high school, and special category earn the exclusive right to purchase and wear the official California State Championship jersey.
🚩 Club State Championships
All State Championships also serve as the Club State Championships. Clubs (age group & high school) can earn the designation of Top Club in California and win a Club State Champion banner from USA Triathlon.

🎟️ Qualification for Nationals

Sprint Triathlon → Qualifies you for Sprint Nationals
International Triathlon → Qualifies you for Olympic-Distance Nationals
Top 35% of finishers or top 5 athletes (whichever is greater) qualify.
State Championships after June 1, 2026, qualify athletes for both 2026 AND 2027 Nationals.

🎓 High School Championships

Eligibility: Any student currently enrolled in high school and up to six (6) months post-graduation.
Exemption: All athletes who finish a State High School Championship race will automatically qualify for Sprint Nationals, provided they are age 15 or older by December 31, 2026.
🌍 Open to all athletes — residency in California is not required.

Why Race Mission Bay?
Race in San Diego’s iconic Mission Bay, claim your place on the podium, and showcase your achievement in the California State Championship Jersey. 🚴‍♂️🏊‍♀️🏃‍♀️

👉 Don’t miss your moment to race, win, and represent — Register today!

Join us at the birthplace of the sport for the XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon!

2026 is the 38th annual XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon benefitting Life Sports Foundation. San Diego is the Birthplace of Triathlon! In 1974, the first Mission Bay Triathlon was as a run-bike-swim-run event on Fiesta Island by the San Diego Track Club. Every year competitors from around the country and from around the world, come to Mission Bay to celebrate the birthplace triathlon.  We invite you to become part of this wonderful legacy event and become part of history!

The event offers races for adults and kids,  from complete beginners to seasoned Professionals. There are many different races going on simultaneously, and while a traditional Triathlon is Swim / Bike / Run, KOZ Events, the organizer of the San Diego Triathlon Series,  offers more of a Multisport Race. Our race is very inclusive and we make triathlon accessible to as many people as possible. We have the traditional Swim/bike/ Run Triathlon but we offer so much more. If you do not like swimming, we have the Duathlon which is a Run/ Bike/ Run, if you don’t want to bike then choose the Aquathlon Swim / Run, or if you don’t want to run choose the Aquabike  Swim/Bike. We even have a Mini Distance Triathlon for beginners that want to try out the sport. We even offer free training groups every week to help people get started, train, and get connected to the San Diego Triathlon Community.

name: 2027 Altadena Forever Run - LASAA Mug Run
description:
Thank you for registering for the 2027 Altadena Forever Run! On Sunday, January 10, 2027, thousands of runners, walkers, families, first responders, community members, and friends of Altadena will come together to commemorate the two-year anniversary of the Eaton Fire—and celebrate the strength, resilience, and enduring spirit of this community. Whether you’re joining us for the 10K, 5K, or 1K Family Run/Walk, we’re so glad you’ll be part of this special day.
 

RACE DAY
Sunday, January 10, 2027
Race Start: 8:00 AM
Start & Finish: Mariposa Junction
Mariposa Street between El Molino Avenue and Lake Avenue
849 E. Mariposa Street
Altadena, CA 91001
 

PACKET PICKUP
Grocery Outlet – Altadena
2270 Lake Avenue
Altadena, CA 91001
Days/Times:
January 7, 2027, 12p - 8p
January 8, 2027, 10a - 7p
January 9, 2027, 10a - 7p
 

ABOUT THE ALTADENA FOREVER RUN
The Altadena Forever Run was created in the aftermath of the Eaton Fire as a way to bring our community together—to remember what was lost, honor those who were impacted, celebrate the extraordinary resilience of Altadena, and support its recovery. The Run is held in partnership with the Los Angeles Sheriff’s Athletic Association (LASAA) who is providing race logistical support and who hosts annual station Mug Runs, and the Sheriff’s Support Group of Altadena (SSGA). The Mug Run series began in 1993 as a small event primarily for law enforcement personnel and has grown over the years to welcome the broader community. Each year, LASAA partners with Sheriff’s stations throughout Los Angeles County, with each station bringing its own community, traditions, and purpose to its Run.


THE COURSES


5K
Extending into the lower foothill neighborhoods east of Lake Avenue, the 5K brings runners and walkers through streets lined with volunteers and cheering residents—each voice a testament to Altadena’s unity, renewal, and pride. 

 

10K
The full 10K follows the 5K route, offering spectacular views of the San Gabriel Mountains before returning toward the historic Mariposa business district. The course then turns west, guiding participants past neighborhoods in various stages of rebuilding—a moving portrait of perseverance, where homes under construction stand as symbols of endurance and hope. The Run passes Charles White Park before finishing triumphantly back on Mariposa Street.

  
1K FAMILY RUN/WALK
Kids 10 and under participate FREE in the 1K Family Run/Walk!
Starting at El Molino Avenue and heading west past the Altadena Library before looping back to Mariposa Street, this short, joyful course is perfect for families and children to share in the spirit of the day.


WANT TO DO EVEN MORE FOR EATON FIRE SURVIVORS?
Your registration already makes you part of something meaningful. If you would like to take your support a step further, you can make a donation to the Altadena Forever Community Fund or create your own individual or team fundraising page. 100% of donations and funds raised through the Altadena Forever Community Fund go specifically and solely to Altadena Eaton Fire survivors.
 

CREATE YOUR OWN FUNDRAISER
Turn your Run into something even bigger. Create an individual or team fundraising page through the Altadena Forever Recovery Fund, share why Altadena matters to you, and invite your friends, family, coworkers, teammates, and community to support Eaton Fire survivors alongside you. START A FUNDRAISER


MAKE A DONATION
Fundraising isn’t for everyone—and that’s okay. You can also make a direct donation to the Altadena Forever Recovery Fund. Every donation made through the Fund goes specifically and solely to Altadena Eaton Fire survivors. MAKE A DONATION


Whether you run, walk, fundraise, donate, volunteer, or simply share the Altadena Forever Run with others, you are helping remind Eaton Fire survivors that they are not rebuilding alone.

 

STAY CONNECTED WITH THE SHERIFF'S SUPPORT GROUP OF ALTADENA
The Sheriff’s Support Group of Altadena supports the Altadena Sheriff’s Station and programs that strengthen the relationship between the Station and the community it serves.  If you would like to receive news and updates from SSGA beyond the Altadena Forever Run, you may opt-in to its email list here. 
 

SHARE THE RUN
Help us bring even more people to the starting line. Tell your friends, family, neighbors, running clubs, coworkers, and teammates that you’re participating in the 2027 Altadena Forever Run and invite them to join you.
Facebook | Instagram | Website
 

QUESTIONS?
For race-related questions, please check the Altadena Forever Run website or email altadenaforeverrun@gmail.com.
 

Thank you for being part of the 2027 Altadena Forever Run.  We can’t wait to see you at the starting line!


Warmly,
 

The Altadena Forever Run Team

description:
Thank you for registering for the 2027 Altadena Forever Run! On Sunday, January 10, 2027, thousands of runners, walkers, families, first responders, community members, and friends of Altadena will come together to commemorate the two-year anniversary of the Eaton Fire—and celebrate the strength, resilience, and enduring spirit of this community. Whether you’re joining us for the 10K, 5K, or 1K Family Run/Walk, we’re so glad you’ll be part of this special day.
 

RACE DAY
Sunday, January 10, 2027

Start & Finish: Mariposa Junction
Mariposa Street between El Molino Avenue and Lake Avenue
849 E. Mariposa Street
Altadena, CA 91001
 

PACKET PICKUP
Grocery Outlet – Altadena
2270 Lake Avenue
Altadena, CA 91001
Days/Times:
January 7, 2027, 12p - 8p
January 8, 2027, 10a - 7p
January 9, 2027, 10a - 7p
 

ABOUT THE ALTADENA FOREVER RUN
The Altadena Forever Run was created in the aftermath of the Eaton Fire as a way to bring our community together—to remember what was lost, honor those who were impacted, celebrate the extraordinary resilience of Altadena, and support its recovery. The Run is held in partnership with the Los Angeles Sheriff’s Athletic Association (LASAA) who is providing race logistical support and who hosts annual station Mug Runs, and the Sheriff’s Support Group of Altadena (SSGA). The Mug Run series began in 1993 as a small event primarily for law enforcement personnel and has grown over the years to welcome the broader community. Each year, LASAA partners with Sheriff’s stations throughout Los Angeles County, with each station bringing its own community, traditions, and purpose to its Run.


THE COURSES


5K
Extending into the lower foothill neighborhoods east of Lake Avenue, the 5K brings runners and walkers through streets lined with volunteers and cheering residents—each voice a testament to Altadena’s unity, renewal, and pride. 

 

10K
The full 10K follows the 5K route, offering spectacular views of the San Gabriel Mountains before returning toward the historic Mariposa business district. The course then turns west, guiding participants past neighborhoods in various stages of rebuilding—a moving portrait of perseverance, where homes under construction stand as symbols of endurance and hope. The Run passes Charles White Park before finishing triumphantly back on Mariposa Street.

  
1K FAMILY RUN/WALK
Kids 10 and under participate FREE in the 1K Family Run/Walk!
Starting at El Molino Avenue and heading west past the Altadena Library before looping back to Mariposa Street, this short, joyful course is perfect for families and children to share in the spirit of the day.

name: 2027 Avenue of the Giants Marathon
description: The Avenue of the Giants is one of the most beautiful races in the world!  It runs through old growth redwoods and follows a natural creek in the middle of a state park.  Staged on "The Avenue of the Giants" in Humboldt Redwoods State Park, located in rural Northern California. Course is on a paved road that winds gently up hill but is mostly a flat, fast destination race.  With little to distract you, the tall trees inspire the athlete in each of us to be strong.  The course is certified and the marathon is a Boston Qualifying event.

name: 2027 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.19.27
description:
2027 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.19.27

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

CASTAIC LAKE. 
Cal Tri Castaic Lake takes place at scenic Castaic Lake just 20 miles north of Los Angeles. The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake. 

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG).
Mid June temperatures are often cooler in the morning, with early morning fog burning off to reach the mid 80s.  Our event will possibly be around 60 degrees.

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 

Water temps in June typically range in the mid to high 60s.  Email updates will be sent out closer to the race with updates. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

CASTAIC LAKE. 
Cal Tri Castaic Lake takes place at scenic Castaic Lake just 20 miles north of Los Angeles. The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake. 

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG).
Mid June temperatures are often cooler in the morning, with early morning fog burning off to reach the mid 80s.  Our event will possibly be around 60 degrees.

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 

Water temps in June typically range in the mid to high 60s.  Email updates will be sent out closer to the race with updates. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2027 Cal Tri La Crema - 6.27.27
description:
2027 Cal Tri La Crema - 6.27.27. Located in Sonoma County, the La Crema Cal Tri Sonoma triathlon starts at iconic Johnson's Beach with a Russian River swim, a scenic bike ride along River Road towards the ultimate destination, La Crema Estate at Saralee’s Vineyard, where athletes run through the vineyards chasing that elusive finish line. name: 2027 Giro di San Diego
description:
🏁 GranFondo – Mesa Grande (95 mi)

🏁 GranFondo – Palomar (56 mi)

🏁 MedioFondo (32 mi)

🏁 PiccoloFondo (20 mi)

ARE YOU UP FOR THE CHALLENGE?
The Giro di San Diego GranFondo is not an easy day on the bike—and that’s part of what makes finishing it so rewarding.

Choose the distance that fits your goals, ride some of San Diego County’s beautiful backcountry roads, and challenge yourself on a fully supported cycling event.

Whether your goal is conquering Mt. Palomar, taking on a challenging shorter route, or simply pushing yourself farther than you have before, there’s a Giro challenge for you.

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE 🚴


95-Mile GranFondo
Our Version of a Century Ride
Want the big challenge? This is it.

At 95 miles, our GranFondo gives you nearly a full century of riding while taking on one of Southern California’s best-known cycling challenges: Mt. Palomar.

Expect a demanding day of climbing, descending, and riding through the San Diego County backcountry.

The GranFondo features a mass start and a timed route, including a separately timed Mt. Palomar KOM/QOM climbing segment.

If climbing Mt. Palomar has been sitting on your cycling bucket list, this is your opportunity to take it on.

56-Mile Metric Century
Mt. Palomar Without the 95 Miles
Don’t let the shorter mileage fool you.

The 56-mile Metric Century also climbs Mt. Palomar, giving riders the opportunity to take on the signature Giro challenge without committing to the full 95-mile GranFondo.

You’ll still get serious climbing, beautiful backcountry roads and the satisfaction of conquering Palomar.

The Mt. Palomar climb is timed for the KOM/QOM competition, so riders who want an extra challenge can see how they stack up on the mountain.

32-Mile Route
A Shorter Giro Challenge
Looking for a shorter day on the bike?

The 32-mile route still gives you a challenging Giro experience with San Diego County scenery, climbing and full event support without taking on Mt. Palomar or the longer distances.

Enjoy the stocked rest stops, mechanical and SAG support, included lunch, massage and finish-line celebration.

20-Mile Route
Your Introduction to the Giro
The shortest Giro option is a great choice for newer cyclists, riders building toward longer distances, or anyone who wants to be part of Giro day without spending most of the day in the saddle.

Twenty miles may be our shortest route, but it’s still a ride—and still an accomplishment.

THE MT. PALOMAR CHALLENGE ⛰️
Mt. Palomar is one of Southern California’s most recognized cycling climbs.

It’s long.

name: 2027 Granfondo San Diego
description:
San Diego's Favorite Cycling Event! - Voted Best GranFondo in America & Top 10 Best Century Ride in the USA

Welcome to the ultimate celebration of cycling, flavor, and the breathtaking San Diego waterfront! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey at the Southern California-Italian fusion extravaganza – our Gran Fondo awaits!
More Than a Century Ride

🚴 Routes: Choose Your Path, Seize Your Glory! Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or a weekend warrior, our event caters to all levels. Pick your challenge from our diverse route options: 100, 60, or 35 miles. As you pedal through the stunning landscapes, know that every mile brings you closer to the full GranFondo experience!

🏅 Swag: Earn Your Medal, Revel in Victory! Cross the finish line triumphantly, and the cheers of the crowd will resonate with your achievement. Your reward? A well-deserved medal, the tangible proof of your cycling prowess. But the celebration doesn't stop there – brace yourself for the Fantastic Finish extravaganza!

🎉 Fantastic Finish Celebration – Unleash the Festivities! Immerse yourself in the post-ride revelry at our Fantastic Finish Celebration! Live music will set the stage for your triumph, and the bike valet ensures your trusty steed is taken care of. Delight your taste buds at the Italian Pasta Fest and quench your thirst at the Beer Garden – the perfect way to relish your victory!

🌇 SoCal Meets Italy – A Fusion of Culture and Cycling! Picture this: the vibrant energy of Southern California seamlessly blending with the charm of Italy against the backdrop of San Diego's picturesque waterfront. It's a two-day festival that goes beyond cycling – it's an immersion into a world where passion for food, fitness, and community collide.

🏞️ Downtown San Diego – The Perfect Host! Our event unfolds in the heart of beautiful Downtown San Diego. The cityscape adds an urban flair to your cycling adventure, making every turn and twist of the route an exploration of San Diego's charm.

🚵‍♂️ Gran Fondo Highlights: Challenging Routes & Exciting Competitions! Feel the rush as you tackle challenging and inspiring routes that cater to the cyclist in you. Engage in the thrill of timed King and Queen of the Mountain competitions – an opportunity to showcase your climbing prowess. The Bike & Fitness Expo awaits, where you can explore the latest trends and innovations in the cycling world.

🍝 Italian Feast – Savor the Flavorful Finale! Cap off your cycling odyssey with an Italian Feast at the Finish. Indulge in delectable dishes that celebrate the essence of Italy, bringing a delicious conclusion to your GranFondo adventure.
 Presenting Sponsor

🚀 Join Us for an Epic Experience! Are you ready to be part of a cycling spectacle like no other? Embrace the challenge, savor the flavor, and revel in the community spirit at our GranFondo. Secure your spot today and gear up for a weekend of cycling, festivities, and memories that will last a lifetime! 🚴🍝🎉

Delight your taste buds at the Italian Pasta Fest and quench your thirst at the Beer Garden – the perfect way to relish your victory!

Picture this: the vibrant energy of Southern California seamlessly blending with the charm of Italy against the backdrop of San Diego's picturesque waterfront. It's a two-day festival that goes beyond cycling – it's an immersion into a world where passion for food, fitness, and community collide.

🏞️ Downtown San Diego – The Perfect Host! Our event unfolds in the heart of beautiful Downtown San Diego. The cityscape adds an urban flair to your cycling adventure, making every turn and twist of the route an exploration of San Diego's charm.

🚵‍♂️ Gran Fondo Highlights: Challenging Routes & Exciting Competitions! Feel the rush as you tackle challenging and inspiring routes that cater to the cyclist in you. Engage in the thrill of timed King and Queen of the Mountain competitions – an opportunity to showcase your climbing prowess. The Bike & Fitness Expo awaits, where you can explore the latest trends and innovations in the cycling world.

🍝 Italian Feast – Savor the Flavorful Finale! Cap off your cycling odyssey with an Italian Feast at the Finish. Indulge in delectable dishes that celebrate the essence of Italy, bringing a delicious conclusion to your GranFondo adventure.
 Presenting Sponsor

🚀 Join Us for an Epic Experience! Are you ready to be part of a cycling spectacle like no other? Embrace the challenge, savor the flavor, and revel in the community spirit at our GranFondo. Secure your spot today and gear up for a weekend of cycling, festivities, and memories that will last a lifetime! 🚴🍝🎉

name: 2027 Highland Y Run
description:
Every year the Highland YMCA welcomes runners and race enthusiasts of all ages and abilities to participate in a chipped or unchipped race.  The Highland Y Run is a fundraising event for the Highland YMCA that offers a scenic 5K or 10K route through the beautiful city of Highland, CA. name: 2027 Lake Chabot Trail Challenge (Half Marathon & 5K)
description:
RACE INFO: We are so excited to celebrate the 43rd annual Lake Chabot Trail Challenge Half Marathon and 5K. This race is well regarded amongst serious trail runners in the outlying areas. The race begins at 8am for the Half Marathon and 8:30am for the 5K. Please arrive early so that you may find parking, pick up your bibs, use restrooms facilities, and be properly prepared to race before the start. Race takes place rain or shine and there are no refunds.

RACE COURSE: The half marathon course is a scenic, hilly loop, mainly on dirt fire roads.  The ridge-line views look down upon scenic Lake Chabot, surrounding grassy slopes, and eucalyptus groves.  Mt. Diablo and San Francisco Bay are visible along the route. There are water stations with first aid and radio support; we recommend bringing your own hydration as well.  The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. The 5k (3.1 miles) course is an out and back that has gentle rolling hills and consists mostly of paved surfaces.  This route includes one water station with first aid and radio support.

RACE FEE: Pre-registered runners will be guaranteed a t-shirt if registered by Sunday, May 9th, 2027.  The price for the 5K is $40 and Half Marathon $65. You must register by Saturday, June 5th. We will accept race day registration; however, the price for the 5K is $45 and Half Marathon $70. If you register on race day, we can only accept cash, check or Venmo.

There is a nominal fee (~$5) for Chabot parking lot. Free parking on Lake Chabot Rd and nearby streets.

RACE PACKET & BIB PICK-UP:  We will have race packet and bib pick-up on Sunday, June 6th starting at 7am at the Willow picnic site which is also the finish line area. We will not be mailing out any race packets or bibs. Both races are chip-timed.

T-SHIRT: Entry fee includes short sleeve, high quality t-shirts for registrations by May 9th so sign-up early.  There are no guarantee of t-shirts for runners registered after that date and on race day. We ask for those who did not get a shirt to check in after the race. Please ensure that you select the appropriate t-shirt size. We will not be doing any size exchanges from your original request.

AWARDS: Finisher's medals to those who complete their race.  Age division medals given to the top 3 in each of 12 age divisions in the half marathon and 9 age divisions in the 5K.

QUESTIONS: If you have any questions, please contact Rachel Lunt at teamlunt07@gmail.com.

DIRECTIONS: The entrance closest to the event's parking lot is: 17404 Lake Chabot Road, Castro Valley, CA 94546.  On Google Maps, this will appear as "Entry of Lake Chabot Parking Space."  The registration area and start lines are just a few minutes walk from the lot ( just follow the signs).

name: 2027 SFA Los Angeles Marathon Team
description:
Sarcoma Foundation of America (SFA) is a proud partner of the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon Weekend. The ASICS Los Angeles Marathon weekend takes place March 6 - 7, 2027.  The race weekend includes a 2-day Lifestyle Expo at the iconic Dodger Stadium, and the LA 5K and LA Kids Run on Saturday, followed by the Charity Half Marathon and ASICS Los Angeles Marathon on Sunday.

SFA invites you to join our marathon team. When you participate, you are choosing to join hundreds of others who want to make a difference for sarcoma patients and their families. Funds raised through our race team drive innovative research for sarcoma. 

Secure access to your guaranteed race entry* today!

Runners seeking to join the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon SFA race team will receive the following perks:

  • Guaranteed entry 
  • Custom SFA marathon shirt
  • Personal fundraising page
  • Dedicated staff to support fundraising
  • Complimentary registration
  • Note: Runners must commit to a minimum personal fundraising goal:
    • Marathon ($750) 
    • 5K ($250)

Your support will go beyond the finish line when you join our community of teammates from across the country as you train for this incredible event.  Our SFA Team is here to provide support every step of the way!  

Our Marathon Team’s Impact

SFA Marathon Runners have raised over $130,000 to support sarcoma research. We hope to raise an additional $10,000 through the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon Weekend, to continue to support those impacted by sarcoma. 

For additional information, please contact Annie Blake at ablake@curesarcoma.org.  

Together we can find a cure!

name: 2nd Annual AMCFF “Running Con Ganas” 5K to Unite Los Angeles Community at LA Mission College
description:
AMCFF is proud to announce the first ever Running Con Ganas 5K, taking place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at Los Angeles Mission College. This inspiring community run will bring together students, families, and neighbors to celebrate health, determination, and educational opportunity.

“Ganas” — the Spanish word for “desire, drive, and motivation” — reflects the spirit of this event. All fitness levels are welcome to participate in the 5K, which will weave through the scenic LA Mission College campus and surrounding areas.

Running With Purpose

The AMCFF “Running Con Ganas” 5K is more than just a race — it’s a movement to:

Promote health, wellness, and community pride
Encourage students and families to engage in active lifestyles
Raise funds to support the 2027 AMCFF Scholars, providing financial assistance and resources to deserving students

Runners will receive a medal and timed bib!

For more information, visit www.cardenasfoundation.org/

name: 310K Run/walk powered by Leslie Cohen Law
description:
2025 Results at this link

https://www.racefoxresults.com/leslie-cohen-law-5k 

Leslie Cohen Law PC is once again proud to be hosting the 310K Run/Walk, a 5K event that raises funds for the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project. Now in its 15th year, the 310K is a community-driven race that takes place right on the beach in Santa Monica, drawing many returning runners and walkers year after year. The event welcomes participants of all paces—whether you're running to set a new personal record or walking with friends to support a great cause. With in-person and virtual options, the 310K offers a meaningful way to give back while enjoying one of the most scenic race routes in beautiful LA.

 

For the 2nd year in a row, we return to the California Incline!

This year, the 310K will take place on Sunday, November 22nd—a great way to kick off Thanksgiving week with purpose and community spirit.

Our new location last year got such rave reviews that we need to make it a tradition. We will once again start at the iconic Santa Monica Pier and run down and then back up the California Incline.

Our Beneficiary

Proceeds from the 310K support the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project (DAP), which provides free bankruptcy-related legal services to individuals and families across Greater Los Angeles. Through clinics, educational workshops, and one-on-one legal representation, DAP helps clients understand their rights, navigate the legal system, and find paths toward financial stability. DAP is part of Public Counsel, the largest pro bono legal aid organization in the United States. Leslie Cohen Law PC received the James King Community Service Award from Public Counsel in 2016 in recognition of the impact of the 310K.

name: 37th Annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K
description:
The Lopers Club and the City of Loma Linda present the 37th annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K! The Holiday Classic is the Inland Empire’s longest running annual holiday running event and a local tradition for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities!

Location

The race Start/Finish will take place in front of the Loma Linda Fire Station located at 11325 Loma Linda Drive in Loma Linda. Park in any nearby lot except for the Veteran's Hospital.

Event information

This year’s event will take place on Sunday, December 6, 2026. The Half Marathon, 10K and 5K have a wave start, with 10 minutes between waves. Start time is 7:00 am. The Half Marathon has a course limit of 4 hours which is allows for walkers who can maintain an 18 minute per mile average pace. There will be many walkers as well as runners in both the 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.

The Start/Finish Line will be located near the corner of Barton Road and Loma Linda Drive, in front of the Loma Linda Fire station.

Event features

The Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K,  and 5K run/walk, provides scenic mountain views with stimulating inclines on a course which winds through the lovely streets of Loma Linda. Beautiful, long-sleeved tech shirts will be provided for all participants who register prior to November 1, 2026. Participants registering after the cutoff will receive a shirt while supplies last, we might not have your size if you register in less than three weeks before the event. All finishers of both the Half Marathon, 10K and the 5K event will be awarded beautiful finishers' medals. Trophies will be awarded to the overall top male and female winner of each race. Division medals will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place male and female finishers in each of 20 age divisions.

Bring the kids! The Holiday Classic includes a ¼ mile Elves Trot fun run for children ages 3-6. Every participating elf will receive an adorable Santa medal.

Post-race festivities

All participants of the Half Marathon, 10K and 5K will receive a free breakfast. There is a $3 charge for Elves Trot participants. Also free to all participants, a soothing, post-race mini-massage provided by gentle therapists from Precision in Movement.

Groups/teams

Create a team for your family, friends and coworkers to join. Each team participant will get a $5 discount for teams of between 5 and 14 participants. Each participant will get a $10 discount for teams of greater than 15 participants.

Holiday Toy Drive

Join the Loma Linda Fire Department and ABC7 in the 34th annual Spark of Love Toy Drive--the largest community toy drive in the nation.

The fire department will be accepting new, unwrapped toys and sports equipment for under-served children and teens. The toys collected will be donated to families within our own community.

Donations are also accepted at both Loma Linda fire stations and at Loma Linda City Hall.

name: 37th Annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K
description:
The Lopers Club and the City of Loma Linda present the 37th annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K! The Holiday Classic is the Inland Empire’s longest running annual holiday running event and a local tradition for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities!

Location

The race Start/Finish will take place in front of the Loma Linda Fire Station located at 11325 Loma Linda Drive in Loma Linda. Park in any nearby lot except for the Veteran's Hospital.

Event information

This year’s event will take place on Sunday, December 6, 2026. The Half Marathon, 10K and 5K have a wave start, with 10 minutes between waves. Start time is 7:00 am. The Half Marathon has a course limit of 4 hours which is allows for walkers who can maintain an 18 minute per mile average pace. There will be many walkers as well as runners in both the 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.

The Start/Finish Line will be located near the corner of Barton Road and Loma Linda Drive, in front of the Loma Linda Fire station.

Event features

The Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K,  and 5K run/walk, provides scenic mountain views with stimulating inclines on a course which winds through the lovely streets of Loma Linda. Beautiful, long-sleeved tech shirts will be provided for all participants who register prior to November 1, 2026. Participants registering after the cutoff will receive a shirt while supplies last, we might not have your size if you register in less than three weeks before the event. All finishers of both the Half Marathon, 10K and the 5K event will be awarded beautiful finishers' medals. Trophies will be awarded to the overall top male and female winner of each race. Division medals will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place male and female finishers in each of 20 age divisions.

Bring the kids! The Holiday Classic includes a ¼ mile Elves Trot fun run for children ages 3-6. Every participating elf will receive an adorable Santa medal.

Post-race festivities

All participants of the Half Marathon, 10K and 5K will receive a free breakfast. There is a $3 charge for Elves Trot participants. Also free to all participants, a soothing, post-race mini-massage provided by gentle therapists from Precision in Movement.

Groups/teams

Create a team for your family, friends and coworkers to join. Each team participant will get a $5 discount for teams of between 5 and 14 participants. Each participant will get a $10 discount for teams of greater than 15 participants.

Holiday Toy Drive

Join the Loma Linda Fire Department and ABC7 in the 34th annual Spark of Love Toy Drive--the largest community toy drive in the nation.

The fire department will be accepting new, unwrapped toys and sports equipment for under-served children and teens. The toys collected will be donated to families within our own community.

Donations are also accepted at both Loma Linda fire stations and at Loma Linda City Hall.

The Spark of Love Toy Drive embodies the spirit of compassion, generosity and community involvement during the holiday season.

name: 40th Annual Tinsel Triathlon
description:
Tinsel Triathlon & 5K
Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon
As one of the oldest and largest independently owned reverse sprint pool triathlons on the West Coast, it is certainly an ideal end of the season endurance race.  The 35 year old event truly can be the perfect venue for Triathletes of all levels.  For first timers who have always wanted to be triathletes the course is well defined, attainable and loaded with helpful volunteers.  We are also an awesome setting for the seasoned triathlete. The course layout lets you push yourself hard for a solid workout.  What better way to get your game on ... Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon!

The Tinsel is a Sunday Triathlon run on a usually sunny, yet crisp, Southern California day with all roads closed and the coffee hot.  The 5K run takes place in a scenic, calm area of West Hemet, California in Riverside County.   Known as a "flat & fast" course, the 12 mile bike ride gives the rider a feeling of being on the country roadside.  The race ends in the 25 meter heated pool at West Valley High School, triathletes will swim 150 meters (up & back 6 times) to the finish line where you receive a unique Tinsel finisher medal.  The awards ceremony follows immediately and the bling is top shelf!

name: 44th Annual Highland Y Run
description:
Every year the Highland YMCA welcomes runners and race enthusiasts of all ages and abilities to participate in a chipped or unchipped race. The Highland Y Run is a fundraising event for the Highland YMCA that offers a scenic 5K or 10K route through the beautiful City of Highland, CA. All net proceeds from the Highland Y Run benefit the YMCA Financial Assistance program.  Through our Financial Assistance Program, the YMCA offers scholarships to Highland youth and families who may be unable to afford our programs.  By participating and supporting the Highland Y Run, you work alongside the Y to build strong kids, strong families and strong communities.  

The first 500 participants will receive a participation medal, run shirt guaranteed during pre-registration (1/4/2027)

name: 44th Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
description:
🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 44th Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 44th Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! Established in 1977, The Brentwood Run is Los Angeles' oldest road race.

This historic race features an out and back course with a slight incline in the second half. It is considered a easy/fast and enjoyable run or walk course for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 44th Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 44th Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! Established in 1977, The Brentwood Run is Los Angeles' oldest road race.

This historic race features an out and back course with a slight incline in the second half. It is considered a easy/fast and enjoyable run or walk course for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

name: 47th Annual AMS 5K & Wellness Expo VI
description:
Locals know this as a popular and inclusive community event that offers a fun family environment focused on physical and spiritual Wellness. Participants walk, jog, run, and/or race. This event also includes a Stroller Competition and Costume Contest.  


For those racing, the fast and challenging 3.1-mile course includes certified timing and a large digital clock at the finish.


For EVERYONE, this event provides an opportunity for Wellness and to experience a fun-filled, all-inclusive activity & the American Martyrs community.

name: 47th Annual Foggy Bottom Milk Run
description:
Visit Ferndale for the Foggy Bottom Milk Run! The race features a 4 Mile, 2 Mile, and 10 Mile course. The race starts and finishes in downtown Ferndale, CA

name: 4th Annual Porterville 5K/10K Trail Run
description:
Description:

On 4/10/2027, the Porterville Military Academy athletic department is hosting a 5k/10k run/walk starting and finishing at Porterville Military Academy. Join us for a 5k or 10k dirt path course that is out and back. We are also hosting a children's 1/4 mile short course for your little ones to get in on the action. We look forward to seeing your whole family enjoy this community event.

All 5k race participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher Medal
  • Chip time and digital certificate
  • Race bib with individual number
  • Upbeat motivational music
  • Free Parking
All kids 1/4 mile participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher medal

Age Group Winners:

The top three males and the top three females in each age group will be rewarded with a prize after the race! The prize is still being worked on and will be posted here as soon as the artwork comes back. The age groups are...

  • 1-10
  • 11-15
  • 16-19
  • 20-29
  • 30-39
  • 40-49
  • 50-59
  • 60-69
  • 70+

Packet Pickup:

  • Place: Porterville Military Academy front office
  • Date: TBD
  • If you are unable to make it to packet pickup, you can come on the morning of the event from 6:30 AM - 7:30 AM

Virtual Race - If you live locally, you are encouraged to come to packet pickup. Otherwise, the race medal will be mailed to you after the race.

We do not store any unclaimed race packets after the race. If you do not pick up your packet prior to the race, then it is considered forfeited. Leftover supplies are donated to volunteers and local charities.

Who we support:

  • The Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA), is an international organization with over 200,000 members. EAA chapters provide a community for pilots and aviation enthusiasts. The Porterville EAA Chapter 1547 has supported Porterville Military Academy Cadets in multiple facets by providing scholarships, overseeing more than 150 Porterville Military Academy Cadets flying an airplane, and mentoring our future aviators on the theories of flight.

name: 50th Annual Holiday Run and Walk for Health
description:
We are very excited to bring back the Kiwanis Holiday run. This year will be the 50th running of this event. We have partnered with Rotary Club of the Delta to make sure we bring a high-quality event. We have worked to provide a better course, and lots of medals. We also hope our school’s challenge will be bigger than ever. There will be a medal to the top five runners in every age category, as well as cash prizes and trophies to our top three High school, middle school, and elementary schools. 

Many people have put a lot of work together to make this event happen, none more important than former race director Paul Schorr.

We hope you join us for the 50th Annual – Kiwanis/ Rotary – Paul Schorr Memorial Holiday Run and walk for health. Do it for the Health of It!
