name: 56th NorCal John Frank Memorial Run
description:
March 6, 2027

10-Mile USATF Pacific Association Road Grand Prix event.

Run a spring race along the beautiful Sacramento River Trail and across two iconic pedestrian bridges, the Diestelhorst Bridge and the Stress Ribbon Bridge, in Redding, CA.

Plus a 3-Mile Run/Walk and 1 Mile Run/Walk. Kids 14 and under run the 1 Mile for free.

Course Records:

$2900 in prize purse for 10-Mile, awarded to USATF Pacific Association members.
$2500 in course record prize purse for 10-Mile. $1000 for men/women open course records, $250 for men/women masters (40+ y/o) course records.

  • Women's Open: 55:23 (Sara Hall, 2016)
  • Men's Open: 48:38 (Brendan Gregg, 2022)
  • Women's Masters: 57:09 (Linda Smith, 2010)
  • Men's Masters: 50:47 (Sergio Reyes, 2022)

Packet pickup will be on Friday March 5, from 11am to 5pm, at Fleet Feet Redding, 1376 Hilltop Dr, Redding, CA 96003.
Race day registration opens at 7:30am at Lake Redding Park, 2225 Benton Dr, Redding, CA US 96003.

1 Mile starts at 8:30 AM.
10 Mile starts at 10:00 AM.
3 Mile starts at 10:05 AM.

name: 5K and Fun Day for Fragile X
description:
Superheroes are back once again!! 

Join us on Saturday, April 17th, 2027 for the 14th Annual 5K Walk/Roll/Run/Cheer for Fragile X and celebrate our Southern California Fragile X Community! Click Here for Event Details for Participants 

This isn't your typical 5K.  It is more of a choose your own adventure sort of day.  You can particpate in the full 5K at your own speed, take the 1.8 mile scenic "short cut" loop, or just hang back at the event area to enjoy all the fun.

Why race for Fragile X syndrome? 

Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the leading known cause of inherited intellectual disability and the leading single gene cause of Autism. Fraxsocal’s mission is to promote public awareness and with your help we can accomplish this goal! Also, to provide a forum for families and children with FXS to meet & greet and create a stronger FXS community! We also support research for effective treatments and ultimately a cure for FXS. Treatments for Fragile X are likely to help people affected by autism, Alzheimer’s, and other brain disorders.

Fragile X Community 

A Family Fun Day will proceed after the walk with Family, Friends, Food and Fun!! It's a great time to chat with other families affected by fragile X syndrome (FXS) and it's also a nice opportunity for you to take your kid(s) or adult(s) with FXS or any disability for that matter, judgement free! 

How to participate:
  • Participate in person: Sign up to walk, run, bike, scoot or stroll (it's a very family friendly walk/run) All you do is click the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! Mark your calendar and be sure to arrive early so you can get your FREE t-shirt and goodies before we begin. You can do the full 5K, the short 1.8 mile scenic loop, or simply hang back at the event area and relax.   
  • Participate virtually: Sign up by clicking the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! (Make sure you have someone there in person to pick up your t-shirts otherwise you will be donating them to our organization in which we say, "thank you"! )  Or, just click "donate" and give what you can. 
  • Start a Fundraiser: Whether you are participating in person or virtually, you can start an individual fundraiser and attach it to a TEAM in the honor of your Fragile X Super Hero.
  • Become a Sponsor:  Whether you personally, your company or a company you know are interested we have multiple packages to choose from! 
  • Recognize a participant with a fun, inspirational sign to be placed along the 5K course! (see the "store" section of this website)
 
Race Fundraising Goal: $60,000 Last year we raised over $55,000!!! Let's see if we can top that!! Donations can be made by clicking the Donate Tab.
 
Share!

Inform your network of supporters! Use these Social Media graphic template to help you tell others that you are racing and/or fundraising! Invite them to race or donate in your honor or in the honor of your Fragile X Superhero.

Map to find us

More about our organization: 
FRAGILE X ASSOCIATION of SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (FRAXSOCAL)
Our non-profit organization was formed to promote public awareness of Fragile X Syndrome with special emphasis on educators and health professionals; provide a forum for families and children with Fragile X to meet and share their ideas, concerns and problems; and support scientific research on Fragile X Syndrome.

name: 5k/1mile- WALK/RUN  FOR TYPE 1 DIABETES AWARENESS
description:
Join Us for the Type 1 Diabetes Walk/Run!

Whether you're living with type 1 diabetes, supporting someone you love, or simply want to make a difference, we invite you to be part of this special community event. Together, we'll celebrate the strength of the T1D community, honor every person whose life has been touched by type 1 diabetes, and raise critical funds to help create a world without T1D! Every step we take and every dollar we raise supports Breakthrough T1D's mission to accelerate life-changing breakthroughs to cure, prevent, and treat type 1 diabetes and its complications.

You can make an impact by:

Registering to participate in the Walk/Run.
Creating a team and inviting your family, friends, and coworkers to join you.
Fundraising to help advance critical T1D research. Use the fundraising link above to track your donations and see the impact this event has on finding a cure for type 1 diabetes!
To donate if you're unable to attend but still want to support the cause, use the link above to make an impact. You can donate with a message and share your reason!
Together, we're building a stronger community, creating hope for families living with T1D, and moving us closer to a future where no one has to live with this disease.

Thank you for helping us turn hope into action!

name: 8th Annual KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 2 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs or pets are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 3, 2026. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

name: 8th Annual Super Bulldog Jog 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Bulldog Jog is a 5K run/walk for all ages.  Course will begin and end inside the school, however the majority of the 5K will run through our surrounding community residential streets.  Located exclusively on the school’s campus, will also be the “Health Fair," which will include “FREE” pre- and post-run festivities (beginning at 7am) featuring a variety of entertainment, as well as health and fitness information.  This event will offer not only finisher medals, shirts, and timed bib at a low cost to those who register, but also fun activities for the whole family at the Health Fair.

-----------------------------------------------------

El Bulldog Jog es una carrera/caminata de 5 km para todas las edades. El recorrido comenzará y terminará dentro de la escuela; sin embargo, la mayor parte de la carrera se realizará por las calles residenciales de nuestra comunidad circundante. Ubicada exclusivamente en el campus de la escuela, también se realizará la "Feria de la Salud", que incluirá actividades gratuitas antes y después de la carrera (a partir de las 7:00 a. m.) con una variedad de entretenimiento, así como información sobre salud y ejercicio. Este evento no solo ofrecerá medallas, camisetas y dorsales cronometrados a bajo costo para quienes se inscriban, sino también actividades divertidas para toda la familia en la Feria de la Salud.

name: 9/11 Run to Remember
description:
Join us for the 9/11 Run to Remember at the California 9/11 Memorial in Clovis, California— the largest permanent 9/11 memorial outside of New York City.

This meaningful community event honors the 2,977 lives lost on September 11, 2001, including civilians, first responders, and military personnel. More than a race, this is a morning of remembrance, unity, patriotism, and reflection.

Whether you run the 5K or walk the 1 Mile course, every step helps ensure we never forget.

name: 9th Annual Run4Sharks & Ocean Health Fair 5k Fundraiser...Custom medal to all Finishers! Timed 5k on a new flat course in Long Beach
description:
Come out and get your fitness on with a 5k timed race along the bike paths in Long Beach with a view of the ocean. Starting at our monthly beach cleanup location near Saltwater Deck, this will be an out & back 5k on flat fast course. BE SAFE and watch for cyclists, dogs, beach goers, and fitness enthusiasts that use the path daily.

Sponsor a Kid: We want to send a group of kids to CIMI on Catalina Island, a ocean science weekend. Sponsor a kid, any amount and we will pool the funds to make sure a kid runs instead of you, earning his/her spot on the list to go to Catalina.  Thank you in advance for your generosity.

TEAMS OF 5 OR MORE GET $5 OFF...Here's how: The first four people signing up for the team pay current price. Anyone signing up for  team after the fourth person gets $5 off current price and the first four people will then automatically get a $5 refund. Questions? call or text race director: Maria @ 951-496-6520. 

 

Can't make it to the event? Choose our Virtual Option and do it in your neighborhood. On site, browse through our booths and learn about ocean health, sharks, and fitness from our sponsors. Located at our beach cleanup location near Saltwater Deck. This is a fundraising event with an Opportunity drawing supporting Shark Stewards, a fiscally sponsored project of Earth Island Institute, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Shark Stewards works to protect sharks and preserve healthy ocean ecosystems.

 

ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSES 6PM ON FRIDAY MARCH 26TH,  RACE DAY REGISTRATION OPENS AT 7:30 AM.

name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅
Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: A Snail's Pace x Saucony Sunset Relays
description:
Music, food and running! Celebrate a night under the lights with your running crew, racing nothing but RELAYS all night - 4x100, 4x200, 4x400, 4x800, 4x1600 and the distance medley relay (AKA DMR - 1200m, 400m, 800m, 1600m). This event is open to all ability levels. 

4x100m - 1 heat

4x200m - 1 heat

4x400m - 5 heats

4x800m - 2 heats

4x1600m - 1 heat

DMR - 3 heats

Top finishers will also receive a commemorative race medal, and winners of each heat will get a special surprise.

Saucony will have the Endorphin Speed 6 shoes for you to demo during the race so you can hit your fastest time! Featuring an Endorphin Speed 6 heat, racing in Speed 6 and winners receive the anticipated Endorphin Speed 6.

Heats will be announced the day before the race. Once heats are set, we are unable to move your start time. If you miss your call time, we cannot place you in a later heat. Please check in with the clerk of the course no later than 45 minutes before your heat time. 

Space is limited and will sell out. 

**Race director reserves the right to review and revoke winning times.

name: Advanced Sailing November 21 US Sailing 101
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 6 hours of sail time at the Intermediate level (Catalina Capri 22) is required post Intermediate sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The course will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

name: Advanced Sailing November 21 US Sailing 101
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 6 hours of sail time at the Intermediate level (Catalina Capri 22) is required post Intermediate sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

name: Aim High With Charge
description:
Join us as we celebrate our 10th annual Aim High in 2026. Through this event we are able to give back to those who serve our countries and communities. The event will be held, Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026 Aim High at Coyote Valley Sporting Clays in Morgan Hill, CA, and includes a 20-station clay shoot competition, multiple raffles for firearms and other prizes, as well as breakfast and lunch.

As in year's past, Aim High raises funds for the Taya and Chris Kyle Foundation (formerly the Chris Kyle Frog Foundation). TACK-F is focused on changing the world for this generation and the next by recognizing and strengthening service families through unique programs and powerful partnerships. Donate, sponsor, volunteer or attend! All funds raised through Aim High go directly to TACK-F and can be put to work immediately.

name: Akash Wine Run 5k
description:
THIS EVENT WILL SELL OUT! SIGN UP TODAY!

Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, February 28, 2027 for an exciting annual event that features Akash Winery & Vineyards. We have 2 waves starting at 9am and 11am but both will sell out fast so sign up soon!  Come join us on the gorgeous, open-air patio, where you’ll find far more than beautiful views and amazing wine. This winery is loved by locals and out-of-towners alike, thanks to the happy energy and friendly faces of our knowledgeable team.  So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Alameda Island Running Festival
description:
We are excited to announce that we are moving our Island Running Festival to align with our spring run date(s) and will be back at Faction Brewery for the post run Expo and beer garden. There will be two days of racing along with our Health and Wellness expo presented by Alameda Health Systems. 

 

Join us for a new 5 Mile distance or the family fun run on Saturday, or stick with one of our traditional Sunday events. there will also be Yoga on Saturday, course previews and the Expo

 

A portion of the proceeds from the event will benefit the Alameda Hospital Foundation.  portion of our registrations will be donated to our Beneficiary Alameda Education Foundation. you can read more about them from our direct links below:
AHF Website: https://www.ahfgift.org 
 
Race Weekend Packet Pick Up:
  • Thursday and Friday April 15th and 16th : Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St, Alameda, Ca. 94501
    • 10:00am - 6:00pm * we encourage you to get your BIB and shirt early and sleep in race morning! 
  • Saturday 8:00am - 10:00am - Race Start/Finish Faction Brewery 2501 Monarch St, Alameda Pt. Alameda
  • Sunday: 6:30am - 8:15am - Race Start/Finish Faction Brewery 2501 Monarch St, Alameda Pt. Alameda
 
Race Events and Schedule: 
  • Saturday: 
    • 5 Mile run: 9:00am
    • 1 Mile family fun run: 10:00am
    • Yoga on the patio presented by Breathing Room - 2:00pm
  • Sunday 
    • Half Marathon: 7:30am
    • 10K: 8:00am 
    • 5k Presented by Penumbra: 8:15am
 
Race Timing and Restrictions:

the Island Running Festival is a chip-timed event.  Participants can run, jog or walk the entire course. 
Jogging strollers are permitted but are asked to start in the back of the pack.  Wheelchair athletes are permitted but due to safety concerns and street closure restrictions cannot travel faster than the fastest runner.   No bikes, scooters, skateboards or other wheeled vehicles are allowed. Dogs are not allowed on our race courses.  We love dogs, but there are those who are not so comfortable around them and there are also dogs that are uncomfortable around hundreds of other people, therefore NO DOGS ALLOWED on the course or at the finish line.

We will provide bike parking for those of you that prefer to bike to the event. See out athlete guide for more details as we approach Raceday

 

Medical and Water Stops:

We will have a dedicated paramedics team on site and available to help assess your race day medical needs and administer acute first aid when necessary. A medical station will be located near the finish line and team members will be roaming the course. 
Water Stops: see maps page for more info
  • Half: Mile 2, 5.5 & 11
  • 10k: Mile 2, 5.5
  • 5k: Mile  2 & 2.5 
 
Volunteers:
We can always use volunteers and it takes the support or our community and friends to make these events successful. if you are interested in learning more visit our website and volunteer support page or reach out to info@outfrontendurance.com

name: Alameda July 4th Parade R.A.C.E.
description:
Registration is open for our July 4th tradition. Run this flat and fast point to point 5k thru the closed streets of Alameda. We will be starting again at 8:30am to provide ample space between our runners and the Parade that follows. 

We had an amazing 250th celebration and learned a lot. The SHUTTLE service  was a great success and we will be adding more routes in 2027 from the race finish back to the start FREE of charge. 

General Overview: 

The 5K run (3.1 mile) and walk takes you through beautiful Alameda winding thru business and residential streets. This run benefits the Midway Shelter of Alameda and kicks off our historic Island Parade, the longest in the country! Runners start in the Park St Business District and end at the Webster Farmers Market location with completely closed roads and spectators beginning to line up for the Parade that follow at 10:00am

Packet Pick-up:

  • 7/1 thru 7/3: Laurens Closet. 1420 Park St, Alameda. Hours 10:00am - 5:00pm  
  • 7/4 Race morning registration opens at 7:30am 1440 Park St, Alameda ~ La Penca Restaurant. Corner of Santa Clara

Race Day Details: 

  • Start: 1420 Park St. Alameda, ca. 94501
  • Packet Pick-up : 7:30am
  • Race Start : 8:30am
  • Finish: 1526 Webster St, Alameda, CA 94501 (Tues/Saturday Farmers Market Location)

This race is BIB timed but we will have no AG awards this year. With a focus on community involvement we have great finisher shirts and customs medals as well as some "run the island" SWAG at the finish

 

Our expo will have the best of local businesses focused on health and longevity, and of course our Beer Garden sponsored by Faction Brewery. 

 

If you are traveling via Bart or public transportation please review the schedules below to get you to the race start, and picked up from the race finish. And if you park at the start, don't forget to follow the signs to the Post run Shuttle back to the start: Shuttle will run from 9am - 1pm with priority to runners with BIBS but will be open to all of our community ! 

  • Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/
  • AC Transit Site: https://www.actransit.org/

name: Alhambra Pumpkin Run 2026
description:
Join us on Sunday, October 25th for our 13th Annual Alhambra Pumpkin Run and Halloween Festival in Downtown Alhambra! Proceeds benefit the Alhambra Educational Foundation! Our mission is to provide a fun, family environment to promote physical fitness, health and give back to our community with a fun event that brings you costumes, music and entertainment.
HOW TO RUN WITH US?
STEP #1: SIGN UP! - Register online early! We will be selling out and selling a capped number of runners this year.
STEP #2: PICK UP! - Pick up your runner’s packet on Saturday, October 24th: 9am - 1pm at Alhambra High School Cafeteria.
STEP #3: SHOW UP! - Show up on Sunday, October 25th to run or walk with us in your run gear, Halloween costume, or your Pumpkin Run t-shirt!
RUNNERS RECEIVE:
Commemorative 2026 Pumpkin Run t-shirt
Commemorative 2026 Pumpkin Run custom finisher’s medal received after crossing the finish line
Commemorative 2026 Pumpkin Run runner's bib with timing chip
Commemorative 2026 sponsored tote bag for 10K, 5K and 1K finishers
Chip timing (excluding 1K runners) for accurate run time results received after the 10K and 5K
1 Free Beer sponsored by Ohana Brewery for runners 21+ OR 1 Free non-alcoholic drink sponsored by Alhambra Educational Foundation for runners under 21 years of age located next to the Beer Garden tent across from the main stage.
Prizes for fastest runners to be determined.
Free photos from our photographers that will be posted on our Facebook page after the event.
Free goodies and giveaways at the finish line and festival hosted by proud sponsors.
EVENT HIGHLIGHTS:
Free and fun outdoor festival for the entire family!
Live entertainment including a band, dance performances and DJ!
Certified Alhambra Farmers Market!
AEF Hallowscream Kids Costume Contest at 11:00am!
Kids Zone including pumpkin patch, carnival games, and more!
Beer Garden and bar hosted by Alhambra Education Foundation and sponsored by Ohana Brewery! Proceeds benefit the Alhambra Educational Foundation. 
 
AGE REQUIREMENTS:
10K AGES:
Children 6 years and up may run/walk the 10K as paid participants. All children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by a registered adult for the entire duration of the race for safety. All participants need a bib/registration to enter the 10K and run the route. Children 5 years and younger are free to run/walk or be pushed in strollers for free. There is no registration needed for children 0 to 5 years.
5K AGES:
Children 6 years and up may run/walk the 5K as paid participants. All children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by a registered adult for the entire duration of the race for safety. All participants need a bib/registration to enter the 5K and run the route. Children 5 years and younger are free to run/walk or be pushed in strollers for free. There is no registration needed for children 0 to 5 years.
1K AGES:
Our 1K Kids race begins with a fun warm up of exercises and quick dances led by our fun Master of Ceremonies before this race begins. A 1K is 0.62 miles. Parents/Guardians may run behind their runner during the run. *All parents and runners must wait behind the barricades until it is their assigned group time.
Group #1: Age 6
Group #2: Age 7
Group #3: Ages 8
Group #4: Ages 9 & 10
KIDDIE FUN RUN AGES:
The Kiddie Fun Run is back! Our Kiddie Fun Run begins with a fun warm up of exercises and quick dances led by our fun Master of Ceremonies before the race begins. This route will be a 1/2 K (roughly a quarter mile). Parents/Guardians may run behind their runner during the run. *All parents and runners must wait behind the barricades until it is their assigned group time.
Group #1: Age 4
Group #2: Age 5
PLEASE NOTE: Age divisions for the 1K and Kiddie Fun Run are subject to change depending on registration participation. For the safety of the children, some divisions may be divided up into smaller groups. Updated age divisions are subject to change. Final determination will be made by the race director and posted on our social media pages before the race.
RUN ROUTES:
10K ROUTE:
Our 10K route is two loops of our 5K route. You get to see our beautiful Alhambra community twice. How lucky are you? Upon making the 1st loop around and beginning the 2nd loop, DO NOT RUN OVER THE TIMING MAT. Running over it will stop your time and we want to make sure your run time counts. Make sure you enter the barricaded lane to the right of the inflatable archway and keep running.
5K ROUTE:
Our 5K route begins on Main Street facing west. Runners travel west on Main Street to 6th Street and turn right and loop back on Main Street facing east. When runners hit Garfield, they will turn left onto Garfield traveling north as they pass the Renaissance Theater corner.
Runners then loop right and travel back to Main Street as they pass a DJ on the Renaissance Theater corner by Applebees’s and turn left onto Main Street and travel east down to El Molino Ave and then make a U-turn back around to face west on Main Street.
Runners travel west back to Garfield Ave. and turn left and travel south on Garfield Ave. to Bay State and then make a U-turn back around to face north on Garfield Ave. When runners hit Main Street, they will turn left onto Main Street traveling west to the FINISH LINE!
1K ROUTE:
The 1K course features a turnaround loop easy for the kids to follow and a police bike will be guiding the runners on the loop. The race begins on Main Street at our start line (cross street: 2nd Street) facing east Alhambra. The race begins and runners make a U-Turn at 5th Street and runners turn back around on Main Street facing west and ending at the finish line on 2nd Street.
KIDDIE FUN RUN ROUTE: 
The Kiddie Fun Run course features a turnaround loop easy for the kids to follow and a police bike will be guiding the runners on the loop. The race begins on Main Street at our start line (cross street: 2nd Street) facing east Alhambra. The race begins and runners make a U-Turn at 3rd Street and runners turn back around on Main Street facing west and ending at the finish line on 2nd Street.
PARTY TIME & FUN RUN!
The Alhambra Pumpkin Run is also a HUGE party! Dress up in your best Halloween, Pumpkin or Orange gear! Being so close to Halloween, many of our runners dress up to the run. Feel free to wear anything and all orange, a Halloween costume or a big and fun pumpkin tutu! Make it fun. Make it memorable.
*Costumes may not create a safety hazard to yourself or other runners.
*Costumes must be family friendly and appropriate for all ages. 
REFUND POLICY:
All entry fees are non-refundable and non-transferable. 
You may not alter, reproduce, give or sell your number to another individual – doing so will result in your disqualification as well as the participant who uses your race number. The entry fee for this year's event will not transfer to next year's event, no exceptions. This policy stays in effect whether you are injured, have an unexpected business or family emergency, pregnancy, Act of God, etc. There are no exceptions. Any inquiry regarding this policy will be directed back to this page. There is no rain check date, events will be held rain or shine.
There is no rain check date. The event will be held rain or shine.

Free goodies and giveaways at the finish line and festival hosted by proud sponsors.
EVENT HIGHLIGHTS:
Free and fun outdoor festival for the entire family!
Live entertainment including a band, dance performances and DJ!
Certified Alhambra Farmers Market!
AEF Hallowscream Kids Costume Contest at 11:00am!
Kids Zone including pumpkin patch, carnival games, and more!
Beer Garden and bar hosted by Alhambra Education Foundation and sponsored by Ohana Brewery! Proceeds benefit the Alhambra Educational Foundation. 
 
AGE REQUIREMENTS:
10K AGES:
Children 6 years and up may run/walk the 10K as paid participants. All children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by a registered adult for the entire duration of the race for safety. All participants need a bib/registration to enter the 10K and run the route. Children 5 years and younger are free to run/walk or be pushed in strollers for free. There is no registration needed for children 0 to 5 years.
5K AGES:
Children 6 years and up may run/walk the 5K as paid participants. All children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by a registered adult for the entire duration of the race for safety. All participants need a bib/registration to enter the 5K and run the route. Children 5 years and younger are free to run/walk or be pushed in strollers for free. There is no registration needed for children 0 to 5 years.
1K AGES:
Our 1K Kids race begins with a fun warm up of exercises and quick dances led by our fun Master of Ceremonies before this race begins. A 1K is 0.62 miles. Parents/Guardians may run behind their runner during the run. *All parents and runners must wait behind the barricades until it is their assigned group time.
Group #1: Age 6
Group #2: Age 7
Group #3: Ages 8
Group #4: Ages 9 & 10
KIDDIE FUN RUN AGES:
The Kiddie Fun Run is back! Our Kiddie Fun Run begins with a fun warm up of exercises and quick dances led by our fun Master of Ceremonies before the race begins. This route will be a 1/2 K (roughly a quarter mile). Parents/Guardians may run behind their runner during the run. *All parents and runners must wait behind the barricades until it is their assigned group time.
Group #1: Age 4
Group #2: Age 5
PLEASE NOTE: Age divisions for the 1K and Kiddie Fun Run are subject to change depending on registration participation. For the safety of the children, some divisions may be divided up into smaller groups. Updated age divisions are subject to change. Final determination will be made by the race director and posted on our social media pages before the race.
RUN ROUTES:
10K ROUTE:
Our 10K route is two loops of our 5K route. You get to see our beautiful Alhambra community twice. How lucky are you? Upon making the 1st loop around and beginning the 2nd loop, DO NOT RUN OVER THE TIMING MAT. Running over it will stop your time and we want to make sure your run time counts. Make sure you enter the barricaded lane to the right of the inflatable archway and keep running.
5K ROUTE:
Our 5K route begins on Main Street facing west. Runners travel west on Main Street to 6th Street and turn right and loop back on Main Street facing east. When runners hit Garfield, they will turn left onto Garfield traveling north as they pass the Renaissance Theater corner.
Runners then loop right and travel back to Main Street as they pass a DJ on the Renaissance Theater corner by Applebees’s and turn left onto Main Street and travel east down to El Molino Ave and then make a U-turn back around to face west on Main Street.
Runners travel west back to Garfield Ave. and turn left and travel south on Garfield Ave. to Bay State and then make a U-turn back around to face north on Garfield Ave. When runners hit Main Street, they will turn left onto Main Street traveling west to the FINISH LINE!
1K ROUTE:
The 1K course features a turnaround loop easy for the kids to follow and a police bike will be guiding the runners on the loop. The race begins on Main Street at our start line (cross street: 2nd Street) facing east Alhambra. The race begins and runners make a U-Turn at 5th Street and runners turn back around on Main Street facing west and ending at the finish line on 2nd Street.
KIDDIE FUN RUN ROUTE: 
The Kiddie Fun Run course features a turnaround loop easy for the kids to follow and a police bike will be guiding the runners on the loop. The race begins on Main Street at our start line (cross street: 2nd Street) facing east Alhambra. The race begins and runners make a U-Turn at 3rd Street and runners turn back around on Main Street facing west and ending at the finish line on 2nd Street.
PARTY TIME & FUN RUN!
The Alhambra Pumpkin Run is also a HUGE party! Dress up in your best Halloween, Pumpkin or Orange gear! Being so close to Halloween, many of our runners dress up to the run. Feel free to wear anything and all orange, a Halloween costume or a big and fun pumpkin tutu! Make it fun. Make it memorable.
*Costumes may not create a safety hazard to yourself or other runners.
*Costumes must be family friendly and appropriate for all ages. 
REFUND POLICY:
All entry fees are non-refundable and non-transferable. 
You may not alter, reproduce, give or sell your number to another individual – doing so will result in your disqualification as well as the participant who uses your race number. The entry fee for this year's event will not transfer to next year's event, no exceptions. This policy stays in effect whether you are injured, have an unexpected business or family emergency, pregnancy, Act of God, etc. There are no exceptions. Any inquiry regarding this policy will be directed back to this page. There is no rain check date, events will be held rain or shine.
There is no rain check date. The event will be held rain or shine.

FOLLOW US ON FACEBOOK

name: Almond Bowl 5K & 10K November 1st, 2026
description:
Join us, in person, on November 1st, 2026 for the 52nd Annual Almond Bowl in the beautiful Lower Bidwell Park!

Keeping with the Chico tradition we will be hosting a 5k and 10k race starting on South Park Drive and finishing near the Sycamore Field. The price of this race includes your race shirt from Upper Park Clothing, a race bib for you to wear during your run and plenty of post-race snacks for after your run! 


This race, along with the Bidwell classic, are fundraisers for our local high school's cross-country teams and band programs! Additional donations can be accepted in the registration page! 

 

RACE START TIMES


5k: 8:00am

10k: 8:10am

 

REGISTRATION

Registration for this year's Almond Bowl will be available online. In person registration will be available during packet pick up only. 

 

Race Fee Schedule

Dec 11th - March 31st - (online)              10k $50.00

                                                                        5k $40.00

April. 1st - August. 31st - (online)           10k $55.00

                                                                        5k $45.00

September 1st - Oct. 30th                        10k $60.00

(online @ 9am)                                             5k $50.00

In person Registration at Packet Pickup 
 
                                                                      10k $60.00

                                                                        5k $50.00
 

In person registration will be available at Fleet Feet Chico during packet pickup ONLY. (October 30th and 31st, 2026) Packet pickup will be from 10:00am - 2:00pm Friday and 9:00am - 2:00pm on Saturday. 

 
Registration Information
Online registration closes October 30th at 9:00 a.m. Registration will be available in person on October 30th and 31st at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm on Friday and 9am-2pm on Saturday. You need to Register by Friday October 9th to guarantee yourself race shirt. If you register between October 9th - November 1st your shirt will NOT be guaranteed. Limited number of extra shirts will be available first come first serve at packet pickup. All left over shirts/unclaimed shirts will be available for pickup or for sale (non-registered runners) AFTER the race on November 1st. Shirts will be first come first serve starting at 9:00am.  

OFFICAL COURSE CERTIFICATION AND MAPS

5K and 10K: Flat, fast loop through beautiful (newly paved!) lower Bidwell Park. 

Click here for both course maps.

 

DIRECTIONS AND PARKING FOR OPTIONAL RACE LOCATION

To the course:
Enter Chico via Highway 99 either from the north or from the south. If you are coming from the north on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn right at the first intersection. If you are coming from the south on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn left at the second intersection. Now you're heading west on 32 (East 8th St). From here. If coming from north 99 take the highway 32 exit and turn right onto 8th St. 

Take 8th St just under a half-mile, then turn right on Sycamore St.
Sycamore St runs a few blocks into Woodland Ave, which runs parallel to the park. The park itself will be closed to vehicle traffic on race day, so find a parking spot on or near Woodland Ave. Please be courteous and park legally. Do not park in a way that blocks local residents' entry to or exit from their homes.
There are several entrances to the One Mile Recreation Area from Woodland Ave. For race-day packet pickup, look for the sign marked pre-Registered. For any other assistance, make your way to the Information booth.


 

PACKET PICKUP

Packet pickup will be held at Fleet Feet Chico on the following days and times:

Friday and Saturday October 30th and 31st, 2026

10:00am-2:00pm (Friday)

9:00am-2:00pm (Saturday)

Fleet Feet - Chico
241 Main Street
Chico, CA 95928
(530) 345-1000

 
Race Rules:
Be courteous when overtaking slower runners or walkers in your elected race location. We want you to race hard and fast, but with safety of yourself and others in mind.

Where your Race number so it is visible on the participant's front!

Run your race with pride!

You must cross the timing mat for your chip to be read. If you are planning of racing for top finisher, the race is based on gun time and first to cross the finish line.

All other placements (age groups) will be based on chip timing.


Run, hard, run fast and have fun!


No pets will be allowed on course during the race.


All strollers must start at the back of the pack.


Thank you for understanding. 
 

AID STATIONS AND RESTROOMS
There will be 3 for the 10k and 2 for the 5k.

1.     Cedar Grove Bathrooms – Water 
2.     Peterson Drive Gate – Water 
3.     99 Overpass (Vallombrosa side) – Water
Restroom on the course will be located at One Mile recreation on the North and South side of the pool, Cedar Grove Park, and Pettersen Dr. Park entrance as well as portable restrooms at the start and finish.
 
 

T-SHIRTS AND AWARDS
Guaranteed Tee-shirt cutoff is October 9th, 2026

Cotton Poly blend shirts from Upper Park Clothing Co. will be provided to all participants who register for this event before the tee shirt cutoff. (10/9/26) Any participant who registers on or before October 9th will be guaranteed a race tee. Any participant who registers after October 10th will be able to receive a race shirt based on a limited size availability (very few extras will be ordered). Any shirts not picked up at packet pick up prior to the race will be available on a first come first serve basis to all paid runners for pick up, and available for sale to any unregistered spectators starting at 9:00am at the Fleet Feet booth. 
All shirts come in adult male (unisex) sizes, so you may wish to choose a smaller size than normal for female and child runners. No youth sizes will be available. 
 

AWARDS FOR TOP FINISHERS
 
We will be offering a CASH PRIZE Top male and female for each race! (5k & 10k) We will have an award ceremony at 8:30am for the 5k, 9:00am for the 10k.
 
Age group awards can be found at the Fleet Feet tent following the award ceremony for each race. 
(Awards will also be offered to the top three in each age group category for each gender in each race)
 
All unclaimed prized will be available for pick up at Fleet Feet Chico on Tuesday 3rd during regular business hours. (10:00am-5:00pm)

Age group brackets will be as followed: 

14 and under / 15-19 / 20-29 / 30-39 / 40-49 / 50-59 / 60-69 / 70 and over
  
For more information, please email kristina@fleetfeetchico.com or shawna@feetfeetchico.com

**No Refunds on race entries or merchandise purchased for this event**

name: Alpha Kappa Psi - Psi Kappa Ocean Conservation 5K
description:
Alpha Kappa Psi – Psi Kappa Ocean Conservation 5K 🌊

Join Alpha Kappa Psi – Psi Kappa Chapter for our Ocean Conservation 5K at the Great Highway on November 8!

This free 5K run/walk brings together current brothers, alumni, friends, and guests to support ocean conservation. We are supporting The Nature Conservancy, whose conservation work includes protecting oceans and marine ecosystems through science-based research!


There is no entrance fee to participate! Instead, we’re using Charity Miles to help raise funds for our cause. Charity Miles connects us with sponsors who donate based on the miles participants complete.

So whether you walk, jog, or run, your miles can help contribute to our fundraising efforts!

Make sure you join our Charity Miles group before November 8th. Instructions for joining the group are included in your email.

Date: November 8th
Time: 12:00pm
Starting Location: Sunset Dunes Park Skate Park (Great Highway & Sloat Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94116) 
Finishing Location: The Cliff House (1090 Point Lobos Ave, San Francisco, CA 94121)

We hope to see our brothers, alumni, friends, and guests out there!

name: Always Hope Easter Run LOS ANGELES
description:
🐣🏃‍♀️Hop Into Action at the Always Hope Easter Run! 

Spring into the season with purpose, community, and fun! Whether you're chasing a personal best, strolling with family, or hunting for a reason to get moving, the Always Hope Easter Run has a place for you on the starting line.

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: American River Parkway Half Marathon
description:
The Parkway Half Marathon is an annual spring-time tradition for runners and walkers in the Sacramento region!  This flat, fast, and shady course travels along the American River Parkway through old-growth Oak forests, lush meadows, and pristine riparian habitat, making it a perfect race for a PR, and a scenic journey for everyone!  But the Parkway Half is more than just a race- it is the first, and for nearly a decade, the ONLY race event to donate 100% of its proceeds to benefit the American River Parkway. As of 2026, our cumulative donations have amounted to over $400,000! 

These donations help fund habitat restoration, invasive plant removal, trash clean up, kids’ interactive nature trails, and our latest project - drinking fountain installations, of which five have been installed, with two more on the way! As such, participating in the Parkway Half Marathon is the number one way to support your Parkway!

Come on out for the race, stay for the party, and support your Parkway along the way!

name: Anaheim Ducks 5K presented by Arrowhead Water
description:
The Anaheim Ducks 5K presented by Arrowhead Water will return to Great Park in Irvine on Sunday, November 22nd! Race activities will start promptly at 8:00 AM.

Runners and walkers of all levels are welcome, and as always, all proceeds from the event will benefit the Anaheim Ducks Foundation. Whether you sign up for the 5K Run or 1-Mile Fun Run / Walk, each participant will receive a race day t-shirt, finisher's medal, souvenir runner's bib, plus (1) Terrace Level ticket to one of the below Ducks home games at Honda Center:

  • November 11th vs Nashville Predators
  • December 16th vs Vancouver Canucks
  • January 5th vs Minnesota Wild

name: Anaheim Turkey Trot 5K/10K  -Corner of Katella on the SANTA ANA RIVER TRAIL.  Across the street from Honda Center
description:
Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot 5K/10K
Run up a Thanksgiving appetite at this year’s Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot! Caren Ware Events brings you the ultimate race bling and the best holiday-themed motivation to stay healthy and active. Enjoy a scenic run along the paved Santa Ana River Trail and finish with a view of the iconic “Big A” of Angel Stadium.

Event Location:
Just north of Katella & S Douglas Road on the Santa Ana River Trail, between Angel Stadium and the Honda Center.
Closest Google address: 2610 E. Katella Ave, Anaheim, CA 92806 (former JT Schmid location).

 
What Each Participant Receives:
A collectible themed turkey shirt, beanie, or stuffed event turkey
A custom cast Turkey finisher medal or a choice of race beanie
Chip timing by ITZABOUTTIME with age division awards (3-deep per 5-year span)
A fresh slice of pumpkin pie with whipped cream at the finish
Fun, camaraderie, and holiday cheer
Enjoy music, a festive “along the fence” event expo, Thanksgiving decorations, and photo ops!

 
Race Day Schedule:
6:30 – 8:00 AM: Registration & walk-up packet pick-up
7:50 AM: Warm-up session
7:55 – 8:10 AM: Rolling start for 5K & 10K (must start by 8:10 AM)
8:11 AM: 1-Mile Fun Run start

name: Annual San Bernardino Turkey Trot
description:
San Bernardino's Family Fun Thanksgiving Tradition returns for its 12th year!

Join us on the Saturday before Thanksgiving, the 21st of November.

We are excited to return to our scenic course through Cal State San Bernardino! Moving our start times an hour later this year.

Please come out and "wobble before you gobble".  Come out and continue your family fun tradition with your closest and newest friends at our new location.

A portion of the net proceeds will go towards supporting Alexander Foundation and Exonerated Nation.  

It is important to note that any runners that register after November 10th are not guaranteed a participant shirt.

5k, 10k and kids 1k courses around campus.

  • Chip timing for 5k and 10k run/walks
  • Custom-designed diecast finisher medals to all 5k/10k participants  
  • Age group awards three deep to top male and female 5k & 10K winners in 18 age categories
  • Shirts for 5k/10k participants in adult unisex and youth sizes
  • Discounts for teams/group of 8 or more (*contact is sbturkeytrot@gmail.com or hit the contact us button)
  • Team competitions with awards to the biggest team and the fastest team
  • Finish-line festival featuring costume contest, music, food, freebies, and fun for adults and kids of all ages

PACKET PICK-UP 

Tentatively scheduled for Friday, November 20th, 1-4pm

in San Bernardino, CA - Location TBD

You can pick up your bib, t-shirt, at packet pick-up or on race day morning at the event venue starting at 7:00 AM.

We expect heavy traffic race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

RACE DAY SCHEDULE 
7:00 AM - Late registration / packet pick-up 
8:00 AM - 10k start 
8:15 AM - 5k start 
9:30 AM - 1k Kids Run

9:00 AM - 5k & 10k age group winners announced*

*Age group awards are based on chip time.

name: Apple Dash 5K
description:
The Apple Dash 5K takes place this Saturday, October 10th. Race start is at 8:00 AM. Both the start and finish line will be located at Philip Marx Central Park, near the Scout Hut, southwest corner of the park off East E Street in Tehachapi, CA (93561).

If you have friends or family who still want to join the fun, race-day registration will be open starting at 7:00 AM. The fee will be $40, and we’ll accept Card, Venmo, or Zelle payments.


Race-Day Details

Please arrive early to check in and pick up your grab bag, which includes your race shirt, bib and water.
All runners must sign a waiver before racing — please be sure to complete it at check-in.
Restrooms will be available courtesy of TVRPD
Current forecasts show partly cloudy skies and temperatures in the low to mid-50s around race time — perfect running weather!
$100 Apple gift card or $100 VISA prepaid card for top Male and top female finishers

$50 apple gift card or $50 VISA prepaid card for 2nd overall Male and Female finishers

$25 apple gift card or $25 VISA prepaid card for 3rd overall Male and Female finishers

**Participation Medal for all runners upon completion of race**

**1st, 2nd and 3rd Place Medals will be given to the top 3 male and female finishers.  Medals will be awarded at race completion.** 

**Runners can only qualify for one winning category and not multiple categories**

We’re excited to see you out there for a great morning of running, community, and fun!

See you Saturday at the Apple Dash!

name: Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot
description:
Founded and produced by the Silicon Valley Leadership Group Foundation, the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot is America's largest Thanksgiving Day race. It allows participants to start Thanksgiving Day off on the right foot by celebrating generosity and wellness with thousands of other runners and walkers committed to investing in their community. All event proceeds are donated to four nonprofit beneficiaries: Healthier Kids Foundation, HomeFirst, Second Harvest of Silicon Valley, and Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County.

This family-focused event welcomes participants of all fitness levels—elite runners, joggers, and walkers—to enjoy the flat and fast course that flows through downtown San Jose's local neighborhoods and businesses.

So kick off the holiday season by joining your Silicon Valley neighbors at San Jose's biggest Thanksgiving Day block party. Sign up to make the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot your newest Thanksgiving tradition!

name: Auburn Santa Run/Walk 5k
description:
December 19, 2026

Join us in downtown Auburn for the annual Auburn Santa Run 5K, a premier community tradition celebrating fitness and the holiday season. Participants are invited to select their division—Team Santa or Team Grinch—adding a spirited, friendly rivalry to the standard 5K course. Runners and walkers of all ages and fitness levels are encouraged to attend in themed athletic apparel.

Virtual Participation Option

For participants unable to attend the in-person event, a virtual race option is available.

Overview: Virtual participants complete their run independently at any location and pace. Because this division is non-competitive, no formal placements (first, second, or third) are awarded.
Date & Submission Window: On December 19, 2026, registered virtual participants will receive an email and SMS containing instructions for submitting race completion data. The official completion and submission window runs from December 19, 2026 to December 25, 2026.
Finisher Packet: Each registered participant will receive an official event T-shirt and finisher medal via mail.
Completion Policy

To qualify for an official finisher medal, participants must complete the 5K distance—either running or walking—and submit their completion status through the designated results portal. Packets are dispatched upon receipt of verified submissions.

name: Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run
description: The Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run is the oldest Ultra Trail Run in California with the 50 Mile run entering its 44th year.   The 50K joined the party seven years ago and instantly became a California classic in trail running traversing all of the same trails that the older run uses.   Running the Avalon Benefit 50Mile/50K provides you a first rate, up-close and personal experience of one of California's natural jewels in trail running across Catalina Island.   The run begins and ends in Avalon and in between you simply have to run the entire length of the island - and back!  In between you will experience beautiful vistas, tremendous views of the Pacific Ocean, see a bison or two and experience some of the sports great volunteers and aid stations.

name: Back the Blue
description:
Join us for the Back the Blue Run ,1-Mile Fun Run, 5k, and 10k race, a family-friendly community event dedicated to strengthening the relationship between law enforcement and the communities we proudly serve. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual walker, or simply looking for a fun way to spend the day with family and friends, everyone is welcome. 

We are excited to add a 5k Ruck category. Rucking is walking with a weighted backpack, combining cardio and strength straining for a full body workout. We are partnering with the Garlic City Ruckers who will be weighing the ruck packs before the race. 

The Back the Blue Run is more than just a race- its a celebration of service, unity, and the people who make our communities stronger. Together we honor the dedication of first responders while encouraging positive relationships between law enforcement and the public through fitness, fun, and fellowship. 

Join us Saturday, November 7, 2026 at Christmas Hill Park and be part of a tradition that brings our community together- one step at a time.

About the Course:

The route will begin at Christmas Hill Park (Ranch Side) and continues along the Uvas Creek Levee Trail. There will be visibly marked turnaround points for runners. The course is mainly flat and paved, offering a beautiful scenic route. 

 

SPONSORSHIP AND DONATIONS

Back the Blue Run offers various levels of sponsorships. Each Sponsorship Tier provides different specifications from social media recognition to your business logo on the race medal and shirt. Please email backthebluegilroyca@gmail.com for information on sponsorship opportunities. 

Whether you choose to donate supplies, services, or financial support, every contribution is sincerely appreciated. Your generosity helps make Back the Blue Run a success and allows us to continue strengthen relationships between law enforcement and the communities we serve. 

 

IMPORTANT DETAILS:

  • Registration deadline for confirmed T-shirts is Friday October 2, 2026. 
  • Final registration Friday October 23. Shirt size not guaranteed. 
  • Sponsorship deadline is Friday October2 4 for businesses with logos on shirt and posters.
  • Sponsorship deadline is October 23 for LEO agencies, vendors, or businesses with no logo on shirts/medals.
  • Strollers allowed but please start towards the back of the group to allow space.
  • No Pets Allowed

More Than a Race

Back the Blue is a celebration of community and Law Enforcement Agencies:

  • First responder displays
  • Family-friendly atmosphere
  • Vendor booths
  • Finisher medals
  • Food Vendors
  • Kids Corner with face painting and crafts!

Race Packet Options

UPDATE!!!!!!!!!!

T-shirts and bibs will be available for in person pickup on Thursday November 5 and Friday November 6 at Under Armour Outlet, 8300 Arroyo Circle Suite 220 between 4-8 PM. Participants may also pick up t-shirts and bibs race day check-in beginning at 7:00-8:30 on Saturday November 7 at Christmas Hill Park (Ranch Side).

Participants may pick up race packets for other registered runners with approval and verification from the registrant.

name: Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half
description:
Get ready to rev up your DeLorean and hit 88 MPH!

Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash celebrates the iconic time-traveling trilogy with a special nod to Back to the Future Day, October 21, the date Marty McFly and Doc Brown traveled to the future in Back to the Future Part II.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you're a time-traveling teen or a mad scientist, this race lets you channel your inner McFly and dash through time with style.

And this time, we're messing with the space-time continuum.

Choose your morning adventure (7AM):

  • 88 MPH Sprint 5K 🚗 Perfect for those looking to make a quick getaway from 1985.
  • Twin Pines 10K 🌲 A tribute to the mall where it all began, before one unfortunate encounter with a pine tree.
  • The 13.1 Gigawatt Half Marathon ⚡ Go the distance with enough time-traveling determination to make it all the way back to 1955.

🌙 Back to the Future After Dark (7PM)

Not a morning person? Great Scott! Come back after dark and take another trip through time under the night sky.

  • Enchantment Under the Run 5K 🎶 Five kilometers of nighttime time-traveling fun.
  • The Clock Tower Lightning 10K ⚡ Double the distance and keep the flux capacitor running after dark.

🌀 The Multiverse Flux Capacitor Challenge (Virtual)

Can't make it in person? Join us from your own timeline and complete your race wherever you are to earn your medal.

Expect time-traveling tunes and plenty of 80s nostalgia. Costumes encouraged. Puffer vests, lab coats, denim, and your best time-traveling looks are welcome.

Whether you race in the morning, come back after dark, or join us from another timeline, remember: where we're going, we don't need roads.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of heart.

 

Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official rights holders.

name: Bad Bass
description:
Rising up from the depths of Lake Chabot, the Bad Bass (a strangely kilt-wearing, bagpipe-playing Scottish bass with teeth) shows itself once again on July 24th 2027! Why is he Scottish? What is he doing in Castro Valley? How can he play bagpipes with his fin? We have no idea how to answer those questions. Why is he so bad-to-the-fishbone? Maybe he just knows how awesome the trails of Lake Chabot really are!

Whatever the Bad Bass is doing here, we hope you'll join us at the beautiful Lake Chabot Marina in Castro Valley for the scenic Bad Bass 5K, 10K or Half Marathon!

name: Badwater 267 VR
description:
BADWATER: It’s a frame of mind, a global family of horizon-chasers, and a statement to the world about priorities and preconceived notions of what is possible. Badwater is a way of life! Are you ready to kick off the New Year with an authentic, original Badwater experience?

AdventureCORPS® – the organizers of the iconic worldwide series of Badwater® races – are pleased to offer the BADWATER 267 VR in which competitors virtually and sequentially traverse the routes of all three Badwater® races – the 51-mile Badwater Cape Fear, the 81-mile Badwater Salton Sea, and the 135-mile Badwater 135 – for a total of 267 miles, or 430km. These three events comprise the legendary Badwater Ultra Cup - and Badwater 267 VR! Start off the New Year with this new challenge and lay the ultimate foundation for your best year yet!

During this challenge, you will complete 267 miles (430km) during the month of January. You have 31 days to complete 267 miles and you can do them anywhere you want, including indoors. There is also a multi-sport division for those who want to combine different sports (including cycling swimming, paddle sports, cross-country and downhill skiing, skateboarding, and more; see below.) Participation is mostly* based on the “honor system,” but there is a highly recommended - and very popular - Private Strava Club to bring everyone together. You can also sync your Strava account with your RunSignUp page so that all your activities automatically post here to RunSignUp.

* All participants in the top ten on the leaderboard - at any point during the whole month - MUST provide a high level of transparency. Additionally, ALL runs completed on a treadmill must be verified with a photo of the screen at the conclusion of the run. (Measuring distances on a treadmill with a non-synced GPS watch has proven to be an issue in the past.)

Go at your own pace, as often or as long as you want, wherever you live, anywhere on the planet! 

Guidelines:

• Running Division: You must complete all 267 miles on foot: This includes Walking, Hiking, Snowshoeing, and Treadmill, whether indoors or outdoors, covering 267 miles (430km) in 31 days. This is the Running Division, in which ONLY these bipedal activities may be counted. Also Note: In the Strava app, always log any of these activities as "Running" so that they appear on the club leaderboard.

NOTE: Elliptical is NOT allowed in the Running Division. 

• Multi-Sport division: MANY sports may be included: running, cycling, and swimming, and ALSO: All outdoor paddle and rowing sports*, plus ice-skating, rollerblading, skateboarding, and cross-country skiing are also allowed in the multi-sport category, and all they all count one-for-one. Others have a mileage conversion to "equate" them with running:

• Cycling: 3 miles cycling = 1 mile running. If you are cycling indoors, please make it realistic: Indoor bike rides are capped at an average speed of no more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH.

• Swimming: 1 mile swimming = 2 miles running.

• Elliptical: you must go 2 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. (Elliptical is only allowed in the Multi-Sport division, NOT in the Running division.)

• Indoor rowing or paddling: you must go 1.5 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. 

• Strength training: 1 hour of strength training equates to 4 miles of running.

• Yoga and other types of fitness classes count as 3 miles for a one-hour class.

• Downhill skiing or snowboarding: 1150 feet of vert = one mile, thus 10,000 feet of vert equals the 8.67-mile daily requirement. (A total of 307,050 for 267 miles!)

SWAG & AWARDS:

Unless they opt for "No Swag," participants will receive a BADWATER 267 VR tech shirt, BADWATER buff, and BADWATER sunglasses in a custom Badwater box. For those who log the necessary miles within the RunSignUp system, a BADWATER 267 VR Medal will also be awarded. (Medals are not sent just for participating; they are sent to those who cover the distance AND log all the necessary miles with the RunSignUp system.)

ALL of these items will be shipped approximately 45 days after BADWATER 267 VR concludes.

This is not a traditional ultra, nor a run-of-the-mill virtual – Badwater events are NEVER traditional – it’s the BADWATER 267 VR – an authentic and original BADWATER event – and we hope you will join us!

POLICIES:

There are NO refunds after December 30. There are also no credits or transfers.

See the event webpage for all the info.

name: Badwater Presents 40/40 NOW: Creating Balance in an Ultra World
description:
40/40 NOW: May 13 - June 21, 2026

 

Creating Balance in an Ultra World

Presented by AdventureCORPS®, the masterminds behind Badwater®

 

We invite you to join us for a very special, one-of-a-kind 40-Day Life Adventure that you can do anywhere on Planet Earth!

 

40/40 NOW is a 40-day program which can serve many purposes:

-              Cross-Training for Sport, and for Life

-              Celebrate the Summer Solstice as your Best Self

-              For Athletes: Sharpen your Body and Mind for the Summer Racing Season

-              An Adventure in Life

 

40 / 40 NOW is open to anyone and everyone! (While we are the people behind the world-wide series of BADWATER® Ultramarathons, this opportunity is for anybody looking to head into summer as their very best self.)

 

Duration: 40 Days, from Wednesday, May 13 through Sunday, June 21.  

(The 2027 summer solstice is on Sunday, June 21, 2026 at 7:10 AM, Pacific Daylight Time.)

 

Why 40 Days?

30 Days Creates a Habit, but a 40 Day Effort is a Transformative Spiritual Odyssey.

 

What Is the 40/40 Path? How does it work? What's involved? 

 

The core of this challenge is completing 40 minutes of intentional movement activities in the AM, and 40 minutes in the PM.        

-              One must be strength and/or flexibility oriented. Think weightlifting, yoga, stretch class, dance class, or martial arts. (This can be done at a gym or fitness studio, but also on your own at home, following DVDs or YouTube classes.)

 

-              The other 40-minute activity will be cardio-oriented. Think running, walking, hiking, bicycling, skating, or swimming. (For participants who already run or bike well over 40 minutes per day, we recommend pursuing a different sport for this 40-minute cardio activity.)

 

Additionally, each participant will check-In daily in the Strava Club: Given that participants will be all over the world, each morning (Pacific Time) we will post a “Daily Check-In!” reminder in the Strava Club: Every participant will comment to tell us what they did – and perhaps learned – that day after their PM activity. Accountability makes it real! Teamwork makes the dream work!

 

40/40 participants will also pursue ten different four-day personal challenges, and take “brain breaks” every Sunday: 

-              10 Personal Challenges: One will be announced every Four Days

-              Screen-Free Sundays: No digital noise for 8 hours: You pick the timeframe, as long as it's during waking hours. (If work or childcare means you need your phone close, keep the ringer on for notifications, or have a family member or friend be in charge of your phone. Or if you must be on your phone, just don’t scroll any social media.)

-              Also every Sunday: Pause and Celebrate!  This is the opposite of a To Do List, this is a Done List: Write it and celebrate all you’ve achieved in the past week!

Every day each participant will receive an email which contains:

-              An inspiring quote

-              A simple but powerful nutrition tip and/or recipe

-              A link to an inspiring online or social media talk

-              Also, every four days, the email will announce the next of the ten 4-Day Personal Challenges

 

The 40/40 participants will receive a printed interactive guidebook written by Chris Kostman and Erika Small which includes: 

-              “The Power and Meaning of 40”

-              “The Power and Meaning of the Summer Solstice”

-              "40 Books that could Change Your Life" Recommended Reading List

-              40-Day Calendar to track your progress: May 13-June 21, 2027

 

 

HOW WILL 40/40 NOW PARTICIPANTS INTERACT?

For camaraderie and to share insights and inspirations, a special, private Strava Club brings everyone together on an ongoing basis.

 

WHAT HAPPENS ON DAY 1?

• You will study the 40 / 40 NOW Guidebook

• You will write a note to yourself about what you hope to gain from this, how you feel your life is now (where are you happy or unhappy, how you want to become a better version of yourself.) You will put this is an envelope and set it aside for 40 days.

• You will begin! – Your 40-minute AM and 40-minute PM activities, and the first of the four-day personal challenges.

 

WHAT HAPPENS ON DAY 40?

 
THE END IS JUST THE BEGINNING : COMING TOGETHER ON THE SUMMER SOLSTICE

 

With the arrival of the Summer Solstice, we will celebrate and “seal” this experience in several ways:

 

• First, you will read your Day 1 Challenge note to yourself. Whether you share about this in the Strava Club is entirely up to you; no pressure to “over share”!

• We will send out a few simple Rituals to Celebrate the Summer Solstice; choose one or more!

• You will post your final AM and PM activities to the Strava Club and log them in your printed 40 / 40 NOW Guidebook.

• Video Call: We will all come together for a 40-minute video chat via  Zoom; this will take place at 900am, Pacific Time. (There will be participants all over the world, but this time works best for those in the Western Hemisphere and Europe; apologies to the rest of the world!)

 

MEMENTOS

FINALLY, some Mementos will be sent to each participant after  40/40 NOW concludes:

40/40 NOW Keychain (Made in the USA, very high quality, meant to last!)

40/40 NOW tri-blend long-sleeve T-shirt

40/40 NOW Decal Sheet

Delivered in a Custom 40/40 NOW Box

 

We hope you will join us for 40/40 NOW! Make the Commitment to Yourself and Register Now!

name: Bakersfield Mother’s Day Run
description:
Our main events have SOLD-OUT, but we have setup a Late Comers division for those that would like to still participate but without receiving a finisher's medallion.  All participants will still receive an event shirt, official timing with awards, photos and participant food.

 

Join us for our 3rd Annual Bakersfield Mother’s Day Run as we celebrate the incredible women who keep our communities strong. Whether you’re running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines, this is a morning all about honoring our SUPER MOMS!

Every step leads to something sweet, and meaningful.

name: Barbara Schmidt Millar Women's Triathlon & 5K: Celebrating Life, Empowering Women
description:
Refund & Transfer Policy
Thank you for supporting the Barbara Schmidt Millar Women’s Triathlon & 5K. Your registration is a meaningful contribution that helps advance access to cancer treatment, support women’s health initiatives, and fund scholarships for local students pursuing careers in healthcare.

Because this is a fundraising event, all proceeds are committed in advance to these community programs. For this reason, all registrations are considered final and non-refundable. We are unable to offer refunds for any reason, including scheduling conflicts, personal circumstances, weather, or course conditions.

We understand that plans can change. Registration transfers to another eligible participant are permitted and must be completed by the registration deadline, subject to event guidelines and approval.

We are sincerely grateful for your participation and support—your registration fee directly helps make this event’s mission possible and strengthens its impact in the community.

name: Bayshore  70.4 and Sprint Triathlon
description:

START:  7AM

DISTANCE:  SWIM 2200yd   BIKE 56mi   RUN 13.1mi
