name: Chupacabra  5K. 10K. 18 Miler & 50K
description:
🐾 CHUPACABRA 50K
September 18, 2027 | Long Beach, California
5K • 10K • 18 Mile • 50K

Something is lurking on the Long Beach coastline.
The legendary Chupacabra has made its way to the beach—and this time, you’re not running away from it. You’re chasing it for 31 miles.

Welcome to the Chupacabra 50K, a flat, fast and fully supported beachfront endurance event built for runners ready to go beyond the half marathon, chase a new distance, or take on their first ultra.

Whether you're tackling the 5K, 10K, stepping up to 18 miles, or going all the way to 50K, choose your distance and get ready to hunt the legend.

18 MILE + 50K
The 18-mile and 50K races begin at 6:30 AM and follow a six-mile beachfront loop from the start, along the Long Beach pedestrian path to Alamitos Beach and back.

18 Mile: Three 6-mile loops
50K: Five 6-mile loops + 1.07-mile out-and-back
Time Limit: 6 hours
Course Closes: 12:30 PM

All 18-mile and 50K participants must complete their distance within the six-hour course limit.

5K + 10K
The 5K and 10K begin at 8:00 AM, bringing even more runners and energy to the beachfront course while our ultra runners continue their hunt.

RACE-DAY SCHEDULE
6:00 AM: Bib pickup opens
6:30 AM: 18 Mile + 50K start
8:00 AM: 5K + 10K start
12:30 PM: Course closes

YOUR REGISTRATION INCLUDES
Custom Chupacabra finisher medal, professional chip timing, live race results, free race photos, fully supported course and water stations, finish-line celebration with DJ + MC, and overall and age-group awards.

Runners, walkers and friendly dogs are welcome in the 5K and 10K. Participants in the 18 Mile and 50K should be prepared to maintain the pace necessary to finish within the six-hour course limit.

THE LEGEND IS REAL. THE DISTANCE IS REALER.
CHOOSE YOUR DISTANCE.
HUNT THE CHUPACABRA.
CLAIM YOUR MEDAL.

name: Citrus Heritage Run
description:
The Citrus Heritage Run is a Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, and 1-mile kids race on Saturday, January 9, 2027. This unique and “sweet-smelling” course winds through the historic orange groves of the California Citrus State Historic Park in Riverside, CA. As one of the most scenic course routes in Southern California, you will experience breathtaking views of surrounding mountain ranges and skyline as you inhale the smell of sweet citrus and orange blossoms beginning to bloom. This race is truly one-of-a-kind and all race distances sold out in 2026!

This event is a great tune-up race for 2027.We offer high-quality tech-fabric long-sleeve tees, finisher medals and age group awards. Along the course, you will find entertainment (live bands) and several hydration stops. name: City of Lincoln Huffin' for the Stuffin' Turkey Trot
description:
Welcome to the 9th annual Huffin' for the Stuffin' Turkey Trot presented by the City of Lincoln Recreation Department.

Our 5K run is LIVE with professional timers as we continue our festive engagement with families and community.

There is a .17 mile Donut Dash for children 4 to 7 years old to take part in but its limited to particpnats and typically sells out. 

This event is a FUN RUN and meant for community engagement & family FUN! There will be 1st, 2nd & 3rd place finisher awards as well as general finisher award for participants who sign up before the deadline. The proceeds from our run helps to support the City of Lincoln Recreations Scholarship Fund which helps offer scholarships (financial aid) to cover fees for our recreation programs to families in need. 

Registration: Registration is now open thru November 23rd 2026.  Please register by November 1st to receive a shirt and finisher award!

We do order extra shirts, they will be on a first come first served basis after the deadline. 

Race Schedule: Thursday, November 26th 7:45am arrival

RACE DAY
Plan to arrive no later than 7:45am in order to park and arrive at the starting area for announcements. The first announcements start promptly at 8:00am.

Refreshments provided for all registered participants following the race.

5K participants receive a unisex 50/50 cotton blend race shirt, if registerd by Novemeber 1st 2026. Late registrants are not guaranteed shirt or medal.

Register online by November 1, 2026 to guarantee your shirt size and finisher award!

                           Kids Donut Dash at 8:00am 

                           5K to start at 8:30am 

Route Information: Twelve Bridges Park and trail 5k route  Lincoln Turkey Trot 5K - 

https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6645991889/ 

Pre-Race Shirt/Bib Pick Up: Lincoln Community Center 2010 First Street Lincoln CA 95648

Tuesday, November 24th & Wednesday, November 25th 11am to 6pm.

Please plan to attend one of the Pickup days or have someone collect your shirt for you. Please register early to guarantee your shirt and finisher award! IF YOU ARE REGISTERED FOR THE DONUT DASH ONLY, YOU DO NOT NEED to COME TO THE PICK UP DATES.

The pick up dates are for shirts and bibs as we have liitle time on race day for pick up. 

Refund Policy: All entries are non-refundable and non-transferable and are considered a donation to our recreation department (without purchase of race insurance)

Welcome to the 19th annual Claremont Turkey Trot presented by Claremont Sunrise Rotary. 8:30AM    5K Run/Walk

name: Clarksburg Country Run
description:
Please join us for the 60th Annual Clarksburg Country Run. Break away from the city and enjoy some small town hospitality. This event offers a variety of race distances and you can enjoy a complimentary meal after the race. To celebrate our 60th event, all finishers will receive a belt-buckle style medal that celebrates sixty years of the event and running through the agricultural lands of Clarksburg.

5K, 10K, Half, and 30K entries will receive a post-race beer sample, plus a choice regarding their t-shirt type: choose from either a DryBlend long sleeve shirt (available in unisex sizes; Adult S-3X, Youth S-XL) or a 100% polyester long sleeve shirt (Additional $7 fee for 100% polyester) (Available in sizes XXS-2X). Don't want a t-shirt? Opt-out and save $5.00. 5K, 10K, Half, and 30K entries also include a bib/timing, finisher medal, eligibility for awards, and post-race meal.

The Kids Fun Run is non-competitive and not timed, and all entrants will receive a bib, finisher medal and post-race meal. Add on a long sleeve DryBlend t-shirt for $8.00. 

 

Packet Pick Up

Race packets (bib and shirt) can be picked up before the race on Saturday, October 31 - time and place TBA.

On race day, Sunday November 1, 2026, bibs can be picked up at the race site beginning at 6:30 am. In person registration also available during this time. Arrive one hour before your race start if picking up on event morning.

Refund and Transfer Policy

All entries are non-refundable and non-transferable to another event or another athlete; event happens rain or shine. Race insurance is available to participants but is not required. We reserve the right to cancel, delay or postpone the event due to Acts of God or other local emergencies which would threaten the safety and health of participants, spectators, volunteers, or officials. No refunds, deferrals, or transfers to someone else in the case of injury, change of plans, etc. 

Start Times

30K - 8:00 a.m.
Kids Runs - 8:10 a.m.
Half Marathon - 8:30 a.m.
5K/10K - 8:45 a.m.
Please Note: The Clarksburg Country Run course cut-off time is 12:30 p.m.
Early starts are not available.

Results and Awards

Results will be available on the internet during the event at results.changeofpace.com - select the Clarksburg Country Run. At the race, QR codes will be posted around the venue, and with any smartphone you can use the camera app to scan the code (simply hold the phone over the code as if you were going to take a picture of it), which will open your mobile browser on the event results page.

Awards will be available for pick up on site. If you are an age group contender, please stick around to pick up your award. They will not be mailed. 

The 30K, 10K and 5K will be scored based on Net time. The Half Marathon, since it is the PAUSATF Half Marathon Championship, will be scored by the Pacific Association based on Gun time, although net time will be reported.

Packet Pick Up

Race packets (bib and shirt) can be picked up before the race on Saturday, October 31 - time and place TBA.

On race day, Sunday November 1, 2026, bibs can be picked up at the race site beginning at 6:30 am. In person registration also available during this time. Arrive one hour before your race start if picking up on event morning.

Refund and Transfer Policy

All entries are non-refundable and non-transferable to another event or another athlete; event happens rain or shine. Race insurance is available to participants but is not required. We reserve the right to cancel, delay or postpone the event due to Acts of God or other local emergencies which would threaten the safety and health of participants, spectators, volunteers, or officials. No refunds, deferrals, or transfers to someone else in the case of injury, change of plans, etc. 

Start Times

30K - 8:00 a.m.
Kids Runs - 8:10 a.m.
Half Marathon - 8:30 a.m.
5K/10K - 8:45 a.m.
Please Note: The Clarksburg Country Run course cut-off time is 12:30 p.m.
Early starts are not available.

Results and Awards

Results will be available on the internet during the event at results.changeofpace.com - select the Clarksburg Country Run. At the race, QR codes will be posted around the venue, and with any smartphone you can use the camera app to scan the code (simply hold the phone over the code as if you were going to take a picture of it), which will open your mobile browser on the event results page.

Awards will be available for pick up on site. If you are an age group contender, please stick around to pick up your award. They will not be mailed. 

The 30K, 10K and 5K will be scored based on Net time. The Half Marathon, since it is the PAUSATF Half Marathon Championship, will be scored by the Pacific Association based on Gun time, although net time will be reported.

name: Clueless & Breathless 5K, 10K & Half
description:
Like, ugh, are you seriously going to miss this?

Step into your platform shoes and strut into the Clueless & Breathless 5K, 10K & Half Marathon, a 90s-inspired run packed with mall glam, plaid, and way too much lip gloss.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you’re a Beverly Hills princess, a debate team queen, or just looking for an excuse to break out your best 90s look, this race is your chance to be totally buggin’...in the best way.

Choose your challenge:

  • Clueless & Breathless 5K 🎀 This one's as quick as a shopping trip to The Galleria. Bonus points if you run in plaid.
  • Totally Buggin’ 10K 💅 Longer than Cher's shopping list and twice as fierce.
  • The Alaïa Half Marathon 👠 Because it's like, a totally important designer challenge. Stay hydrated.
  • The Multiverse Mall Dash (Virtual) 🛍️ Can’t make it in person? Run from wherever you are and still earn your medal.

Expect 90s jams and plenty of mallcore energy.

Costumes strongly encouraged. Plaid, platform-shoe energy, feather pens, and your most fabulous 90s looks are all welcome.

📦 Multiverse Option (Virtual Runners Welcome!)

Can’t make it to Canoga Park? Join us from your own timeline. Complete your race wherever you are and earn the same finisher medal as our in-person runners.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. This run is like, totally important.

This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 90s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: cmX 5K 2027
description:
Welcome to the cmX 5K hosted by the CMAA Southern California Chapter Foundation.

 

Due to the popularity of our event, we have outgrown our previous location and have happily moved to an exciting new start line for 2027! 

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

  
 
Join us on Saturday, February 20th on the water front, behind the aquarium, in Long Beach, California (or virtually).

Join us for an exhilarating run through the marina and along the shore with views of the Queen Mary in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the shoreline.

Event Details:

Avoid lines on race day and pick up your bib and shirt on Friday February 19th at Sports Basement in Long Beach from 4pm to 6pm

Race Day Schedule:

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8:30 am Kids Dash: 10:00 am

Parking Available a short walk away at the multi-level aquarium parking lot. Fees in the lot are by the hour, click this link for more details.


Course Map: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6274860286/

Course Description:

The race starts and ends behind the aquarium, next to Pierpont Landing.

5k runners will follow the scenic path around along the marina, through Shoreline Village and out along the jetty where you will have a majestic view of the Queen Mary before heading back to the start.

Water station will be at the entrance to the jetty and you can stop here twice during the run/walk if you need to.

name: Coastal Love Chase – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
We love these beach race mornings!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Ave Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
3-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support
A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Coffee Lover Run LOS ANGELES
description:
☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ 
For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon!  😊 

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.

Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.

☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ 
For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon!  😊 

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.

name: College of the Canyons 18th Annual Turkey Trot
description:
SANTA CLARITA'S ORIGINAL TURKEY TROT

A Santa Clarita annual tradition. Come join us for a calorie earning three-mile Turkey Trot. Beginning at College of the Canyons and winding through the campus and trails overlooking the Santa Clarita Valley. The course then has a fast downhill finish and onto the Cougar Stadium Track.

Live Results showing your finishing times completes the experience before you head off to get your fill of Turkey, fixins' and family to complete your day.

Your entry fee includes an original t-shirt design and finisher medals for the first 300 athletes crossing the finish line.

Free parking

name: Como La Flor 5K. 10K, Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🌹 COMO LA FLOR 5K, 10K & HALF MARATHON BY CALIFLOW RUNS™ 🌹

📅 Saturday, March 27, 2027 | Sábado, 27 de marzo de 2027

📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

⏰ Event Day Schedule | Horario del Evento

6:00 AM – Registration Opens | Apertura de Registro
7:00 AM – Half Marathon Start | Inicio del Medio Maratón
8:00 AM – 5K & 10K Start | Inicio del 5K y 10K
10:30 AM – Finish Line Closes | Cierre de la Meta

Join CaliFlow Runs for the inaugural Como La Flor 5K, 10K & Half Marathon along the beautiful Long Beach waterfront. Inspired by blooming flowers, vibrant colors, and the joy of community, this event celebrates movement, friendship, and finish lines.

Únete a CaliFlow Runs para la primera edición de Como La Flor 5K, 10K y Medio Maratón a lo largo del hermoso paseo marítimo de Long Beach. Inspirado en las flores en plena floración, los colores vibrantes y la alegría de la comunidad, este evento celebra el movimiento, la amistad y las metas alcanzadas.

Whether you're running, walking, pushing a stroller, or bringing your favorite four-legged training partner, you'll find a fun, welcoming, and supportive atmosphere from start to finish.

Ya sea que corras, camines, empujes una carriola o participes con tu compañero de cuatro patas favorito, encontrarás un ambiente divertido, acogedor y lleno de apoyo desde la salida hasta la meta.

🌹 USATF Certified Course | Recorrido Certificado por USATF
🌹 Professional Chip Timing | Cronometraje Profesional con Chip
🌹 Custom Finisher Medal | Medalla Personalizada para Finalistas
🌹 FREE Race Photos | Fotos de Carrera GRATIS
🌹 Overall & Age Group Awards | Premios Generales y por Categoría de Edad
🌹 On-Course Water Stations | Estaciones de Agua en el Recorrido
🌹 Finish Line Fiesta with DJ | Fiesta en la Meta con DJ
🌹 Dog Friendly | Se Admiten Perros
🌹 Stroller Friendly | Apto para Carriolas
🌹 Walkers Welcome | Caminantes Bienvenidos

From the start line to the finish line celebration, Como La Flor is designed to bring people together for a morning filled with energy, community, and good vibes.

Desde la línea de salida hasta la celebración en la meta, Como La Flor está diseñado para reunir a las personas en una mañana llena de energía, comunidad y buenas vibras.

🌹 Every Mile Blooms. | Cada Milla Florece. 🌹

name: Concord 5000
description:
Welcome to the second annual Concord 5000. Our first year was a huge success and we are looking forward to hosting this meet again. This race offers a unique opportunity to run a 5000 on a track and get your true 5000 time. Concord High School Cross Country and Track & Field teams are excited to host this event for our community. Come join the fun with music and friends!

Road Runner will provide gift cards to the top overall finishers in each division as well as some raffle prizes!

First, Second and Third places overall in each division will get Goodr sunglasses!

All athletes under the age of 18 will get medals. 

Please contact us if you have a team you want to register, we can offer a reduced group fee. 

We plan on having a taco bar vendor for your post race meal!

name: Concord California Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Diablo Valley Federal Credit Union (DVFCU) is pleased to welcome you to our information page about the Concord Turkey Trot, a 5K run/walk benefiting Loaves and Fishes of Contra Costa.

The event will take place at Newhall Park on Thanksgiving, Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 8 AM.  For the safety and enjoyment of all participants, registration for this event is capped at 2,000 participants.  Everyone participating in the 5K run/walk course must have a paid registration, with the exception of children 2 years old and under, who will be in a stroller for the duration of the event. 

The course includes varied terrain, including grass fields, park pathways, and city streets. Those participating with strollers or pets will be asked to enter at the back of the start area so as not to impede those wishing to race for time. All 5K Run/Walk Participants will receive a tech t-shirt and a medal!

The race will take place rain or shine.  Once your registration has been paid, there are no refunds. This includes inclement weather or any other reason, such as injuries, illness, or personal emergencies.

name: Cookie Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Get Ready for the Cookie Run! 🍪✨

Join us for the Cookie Run It's not just a race, it's an adventure filled with delicious cookies for those who run with a sweet reward in mind!
You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! 

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.

Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.

name: Cork & Dash 5K
description:
Cork & Dash 5K & 1 Mile – A Spooktacular Wine Country Adventure!
Saturday, October 24, 2026 | Pianetta Winery | San Miguel, CA

Run. Walk. Sip. Celebrate. And Come in Costume!
Get ready for a wickedly fun day in wine country! The Cork & Dash 5K & 1 Mile is bringing Halloween magic to the beautiful vineyards of Pianetta Winery!

Whether you're a competitive runner, casual walker, wine enthusiast, or just looking for a fun fall adventure with friends, this is one Halloween celebration you won't want to miss!

Imagine running or walking through beautiful vineyard rows surrounded by autumn colors, festive Halloween decorations, and spooky surprises along the way. Then cross the finish line, collect your HUGE finisher medal, and celebrate with wine, beer, or a refreshing soft drink!

🎃 A Vineyard Full of Halloween Fun!

This isn't your ordinary wine run! We're transforming the course into a festive Halloween experience, complete with:

👻 Halloween Decorations Throughout the Course!

Enjoy spooky surprises, festive displays, and plenty of photo opportunities as you wind your way through the vineyard.

🏆 Halloween Costume Contest!

Dress to impress! From spooky and scary to clever and hilarious, show off your Halloween creativity for a chance to win!

🍇 Beautiful Vineyard Scenery!

Experience the rolling hills, vineyard rows, and breathtaking wine-country views at Pianetta Winery.

🎉 Fun for Runners and Walkers!

Whether you're chasing a personal best or enjoying a leisurely stroll, there's something for everyone.
Costumes are encouraged, so grab your friends, get creative, and make this a Halloween adventure to remember!

🍷 5K Vineyard Run/Walk – THREE Wine Tastings!

Take on a scenic 3.1-mile adventure through the beautiful vineyards of Pianetta Winery!

Along the way, you'll enjoy THREE wine-tasting stops as you make your way through the vineyard.

Enjoy the fresh country air, gorgeous vineyard views, colorful Halloween decorations, and festive atmosphere from start to finish.

Whether you're a seasoned runner chasing a personal best or a wine lover looking for a unique experience, this 5K has something for everyone!

🍷 1 Mile Wine Run/Walk – TWO Wine Tastings!


Want a shorter adventure with plenty of sipping?

Our 1-mile course features TWO wine-tasting stops along the route!

Sip, stroll, and enjoy the beautiful vineyard scenery while taking in the Halloween festivities.

It's the perfect choice for friends who want to enjoy wine country at a more relaxed pace.

Run for time or walk for wine — either way, you're in for a great time!

 

⏱ Professionally Chip-Timed 5K & 1 Mile!

Whether you're racing for a personal best or simply enjoying a festive day in wine country, we've got you covered!

Both the 5K and 1 Mile events will be professionally chip-timed, so you can track your performance and celebrate your accomplishment.

Run fast, take your time, or stop to enjoy the wine tastings — the choice is yours!

 

🏅 Everyone Earns a HUGE 5-Inch Finisher Medal!

That's right — a spectacular 5-INCH finisher medal for every finisher!

Our custom Cork & Dash medal features beautiful vineyard scenery, colorful grapes, and wine-inspired details, making it an impressive keepsake of your wine-country adventure.

Whether you tackle the 5K or enjoy the 1 Mile, you'll have an amazing medal to remember the day!

 

🍷🍺 Wine, Beer & Refreshments for Everyone!

Wine may be the star of Cork & Dash, but it's not the only way to celebrate!

In addition to the wonderful wines of Pianetta Winery, we'll also have beer and soft drink options available, so there's something for everyone to enjoy.

Not a wine drinker? No problem!

Whether you prefer a glass of wine, a cold beer, or a refreshing nonalcoholic beverage, you can join in the finish-line festivities.

Stick around after your run or walk, relax with friends, take photos with your medal, and enjoy the beautiful winery atmosphere.

Alcoholic beverages are available only to participants and guests age 21 and older.

 

👻 Halloween Costume Contest!

Here's your chance to show off your Halloween spirit!

Come dressed in your favorite costume and join the fun. Whether you're spooky, silly, creative, or completely outrageous, we want to see it!

Imagine a vineyard filled with running skeletons, superheroes, witches, pirates, and all sorts of Halloween characters!

Costumes are encouraged but not required. Just bring your enthusiasm and be ready for a great time!

 

🍇 More Than Just a Race — It's a Wine Country Experience!

Cork & Dash is about more than crossing a finish line.

It's about spending a beautiful fall day with friends, enjoying the scenery, sharing a few laughs, and making memories in the heart of California wine country.

With three wine tastings on the 5K, two tastings on the 1 Mile, professional chip timing, Halloween decorations throughout the course, a costume contest, beer and soft drink options, and an enormous 5-inch finisher medal, this is an event you won't want to miss!

 

🎃 Join Us for Cork & Dash!

  • 📅 Saturday, October 24, 2026
  • 📍 Pianetta Winery – San Miguel, California
  • 🏃 5K & 1 Mile Run/Walk
  • 🍷 5K Wine Tastings: 3 stops along the course
  • 🍷 1 Mile Wine Tastings: 2 stops along the course
  • ⏱   Professionally Chip-Timed
  • 🏅 HUGE 5-Inch Custom Medal
  • 🍺 Wine, beer, and soft drink options
  • 👻 Halloween Fun: Costume contest and decorations throughout the course
  • 🎟  Grab your friends, plan your costumes, and get ready for a Halloween celebration in wine country!
  • 🍷🎃 Run It. Walk It. Sip It. Spook It!

name: Corona 5000
description:
From 1913-1916, the roar of engines and the thrill of speeds approaching 100 mph electrified Grand Boulevard in Corona, as up to 100,000 spectators cheered during the legendary Corona Road Races. This perfect circle in the heart of “Circle City” was the stage for automotive history. Now, 110 years later, Grand Boulevard is set to pulse with excitement once again!

Join us for the 2nd Annual Corona 5000, a vibrant 5K run and walk that revives the spirit of this historic course. Lace up your shoes and be part of a new legacy, racing or strolling the iconic loop of Grand Boulevard. 

This is a Race For the Ages, all ages. 

Don’t miss your chance to make history in Corona’s Circle City!

name: Coronado Turkey Trot presented by Rady Children’s Hospital Auxiliary
description:
MOVE YOUR FEET BEFORE THE FEAST!

Join us for the 13th Annual Turkey Trot presented by the Coronado Unit of the Rady Children’s Hospital Auxiliary on Thanksgiving, November 26, 2026, at Tidelands Park. This family-friendly 5K welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. Enjoy a beautiful course along the San Diego Bay and celebrate the holiday with a fun, festive atmosphere! For our 15 and under runners, your age-based pricing discount is already built in as soon as you enter your birth date.

All net proceeds benefit the Division of Endocrinology/Diabetes at Rady Children’s Hospital in support of children and families affected by Type 1 Diabetes. Register early as this event sells out every year!

_________________________________________

We offer three ways to participate in the Coronado Turkey Trot, ensuring everyone—from seasoned runners to our tiniest trotters—can join the Thanksgiving fun:

5K Run/Walk: Our signature race welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The 5K follows a scenic out-and-back route along the San Diego Bay and includes full race amenities, including an event shirt and finisher medal for paid 5K participants. Kids 15 and under automatically receive built-in age-based pricing at checkout.

Tiny Trotters Fun Run (Ages 5 & Under): A special option for our littlest runners! Tiny Trotters (ages 5 & under) run alongside the 5K with their families. It’s a simple, no-cost way to let young children be part of the excitement. Registration is free (no shirt or commemorative medal included).

Virtual 5K: Not in Coronado on race day? You can still be part of the tradition from wherever you are! Virtual participants complete their 5K on their own time and course, and we’ll mail your race items directly to the address provided at registration. A great option for out-of-towners or anyone who prefers a flexible race experience.

 

Race Day Schedule


6:30am – Packet Pick-Up Opens

7:35am – Pre-Race Warm Up 

8:00am – 5K Start 

9:15am – Awards Ceremony (Overall Winners)

9:30am – Event Concludes

Subject to change

 

Packet Pick Up - Hours & Locations

 

Pre Race Packet Pickup Details TBD

 

RACE DAY, November 26, 2026
Tidelands Park
2000 Mullinex Dr, Coronado, CA 92118
6:30 AM – 8:00 AM

 

Notes for Packet Pick-Up

Walk-up Registration is available at Packet Pick-Up if the event is not sold out. Photo IDs are required. You may pick up for a friend if you have a copy of their photo ID. NO EXCEPTIONS! Photos of ID shown on cell phones are accepted. Please plan on attending one of the pre-race packet pick-ups; out-of-towners may pick up on race morning beginning at 6:30am, but it is discouraged.

name: Corporal Javier Bejar Memorial Run     Reedley Police Department
description:
Join us as we honor the life and legacy of Corporal Javier Bejar, a Reedley Police Officer, Marine Corps veteran, and beloved member of our community who made the ultimate sacrifice in the line of duty.

This memorial run is more than a race—it’s a tribute to courage, service, and community. Every stride taken represents our gratitude for Corporal Bejar’s dedication and the enduring impact he left behind.

All participants will receive a commemorative race shirt and finisher’s medal, designed to celebrate his life and sacrifice. Whether you run, walk, or cheer from the sidelines, your presence helps keep his memory alive and supports the values he stood for: honor, commitment, and service.

Together, let’s run in remembrance and unity.

 

NOTE: Only the first 350 Runners are guaranteed a medal.

Any participant registered after 01/25/2027 is NOT guaranteed a shirt. 

 

Packet Pickup & Schedule

Friday, February 19th: Packet Pickup from 3:00pm - 6:00pm

Location: Reedley PD - Annex Building 843 G Street, Reedley, CA

Race Day Schedule (Saturday, February 20th):

6:00am Late Packet Pickup 

7:00am Ceremony

8:00am 10K Walk Start

8:15am 10K Run Start

8:30am 5K Walk

8:45am 5K Run

All participants will receive a commemorative race shirt and finisher’s medal, designed to celebrate his life and sacrifice. Whether you run, walk, or cheer from the sidelines, your presence helps keep his memory alive and supports the values he stood for: honor, commitment, and service.

Together, let’s run in remembrance and unity.

Any participant registered after 01/25/2027 is NOT guaranteed a shirt.

name: Countdown to the Finish – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
End your 2026 on a High Note with High Tides Runs!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route
An early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, and Fountain Valley. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: COVINA FUN RUN XXX
description:
Join Us for the 2027 Covina Fun Run!
The Covina Rotary Club is proud to sponsor the 2027 Covina Fun Run at District Field Covina on April 24, 2027! In partnership with Covina-Valley Unified School District, Charter Oak Unified School District, and valued sponsors, our dedicated committee members are volunteering their time to create a fun, family-friendly, and health-conscious event that brings our community together.

How You Can Make a Difference
Since 1923, the Covina Rotary Club has been committed to serving and uplifting our community. Proceeds from this event directly support local youth programs, veterans, and other vital initiatives. Would you consider making a donation to help us achieve our mission? Every contribution—big or small—makes an impact, helping to fund teacher mini grants, youth programs, and other community-driven efforts.

Join Us!
Be part of something special—run, walk, sponsor, or donate to help make a lasting difference in Covina. Together, we can strengthen our schools, support our teachers, and promote health and wellness in our community.

Covina Rotary Charities is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

name: Coyote Hills
description:
This Fremont park has "hills" in the name, but the climbing is minimal at these runs by the bay. You will find an abundance of scenic views and variety of surfaces from dirt to paved to the wood boardwalks running through the marsh!
Hikers/walkers are always welcome!

About Coyote Hills Regional Park
The low-lying Coyote Hills rise as a prominent landmark on the eastern shoreline of San Francisco Bay, along the western edge of southern Alameda County.

Archaeology has revealed that Native Americans have lived in the area for at least 12,900 to 13,500 years. The Tuibun Ohlone village site (which is more than 2,000 years old) may be visited at Coyote Hills Regional Park on naturalist-led programs. Learn more about Coyote Hills Regional Park here.

name: Creekcut Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, April 4, 2027 at 9:00am for an exciting  new event that features the amazing scenery and landscape of Creekcut Winery! The name Creekcut is an homage to the ancient creek that cuts through the heart of our estate terroir, sustaining our land’s native habitat and shaping the character of our wines. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: 
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Cuyamaca Rancho State Park
description:
Just one hour east of San Diego lies Cuyamaca Rancho State Park — 24,000 acres of oak woodland, pine forest, sweeping meadow, and mountain vista. It's prime territory for a day of orienteering, whatever course you choose. Pick the challenge that fits you: a beginner-friendly loop, or a more demanding Intermediate/Advanced (mostly off-trail) or an Advanced/Expert route. New to navigation? We'll walk you through the basics at check-in, and if you don't have a compass, we'll loan you one free. 🧭

New this year: two start locations:

  • Beginner course: start and finish at HQ.
  • Intermediate and Advanced courses: use a remote start at Stonewall Mine. 

A shuttle runs continuously from the HQ to the remote start, and the ride takes about 10 minutes. See Course Notes for more details.

Event Team:

  • Event Director: Dana Borie
  • Course Setter: Ori Auslender
  • Visit the Volunteer page to learn how to help with the event.
    • See "Volunteer" at the top right of the page. 🔝
    • Volunteers get up to a $20 credit for a race to cover their registration fee.
    • Volunteer roles explained in detail

Format: Traditional 

Map:  scale: see Course Notes  |  5m contours

Courses: Beginner, Intermediate/Advanced, and Advanced/Expert

  • Beginner: 2 km as the crow flies, 30m of altitude
  • Intermediate/Advance: 4 km as the crow flies, 110m of altitude, mostly off-trail
  • Advanced/Expert: 7.4km as the crow flies, 185m of altitude, mostly off-trail
  • See Course Notes for more details

Starts: 10am to 11am

Time Limit: Two and half hours. All competitors must return to HQ and download by 1:30pm so we know you are safe. If you don't check in before leaving, volunteers will search the course to ensure you are not lost. Please check in before you leave.

Scoring: Electronic punching will be offered. All participants must bring, rent, or purchase one. Controls will be AIR+ enabled. 

E-Punches: Rental electronic punches will be available for $5. Alternatively, you can purchase your own e-punch at our gear store for delivery to the event (use "000000" when registering).

name: Cycle Through the Vineyards
description:
CYCLE THROUGH THE VINEYARDS 2025

 

Temecula Sunrise Rotary (a 501c3 nonprofit) is again celebrating Spring in the beautiful Temecula Valley Wine Country on Sunday May 3rd with our annual CYCLE THROUGH THE VINEYARDS 2026! And for our past participants, 2026 brings exciting changes! For the first time LORIMAR Vineyards will be our host venue for the start/finish, post-ride celebration and raffle! And we are again excited to award a raffle grand prize drawing of an AVENTON E-BIKE from AVENTON BIKES! And our local AVENTON dealer Bicycle Warehouse of Temecula has upgraded the ebike and warranty coverage to bring the value of this ebike to over $2,500!  Secondly, we will again offer a shorter scenic guided tour route of 13 miles for our intermediate riders. While there is no way to totally avoid the challenges of the vineyards naturally hilly terrain, the shorter route is designed to better accomodate some of our intermediate level participants. 

Lorimar Winery is a popular local winery known for its daily live entertainment and is nestled amongst the gentle vine covered rolling hills in the heart of Temecula Wine Country. They will be offering discounts on their wines (both flights and bottles) and food for our ride participants! We are confident that our riders and guests will find LORIMAR Winery a great venue to hold our post ride “happy hour”! This year we will also be celebrating AMERICA 250 and have a fun filled experience planned for our participants! We are truly fortunate to have such a picturesque location for our Cycle Through the Vineyards this year.

name: Dalton Canyon Ultra
description:
Welcome to the Dalton Canyon Ultra, a trail race made by wildland firefighters, for wildland firefighters. This event is right in the backyard of the Dalton Hotshot Camp on the Angeles National Forest in Glendora California. It’s an extremely challenging 32 mile course with about 6,000-7,000 total feet of elevation gain and loss on dirt trails with sections of pavement. There is a 50K solo race, a 50K 4 person open relay race, and a 10K solo option.

The mission of our organization and this event is to bring the wildland fire community together, honor, share and preserve hotshot history, and raise money to take care of our fellow wildland firefighters in times of hardship, illness, injury or death. All profits and donations for this first year of the event will be donated to the Wildland Firefighter Foundation to support their mission and all the good work they do.

The event is scheduled to take place February 6, 2027 rain or shine.

Course Description:

50K Course: Starting at Big Dalton Campground, going out the canyon to the Dalton Fire Station and up the Colby Garcia Trail where you will finish and pop out on Glendora Mountain Road for a few miles until you hit the first aid station. You will touch that station then go back down the hill along Glendora Mountain Road until you reach Lower Monroe Trail then you will head down Mystic Canyon Trail, go down Big Dalton Canyon, make a right and go up Poop Out Trail, continue up and take Truck Trail all the way up to Glendora Mountain Road where you will find the second aid station. Touch this point and head right back down truck trail, then down mystic canyon trail. At the bottom of Mystic you will take Big Dalton Canyon Trail all the way down to the dam gate and hop across to the Keiser Trail system where you will pop out to Big Dalton Canyon road, then go down to the Wren Meacham Trail, pop out and head to the Eqestrian Area, back out onto GMR, then up Big Dalton Canyon to the Start/Finish line in Big Dalton Campground.

50K Relay Course: The relay course will use the exact same route as the 50K Solo. Each team must have 4 members, if for any reason the team loses a member they will be allowed to sub in up until the day of the event. If any team member is injured or can’t finish their section it’s up to their teammate to pick up where they left off and finish out that leg. 

-Leg 1 is from the start of the race to mile 7 (Aid station 1)  -Leg 2 goes from mile 7 to mile 14.5 (Aid station 3)  -Leg 3 goes from mile 14.5 to mile 21 (Aid station 4)  -Leg 4 is from mile 21.5 to the finish line at mile 32.  Map for the aid station and relay points is posted on the website and on the instagram page.

10K Course: 7.2 Mile loop Starting at Big Dalton Campground in Big Dalton Canyon, up Glendora Mountain Road to Lowe Monroe Trail, down Mystic Canyon, up Big Dalton Canyon trail to the dam gate and across to the Keiser Trail system, down and out back to Big Dalton Canyon Road, up Wren Meacham Trail, out to the Equestian Area and back up GMR and back to Big Dalton Campground to Finish.

-All runners will be required to have a refillable water bottle or running vest with hydration on their person during the race and are strongly encouraged to bring gels/nutrition with them

-Time cap will be at 1600 for all 3 events

 

Aid Stations:

-There will be a total of 5 aid stations throughout the course. Aid stations will have water, electrolytes, and snacks. Aid station 2 and 3 will be water only stations. Drop bags must be handed off on 2/5/27 with your name and which aid station you’d like it to live at.

Aid station 1: @ mile 7,  Aid station 2 (Water only): @ mile 11,   Aid station 3 (Water only): @mile 14.5,  Aid station 4: @ mile 21.5,  Aid station 5: @ mile 26.

 

For general information, donation or volunteer inquiry please email daltoncanyonultra@gmail.com, or check out our instagram @DaltonCanyon50k.  Race Director: Matt Fraga

name: Davis Stampede
description:
The Davis Stampede takes place each year in February, and includes 5K, 10K and Half Marathon routes. We also offer a family friendly 2K (1.24 mile) fun run/walk division that is perfect for younger athletes, families, and walkers. Starting and finishing at Davis’ Playfields Park, the Davis Stampede is a great way to kick off 2027 with a commitment to fitness. Courses are mostly flat and take runners and walkers through east and south Davis’s greenbelts and neighborhood streets. Race amenities include finisher’s medals, half marathon pace groups, t-shirts, a post-race expo, and course water stations stocked with water and electrolyte replacement along the course.

New for 2027: free downloadable athlete race photos!

Registration for the 44th Annual Davis Stampede opens on October 1.
Please register early! The Half Marathon often sells out or comes close to it.

Start Times:
Sunday, February 28, 2027

8:00 a.m. - Half Marathon and 10K
8:10 a.m. - 5K
9:00 a.m. - 2K 
last updated 9/2026; subject to change

Entry Includes:

Blend performance short sleeved t-shirt, finisher medal, chip timing, downloadable photos, eligibility for division awards. Option to upgrade to a long sleeve technical (100% polyester) shirt for $8; available while supplies last. You also may opt out of the short sleeve t-shirt and save $5. 

Packet Pick Up:

You can pick up your packet (bib and shirt) on Saturday, February 27 from 1:30pm to 4:30pm at Playfields Park (race venue). We allow you to pick up for friends, and ID is not required.  You can also pick up on race day (Feb. 28) starting at 6:30 a.m. If picking up on race day, we suggest arriving at least one hour prior to your race start. We encourage all participants to have their QR code available on their phone for fast check-in. You can find this in your confirmation email. 

Safety pins will be available at registration. On race morning, please pin your race bib to the clothing on the FRONT of your body so that it is visible to timing officials, course monitors, and race photographers. 

Overall and Age Group Awards:

Overall awards will be presented to the top male, female and nonbinary finishers based on gun time. Age group awards will be determined by net time and will be awarded to the top three male, female, and nonbinary registrants per age group. Registrants may decline to state their gender and / or age, however, those entrants will not be eligible for age group or overall awards or results ranking in those categories.  Award pick up is available on race day; unclaimed awards are not mailed. Awards also presented to the top three finishers in each special division. See section below for more detailed information on age groups and special divisions. 

Participate Virtually:

Those who are unable to attend on event day or who would prefer to participate on their own schedule may register as a virtual participant. Virtual packets will be mailed on or about 3/3/27 and will include a bib, finisher medal for the division you designate upon entry, and t-shirt (if selected). Virtual participants are welcome to pick up their packets at the Saturday Packet Pick Up if preferred. The deadline to sign up as a Virtual Participant is Thursday, February 25. The last day to request a switch from an in-person division to the virtual division (in cases of injury, change of plans, illness, etc.) is February 27 at 11:59 pm and this may be done via email.  Virtual participants may upload their results online by following these steps: (1) search name in upper right-hand corner; (2) next to name, click 'edit time'; (3) input your finish time in the format of HH:MM:SS and provide other requested information. Times may be submitted from February 28 through March 22 (link will be available on Feb. 28), although you may complete your run/walk any time that works for you after time of registration. Submitting a time is optional and not required. There are no age group or overall awards for the virtual divisions.  

Half Marathon:


Half Marathon course cut-off time is 3.5 hours or 11:30 a.m. Those on a pace to finish after this time will be offered a ride back to the finish line.

Minimum age to participate in the Half Marathon is 15. Consideration will be made on a case by case basis for youth 14 and under to participate in the Half Marathon who are sufficiently trained; must be accompanied by an adult (who must be registered). Times may be submitted from February 28 through March 22 (link will be available on Feb. 28), although you may complete your run/walk any time that works for you after time of registration. Submitting a time is optional and not required. There are no age group or overall awards for the virtual divisions.  

Half Marathon:


Half Marathon course cut-off time is 3.5 hours or 11:30 a.m. Those on a pace to finish after this time will be offered a ride back to the finish line.

Minimum age to participate in the Half Marathon is 15. Consideration will be made on a case by case basis for youth 14 and under to participate in the Half Marathon who are sufficiently trained; must be accompanied by an adult (who must be registered). Send your request to events@changeofpace.com by February 15.

Water/fluid stations will be located approximately every two miles and will offer water and electrolyte replacement. Please carry nutrition or salt with you should it be a part of your training/racing regimen. 

Strollers, Wagons, and Wheels:

Wheelchair entrants may participate in all divisions. Racing wheelchairs should start at the front and coordinate with event official; pushed or casual wheelchair entrants should start toward the back. Pushed wheelchairs should start towards the back. Adaptive Divisions in the 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon.  Please note: half marathon has approximately 1/4 mile on crushed gravel by Barovetto Park plus about 1 mile on trail (service road around Wildhorse Golf Course).

5K or 10K entrants wishing to push a stroller MUST start toward the back of the pack at the starting line, no exceptions.  In the 2K, strollers and wagons (for children) and wheelchairs are permitted. Wagons must have seatbelts if children are inside them. Those with  strollers should line up behind the runners who are participating without a stroller.

It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied in the 2K.

Those registering as a support runner will not be eligible for age group awards nor be ranked by age.   In the case that support runners  wish to receive the full race experience (eligible for awards, ranked by age division, etc) in that case they should register for the distance they are going to run/walk (Half Marathon, 5K, etc) instead of as a Support Runner, but be sure to not enter an Adaptive Division. Email events@changeofpace.com with any questions prior to registering.  

Notes:
- We suggest that support runners/walkers and guides wear high visibility clothing or a vest indicating that they are a guide or a support runner. However, it is not required. 
- Please do not register as a Support Runner if you do not already have an athlete you are paired with. 
- Please email us at events@changeofpace.com with any questions. 

Beneficiary 

The event will benefit Cancer Champions. Read more about their mission at https://cancerchampions.org.  

Volunteers

Volunteers are needed to help with a variety of tasks on race day, as well as at Packet Pick Up. Sign up on the volunteer tab. For more information about the opportunities we have available for interested volunteers, or to sign up as a group, please see the volunteer tab on our website here. 

Refund Policy & Race Rules:

Entries are non-refundable and non-transferable to other events in the case of illness, injury, or change of plans; event happens rain or shine. You must be registered for the distance for which you intend to participate.  We reserve the right to postpone, delay, reschedule, or cancel the event if unforeseen condition occur that would compromise the ability for the event to be held in a manner that is safe for athletes, volunteers, staff, law enforcement, and the community. Should the event be postponed, rescheduled, or canceled, refunds will NOT be offered. Read complete details here: https://runsignup.com/Race/28183/RefundPolicy. Event insurance is offered through a third party and offered at the time of registration.

name: Davis Turkey Trot
description:
Registration opens at Noon on Friday, August 14, 2026. 

The Davis Turkey Trot is an annual run/walk taking place the Saturday before Thanksgiving each year since 1988. We offer multiple events and distances, with something for every age group and ability. On event morning, along with an enjoyable run or walk through Davis’ residential neighborhoods and greenbelts, participants enjoy our post-race expo, with refreshments and samples from vendors. Prizes for timed events to overall winners as well as the top three finishers in each category. Prizes to top finishers in special divisions for 5K, 10K, and Half.

  • The half marathon sold out in 2025 - please register early.
  • Due to changes in insurance, dogs are not permitted on any of the race courses.

2026 Start Times

2026 times are subject to change and may change from the below

7:50 AM - Half Marathon
8:05 AM - 5K
8:45 AM - 10K and 2 Mile
10:15 AM - 1 Mile (Timed, all ages)
10:30 AM - Kids Fun Runs (1/2, 1/4 mile + Toddler Trot)
Last Updated 8/13/26

 

RACE INFO AT A GLANCE:

Race Venue: Civic Center Park | Corner 7th and B Streets 
Google Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bWHbhN219Muk71ve9  

Packet Pick Up

Pre-Race Packet Pick Up: Friday, November 20 from 2:30 pm to 6:30 pm at the Veterans Memorial Center, located at 14th Street at B Street (in between the Yolo County Library and Davis High School). Address: 203 East 14th Street, Davis, CA 95616
Friday Parking: Davis High School student lot or library lot, side streets
What to bring to Packet Pick Up: Bring your QR code and show on your phone (hard copy printout ok too) to the check-in volunteer. You may check in family and friends- please bring their QR code / screenshot of it to check them in.

Saturday (Race Day Pick Up): 6:30 am onwards at Civic Center Park
Arrive at registration 60-75 minutes early if picking up race day
What to bring to Race Day Packet Pick Up: Bring your QR code and show on your phone (hard copy printout ok too) to the check-in volunteer. You may check in family and friends- please bring their QR code / screenshot of it to check them in.
Saturday parking: Downtown streets or at Davis High School
(suggested) and walk down B Street from 14th to 7th Street

 

Divisions and Amenities

1 MILE/2 MILE/5K/10K/HALF Entries: Includes chip timing and eligibility for overall & age group awards, long sleeve, DryBlend (50/50) t-shirt, and a finisher medal.  Age division awards three-deep in age groups. Prizes to the top three finishers by gender (men, women, nonbinary) in special divisions in the 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon.  Participants are eligible to win both age group and special division prizes. See bottom of page for more info.  It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in any of these distances. All participants on the course for the 1M, 2M, 5K, 10K, Half must be registered. Children in strollers are FREE but we ask that you complete a registration for them. They will receive a complimentary commemorative race bib (which you can display during the race on the stroller for photo purposes, not required) and you will have the option to add-on a short sleeve t-shirt for them if you desire. One parent / guardian may run alongside a child in the Kids Fun Run and does not need to be registered. All participants on the course in the 1 Mile, 2 Mile, 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon must be registered. 

Cancer survivors who identify themselves as such during the registration process will be presented with a special cancer survivor's finisher medal, which can be picked up at the Cancer Champions booth on race day after finishing the event.

Age Groups: 5K, 10K, Half Marathon have 5 year age groups as follows:

  • 5K: 7 & Under, 8-9, 10-11, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, …, 75-79, 90+
  • 10K: 11 & Under, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, 20-24, …, 75-79, 80+
  • Half Marathon:  1-15 Yrs, 16-19, 20-24, …, 65-69, 70+

2 Mile and 1 Mile will have the following age groups: 

  • Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+.

Men, women, and nonbinary divisions will be awarded equally. Age group placement will be determined by net (chip) time for all events. Overall top finishers by gender (top 3 for 5K, 10K, Half; top 1 for 2 mile and 1 mile) will be determined by gun time for all timed events. 

 

Half Marathon: This 13.1 mile course starts at 7:50 a.m. and travels through Downtown Davis, the Cannery, into the country via F Street and Road 29, and through the Davis greenbelts, finishing on B Street at the same finish line as the other races. Pacers from GVH will be present from 1:40 to 3:00 goal finish times to help you achieve your race aspirations. Water stops are every two miles (approx.). Course cut-off is 4 hours or 11:50 am. If you are not on track to finish within this timeframe, you will be offered a ride back to the finish line.  There are two "hills" on the half marathon route: 1) Covell Blvd overpass after the Cannery (to go up and over the train tracks) and 2) the footbridge to cross Covell and enter Community Park, near Catalina Ave. For the most part this is a very flat course.  The course has approximately one unpaved mile along the north edge of town along the canal. Minimum age is 15. Age exceptions made on a case by case basis; if granted, those under 15 must be accompanied by an adult who is registered for the race. Email to inquire. 

Dogs: Dogs are not permitted in this event in any distance due to new insurance policies.

Strollers: Strollers are allowed, however you must start toward the back at the starting line. If you are hoping to run fast, win an age group award, or place in a special division, do not run with a stroller. The course is too crowded and it is not safe for you, your child, or other people to do a lot of weaving, especially on the narrower portions.

Virtual Entries: Includes packet mailing via USPS (packets sent postrace), commemorative bib number, Long Sleeved t-shirt (opt-out if you prefer no tshirt), and finisher medal. Virtual Entrants will be emailed information about how to upload their time to our results server. Complete your virtual run or walk anytime between November 1 and December 15th. Virtual entrants may pick up their packets at packet pick up 11/20 if desired; otherwise they will be mailed after the race.

 

1 Mile All-Ages Run or Walk: The 1 Mile race will be timed and be for all ages. Prizes will be awarded to the top overall men, women, and nonbinary finisher plus the top three finishers by gender in each of the following age divisions: Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+. All people traveling on the 1 Mile course must be registered. Strollers are allowed but must start at the back, no exceptions. It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in the 1 Mile. This race goes on city streets.

 

Kids Fun Run Entries: A non-competitive, un-timed fun run with multiple distances. 1/4 Mile: Ages 3-12. 1/2 Mile: Ages 5-12. Toddler Trot: Ages 5 and Under.

 

Add-On Davis Turkey Trot Merchandise for participants: During registration you may add-on the following items to your entry:

  • Short Sleeved cotton t-shirt. Available in sizes Adult S up to Adult 2X and Youth XS-XL. This shirt will be available for pick up in the Extra Merchandise table during Packet Pick Up or on Race Day.
  • Davis Turkey Trot hat. Moisture wicking running cap or trucker cap (47 brand) adjustable. Available in one-size-fits-most adults. Hats will be available for pick up in the Extra Merchandise tent during Packet Pick Up or on Race Day.
  • Add-ons are available while supplies last; please order early. No refunds; all sales are final. Sales tax will be applied to add-on purchases.
  • Add-ons are not mailed for no shows but are mailed for virtual participants with their packets.

Guides/Support Runners for Adaptive Entrants: If you are a sighted guide for a visually impaired participant, or a support runner/walker for a disabled entrant in an adaptive category, please do not enter the adaptive division - that division is for the disabled athlete to enter. Support Runners (including sighted guides) for entrants must be registered for the event either as a standard paid entrant or as a support runner. Entering as a support runner is is offered at reduced charge and includes a finisher medal and bib (t-shirt can be added on). To register for the support runner/walker category, select "Support Runner" choice at registration (end of list). Those registering as a support runner will not be eligible for age group / special division awards nor be ranked by age.   A bib and finisher medal are included.    (No support runner entry available for wheelchair entrants except for pushed wheelchairs).  In the case that support runners wish to receive the full race experience (eligible for awards, ranked by age division, etc) in that case they should register for the distance they are going to run/walk (2 mile, 5K, etc) instead of as a Support Runner, but be sure to not enter an Adaptive Division. Email events@changeofpace.com with any questions prior to registering.  Please do not register as a Support Runner if you do not already have an athlete you are paired with. At this time we do not have a matching program.

Wheelchair participants: 
5K, 10K, Half Marathon Wheelchair/Adaptive entrants: If you would like a 2 minute head start for your division please email us at least four days before race day at events@changeofpace.com so that we can schedule that for you and notify start line officials. 

Packet Pick Up

Pre-Race Packet Pick Up:

  • Friday, November 20, 2:30 to 6:30 pm at the Veteran's Memorial Center (Corner 14th and B Streets, Davis)
  • Packets will include your bib and t-shirt.
  • You may pick up for friends (please bring their QR code)
  • ID is not required
  • Please bring your unique QR code from your race confirmation email for easy check-in and show it to the registration check-in volunteer. A copy/screenshot on your phone or in mobile wallet is perfect. 
  • We will not be able to accommodate pick ups outside the posted registration times, as this is the timeframes we have volunteers scheduled to assist. Please do not arrive early.


Race Morning Pick Up

  • Opens at 6:30 a.m.
  • Located on the basketball court on the north end of Civic Field; adjacent to MLK School*
  • Packets will include your bib and t-shirt.
  • ID is not required to pick up
  • Please bring your unique QR code from your race confirmation email for easy check-in and show it to the registration check-in volunteer. A copy/screenshot on your phone or in mobile wallet is perfect. 
  • Please arrive at least 60 minutes prior to your race start if you are picking up your packet on race day
  • On-site registration will be available, however registering online prior to arrival is strongly encouraged. Cash and card accepted. No checks. 

*in the event of rain, registration location may change

FAQ

  • Strollers are permitted but must start toward the back. No exceptions. Please do not line up right on the starting line. If you wish to run a faster time or compete for an age group prize, we suggest you do not run with a stroller, or you will be doing a lot of weaving. This is not safe for you or for other participants.
  • All events (except the Kids Fun Run) are scored and placed using your chip time, therefore, feel free to hang back from the crowd at the start. Your time does not start until you cross the starting mats. Only overall awards (top three by gender) are based on gun time. 
  • Unclaimed awards are not mailed. Please pick up on race day.
  • Shirts are not held for no-shows and packets are not sent for no-shows. 
  • If you would like to participate in more than one event, please register for each event separately. 
  • Need to change your race distance after you have registered? (E.g. Registered for the half marathon, wish to switch to the 10K). You may do so within your runsignup account OR send us an email asking us to make the switch (Email deadline is 11/18). Division transfers may also be made when picking up race bib. No refunds for the difference if you "downgrade". 
  • Interested volunteer groups, please email us
  • Interested booth vendors: more information is available here. 
  • Scooters, bikes, hula hoops, rollerblades, skateboards, hoverboards, roller skates, trikes, and sports balls are not allowed on the course. No children in wagons unless there is a seatbelt.
  • The Half Marathon and 10K both have one location on the course where participants go up a curb. We will do our best to make a ramp in this location. 10K entrants cross this point one time and Half Marathoners cross it twice.  
  • Children in strollers: We are asking children in strollers to be registered for the event. Registration for this is free. We will provide you with a commemorative bib when you check them in if you would like one. If you would like to purchase the child in the stroller a race t-shirt, you will have the opportunity to do so during registration. 

Refund Policy

Please Note Refund Policy: Start times are subject to change. Event happens rain or shine. All entries are strictly non refundable and non transferable.  Race insurance is offered by a third party in the case that you become injured or cannot attend. We reserve the right to postpone, delay or cancel the event due to unforeseen circumstances or acts of God which would make staging the event unsafe for event participants, volunteers, sponsors or staff. If we, the State of California, Yolo County, or the City of Davis deem this event unsafe to occur in person due to current health conditions (including disease, or air quality due to wildfires) we will notify you of our decision to postpone or cancel, or move to virtual, by email as well as on our website and social media pages. There will be no refunds  should this occur, and all entry fees will be first used to cover incurred expenses and then donated to our charity.  If you become ill prior to event day, have to go out of town for work, or cannot attend due to family issues, we can transfer your entry to the virtual division (deadline is 11/20) and you can participate virtually; or if you purchased the race insurance you can file a claim. We also allow transfers to a friend/family member IF your request is submitted on or before Thursday, Nov. 19. We do not, however, grant refunds should the an illness/unable to attend circumstance occurs.

  • You may pick up for friends (please bring their QR code)
  • ID is not required
  • Please bring your unique QR code from your race confirmation email for easy check-in and show it to the registration check-in volunteer. A copy/screenshot on your phone or in mobile wallet is perfect.
