  • Please bring your unique QR code from your race confirmation email for easy check-in and show it to the registration check-in volunteer. A copy/screenshot on your phone or in mobile wallet is perfect. 
  • Please arrive at least 60 minutes prior to your race start if you are picking up your packet on race day
  • On-site registration will be available, however registering online prior to arrival is strongly encouraged. Cash and card accepted. No checks. 

*in the event of rain, registration location may change

FAQ

  • Strollers are permitted but must start toward the back. No exceptions. Please do not line up right on the starting line. If you wish to run a faster time or compete for an age group prize, we suggest you do not run with a stroller, or you will be doing a lot of weaving. This is not safe for you or for other participants.
  • All events (except the Kids Fun Run) are scored and placed using your chip time, therefore, feel free to hang back from the crowd at the start. Your time does not start until you cross the starting mats. Only overall awards (top three by gender) are based on gun time. 
  • Unclaimed awards are not mailed. Please pick up on race day.
  • Shirts are not held for no-shows and packets are not sent for no-shows. 
  • If you would like to participate in more than one event, please register for each event separately. 
  • Need to change your race distance after you have registered? (E.g. Registered for the half marathon, wish to switch to the 10K).   • Interested booth vendors: more information is available here.

name: Davis Turkey Trot
description:
Registration opens at Noon on Friday, August 14, 2026. 

The Davis Turkey Trot is an annual run/walk taking place the Saturday before Thanksgiving each year since 1988. We offer multiple events and distances, with something for every age group and ability. On event morning, along with an enjoyable run or walk through Davis’ residential neighborhoods and greenbelts, participants enjoy our post-race expo, with refreshments and samples from vendors. Prizes for timed events to overall winners as well as the top three finishers in each category. Prizes to top finishers in special divisions for 5K, 10K, and Half.

  • The half marathon sold out in 2025 - please register early.
  • Due to changes in insurance, dogs are not permitted on any of the race courses.

2026 Start Times

2026 times are subject to change and may change from the below

7:50 AM - Half Marathon
8:05 AM - 5K
8:45 AM - 10K and 2 Mile
10:15 AM - 1 Mile (Timed, all ages)
10:30 AM - Kids Fun Runs (1/2, 1/4 mile + Toddler Trot)
Last Updated 8/13/26

 

RACE INFO AT A GLANCE:

Race Venue: Civic Center Park | Corner 7th and B Streets 
Google Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bWHbhN219Muk71ve9  

Packet Pick Up

Pre-Race Packet Pick Up: Friday, November 20 from 2:30 pm to 6:30 pm at the Veterans Memorial Center, located at 14th Street at B Street (in between the Yolo County Library and Davis High School). Address: 203 East 14th Street, Davis, CA 95616
Friday Parking: Davis High School student lot or library lot, side streets
What to bring to Packet Pick Up: Bring your QR code and show on your phone (hard copy printout ok too) to the check-in volunteer. You may check in family and friends- please bring their QR code / screenshot of it to check them in.

Saturday (Race Day Pick Up): 6:30 am onwards at Civic Center Park
Arrive at registration 60-75 minutes early if picking up race day
What to bring to Race Day Packet Pick Up: Bring your QR code and show on your phone (hard copy printout ok too) to the check-in volunteer. You may check in family and friends- please bring their QR code / screenshot of it to check them in.
Saturday parking: Downtown streets or at Davis High School
(suggested) and walk down B Street from 14th to 7th Street

 

Divisions and Amenities

1 MILE/2 MILE/5K/10K/HALF Entries: Includes chip timing and eligibility for overall & age group awards, long sleeve, DryBlend (50/50) t-shirt, and a finisher medal.  Age division awards three-deep in age groups. Prizes to the top three finishers by gender (men, women, nonbinary) in special divisions in the 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon.  Participants are eligible to win both age group and special division prizes. See bottom of page for more info.  It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in any of these distances. All participants on the course for the 1M, 2M, 5K, 10K, Half must be registered. Children in strollers are FREE but we ask that you complete a registration for them. They will receive a complimentary commemorative race bib (which you can display during the race on the stroller for photo purposes, not required) and you will have the option to add-on a short sleeve t-shirt for them if you desire. One parent / guardian may run alongside a child in the Kids Fun Run and does not need to be registered. All participants on the course in the 1 Mile, 2 Mile, 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon must be registered. 

Cancer survivors who identify themselves as such during the registration process will be presented with a special cancer survivor's finisher medal, which can be picked up at the Cancer Champions booth on race day after finishing the event.

Age Groups: 5K, 10K, Half Marathon have 5 year age groups as follows:

  • 5K: 7 & Under, 8-9, 10-11, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, …, 75-79, 90+
  • 10K: 11 & Under, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, 20-24, …, 75-79, 80+
  • Half Marathon:  1-15 Yrs, 16-19, 20-24, …, 65-69, 70+

2 Mile and 1 Mile will have the following age groups: 

  • Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+.

Men, women, and nonbinary divisions will be awarded equally. Age group placement will be determined by net (chip) time for all events. Overall top finishers by gender (top 3 for 5K, 10K, Half; top 1 for 2 mile and 1 mile) will be determined by gun time for all timed events. 

 

Half Marathon: This 13.1 mile course starts at 7:50 a.m. and travels through Downtown Davis, the Cannery, into the country via F Street and Road 29, and through the Davis greenbelts, finishing on B Street at the same finish line as the other races. Pacers from GVH will be present from 1:40 to 3:00 goal finish times to help you achieve your race aspirations. Water stops are every two miles (approx.). Course cut-off is 4 hours or 11:50 am. If you are not on track to finish within this timeframe, you will be offered a ride back to the finish line.  There are two "hills" on the half marathon route: 1) Covell Blvd overpass after the Cannery (to go up and over the train tracks) and 2) the footbridge to cross Covell and enter Community Park, near Catalina Ave. For the most part this is a very flat course.  The course has approximately one unpaved mile along the north edge of town along the canal. Minimum age is 15. Age exceptions made on a case by case basis; if granted, those under 15 must be accompanied by an adult who is registered for the race. Email to inquire. 

Dogs: Dogs are not permitted in this event in any distance due to new insurance policies.

Strollers: Strollers are allowed, however you must start toward the back at the starting line. If you are hoping to run fast, win an age group award, or place in a special division, do not run with a stroller. The course is too crowded and it is not safe for you, your child, or other people to do a lot of weaving, especially on the narrower portions.

Virtual Entries: Includes packet mailing via USPS (packets sent postrace), commemorative bib number, Long Sleeved t-shirt (opt-out if you prefer no tshirt), and finisher medal. Virtual Entrants will be emailed information about how to upload their time to our results server. Complete your virtual run or walk anytime between November 1 and December 15th. Virtual entrants may pick up their packets at packet pick up 11/20 if desired; otherwise they will be mailed after the race.

 

1 Mile All-Ages Run or Walk: The 1 Mile race will be timed and be for all ages. Prizes will be awarded to the top overall men, women, and nonbinary finisher plus the top three finishers by gender in each of the following age divisions: Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+. All people traveling on the 1 Mile course must be registered. Strollers are allowed but must start at the back, no exceptions. It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in the 1 Mile. This race goes on city streets.

 

Kids Fun Run Entries: A non-competitive, un-timed fun run with multiple distances. 1/4 Mile: Ages 3-12. 1/2 Mile: Ages 5-12. Toddler Trot: Ages 5 and Under.

 

Add-On Davis Turkey Trot Merchandise for participants: During registration you may add-on the following items to your entry:

  • Short Sleeved cotton t-shirt. Available in sizes Adult S up to Adult 2X and Youth XS-XL. This shirt will be available for pick up in the Extra Merchandise table during Packet Pick Up or on Race Day.
  • Davis Turkey Trot hat. Moisture wicking running cap or trucker cap (47 brand) adjustable. Available in one-size-fits-most adults. Hats will be available for pick up in the Extra Merchandise tent during Packet Pick Up or on Race Day.
  • Add-ons are available while supplies last; please order early. No refunds; all sales are final. Sales tax will be applied to add-on purchases.
  • Add-ons are not mailed for no shows but are mailed for virtual participants with their packets.

Guides/Support Runners for Adaptive Entrants: If you are a sighted guide for a visually impaired participant, or a support runner/walker for a disabled entrant in an adaptive category, please do not enter the adaptive division - that division is for the disabled athlete to enter. Support Runners (including sighted guides) for entrants must be registered for the event either as a standard paid entrant or as a support runner. Entering as a support runner is is offered at reduced charge and includes a finisher medal and bib (t-shirt can be added on). To register for the support runner/walker category, select "Support Runner" choice at registration (end of list). Those registering as a support runner will not be eligible for age group / special division awards nor be ranked by age.   A bib and finisher medal are included.    (No support runner entry available for wheelchair entrants except for pushed wheelchairs).  In the case that support runners wish to receive the full race experience (eligible for awards, ranked by age division, etc) in that case they should register for the distance they are going to run/walk (2 mile, 5K, etc) instead of as a Support Runner, but be sure to not enter an Adaptive Division. Email events@changeofpace.com with any questions prior to registering.  Please do not register as a Support Runner if you do not already have an athlete you are paired with. At this time we do not have a matching program.

Wheelchair participants: 
5K, 10K, Half Marathon Wheelchair/Adaptive entrants: If you would like a 2 minute head start for your division please email us at least four days before race day at events@changeofpace.com so that we can schedule that for you and notify start line officials.

name: Davis Turkey Trot Vendor Registration
description:
The Davis Turkey Trot’s 2025 event will mark a thirty-seven year commitment from A Change of Pace to providing Yolo County with a fun, safe health-oriented event. Our goal is to have a giant party afterwards and we want to invite everyone. Our booth fees are meant to be affordable for small and local businesses as well as nonprofits.

 

  • The deadline to sign up to be a booth vendor, or to sponsor a company team, is November 15th.
  • Tents, tablecloths and other items to be supplied by vendor and are not included. 
  • You can add on the rental of one 8’ table and two chairs to your booth reservation. Tents are not available for rental. 
  • A site map and one-sheet will be emailed out on approximately Wed., Nov. 19, 2025.
  • The expo happens on Civic Center Field (grass) on Saturday, November 22, 2025 and will take place rain or shine. 
  • Insurance Requirements - Due to requirements from our event insurance provider, all sponsors, vendors, subcontractors, and booth operators must provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI)

 

We have two options for companies to take part in this year's event:

 

(1) Enhanced vendor booth package. This includes:


- 10x10' vendor booth at the event with premium placement
- Logo on the Davis Turkey Trot event page on changeofpace.com
- One post on the A Change of Pace social media (Facebook, Instagram) promoting your business (business must provide photos)
- One banner displayed at the event on the race finish line fencing (banner must be supplied by sponsor, max size 3'x8')

 

(2) Standard vendor booth package. This includes:


- One 10'x10' booth space in the post-race expo, where you can showcase products to event attendees, sample, do demonstrations, etc. 
- If you need a table and chairs, you may add this on during the registration process for $20
- Discounted rate available for nonprofits

 

 

Questions? Email us at acopfoundation@gmail.com

name: Day of The Dead 5K & 10k
description:
Event Location

  • Date & Time: Sunday, October 25, 2026
    Location: Wild Runners Fair Oaks, 10149 Fair Oaks Blvd, Fair Oaks, CA

Participant Packet Pick Up

  • Saturday, October 24, 2026, 10 am – 4 pm
  • Race Day, Sunday, October 25, 2026, 6:30am - 7:30 am
  • Location: Wild Runners Fair Oaks, 10149 Fair Oaks Blvd,  Fair Oaks Ca 95628

Race Day Schedule

  • 6:30 am - 7:30 am: Race day registration and packet pick up
  • 7:30 am: All final items dropped off for the La Ofrenda
  • 8:05 am - Kids Races begin
  • 8:20 am - Day of the Dead progression to starting line
  • 8:30 am - Day of the Dead 5k/10k race begins
  • 9:30 am - Awards ceremony and costume contest

Swag & Event

All participants receive:

  • Bib number, timing device and safety pins
  • Short-sleeved event shirt
  • Finisher medal
  • Coupon for one-free tamale for each participant*
  • Special offers from our sponsors

* Redeemable only at the post-event expo and festival on October 25, 2026. 

  • Family-Friendly Walk/Run Events: The Day of the Dead 5k has something for every generation to enjoy from a 5k for adults to our Kid Races. 
    Live Entertainment: Immerse yourself in Mexican tradition with live music and performances. With stilt walkers and live music, transport yourself to another time as we pay homage to the cultural heritage of our grandparents.
  • La Ofrenda: To honor loved ones who have passed, bring offerings, such as photographs, flowers, nostalgic items, and foods as we create a collective space of remembrance and gratitude.  All items should be placed on La Ofrenda by 7:30am in front of the Wild Runners store at 10149 Fair Oaks Blvd.
  • Antojitos Delights: Enjoy the flavors and culinary delights that our grandparents cherished. In addition to free home-made tamales for race participants, indulge in the food and delectable treats of Mexican heritage.
  • Post-Race Festival and Expo: Unwind and connect with fellow participants post race! Explore our Community Partner and vendor booths showcasing the latest in fitness, wellness, and recovery services.  

5k Course

The race kicks off with a 0.5-mile downhill through the charming Old Fair Oaks Village neighborhood and over the bridge. Following a 3.2-mile out-and-back path along the picturesque American River Trail towards Bannister Park, the course remains entirely on paved roads and trails, catering to participants of all abilities and those with strollers.  The race concludes with an approximate half-mile ascent back to the finish line.

Awards & Age Divisions

Awards ceremony to follow event at 9:30 a.m. for the 5k and costume contest. Prizes for overall male and female winners will be presented. Top three finishers in each age division will receive a special prize. Age-group winners pick up prizes at the Awards table.

Top boy and girl finishers in the 1/4 and 1/2 mile races will receive a special prize. All other kid finishers will receive medals.

Top 3 finishers in the male and female races will respectively receive: 

  • 1st Place: $100 gift card to Wild Runners
  • 2nd Place: $50 gift card to Wild Runners

name: Deck the Miles 5K, 10K - Venice Beach
description:
🎄🔔 DECK THE MILES — VENICE BEACH HOLIDAY 5K & 10K 🔔🎄
Run. Jingle. Celebrate.
📅 Saturday, December 19, 2026
📍 Venice Beach – 1 Windward Ave, Venice, CA 90291
🏃 5K & 10K Start: 7:00 AM
⏰ Course Closes: 9:30 AM

Grab your Santa hat, lace up your running shoes, and Deck the Miles with us at one of Southern California's most iconic beaches!

We're bringing Christmas cheer to Venice Beach for a festive morning of running, costumes, jingling bells, holiday music, and classic CaliFlow fun.

And because this is Venice... expect a holiday race with a little extra personality. 🎅🌴🌊

🔔 JINGLE ALL THE WAY!
Every runner can add jingle bells to their shoes and bring some Christmas magic to Ocean Front Walk.

You'll hear us coming before you see us!

Santa hats, Christmas socks, ugly sweaters, elves, reindeer, candy canes, Grinches and completely over-the-top holiday outfits are highly encouraged.

🎅 HOLIDAY COSTUME CONTEST
Don't just run it — dress for it!

We're having a Christmas Costume Contest, so bring your holiday A-game.

Funny, festive, creative, ridiculous... we want to see it all!

🏃 THE COURSE
The Start & Finish Line will be located where Windward Avenue meets Ocean Front Walk in the heart of Venice Beach Boardwalk.

From there, runners will head along Ocean Front Walk, taking in everything that makes Venice famous — the colorful boardwalk, murals, shops, ocean views and unmistakable Venice Beach energy.

You'll continue south toward the iconic Venice Fishing Pier before making your way back toward the Start/Finish.

🎄 5K — 1 Loop
🎄 10K — 2 Loops

This is an open pedestrian pathway course, so please be courteous to other runners, walkers and members of the public enjoying Ocean Front Walk.

🏅 WHAT'S INCLUDED
✨ Custom Deck the Miles Finisher Medal
👕 Custom Race Shirt
🔔 Jingle Bells for Your Running Shoes
⏱️ ChronoTrack Chip Timing
🏆 Overall Awards
🏅 Age Group Awards
🎅 Holiday Costume Contest
🎶 Festive Finish Line Fun
🌊 Oceanfront Venice Beach Course
🎄 Plenty of Christmas Cheer

Whether you're racing for a PR, running with friends, walking in your favorite ugly Christmas sweater or simply looking for a fun way to kick off Christmas week, Deck the Miles is for you.

⏰ RACE DAY SCHEDULE
6:00 AM — Parking lot opens
6:00 AM — Race Day Check-In & Bib Pick-Up
7:00 AM — 5K & 10K Start
9:30 AM — Course Closes

Please arrive early enough to park, walk to the Start/Finish, pick up your bib and get ready to run.

🚗 PARKING
We recommend using the South City Parking Lot / Venice Blvd Lot:

📍 2100 Ocean Front Walk, Venice, CA 90291

The lot is located beside the Venice Beach recreation area and famous Muscle Beach and is just a short walk from our Start/Finish area. The public lot opens at 6:00 AM.

Parking is paid, and Venice Beach can get busy, so arrive early and give yourself plenty of time.

☕ RUN EARLY. BRUNCH AFTER.
One of the best parts of our early start?

We'll have you across that finish line just as Venice is waking up.

Finish your 5K or 10K, collect your medal, take some holiday photos, and then head out with your running crew as the neighborhood's restaurants, coffee shops and businesses begin opening for the day.

Race first. Breakfast after. 🥞☕🎄

🎄 CHRISTMAS + VENICE BEACH = A VERY CALIFORNIA HOLIDAY
Palm trees instead of pine trees.

Running shoes instead of snow boots.

Ocean views instead of snowdrifts.

And hundreds of jingling runners taking over Venice Beach on a December morning.

Come Deck the Miles with CaliFlow Runs! 🔔🏃‍♀️🎅🌴

5K • 10K • December 19 • Venice Beach
Big race energy. Holiday edition.

name: Define Your Glow - New Year Reset 5K, 10K, Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
✨ Define Your Glow 5K, 10K & Half Marathon

Date: Saturday, January 16, 2027

📍 LongBeach – 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA
⏰ Race Start:

7:00 AM Half Marathon & 8:00 AM- 5K. 10K 
🏃‍♀️ Run • Walk • Stroller Friendly • Dog Friendly • Virtual Option Available

Some races are about finish times.
This one is about showing up — for yourself and for someone else.

Join us for the Define Your Glow Run + Healing Expo, a powerful morning on the Long Beach waterfront celebrating movement, resilience, and community.

Whether you run, jog, walk, or participate virtually from anywhere in the world, this event is about the simple truth that movement helps us heal, reset, and reconnect with our strength.

The course is a flat, scenic out-and-back along the beach path — perfect for beginners, walkers, experienced runners, families, and dogs.

Come for the miles.
Leave feeling stronger than when you arrived.

 
🌊 Why We Run

This event supports Define Your Glow, helping restore the home of founder Shannel, a certified run coach, 4 time IRONMAN finishers,  and wellness coach whose home suffered severe damage after 27,000 gallons of water flooded the property.

Shanell has spent years helping others rebuild their strength — physically and emotionally — through movement and personal growth.

Now our community is coming together to help rebuild her space so that healing work can continue.

Your registration, donation, or virtual miles help make that possible.

 
✨ Healing Expo After the Race

Stay after the run for the Healing Expo, featuring wellness vendors, recovery tools, and resources focused on physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being.

Because the finish line is just the beginning.

 
🔥 What You Get

✔️ Professional chip timing
✔️ Free race day photos
✔️ Finisher medals
✔️ Overall & age group awards
✔️ Beachfront race vibes
✔️ Access to the Healing Expo
✔️ The chance to run for something bigger than yourself

 
💛 Run anywhere. Run together.

Can’t make it to Long Beach?
Register as a virtual runner and complete your miles from anywhere in the world.

Every step counts.

 
✨ Come move.
Come connect.
Come define your glow.

🔗 Register at CaliFlowRuns.com

name: Día De Los Muertos 5k Race
description:
Come celebrate Día De Los Muertos (Day Of The Dead) and run a 5k race. 

5k run/walk starts 9am on Saturday October 31st, 2026. All levels are welcome, it is a fully paved path, strollers are welcome.

Packet Pick up is Friday October 30th at Sacramento Running Company 5-8pm and Saturday October 31st 7am-8:30am at North Natomas Regional Park (Same location as the race).

All participants will receive a t-shirt, medal, and sticker with registration, top 3 in each age group and top 3 over all in male and female categories will receive ribbons.

The race will be held at North Natomas Regional Park, it is a flat course held on the sidewalk which is a loop around the entire park. All ages and running/walking abilities are welcome to participate. Participants are welcome to wear costumes.

Only dogs allowed are service dogs, this is a USATF rule because this is a sanctioned race by USA Track and field.

https://www.usatf.org/home/top-utility-nav-content/event-insurance-sanctions/sanctions-faqs#Can%20dogs%20or%20other%20animals%20participate%20in%20sanctioned%20events?

 

This is a fundraiser for the Azteca FC Cross Country and Track and Field program. Every season members from Azteca FC work hard to qualify for the National Championships. This 5k is a fundraiser to assist the athletes who qualify to attend and compete in National Championships. Azteca FC is a registered 501C3 with a core mission of providing athletic opportunities in the sports of: Soccer, Track and Field, Cross Country, Trail Running, and Futsal. 

We appreciate the support of all our sponsors in the Día De Los Muertos 5k race. The generous support of the districts and community helped us send three Azteca FC athletes to national competitions this year. 

In February 2026, Gamaliel Gomez and Osiel Soto competed at the USATF Master's Indoor Track and Field National Championship and placed 3rd and 4th in the 800M and 1500M. In July 2026, Jaciel Reveles competed in the 800M and 1500M at the USATF Junior Olympics National Championship. In July 2026 Gamaliel Gomez competed at the USATF Master's Track and Field National Championship and placed 5th in the 800M and 4th in the 1500M.

In July 2025, Jackson Sevilla and Ethan Tang, represented Azteca FC at the Junior Olympics In Savannah, Georgia. Your generous support helps athletes compete at the highest level and gain national recognition to help them earn opportunities to compete at the college level.

www.Aztecafc.com

Sponsors of this race include Lisa Kaplan, District 1 City of Sacramento Councilmember, Vice Mayor Karina Talamantes District 3 City of Sacramento, and Sacramento Running Company.

name: Diabetes Awareness 5K (Stockton)
description:
Run for Hope. Walk for Awareness. Change Lives.

This event will be automatically chip-timed and the first 100 registered participants to cross the finish line will receive a custom medal!  Runners and walkers of all levels are welcome.  Raffle prizes (provided by Alpha Ro Timing) at the conclusion of the race...your bib is your raffle ticket.  Must be present to win.

Welcome!

Every step we take has the power to save a life.  Today, we invite our community to unite for a cause that affects millions of families every day—diabetes awareness, prevention, and education.  The Diabetes Awareness 5K Walk & Run, hosted by the Stockton Healthy Leo-Lions Club, is more than a race. It is a movement dedicated to bringing hope, promoting healthy lifestyles, and supporting those living with diabetes.

Why Diabetes Awareness Matters: 

Diabetes is one of the fastest-growing health challenges in our communities.  Many people are unaware of the serious complications that diabetes can cause, including:  Vision loss and blindness, Kidney disease, Nerve damage, Heart disease and stroke, Foot ulcers leading to amputations, and Premature death.  These outcomes can often be delayed or prevented through education, healthy habits, early detection, and community support.  Awareness saves lives.

Our Mission:

The Stockton Healthy Leo-Lions Club is committed to creating a healthier community by:
1) Educating families about diabetes prevention and management.  2) Encouraging physical activity through walking and running.  3) Promoting healthy lifestyles for all ages.  4) Supporting mental health by bringing people together through community events.  5) Inspiring hope for individuals and families affected by diabetes.  Together, we can make a lasting difference.

Why the Lions Serve:

The Lions Clubs International is the world's largest service organization.  Its global causes include eight areas of service, one of which is Diabetes.  Lions around the world are committed to reducing the impact of diabetes through education, screening, prevention, and community outreach.  The Stockton Healthy Leo-Lions Club proudly supports this mission by organizing events that inspire healthier communities.

Why Participate?

Whether you walk, run, volunteer, sponsor, or donate... You become part of the solution, your participation helps increase diabetes awareness, it encourages healthier lifestyles, it inspires families to become more active, and it strengthen community connections, and your involvement support future diabetes education initiatives.  Every registration... Every donation...Every mile... Makes a difference.  Become a Sponsor!  Businesses and community partners can help create a healthier future.  Sponsors receive community recognition while demonstrating their commitment to:  Health, Wellness, Community Engagement, Youth Development, and Corporate Social Responsibility.  Together, we can reach more families and save more lives.  Join the movement.  Walk for someone you love.  Run for someone fighting diabetes.  Honor someone we've lost.  Celebrate someone living with diabetes.  Together, we can turn awareness into action and action into hope.  Register or donate today.  Every step counts.  Every dollar helps.  Every participant makes a difference.  Run for hope. Walk for awareness. Change lives.

Welcome!

Every step we take has the power to save a life.  Today, we invite our community to unite for a cause that affects millions of families every day—diabetes awareness, prevention, and education.  The Diabetes Awareness 5K Walk & Run, hosted by the Stockton Healthy Leo-Lions Club, is more than a race. It is a movement dedicated to bringing hope, promoting healthy lifestyles, and supporting those living with diabetes.

Why Diabetes Awareness Matters: 

Diabetes is one of the fastest-growing health challenges in our communities.  Many people are unaware of the serious complications that diabetes can cause, including:  Vision loss and blindness, Kidney disease, Nerve damage, Heart disease and stroke, Foot ulcers leading to amputations, and Premature death.  These outcomes can often be delayed or prevented through education, healthy habits, early detection, and community support.  Awareness saves lives.

Our Mission:

The Stockton Healthy Leo-Lions Club is committed to creating a healthier community by:
1) Educating families about diabetes prevention and management.  2) Encouraging physical activity through walking and running.  3) Promoting healthy lifestyles for all ages.  4) Supporting mental health by bringing people together through community events.  5) Inspiring hope for individuals and families affected by diabetes.  Together, we can make a lasting difference.

Why the Lions Serve:

The Lions Clubs International is the world's largest service organization.  Its global causes include eight areas of service, one of which is Diabetes.  Lions around the world are committed to reducing the impact of diabetes through education, screening, prevention, and community outreach.  The Stockton Healthy Leo-Lions Club proudly supports this mission by organizing events that inspire healthier communities.

name: DINO DASH
description:
It's an Orange County tradition!

The Dinosaur Dash is a community run, walk, and bike event benefiting the Tustin Public Schools Foundation. There's something for everyone--a 2k fun run, chip-timed 5k and 10k runs, and Bike Tours for all riding levels (15k and a family-friendly 5k).

The finisher medal for the 10k, 5k, and Bike Tour features our unique, student-designed logo.

The 5k and 10k top finishers in each racing age division will receive the official Dino Dash trophy--hand-made by Tustin Unified students. Second- and third-place finishers will receive a medal. The 2k Fun Run and the Bike Tour are not timed and do not have age division awards.

The 15k bike tour passes through Tustin and Irvine before returning to The Market Place in Tustin.  This tour is recommended for riders age 13 and up since it is on open roads.  We also offer a family-friendly 5K tour on closed roads. The Bike Tours are not timed.

A free family Expo will offer activities, school fundraising booths, and exhibitors.

The Tustin Public Schools Foundation is a charitable organization that supports the students and teachers of Tustin Unified schools by funding grants, scholarships, and enrichment programs such as after-school sports, robotics, college readiness, Tustin Summer Academy, and more. 

PLEASE NOTE: Race day registrations (Sunday, November 1st) do not include a shirt.

SCHEDULE

*** Schedule subject to change ***

5:30 AM - Race-Day Registration Opens (near El Camino and West St.)

6:30 AM - Bike Valet Opens

6:30 AM - Bike Tour - 15k begins on open roads

6:45 AM - Bike Tour - 5k begins on closed roads

7:00 AM - Dino Dash Expo Opens

7:00 AM - 10K Chip-timed Run Begins

8:00 AM - Food Court Opens

8:00 AM - 5K Chip-timed Run Begins

8:20 AM - TUSD Middle School Cross Country 5k Begins

8:45 AM - 2K Fun Run Begins (non-timed)

10:30 AM - Event Ends

name: DIRTY 30 XL - GRAVEL vs MTB
description:
DIRTY 30 XL – GRAVEL vs MTB


Which bike is faster? Gravel or MTB? Take on the Dirty 30XL at Orfila Winery on either a drop-bar gravel bike or mountain bike and we will find out! This one-lap challenge delivers scenic singletrack, rugged fire roads, and relentless climbs—all wrapped into an unforgettable course through the beautiful San Pasqual area.

All the fun starts and finishes at Orfila Winery in Escondido, making the Dirty 30XL more than just a race—it’s an experience. Riders and their families can enjoy Orfila’s beautiful vineyard setting, incredible views, great food and wine, and a welcoming atmosphere before and after the ride. It’s the perfect place to celebrate your accomplishment, hang out with friends, and connect with the local cycling community.

With easy access to the trailhead, a great start/finish venue, and plenty of space to relax and enjoy the day, Orfila Winery sets the stage for an awesome Dirty 30XL experience.

Along the course, riders will find fully stocked aid stations featuring Hammer Nutrition and other great event partners to keep you fueled and moving toward the finish.

**Grit. Glory. Great riding. And a finish at Orfila. Welcome to the Dirty 30XL! **

WHEN:

  • December 5, 2026


WHERE:

  • Orfila Vineyards & Winery GOOGLE MAPS LOCATION

REGISTRATION:

  • Online Registration will be available up to the start of the race.
  • Registration price will increase by $10.00 the day before the race.

SCHEDULE:

  • Registration/Check-In: 7:30am
  • Course Open for Pre-Riding: 7:30am
  • Race Start: 9:00am

COURSE: RIDE WITH GPS COURSE LINK

  • Diverse trail types: Expect a seamless mix of hard-packed gravel, smooth and rolling fire roads, punchy climbs, and technical singletrack — all hugging the scenic from the San Pasqual Valley.
  • Flow and challenge: The route weaves through connecting areas like Raptor Ridge and Mule Trail, offering both flowy descents and test-your-mettle climbs. Lake view trails may also be incorporated for extra elevation and epic views.
  • Distance: 37 miles
  • Elevation gain: Approx. 1,709 Elevation gain
  • Route style: One Big Lap

CATEGORIES: 

Gravel and MTB will be combined in the categories racing against each other. Who will be faster?

  • 14-15
  • 16-17
  • 18-19
  • 20-29
  • 30-39
  • 40-49
  • 50-59
  • 60+
  • Single Speed 16+
  • Big Boned (200+) 16+

ALL REGISTRATIONS ARE FINAL - NO REFUNDS

name: Disco Miles: Beachfront Boogie 5K, 10K, Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🪩 Disco Miles: Beachfront Boogie
Saturday, March 6, 2027 | Long Beach, CA
5K • 10K • Half Marathon

📍 Location: 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

 

⏰ Race Day Schedule
🎽 Bib Pick-Up/Same Day Registration: 6:00AM – 8:00AM @ Race Ready Athletics Tent
🏁 Half Marathon Start: 7:00AM
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 8:00AM

🏅 Overall Finisher Awards | Costume Contest: 8:45AM, 9:00AM (Half Marathon Awards)
 
🚗 Parking Info
Street parking is available (please check posted signs for street sweeping).
Paid beach lot parking is available for $2.00 per hour via the Passport app or payment machine at the lot entrance. Arrive early for the best spots near the start line.


 
🏅 Awards & Medals:
All finishers receive a Disco Miles: Beachfront Boogie medal 🪩🌊
🏆 Age Group Awards available at Results Tent, just ask one of our staff members to verify for you.
🕺 Disco Costume Contest Awards for those who bring the sparkle, bell bottoms, and groove!
 

Get ready to lace up, turn up the groove, and run straight into a Sunday Funday celebration by the sea at Disco Miles: Beachfront Boogie 🕺🌊

This isn’t your average race — it’s a high-energy coastal run with disco flair, beach views, feel-good miles, and a finish line that feels like a party. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running with friends, or just here to boogie your way down the course, Disco Miles is all about movement, music, and fun — CaliFlow style.

Come run. Come dance. Come boogie on the beach.

 
🪩 Race Highlights
✨ Professionally chip-timed for accurate results
📸 FREE race-day photos & downloadable finish-line pics
🎖️ Finisher medals for all participants
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
🕺 Disco-themed costume contest — solo, duo, and group prizes!
🌊 Flat, fast, and scenic beachfront course
🥤 Water stations & restrooms along the course
🎶 Finish-line music, snacks, and epic photo ops

 
🌺 Why CaliFlow Runs?
At CaliFlow Runs, we believe running should be inclusive, affordable, and fun. With 60+ events each year, we create professionally produced race experiences that welcome every pace, every body, and every reason for showing up.

From the start line to the finish-line festival, our events are built around community, good vibes, and memorable moments — without the high price tag. Whether you’re running hard or just grooving through the miles, you belong here.

 
👟 Who Can Participate?
Everyone! Runners, walkers, strollers — all paces and abilities are welcome. Come as you are and leave with tired legs, a shiny medal, and a smile on your face 🪩

 


💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs 🌊
We are not affiliated with any other events in the area.

If you’re looking for a race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow energy, always be sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.

If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an average race. 🪩✨

name: Do It For Her 5K
description:
Run through Temecula’s Wine Country and enjoy the tranquil beauty of rolling vineyards and sun-drenched hills. As you run along the winding paths, the early morning light casts a golden hue over the landscape, highlighting the neat rows of grapevines and the rustic charm of the wineries scattered throughout the valley. Finish with a Vitagliano sangria made from some of the finest Super Tuscan-style wines produced in California.  Shop our local vendors carrying locally grown produce and handcrafted items, all under a beautiful covered patio.  Food Available for purchase.


All proceeds benefit the Heather Janikowski Foundation and the Make A Wish Foundation

Race day Information:

Please follow Parking signs/volunteer directions

7:00am Race Day Registration/Check In (also available Friday and Saturday - See below for times)

7:40am Warm Up 

8:00am Race begins

10:00am Awards

10:30am Raffle Drawing

7:00am-11:00am Enjoy, Coffee, Wine, Food, and our Vendor Market

*For the safety of our runners, please arrive no later than 7:40am

name: Dolphin Dash – 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
We're celebrating the amazing creatures that leap through the waters of Santa Monica Bay! 🐬🌎 Join us for the Dolphin Dash this Earth Day weekend as we celebrate our beautiful planet, the ocean we love, and the joy of moving along the coast. Come make a splash with us in Santa Monica!

Details

Start Location: Tongva Park, Santa Monica
Parking: There is limited street parking on Ocean Ave. There are several public lots in short walking distance, the closest is the Civic Center Parking Lot. The E Line has a station nearby as well.

Event Schedule

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at Tongva Park
6:55am – Cross street to the starting arch at Palisades Park
7:00am – Half Marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Out and Back Course
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps)
Half: This 4.37-mile route is run 3 times

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, San Diego, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

description:

Whether you’re running for a personal best, walking with friends, or just coming for the donuts and good vibes, this event is for everyone.

Participants will enjoy music, medals, giveaways, sweet treats, and an exciting race atmosphere while supporting a great cause. Proceeds from this event help provide back-to-school supplies, resources, and opportunities for local students through MEMC 1440 (Make Every Minute Count).

Walk. Run. Have Fun. Make Every Minute Count.

name: DOUBLE ! Billiards Tournament
description:
Join Our Billiards Tournaments

We are excited to invite you to participate in two upcoming billiards tournaments! Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, these events offer a fantastic opportunity to compete, meet fellow enthusiasts, and enjoy great competition.

Tournament Details

  • Tournament 1: held at NAB Liberty NOV 16
  • Tournament 2: held at NASNI Liberty NOV 28

Both tournaments feature competitive brackets, prizes, and a welcoming atmosphere for players of all skill levels. 

What to Expect

  • 10 Ball/ APA Rules; single elimination, best 2 out of 3 games
  • Professional-grade tables and equipment
  • Fair and impartial officiating
  • Networking opportunities with other billiards enthusiasts
  • Exciting matches and friendly competition
  • 1st, 2nd, and third place prizes

Register today to secure your spot in one or both tournaments. We look forward to seeing you there!

name: Double Dipsea
description:
Stinson Beach to Mill Valley and back to Stinson again, entirely on the world-famous Dipsea Trail both ways!


The Double Dipsea has been run 56 times since 1970 and 2027 will be #57.


This is a handicapped race, so everyone (except the male under 40 division) gets a head start.  In 2026 our winner was 66 (female) and our top 10 finishers included 3 females and 7 males with ages ranging from 15 to 67.  Waves are adjusted each year, so you never know who might cross the line first.

But it isn't really about the time, it's about the epic journey.  Young and old, fast and slow, all are welcome to start and as long as you can make the generous race cutoffs, you can get it done!

name: Downtown Visalia Kiwanis 0.5K Donut Run/Walk and Shoe Fling at Mooney Grove Park
description:
https://www.facebook.com/reel/948814714213813/?mibextid=9drbnH

No matter how you measure a 0.5K (no typo here), it tallies up to one lap plus 180 feet on a standard running track, 5 1/2 football fields, half a kilometer, 546.8 yards, 1,640 feet, or 19,685 inches.

Because a marathon, a 10K or even a 5K may be too great a distance for some, members of the Downtown Visalia Kiwanis will offer a "Point 5K - The Race for The Rest of Us."

The race will begin at 10am on March 20, 2027, Saturday, at Mooney Grove Park (next to Tulare County Museum) in Visalia. Registration will begin at 9am.

An aid station (sponsored by Denny's restaurant) at the halfway mark is there to fill needs for a donut hole break, coffee, or juice.

When you make it to the finish line, you will get a donut and a 1st place medal. That's right, everyone gets a 1st place medal!

While the event is tongue in cheek, the Kiwanians' aim is sincere. Proceeds from the race will benefit Kiwanis projects that serve the children of our community.

Kids (10 years old and younger) can participate for FREE (No T-Shirt).  If you want a T-Shirt, sign up for Youth.  Strollers are welcome.

 

Come as a Donut!  

We will award a small trophy to the Best Dressed Donut costume.

 

Are you a Shoe-Kicking Master?  Prove it at our Brown's Shoe Fit Shoe Fling Competition right after the Donut Run/Walk.  Swing and kick your shoe as far as you can!  The competition will be divided into Adults (18 and over), Youth (Under 18), and Kids (10 and under).  Fly, shoe, fly!

 

We also have a special treat this year.  The 198 Express Barbershop Quartet will sing for us during registration (9am - 10am).

name: Drumstick Dash
description:
Drumstick Dash LA is BACK and bigger than ever! Join us at LA County's LARGEST Thanksgiving day event.

Whether you’re chasing a PR or strolling with the whole family in costume, this is the ultimate way to kick off your holiday.

Expect high energy, epic vibes, tons of freebies, a costume contest that brings the heat, awards, and the unbeatable feeling of running for a powerful cause. Every runner scores a race T-shirt and the BIGGEST… boldest… most brag-worthy finisher medal yet!

Our course takes runners, joggers, and walkers straight through the vibrant NoHo Arts District, where cheering crowds line the streets and DJs keep the beats pumping from start to finish.

And the best part? Every step supports Hope the Mission in providing more than 2 MILLION hot meals to homeless men, women, and children.

Run. Celebrate. Give back. 🦃🔥

name: E-DIRTY CROSS - E-MTB RACE
description:
E-MTB racing is back at Quick n’ Dirty for the 5th year and will be held at a new location! Join us and the Dirty 30 XL at Orfila Vineyards & Winery. So, get your E-bike all charged up and show up for some good ol’ fashioned fun at the races! E-Dirty Cross will take place during the the Dirty 30XL

WHEN: 

  • December 5, 2026

WHERE: 

  • Orfila Vineyards & Winery GOOGLE MAPS LOCATION

REGISTRATION: 

  • Online Registration will be available up to the start of the race.
  • Registration price will increase by $5.00 the day before the race.

SCHEDULE: 

  • Check-In: 7:30am
  • Course Open for Pre-Riding: 7:30am
  • Race Start: 9:20am
  • Awards will be held as soon as the race concludes

COURSE: Course Link Coming Soon

E-MTB CATEGORIES: 

  • E-Bike Class 1 Men Open
  • E-Bike Class 1 Women Open
  • E-Bike Class 3 Men Open
  • E-Bike Class 3 Women Open

***E-BIKE RULES***

The E-MTB race is limited to Class 1 and Class 3 E-Bikes. A Class-1 and Class 3 E-Bike is a pedal-assist electric bike. The motor requires pedaling to power the bike and will cease to provide assistance when the top speed is reached. The top five bikes may be tested with GPS on a 1/16 mile stretch of flat ground.

E-Bike with Class 1 label

  1. The bike must have a factory-installed motor.
  2. The motor can only pedal assist up to 20 mph.
  3. No throttles allowed.
     

E-Bike with Class 3 label

  1. The bike must have a factory-installed motor.
  2. The motor can only pedal assist up to 28 mph.
  3. No throttles allowed.

Cheating will not be tolerated!

 
Race staff will complete equipment inspection post-race for the top three racers and random pre-race equipment inspection for all race categories

name: East Bay Front Runners Pride Run and Walk
description:
Hosted by East Bay Front Runners and Walkers 

Come join us at the East Bay's premier LGBTQ+ Pride Race, EBFRW's 22nd Annual Pride Run and Walk! We are offering both in-person and virtual options. NEW THIS YEAR: For simplicity, the 5K run and 5K walk have been combined into a single event. Participants may choose to run, walk, or a combination.

IN-PERSON PRIDE RUN AND WALK – At beautiful Lake Merritt in downtown Oakland

This year, the race starts and finishes at the grassy picnic area across the street from the Junior Center Of Art & Science in Lakeside Park (on mapping apps: 558 Bellevue Ave., Oakland, CA) on Saturday, October 10, 2026 at 9am. Events include both 5K and 10K distances. Registration for each event is $43.75 (including $3.75 in fees). No refunds or exchanges. Proceeds benefit Running for a Better Oakland, Fishnets and Film, the Pacific Center for Human Growth, and East Bay Front Runners & Walkers. All participants receive discounted shopping at Sports Basement and Road ID, finisher ribbon, and a pair of famed rainbow-tipped Pride socks. Top finishers receive medals. Finisher times will be available on our website and social media. The race celebrates National Coming Out Day.

VIRTUAL PRIDE RUN OR WALK

You have from Saturday, October 10, 2026 through Sunday, October 18, 2026 to complete your distance. Events include both 5K and 10K distances. You can complete your race anywhere you like. Please do so safely. Registration fee is $38.75 (including $3.75 in fees). No refunds or exchanges. Please send us your result no later than Wednesday, October 21, 2026. Proceeds benefit Running for a Better Oakland, Fishnets and Film, the Pacific Center for Human Growth, and East Bay Front Runners & Walkers. All participants receive a PDF bib, discounted shopping at Sports Basement and Road ID, finisher certificate, and finisher ribbon. Print out your PDF bib and send us a photo of yourself wearing it. Finisher times will be available on our website and social media. The race celebrates National Coming Out Day.

name: Eden Rift Haunted Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, October 24, 2026 for an exciting event that features The Eden Rift Vineyards. Due to the popularity of this event, we are offering two start times at 9am and 11am. 

Located just 20 miles from the Monterey Bay, Eden Rift is the oldest continually producing vineyard in California. The Eden Rift Estate is one of those places that needs to been seen to be believed. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wonderful wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience!  This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt or Upgrade to a hoodie for only $10
  • Wine Glass: Plastic Wine Glass!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

Be sure to stick around after the event and enjoy the winery!   Race participants receive discounted wine glass specials ($12 for White Wines, and $15 for Red Wines) on race day!

name: Elevate 5k & 12 Hour Race at First Baptist Church
description:
Please visit www.ElevateRace.com for the most up to date and detailed information.
Thank you for your interest in participating in our 10th annual Elevate race!

  • What: 5k & 12 hour race
  • Purpose: To support our Elevate missions project
  • When: 5k starts Sat, Feb 13, 2027 @ 9:30am / 12 hour race starts Fri, Feb 12, 2027 @ 8:45pm
  • Where: First Baptist Church campus in Santa Maria, CA
  • Cost:
    • 5k = $22
    • 12 Hour = $45

All the proceeds from this event will go to support the Elevate missions project. Your participation as either a runner or volunteer will help make it possible!

5k: For only $22 you can challenge yourself to complete the 5k (3.1 miles) race. Awards will be given to the winners in both distances for the different age groups at the 10:30am awards ceremony. While this is a competition, everyone is invited to participate regardless of age or physical ability. It will be a lively and encouraging environment which will be fun for both first timers and experienced runners. Runners must arrive by 8:45 on race morning to receive their race bib and all final instructions before the race begins at 9:30am.  The 5k awards ceremony will take place at 10:30am.

12 Hour race: I know we have some adventurous people out there! How far do you think you could run and walk in 12 hours? The race runs from Friday night at 8:45pm until Saturday morning at 8:45am. It will finish 45 minutes before the start of the 5k. This is a great time to test yourself physically and mentally. Would you like to complete your first marathon? In 12 hours you could even walk a marathon if you could finish each mile in just under 28 minutes.

Here's some good news. We'll have some food and drinks to fuel you through the night, and you can take breaks as often as you'd like. Each lap is 1 mile, and near the start/finish line we'll have an area set up specifically for the 12 hour participants. You're encouraged to bring a comfortable chair, footrest, change of clothes, blankets and anything else that can help make your experience more comfortable. Napping is permitted but not encouraged. Friends and family members are invited to spend the evening there with us supporting and encouraging the participants. There is no minimum number of miles you have to complete. Yes, the person that completes the most loops is the winner, but runners and walkers of all levels are encouraged to set an individual goal and see what they're capable of doing. Races like this are typically very relaxed. Very few people would run the entire time in a race of this distance. Going through the night also provides a unique experience. There will be a variety of awards for the 12 hour race & the 12 hour race awards ceremony will take place at 8:45am right when the race finishes.

As a bonus (or maybe more like a penalty), all 12 Hour participants can also participate in the 5k for free if desired! 12 Hour runners must arrive by 8:00pm Friday evening to receive their race bib and all final instructions before the race begins at 8:45pm.

Course info: Each loop is 1.036 miles for the 5k. The 5k is three loops. For the 12 Hour race there is a minor adjustment to make each loop 1 mile. The loop is entirely on the First Baptist / VCA campus, and during the 5k there will be volunteers throughout the course in order to provide a safe environment for young runners. 12 Hour runners will need to have either a headlamp or flashlight to use on the back portion of the loop where there are no lights.

For the 5k we will have water, Gatorade and bananas during the race and celebratory ice cream sandwiches at the end for all finishers. The 12 Hour participants will have a variety of hot and cold drinks and solid foods to choose from. We hope you have a great time training for and participating in this race!

Please visit www.ElevateRace.com for the most up to date and detailed information.

name: Elevate 5k & 12 Hour Race at First Baptist Church
description:
Please visit www.ElevateRace.com for the most up to date and detailed information.
Thank you for your interest in participating in our 10th annual Elevate race!

  • What: 5k & 12 hour race
  • Purpose: To support our Elevate missions project
  • When: 5k starts Sat, Feb 13, 2027 @ 9:30am / 12 hour race starts Fri, Feb 12, 2027 @ 8:45pm
  • Where: First Baptist Church campus in Santa Maria, CA
  • Cost:
    • 5k = $22
    • 12 Hour = $45

All the proceeds from this event will go to support the Elevate missions project. Your participation as either a runner or volunteer will help make it possible!

5k: For only $22 you can challenge yourself to complete the 5k (3.1 miles) race. Awards will be given to the winners in both distances for the different age groups at the 10:30am awards ceremony. While this is a competition, everyone is invited to participate regardless of age or physical ability. It will be a lively and encouraging environment which will be fun for both first timers and experienced runners. Runners must arrive by 8:45 on race morning to receive their race bib and all final instructions before the race begins at 9:30am.  The 5k awards ceremony will take place at 10:30am.

12 Hour race: I know we have some adventurous people out there! How far do you think you could run and walk in 12 hours? The race runs from Friday night at 8:45pm until Saturday morning at 8:45am. It will finish 45 minutes before the start of the 5k. This is a great time to test yourself physically and mentally. Would you like to complete your first marathon? In 12 hours you could even walk a marathon if you could finish each mile in just under 28 minutes.

Here's some good news. We'll have some food and drinks to fuel you through the night, and you can take breaks as often as you'd like. Each lap is 1 mile, and near the start/finish line we'll have an area set up specifically for the 12 hour participants. You're encouraged to bring a comfortable chair, footrest, change of clothes, blankets and anything else that can help make your experience more comfortable. Napping is permitted but not encouraged. Friends and family members are invited to spend the evening there with us supporting and encouraging the participants. There is no minimum number of miles you have to complete. Yes, the person that completes the most loops is the winner, but runners and walkers of all levels are encouraged to set an individual goal and see what they're capable of doing. Races like this are typically very relaxed. Very few people would run the entire time in a race of this distance. Going through the night also provides a unique experience. There will be a variety of awards for the 12 hour race & the 12 hour race awards ceremony will take place at 8:45am right when the race finishes.

As a bonus (or maybe more like a penalty), all 12 Hour participants can also participate in the 5k for free if desired! 12 Hour runners must arrive by 8:00pm Friday evening to receive their race bib and all final instructions before the race begins at 8:45pm.

Course info: Each loop is 1.036 miles for the 5k. The 5k is three loops. For the 12 Hour race there is a minor adjustment to make each loop 1 mile. The loop is entirely on the First Baptist / VCA campus, and during the 5k there will be volunteers throughout the course in order to provide a safe environment for young runners. 12 Hour runners will need to have either a headlamp or flashlight to use on the back portion of the loop where there are no lights.

For the 5k we will have water, Gatorade and bananas during the race and celebratory ice cream sandwiches at the end for all finishers. The 12 Hour participants will have a variety of hot and cold drinks and solid foods to choose from. We hope you have a great time training for and participating in this race!

Please visit www.ElevateRace.com for the most up to date and detailed information.

name: EPE Run/Walk
description:
Get moving. Get connected. Make an impact.

Join the EPE 5K Run/Walk, Saturday, November 28, 2026, a nationwide movement bringing together health, fellowship, and support for EPE Empowerment foundation. An organization committed to scholarship, music, and community.

You don't have to be a runner and you don't have to be in the same city! Walk, jog, or run wherever you are. Invite your family, friends, church family, or team to join you, or complete it on your own. Participants are encouraged to share photos and videos along the way as we move together from across the country.

This is about more than crossing a finish line. It's an opportunity to make your health a priority while helping support the mission and ministry of EPE.

Registration is free, and participants are encouraged to create a personal fundraising page and invite family and friends to support their  journey. Every step, and every gift, helps us move closer to our goal.

Walk it. Jog it. Run it. Just move.

Move With Purpose. Give With Purpose.

name: Falcon 5K
description:
Hey Falcon 5k supporters - we’d love to see you in August!

Join us on Saturday, August 14th for the Third Annual Falcon 5k, a community event supporting the College Park High School Cross Country Team! This race is a great way to celebrate the start of the season, build our community, connect with local runners, and show your support for our student-athletes.

Whether you're a seasoned runner, a proud alumni, or a supportive community member, this event is open to all and promises a fun, energetic atmosphere. Proceeds will go directly to the CPHS cross country program to help with travel, gear, and meet expenses.

The race will start at 8AM at the College Park Track, be sure to register by July 26th to guarantee your t-shirt size!

Come run, cheer, and be part of the College Park spirit!


We’re looking for Sponsors, if you or a business you know would be interested, details are HERE!  Thank you!

5K Start: 8:00 AM

Bib Pick up: Road Runner Sports (Concord location) TBD

Race Goodies: All 5K participants will receive an awesome race shirt (Register by deadline to guarantee), post race snacks, and FREE race photos.

On-site Registration & Bib Pick Up: Available starting at 7am morning of the event on the College Park Track (Infield)

name: Fall- Kustoms and Klassics  - Discovery Bay Car Show
description:
Join the Discovery Bay Community Foundations

                          Fall- Kustoms and Klassics Car Show will be Sunday, October 25th.   

                                        This car show will take place of the Oct, Cars and Coffee.

                                        Proceeds will go to a number of local charities.

  Car show will be held at Campos Vinyards, 3501 Byer Rd. Byron, Ca.

Sign up before Oct 10th and save some $$$$$.
On line registration will close on Oct. 24th at noon.

Show from 10:00 AM-2:30 PM

This event is presented by

Discovery Bay Community Foundation and Celebrity Kustoms.

This fun event is an opportunity for all car enthusiasts to share their cherished rides and every type of car, motorcycle or other motorized vehicle is welcome. Remember, if you think your car is something special, chances are many others will too. In the spirit of motoring camaraderie, come join your friends and neighbors for this event. We will have music, food, awards, and much more. 

The “Top 10” STAR Awards will be “BEST of the BEST” and will be split equally between all the classes                                                     KLASSIC / KUSTOM / HOT ROD / STREET ROD / LOW RIDER / EXOTIC / MUSCLE C                                                                                         7 plaques will be for “Outstanding” Award of Excellence which will be spilt between all the categories.

       

Same day will be $40 day of show !!!!

To avoid long lines, check in times will be as follows. If your last name starts with ABCDEFGHI, you will check in between 8:00-8:30. If your last name starts with JKLMNOPQR your check in time will be between 8:30-9:00. If your last name starts with STUVWXYZ, your check in time will be between 9:00-9:30. All same day registrations will be between 9:30-10:00.

name: Father's Day Run
description:
62 Years of Running with Dad


Celebrate Father’s Day the best way we know how. . . moving together, cheering loud, and making memories that stick.

Join us for the 62nd Annual Fresno Father’s Day Run, the longest-running Father’s Day race west of the Rockies! Whether you're racing the 10K or cruising the 2 Mile, this is your moment to show up for Dad and with Dad.

  • Early start at 7:00 AM to beat the heat and keep things fresh.
  • All paces welcome: run, walk, jog, or stroll it out together.
  • Special pricing for kids 9 & under (automatically applied at checkout)

name: Feliz Navidad Run 5K 10K Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🎄✨ Feliz Navidad Run — A Holiday Fiesta on the Coast!
Put on your Santa hat, grab your amigos, and celebrate the season with sunshine, running, and a festive Mexican-inspired holiday celebration in beautiful Long Beach!

🎅🌵 Feliz Navidad Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 (Easy Parking)
📅 Saturday, December 19, 2026
✨ Where Christmas meets fiesta with ocean views, holiday magic, and miles of smiles! (We provide the festive vibes... you bring the running shoes!)

Race Day Registration Available: Opens at 6:00 AM

 
🕕 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
📦 Bib Pick-Up:Starts at 6:00 AM
🏁 Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🏁 Kids Dash: 9:00 AM

⚠️ No late starts — Santa has a busy schedule delivering presents!

 
🎄 About the Event
Celebrate the holidays with a little sunshine and a whole lot of fiesta!

The Feliz Navidad Run combines Christmas traditions with colorful Mexican holiday celebrations for one unforgettable race experience. Run beneath festive decorations, holiday music, vibrant colors, and plenty of Christmas spirit as Long Beach transforms into a holiday fiesta by the sea.

 

 🎁 What You'll Get
🏅 Custom Feliz Navidad Finisher Medal
⏱️ USATF-Certified Course + Professional Chip Timing
🎶 Live DJ at the Finish Line Festival
📸 Colorful Holiday Photo Opportunities
📷 FREE Race Day Photos
🥇 Overall & Age Group Awards
🍪 Finish-Line Snacks & Holiday Treats
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations Every 2 Miles
🎭 Holiday Costume Contest!

 

 🅿️ Parking & Event Info
🚗 Free street parking

💵 Beach parking lot available ($2/hour using Passport App or pay station)

🚻 Restrooms located near the start

👶 Stroller & walker-friendly

🏁 Flat, fast, fully marked course with beautiful ocean views

name: Filthy 50+ - MTB Ride with Benefits
description:
The 12th Annual Filthy 50+ will take you through various areas of San Dieguito River Park and Black Mountain Park. Fast and flowy for all skill levels. The 30 mile riders will head out and turn around at the 15 mile mark and the 50+ mile riders will continue on to the Black Mountain Park area where you will encounter a lollipop and new trails to go with it! The course will be fully marked with Pink Flags and Red Arrows. Fully stocked feed stations will be placed throughout the ride to keep you fueled up.

There will be a kid’s ride supported by Team Quick n’ Dirty at 8:45am. Awards will be given out immediately following the kids ride. Registration for the kid’s ride will be online and onsite. 

When riding the course please be aware that the trails will be open to the public so please pay attention to other riders, hikers, and horseback riders. Please pay special attention when riding the switchbacks portion of the course and use courtesy when passing. Thanks!

WHEN:

  • Saturday, October 31, 2026
    • 8:00am for 50 mile
    • 8:30am for 30 mile
    • 8:45am for Kids Race

WHERE:

  • San Pasqual Staging Area near 18194 Bandy Canyon Rd., Escondido, CA 92025
    • GOOGLE MAPS LOCATION

REGISTRATION:

  • REGISTER EARLY - IT WILL SELL OUT!
    • If registration is full, the waitlists will open.
  • Check-in will be open from 6:00 to 7:45 on day of event

2026 FILTHY 50+ COURSE: https://ridewithgps.com/routes/56883745

FEED STATIONS:

Please stop if you need to refuel. There will be plenty of Hammer Nutrition products available. The mile marker and addresses are below if your support crew want to do hand-ups.

  • #1– 11 Miles & #4– 42 Miles (12653 Sunset Dr Escondido, CA  92025)
  • #2– 21 Miles & #3– 32 Miles (San Dieguito River Park San Diego, CA 92127)

FILTHY 50+ REGISTERED RIDERS WILL RECEIVE:

  • Swag bag provided by Hammer Nutrition
  • Commemorative FILTHY 50+ event item
  • QnD Costume Party sponsor by 805 Beer!
  • Awards for the Top 3 Finishers in each class for the 50+ mile ride
  • Awards for the Top 3 Males and Top 3 Female finisher of the 30 mile ride
  • Electronic Timing and Results.
  • Fully stocked Feed Stations at strategic locations. Feed Stations will include: hydration by Hydro, fruit, food, and Hammer Nutrition Products. The station will also include a self-help mechanic area. (Each Feed Station can be accessed in both directions).

ENTERTAINMENT:

  • Live entertainment at the Filthy 50 Oasis
  • Kids area with a Kids ride!
  • Food will be available at an additional cost
  • Vendor Village
  • Prize raffle with a portion of the proceeds going to SDRP Bike Patrol.

The primary goal of the Filthy 50+ Fun Ride with Benefits is to bring the mountain biking community together and to celebrate what we all love to do, RIDE OUR BIKES! Additionally, we want to bring awareness concerning the trails we ride on, as well as give back to the organizations that keep us riding on those trails. As part of the Filthy 50+ we urge you to help us give back by donating to the SDRP Bike Patrol.

ALL REGISTRATIONS ARE FINAL - NO REFUNDS ALLOWED

name: Finding Kids 5K with LuxFit
description:
Finding Kids and LuxFit are teaming up for a 5K to support a life-changing cause! Finding Kids is an organization dedicated to protecting vulnerable children, locating missing and exploited youth, and ensuring they and their families receive the care and support they need.

When you run, you’re not just racing; you’re giving children a second chance at safety, justice, and hope.

Event Details

  • Date: Sunday, November 15, 2025
  • Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
  • Location: LuxFit
  • Entry Fee: $40 (+ processing fee)

Agenda

  • 9:00 – 9:30 AM: Arrivals & Check-In
  • 9:30 AM: Welcome Remarks from Finding Kids
  • 9:45 AM: 5K Starts
  • 10:30 – 12 PM: Post-race Party, DJ, food, raffle, and closing remarks 

Make Your Miles Matter Even More
Help us raise awareness and vital funds for Finding Kids (www.findingkids.org). When you register, a personal fundraising page will automatically be created for you to share with friends, family, and colleagues. Every dollar raised helps protect children and bring predators to justice.

name: Finish The Ride and Finish The Run Griffith Park
description:
Full event details can be found at www.streetsareforeveryone.org/finish-the-ride-griffith-park

Finish The Run Griffith Park
Saturday, March 20th, 2027 • 6:30 AM - 12:00 PM
The Autry Museum • 4700 Western Heritage Way, Los Angeles, CA 90027

Finish The Ride Griffith Park
Sunday, March 21st, 2027 • 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM
The Autry Museum • 4700 Western Heritage Way, Los Angeles, CA 90027

Join us for a memorable day of running, riding, walking, and rolling—all for a purpose. Finish The Ride & Finish The Run is more than an event; it’s a movement to make roads safer for cyclists, pedestrians, and drivers everywhere.

 
🌄 What to Expect


Multiple Ride Options (Routes are subject to change)

  • 12-Mile Family Fun Ride
  • 20-Mile Nice and Easy Ride
  • 35-Mile Leg Burn Ride
  • Andrew Jelmert Half Century
  • Bahati Foundation Metric Century
  • LA River Ride Century

Run/Walk Options (Routes are subject to change)

  • 5K Run/Walk
  • 10K Run/Walk
  • 15K Run -- This event is a split-time event. You will run the 10K, cross the finish line, and then begin the 5K at its starting time of 9:15 AM.
  • Half Marathon
  • 1K Kids and Puppy Run

 
🕒 Schedule for Finish The Run (Saturday, March 20th, 2027)


Time                                             Event


6:30 AM                                       Check‑in opens
7:30 AM                                       Half Marathon Starts
8:00 AM                                       10K/15K Start
8:45 AM                                       Expo area opens
9:15 AM                                       5K Start
10:15 AM                                     1K Kids & Puppy Runs begin
12:00 PM                                     Expo closes

 

🕒 Schedule for Finish The Ride (Sunday, March 21st, 2027)

Time                                             Event


6:00 AM                                       Check‑in opens
7:00 AM                                       LA River Ride Century & Bahati Foundation Metric Century Start
8:00 AM                                       Andrew Jelmert Half Century & 35 Mile Leg Burn Start
8:30 AM                                       20 Mile Nice and Easy & 12 Mile Fun Ride Start
8:45 AM - 2 PM                           Expo Hours

VIP Tent closes at 5 pm

 

 

 
✔ Important Details


Packet Pickup: Details on packet pickup location, dates, and times will be published as soon as they are finalized. 

 

Support & Aid: Rides are supported by marshals, sag wagons, and free repair/tune‑up stations. If you need assistance, we’re here to help. 


Water & Refreshments: Stations on route for rides & runs; snacks & food trucks at the expo. 


Age & Participation Rules:
• Children under 14 must be accompanied by parent/guardian. 
• Minimum ages vary by event: e.g. 12‑mile ride ≥ 5 yrs, 25‑mile ≥ 8 yrs, 62‑mile ≥ 15 yrs. Runs also have age minimum. 


 
🎯 Why This Matters
Finish The Ride & Finish The Run was founded by Damian Kevitt after a life‑changing hit‑and‑run. What began as one person’s effort to overcome tragedy has grown into a community movement advocating for safer streets in Southern California and beyond. By participating, you are helping raise awareness and support systemic changes—policies, education, infrastructure—that make roads safer for all through Streets Are For Everyone.

 
📍 Logistics & Registration


Location: The Autry Museum, Griffith Park – 4700 Western Heritage Way, Los Angeles

Transportation: You can access the Autry by biking (we’re right by the LA River bike path) or taking transit (the 96 bus line stops next to the Zoo, across from the Autry). If you plan to drive, there is plenty of parking at the Autry and the surrounding lots. 
Fees & Discounts: Registration options vary by event. Special rates may apply for veterans, first responders, groups, etc. Contact us directly at Events@StreetsAreForEveryone.org for more information.
What’s included: Event t‑shirt or athletic sleeves with registration, finishing medals for all events, awards, expo, etc. 
 
Come ride, run, walk, roll—or cheer—on this meaningful day. Let’s finish the ride, finish the run, and finish strong for safer streets for everyone. #NeverGiveUp
