name: Fleet Feet Fall Classic - Trail October 18th, 2026
description:
LOCATION

South Rim Trail Head/ Backside of Bidwell Golf Course
Chico, CA US 95928

 

DISCRIPTION 

Fleet Feet Chico is pleased to offer Three trail races in our beautiful Upper Bidwell Park.  The races will start on the south side of the park down Annies Trail for a fun adventure on the single-track trails. Toss in a creek crossing and a nice finish through Yahi and the golf course, you’re sure to enjoy your run! 

 

The races include a half marathon and a 4-mile an hour backyard endurance challenge, and new this year and one loop 4-mile option!

The Half Marathon will start at 8:10am along the rock wall off Centennial/South Rim trail head. This race will be a challenging climb with 1600 ft of gain in the first half. Enjoy a party at the top of 10-mile house at Aid station #1 and enjoy an all downhill second half of the race!

 

4-mile endurance race will start at 8:00am. Runners will run a 4-mile loop. If you complete the loop in under 60 mins you will go back in the shoot for loop #2. At the top of each hour a new round will start. This will continue for 8 hours! Every other lap we will change the direction of the loop!  If there is more than one person going into the final hour the run will become a foot race to the finish! If you complete all 8 loops, you will have run approximately 32 Miles! Do you have what it takes? Do one loop, 3 loops or all 8! It’s sure to be a good time for the runners and the spectators!

4-mile One Loop Option - This race will start at 8:00am. Runners will run one loop of the endurance challenge. This race will be a gun start with the endurance runners and a chip finish at the end. This event will count as a "5k" for the Fleet Feet Race Series. 

After the race head up to Bidwell Golf Course Bar and grill for some delicious food and drinks! All runners get a breakfast burrito with your race registration at the finish plus and additional 15% off any other food at the pub. 

 

By supporting this race, you are supporting two great causes! 

Chico Velo Trailworks. Launched in 2014, Chico Velo’s Trailworks supports and manages the creation and maintenance of sustainable and enjoyable trails in our region. They have established a strong partnership with the City of Chico to maintain the trails in Upper Bidwell Park. Trailworks have done additional work in the Oroville area and beyond. They are actively seeking new partnerships and opportunities within our community to promote sustainable trail design. Trailworks volunteers put in hundreds of hours every year improving trails for all users to enjoy. To see their latest project check out our Colby Mountain Recreation Project.  A portion of your race entry will go to this great local stewardship as they continue their work to help keep our local trails accessible for us all! If you would like more information on this program or would like to sign up for a park cleanup day, click the link below.

Chico Velo Trailworks - CHICO VELO

 

In addition to supporting Chico Velo Trailworks we are also donating a portion of the race proceeds to local fire academy cadets. Many of the current class are volunteer firefighters who have worked and volunteered in our community and are continuing their education to be able to make a lifelong career the Fire industry. With a fire prone environment that we live in throughout Butte County we rely on our local fire personnel, staff and volunteers to keep our community safe! Cadets will be volunteering on the racecourse to help ensure the safety of all our participants.  Cadets can be seen on our racecourse supporting our race as emergency EMTs and safety aids at the creek crossings. If you are interested in becoming a volunteer firefighter visit the links below for more information.

Become a Volunteer | Butte County, CA

 

RACE START TIMES


4-Mile Endurance Run            8:00am

4-Mile One Loop Run              8:00am 

Half Marathon                         8:10am

 

REGISTRATION

Registration for this race is available online.

  • Online registration closes October 16th at 9:00am.
  • In person registration on October 16th and 17th at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm.
  • Register by Friday September 25th to guarantee yourself race shirt.
  • If you register between September 28th – October 17th your shirt will NOT be guaranteed, they will be first come first serve at packet pickup.
  • All leftover shirts (if any) will be available for pickup or for sale (non-registered runners) AFTER the Half Marathon race on October 18th. The shirts will be available first come first serve starting at 10:00am.  

 

RACE FEE SCHEDULE

  • October 21st – December 31st - (online)        
    • Half Marathon (Chip Timed) _________ $80.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run _______________ $80.00
  • January 1st – May 31st (online)         
    • Half Marathon (Chip Timed) _________ $85.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run________________ $85.00
  • June 1st- September 30th (online)
    • Half Marathon (Chip Timed) _________ $90.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run________________ $90.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run - Single Loop
      • (Chip Timed) ___________________ $40.00 
  • October 1st- October 16th (online, closes at 9:00am on 10.16)
    • Half Marathon (Chip Timed) _________ $95.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run________________ $95.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run - Single Loop
      • (Chip Timed) ___________________$45.00 
  • In person Registration at Packet Pickup (Oct. 16th and 17th) ONLY
    • Half Marathon (Chip Timed) __________$100.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run________________ $100.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run - Single Loop
      • (Chip Timed) ___________________ $50.00

 

 

PRE-RACE SHAKE OUT RUN AND SOCIAL!

Join us on Saturday October 17th at 7:30am at the Horseshoe Lake Parking Lot (Parking Lot E) in Upper Bidwell Park. We will head out on a beautiful 4 mile run before our race on Sunday! Every other lap we will change the direction of the loop!  If there is more than one person going into the final hour the run will become a foot race to the finish! Chico Velo Trailworks. Launched in 2014, Chico Velo’s Trailworks supports and manages the creation and maintenance of sustainable and enjoyable trails in our region. They have established a strong partnership with the City of Chico to maintain the trails in Upper Bidwell Park. Trailworks have done additional work in the Oroville area and beyond. Cadets will be volunteering on the racecourse to help ensure the safety of all our participants.  Cadets can be seen on our racecourse supporting our race as emergency EMTs and safety aids at the creek crossings. After the race head up to Bidwell Golf Course Bar and grill for some delicious food and drinks! All runners get a breakfast burrito with your race registration at the finish plus and additional 15% off any other food at the pub. 

 

By supporting this race, you are supporting two great causes! 

Chico Velo Trailworks. Launched in 2014, Chico Velo’s Trailworks supports and manages the creation and maintenance of sustainable and enjoyable trails in our region. They have established a strong partnership with the City of Chico to maintain the trails in Upper Bidwell Park. Trailworks have done additional work in the Oroville area and beyond. They are actively seeking new partnerships and opportunities within our community to promote sustainable trail design. Trailworks volunteers put in hundreds of hours every year improving trails for all users to enjoy. To see their latest project check out our Colby Mountain Recreation Project.  A portion of your race entry will go to this great local stewardship as they continue their work to help keep our local trails accessible for us all! If you would like more information on this program or would like to sign up for a park cleanup day, click the link below.

Chico Velo Trailworks - CHICO VELO

 

In addition to supporting Chico Velo Trailworks we are also donating a portion of the race proceeds to local fire academy cadets. Many of the current class are volunteer firefighters who have worked and volunteered in our community and are continuing their education to be able to make a lifelong career the Fire industry. With a fire prone environment that we live in throughout Butte County we rely on our local fire personnel, staff and volunteers to keep our community safe! Cadets will be volunteering on the racecourse to help ensure the safety of all our participants.  Cadets can be seen on our racecourse supporting our race as emergency EMTs and safety aids at the creek crossings. If you are interested in becoming a volunteer firefighter visit the links below for more information.

Become a Volunteer | Butte County, CA

RACE RULES:

  • Be courteous when overtaking slower runners or walkers in your elected race location. We want you to race hard and fast, but with the safety of yourself and others in mind.
  • Use best trail educate. Calling out “runner back’ or ‘runner up” when on the trails
  • Follow all trail flagging and marking assigned to the race. Do not go off trails or cut the course. (Pink and Orange Flags)
  • Do NOT remove any course markings!
  • Where your race number on the front of your body so it is visible to the timers!
  • You must cross the timing mat for your chip to be read at the finish of the half marathon. If you are planning to race for top finisher, the race is based on gun time start and first to cross the finish line.
  • 4-Mile runners must complete the loop under the 60 min threshold to be able to start the next loop. If you choose not to start the next loop, you MUST drop by placing your race tag/bracelet in the drop box for your laps to be logged.
  • Please pack out all trash that you may have from your nutrition or hydration. Trash cans will be available at all aid stations. Leave no trace!
  • No crews or pacers will be allowed for either race on course. All crewing must happen at the start/finish area in the designated runner prep area.
  • All drop bags for the 4-mile race must be checked in by 7:45am on race day. They can be checked in and out between each lap as needed.
  • No pets will be allowed on the course during the race.
  • No strollers will be allowed on the course.
  • Run hard, run fast and have fun!
  • You must complete all 8 laps to be considered for top 3 male/female in the endurance race.

Thank you for understanding.

SPECTATING

We would love to see everyone come out to support our local athletes in this new trail race! Because the trail is a single track there are limited locations that you can safely watch your favorite runners without interrupting the flow of the race. Here we have provided a few locations where you can safely watch your runners and help cheer them on to the finish.

All downhill from here! Parking will be very limited. If you plan to cheer for your runners at this location, carpooling is highly recommended!

Runners will be coming in and out of this location from both directions, so this will be a fun and high energy place to spectate.

name: Fog Run
description:
The Probation Auxiliary County of Kern presents their 37th Annual 5K/10K Fog Run at Lake Ming in Bakersfield. This is a fun and family friendly 5K/10K race to support at-risk individuals in Kern County.

Proceeds will also benefit the Kern County Probation Department's Helping Hands program. Helping Hands is a nonprofit organization, and their goal is to guide at risk youth towards success by removing barriers and equipping them with the basic needs. Together the two organizations provide scholarships, vocational training, mentoring, clothing, hygiene products, and other necessities.  We believe our programs leave a lasting impact on youth by removing barriers and increasing self-esteem, confidence, and drive to go to school. It is our hope to set up individuals for success and make our community a safer place. The race takes place on a beautiful scenic course overlooking beautiful mountains and lake views.

Packet Pickup

Thursday, January 7, 2027, from 4:30PM – 6:30PM at Kern County Probation Department, 2005 Ridge Rd., Bakersfield, CA 93305
Friday, January 8, 2027, from 4:00PM – 6:00PM at Orangetheory Fitness, 12838 Stockdale Hwy Suites 4A-1 & 4A-2, Bakersfield, CA 93314
Race Day Check-in/Packet Pickup: January 9, 2027, 6:30am – 7:30am at Lake Ming 

 
Event will occur rain or shine.

name: Fort Bragg Whale Run and Walk
description:
The 39th Annual Whale Run & Walk for 2027!
Fort Bragg, Ca is a small, picturesque city on the Pacific Ocean, nestled between sandy beaches and the redwood forest. We are the home of the world famous Glass Beach! Every year there is a huge Whale Festival on the 3rd weekend of March, and Saturday morning the Whale Run kicks it off! After the Whale Run there are events all over town, including a craft fair; guided whale viewing; clam chowder, beer and wine tasting, entertainment, and music everywhere. See the www.whalerun.org for more information and interesting facts about whales.

The local Soroptimist clubs have been holding this race for 39 years, with up to 800 runners participating on a beautiful day on the Mendocino Coast. The ocean and trails are as magnificent as ever and we know you will love the views and all the festivities in town on race day. All runners, walkers, and spectators will enjoy breathtaking whitewater ocean views (including whales) along this year’s new course starting at the Noyo Headlands Park (Cypress Street) on the Coastal Trail in Fort Bragg, CA

Here are the events you can sign up for:

  • 5k-- runners will run north and turn around at or near Compass Rose.
  • 5k-- "Fun" Walkers will follow the 5k runner's route. 
  • 10k-- runners dash north past Glass Beach then cross the beautiful Pudding Creek Trestle to the 10K turn around (10K map).
  • 1/2 Marathon--same route as 10k but the turnaround is at MacKerricher State Park.
  • Kiddie run -- 400 meter run in 3 age groups (U5, U7, and U10)

There are multiple race age divisions. Note: under 16 run/walkers may enter any race division for a discounted rate at signup.

DOGS: We love dogs, but the insurance won't let us add them mixed with runners. You are welcome to walk your dog on the trails before and after the race (on leash). There's a dog park at race HQ on Cypress, by the CV Starr swim/fitness center on Lincoln and Maple, and there's a city-owned dog beach at the end of north harbor drive.

FAQ's: Click Here to go to the race website www.whalerun.org and find answers to commonly asked questions about the race, about whales and our Noyo Center for Marine Science "whale bone house", Soroptimists and what they do, what to do in Fort Bragg, and more.

name: Fort Bragg Whale Run and Walk
description:
The 39th Annual Whale Run & Walk for 2027!
Fort Bragg, Ca is a small, picturesque city on the Pacific Ocean, nestled between sandy beaches and the redwood forest. We are the home of the world famous Glass Beach! Every year there is a huge Whale Festival on the 3rd weekend of March, and Saturday morning the Whale Run kicks it off! After the Whale Run there are events all over town, including a craft fair; guided whale viewing; clam chowder, beer and wine tasting, entertainment, and music everywhere. See the www.whalerun.org for more information and interesting facts about whales.

The local Soroptimist clubs have been holding this race for 39 years, with up to 800 runners participating on a beautiful day on the Mendocino Coast. The ocean and trails are as magnificent as ever and we know you will love the views and all the festivities in town on race day. All runners, walkers, and spectators will enjoy breathtaking whitewater ocean views (including whales) along this year’s new course starting at the Noyo Headlands Park (Cypress Street) on the Coastal Trail in Fort Bragg, CA

Here are the events you can sign up for:

  • 5k-- runners will run north and turn around at or near Compass Rose.
  • 5k-- "Fun" Walkers will follow the 5k runner's route. 
  • 10k-- runners dash north past Glass Beach then cross the beautiful Pudding Creek Trestle to the 10K turn around (10K map).
  • 1/2 Marathon--same route as 10k but the turnaround is at MacKerricher State Park.
  • Kiddie run -- 400 meter run in 3 age groups (U5, U7, and U10)

There are multiple race age divisions. Note: under 16 run/walkers may enter any race division for a discounted rate at signup.

DOGS: We love dogs, but the insurance won't let us add them mixed with runners. You are welcome to walk your dog on the trails before and after the race (on leash). name: Foster5K + Kids Dash
description:
The 11th Annual Foster5K + Kids Dash

Registration opens in early 2027. Save the Date: May 16, 2027

Run for Hope. Stand for Change.

The 11th Annual Foster5K celebrates a decade of community impact. Amidst a critical funding crisis, your participation in our 5K ensures that we can continue providing advocates for foster youth who have experienced trauma. On Sunday, May 16, 2027, we gather at Martial Cottle Park to turn steps into hope. Race proceeds support Child Advocates of Silicon Valley (CASV) and its Court Appointed Special Advocate (CASA) Program, dedicated to providing everlasting impact on our community's most vulnerable youth.

Ways to Move:

5K Run/Walk: A chip-timed , USATF Certified 5K Course for all ages and abilities at Martial Cottle Park.

Kids Dash: Featuring a "Big Kids Dash" (ages 6–10) and a "Little Kids Dash" (ages 5 and under).  All Dashers get a goodie bag at the finish line!
 

Whether you sprint, jog, or skip, you are running for their future. Join us and stand for change!

All proceeds benefit Child Advocates of Silicon Valley, an independent nonprofit serving our community's most vulnerable youth - foster children aged birth to 21 years old who have experienced abuse, neglect and/or abandonment. Together we can help LIFT UP our foster children. Learn more about how to help a child in foster care at childadvocatessv.org.

name: Four Fools Wine Run 5k
description:
Enjoy wine and running or walking?  This is a must do event for you!  

Race Swag: All participants will receive a race t-shirt, souvenir plastic wine glass, finisher wine medal and a 5 oz. pour of wine (or soda for our under 21 runners) after the race! 

Join us on Saturday, June 12, 2027 at 11:00 am for our annual event that features the scenic views of Rodeo, CA and the San Francisco Bay Trail, and the great Wine produced by locally owned by Four Fools Winery.  With registration options for all wine lovers, runners and walkers, this race is a sure thing for a great time! 

Awards: All participants will receive a finisher wine medal.  This is not a competitive race but it will be a blast for all the participants!

This race benefits the Rodeo Baseball Association.

FAQ's

  • Is the race only for 21+? No, minors are welcome to participate, but they will get a free soda instead of wine.
  • Is walking allowed? Yes, walkers are allowed and encouraged to participate!
  • Are strollers allowed? Yes
  • When is packet pickup?  We will hold packet pickup the morning of the race at Four Fools Winery in Rodeo, CA from 10am to 11am. 
  • Is the race dog friendly? Yes, but please make sure you dog is on a leash.

name: FOURmidable
description:
FOURmidable Trail Run (50K | 35K | Half Marathon+ | 13K)

Presented by SingleTrack Running

Location: Auburn Overlook Park — 855 Pacific Ave, Auburn, CA 95603

Are you ready to test your grit on one of Northern California's premier trail challenges? Hosted in the endurance capital of the world, the FOURmidable Trail Run takes runners through the rugged, scenic canyon trails of the Auburn and Cool areas.

Featuring less than one mile of pavement across all distances, this event treats you to singletrack trails, river canyon views, and the infamous climbs that give the race its name.

The Four Climbs

The signature 50K course packs over 6,000 feet of cumulative elevation gain, headlined by the "FOUR" formidable climbs:

  • Cardiac Hill
  • K2 (aka Training Hill)
  • Knickerbocker (Old Auburn Dam Site)
  • Overlook Hill

Whether you take on the full 50K ultra or choose the 35K, Half Marathon+ (13.2 mi), or 13K, you will experience the best singletrack Auburn has to offer.

Race Schedule & Start Times

All distances run on race day.

DistanceStart Time
50K8:00 AM
35K8:15 AM
Half Marathon+ (13.2 mi)8:30 AM
13K9:00 AM

What's Included

  • Custom Swag & Bibs: SingleTrack Running takes pride in quality, practical swag designed to celebrate your finish without cluttering your closet.
  • Fully Stocked Aid Stations: Staffed by experienced trail volunteers ready to help refuel and hydrate you quickly. Stations include water, electrolyte drink, gels, soda, boiled potatoes, candy, salt tabs, and more.
  • Post-Race Celebration: Finish at Overlook Park with plenty of hot food, drinks, and trail camaraderie.

Important Event Logistics

1. Cupless Racing

In an effort to keep trails clean and minimize waste, FOURmidable is a 100% cupless event.

  • Every runner must carry a handheld bottle, hydration pack, or reusable collapsible cup.
  • Paper cups will not be provided at aid stations. Collapsible cups will be available for purchase on-site, or you can bring your own.

2. Packet Pick-Up

  • Early Pick-Up (Recommended): Friday (day before the race) from 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM at the Start/Finish area (Auburn Overlook Park).
  • Race Morning: Available at Overlook Park starting 1 hour prior to your wave start. Note: Any swag/bibs not claimed by race start will be gifted to race-day volunteers.

3. Parking & Vehicle Camping

  • Runner Parking: Primary parking at Overlook Park is reserved for registered runners. Overflow parking is available along Pacific Ave and at the nearby staging area (staging area parking requires a paid fee—please obey posted local signs).

description:

name: Freedom Fun Run
description:
The Placer Freedom Foundation is excited to host the 2026 Freedom Fun Run at Vernon Street Town Square in downtown Roseville. 
This in-person community event features 5K, 10K, and 1-mile distances to accommodate all fitness levels.

Costume Contest
Join the fun and participate in the Patriotic Costume Contest! Participants will be judged in the following categories:
     Uncle Sam Award: Most patriotic individual costume.
     Firecracker Award: Brightest, loudest, and most energetic individual outfit.
     Dynamic Unit: Best group or duo costume theme.
     Lil' Sparkler: Best kids' individual costume

Special Pricing for Veterans and Families.

Run for a Hero
You can dedicate your race to a special veteran or active-duty military member in your life. When you register, you will have the opportunity to share their name and branch of service. We will provide a special tribute sticker for you to wear on race day so you can carry their legacy with you across the finish line.

Our Mission
The mission of the Placer Freedom Foundation is to support, strengthen, and promote nonprofit organizations and charitable programs. We primarily serve veterans, active-duty military members, first responders, and their families through fundraising and community events.

Can't Run This Year?
You can still support our local heroes and community initiatives. We welcome all donations, sponsorships, and volunteer efforts to help us reach our goals.

name: Freedom Run on the Ranch
description:
A Ladera Ranch tradition returns this Fourth of July! Join us for the Freedom Run on the Ranch—a fun, community-first celebration featuring the Kids Firecracker 1K, 5K, and 10K. This year we are celebrating our 20th Anniversary!

Your participation makes a difference: race registration and sponsorship proceeds support local charities, and in 2026 we are proud to support the Jessie Rees Foundation – NEGU. 

Bring the whole family—whether you’re running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines. Enjoy a festive event morning with a breakfast option and sponsor/vendor area, plus plenty of Fourth of July spirit throughout the community. 

Important: Registration prices increase on June 22. Please register early.

6:00 am Race Registration opens

7:00 am - 10k run starts

8:30 am - 5k run starts

8:00 am - Xclusive breakfast begins

9:45 am - Kids 1k run starts

11:00 am - Event ends

name: Fresno Turkey Trot
description:
Sierra Challenge Express

Presents:

the 27th annual

Fresno Turkey Trot @ Woodward Park

For over a quarter of a century, the Fresno running community has come together on Thanksgiving morning to make a difference—supporting those in need throughout our community through generous donations and race registrations. The Fresno Turkey Trot isn’t just a run; it’s a tradition of gratitude, generosity, and good times. This year, your participation helps support the Fresno Mission as they provide meals, shelter, recovery programs, and life-changing services for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Proceeds also benefit the Coach Ray Knight Youth and Scholarship Programs, helping student-athletes across the Central Valley pursue their academic and athletic dreams.

Kick off your Thanksgiving with purpose! Whether you run the chip-timed 5K or enjoy the untimed 2-Mile Walk, you’ll be part of a festive and meaningful morning. Every participant will receive a long-sleeve Thanksgiving shirt, a commemorative finisher’s medal, and a tasty post-race treat.

Registering your family? If you register 4 to 10 people, you’ll automatically receive 10% off. Register 10 or more, and you’ll save 20%! Simply select "Multi-Person Pricing" during registration.

This year, your participation helps support the Fresno Mission as they provide meals, shelter, recovery programs, and life-changing services for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Proceeds also benefit the Coach Ray Knight Youth and Scholarship Programs, helping student-athletes across the Central Valley pursue their academic and athletic dreams.

Kick off your Thanksgiving with purpose! Whether you run the chip-timed 5K or enjoy the untimed 2-Mile Walk, you’ll be part of a festive and meaningful morning. Every participant will receive a long-sleeve Thanksgiving shirt, a commemorative finisher’s medal, and a tasty post-race treat.

Registering your family? If you register 4 to 10 people, you’ll automatically receive 10% off. Register 10 or more, and you’ll save 20%! Simply select "Multi-Person Pricing" during registration.

name: Fresno Urban Run
description:
Starting inside of Chukchansi Park, you will be put to the challenge of climbing every step from the bottom to the top of the stadium, followed by a run up a 6-story circular garage and then down an adjacent 6-story circular garage, proceeded by a half-mile run down Fulton Street to the Tuolumne Overpass (Urban Hill), before the final challenge, climbing 220 stairs to the top of a 10-story building, The Grand Tower, where your timing sensor will stop your clock!
Overall length of the Urban Run is approx 3 Miles.  
All donations support The Alisa Ann Ruch Burn Foundation!

The Fresno Urban Run is a 20 point race in the California Classic Runner of the Year Series!

name: Friday the 13th Night Race -Deranged Turkey Trot: 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
This a 2026 Event

🦃 Camp Turkey Terror – Where the Turkeys Fight Back


🌲 Friday the 13th 
5K | 10K | Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 Friday, November 13, 2026
🕓 Check-In begins : 4:00 PM to 6:30 PM
Start Times | Half: 5:00 PM | 10K & 5K: 6:30 PM

 
💀 About the Event
Welcome to Camp Turkey Terror — where the tables have turned and the turkeys are taking revenge. 🦃🔥
It’s Friday the 13th, and under the harvest moon, the woods come alive with feathers, fog, and just a hint of chaos.

Join us for the final chapter in the Camp CaliFlow Trilogy, a fall night of fun, fright, and fearless miles. Whether you’re running from guilt, running for the pie, or just running for the glow, this one’s for you.

Because at Camp Turkey Terror… the turkeys fight back.

 
🌊 What to Expect
USATF-Certified Course 🏁
Professional Chip Timing ⏱️
Free Race-Day Photos by Nina & Dre 📸
Finisher Medals for All Participants 🏅
Overall & Age Group Awards 🥇
3 On-Course Water Stations (one at each turnaround)
Finish-Line Feast & Campfire Festival 🔥
Costume Contest – Pilgrims, Pumpkins & Poultry Welcome 🦃🎃
DJ, Lights & Glow Effects for that signature CaliFlow After-Dark magic
All paces welcome — runners, walkers, and leftovers alike!
 
🌕 Course Info
The course begins beneath the glowing CaliFlow Arcch, tracing the flat, scenic Long Beach path under the light of the harvest moon.

As you make your way through the fog, you’ll pass a few iconic “Camp Turkey Terror” checkpoints:
🔥 The Final Feast Turnaround
🍂 Stuffing Station 13
🥧 Pie or Die Water Stop

Half Marathon: 3 × 4.36-mile loops
10K: 2 × 5K out-and-backs
5K: 1 loop

Each turnaround features a full water station, friendly “camp counselors,” and plenty of autumn spirit to keep you moving before the turkeys catch up.

 
🍁 The Vibe – Totally Camp CaliFlow
Think Thanksgiving meets slasher flick, but with way better lighting and medals you’ll actually want to show off.

Expect glowing campfires, pumpkin decor, moody fog, and more laughs than screams as you cross the finish line at our “Campfire Feast” celebration.

Because at CaliFlow Runs, we don’t fear the chaos — we run through it.
And this time… the turkeys are watching. 👀

✨ Not just a race. Join the movement.

name: Furgiving Run: Turkey Trot 5K, 10K, Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🦃💛 THE GREAT FURGIVING RUN
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Family 1-Miler • Kids Dash

📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA

Friends. Family. Doggies. Miles. Gratitude.

The Friendsgiving Run is a feel-good coastal race celebrating connection, movement, and the people we choose to show up with. Whether you’re running with friends, family, your kids, your pup, or your run crew, this is a morning made for togetherness and good vibes by the beach.

Run the scenic Long Beach shoreline, enjoy ocean views, and finish with that signature CaliFlow energy that makes every race feel like home.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
Same-Day Registration & Bib Pickup:
🕕 Opens at 6:00 AM

Start Times
⏰ Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
⏰ 5K & 10K 8:00 AM

⏰ Family 1-Miler: 8:15
⏰ Kids Dash: 9:15 AM

 
🌊 Why You’ll Love This Race
✅ Flat, fast, scenic beach path course
✅ Beginner- and walker-friendly
✅ Strollers welcome
✅ Dogs on leash welcome 🐾
✅ Professional chip timing with accurate results
✅ Overall & age group awards
✅ Free race-day photos
✅ Finisher medals for all participants
✅ Finish-line festival vibes

 
💛 Why CaliFlow Runs
CaliFlow Runs is about more than miles — it’s about community. Our events are inclusive, welcoming, and designed so everyone belongs, no matter your pace or experience level.

Come solo.
Bring your people.
Make new friends.

The Friendsgiving Run is your chance to move together, celebrate gratitude, and start the season on a high note.

name: Gardner Health Services 2026 Día de los Muertos Run-Walk
description:
And......we're back! We're thrilled to announce our 7th Annual Gardner Health Services Día de los Muertos Run-Walk, now featuring a more focused 5K route to make your experience even more vibrant and memorable. Join us on Saturday, October 31, 2026 at 8:30am along the beautiful Guadalupe River Trail in San Jose, CA.

This year, we're streamlining our route to just a 5K to create an even more engaging and energetic event that celebrates life, health, those we love eternally, and the incredible spirit of our community. But, our mission is strong and remains to support children and families who need access to medical care, turning every step into hope and healing.

Get ready for a morning filled with music, entertainment, and a health resource fair that promises fun for the whole family. Together, we'll run, walk, and make a difference!

REGISTRATION INCLUDES

  • Race Entry 
  • Bib and Timing Chip
  • Finisher's Medal
  • Día de los Muertos Tech Shirt

PACKET/BIB PICK-UP

  • Friday, October 30, 2026 | 10:00am - 7:00pm | 1621 Gold St., San Jose, CA 95002
  • Saturday, October 31, 2026 | 7:00am - 7:45am | 1621 Gold St., San Jose, CA 95002

WHAT TO WEAR

Show us your best Día de los Muertos spirit and come in masks, colorful makeup, and costumes. Or, wear the race shirt given at packet pick-up.

LA OFRENDA

Participants are encouraged to bring a photo of a passed loved one, flowers, etc. for our giant ofrenda on display (no glass or open flames).

  • All items should be placed on the ofrenda by 7:30am
  • Photos should be 5″ x 7″ or smaller
  • Please pick up photo/items before leaving venue. All items left at the end of the event will be discarded.

name: Garlic City Turkey Trot
description:
Inaugural Gilroy Turkey Trot

 

**** Important information*****

Dear Participants,

We are working very hard to bring you a one-of-a-kind experience, starting with the finisher t-shirt and medals. We are designing a high-quality t-shirt that you can use for years to come. Because of the production quality, we need adequate time to manufacture and ship the items.

Please note that the deadline to guarantee a finisher t-shirt in your desired size is October 3rd. After this date, you will still be guaranteed a t-shirt, but sizing will be subject to availability.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

 

Initiative 

The idea of hosting a Turkey Trot in Gilroy was born out of my husband's and my tradition of traveling to San Jose to run in their event, which always left us with limited time to prepare for Thanksgiving family gatherings. A local Turkey Trot was an idea that surfaced a few years ago, but due to a lack of funding, we were unable to fulfill that vision until now.

We are thrilled to finally be moving forward with this event for our community. Please let me know if you would like more details on how to get involved or participate.

Description

Please join us for the Inaugural Garlic City Turkey Trot this Thanksgiving morning, hosted by Garlic City Hybrid Training. You can run, walk, or ruck in this festive 5K event, which will feature holiday music, custom shirts, and post-race treats.

This event is organized by the Gilroy community, for the community. Half of the proceeds will go toward acquiring workout equipment to enhance local health and fitness of our community, while the other half will benefit Rebeka's Children's Services for their Culinary Academy. It is a wonderful way to get your family and friends moving while supporting a local nonprofit organization.

We hope to see you there to start this new Thanksgiving tradition together!

About the Course: 

The route begins at Gilroy Sports Park and winds through the Levee Park Preserve alongside oak trees. The course is mainly flat and fully paved, offering a scenic run through one of Gilroy's most beautiful natural areas. It is mostly paved and accessible for strollers, wheelchairs, and other mobility devices.

To ensure a smooth running experience for all participants, the course will be marked and assisted by volunteers with clearly marked turnaround points. There will be one aid station at the halfway point, as well as snacks at the finish line. In addition, the Garlic City Turkey Trot will be a cupless event. Runners will need to carry a bottle, collapsible cup, or other means to drink at aid stations. 

Due to the event falling on Thanksgiving Day, and keeping in mind that participants might be traveling to spend the day with their loved ones, there will be no food trucks at the event. However, coffee will be available to purchase from Taaza.

Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you there.

About Rucking

Rucking is a physical activity that involves walking with a weighted backpack, often referred to as a ruck. It combines the benefits of strength training and cardio, making it an effective workout for building endurance and muscle. Weight requirements are 30 lbs for men and 20 lbs for women, and rucksacks will be weighed prior to the start.

 

Looking forward to seeing you all there!!

name: Get Up Show Up Community Day~Remembering Jenn Casci
description:
The Get Up Show UP Community Day is established in loving memory of Jennifer "Jenn" Casci. who showed up for her family, her friends, her community and herself. A passionate athlete and fitness enthusiast, she believed movement had the power to strengthen not only our bodies, but our connections with one another. This event celebrates everything Jenn stood for: improving our community, encouraging people to get up and move, and bringing neighbors together through health, fitness and service. We welcome everyone to participate in the event best suited to their fitness level. Come join our fundraiser and enjoy delicious food, festivities and guaranteed fun.

This event is a Fundraiser benefiting Jeppy's Playground, helping provide maintenance and future improvements, and a lasting place for children and families to enjoy for years to come, while also helping fund youth scholarships and future community projects. We are a proud partner of Calaveras Community Foundation, making eligible donations to this event tax-deductible. 

For the safety and enjoyment of all participants, pets are not permitted. Service dogs are welcome in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Strollers are welcome in the 5K walk/run/ruck event only, the terrain is not suitable for the 10K route. 

PACKET PICK UP ON RACE DAY ONLY:  Saturday, 0700-0830, Registration is located next to Jeppy's Playground which is easily accessed from the main event parking lot at the back of the park. (START/FINISH LINE). Volunteers will guide you.

0900/0905  5K/10K Walk - Run - Ruck  *The Race Route Starts and Finishes at Jeppy's Playground, Participants Will Leave The Park For This Event.

0945  1-Mile Legacy Walk *Starting Point is at Field C, the route does NOT leave the park.

0945 KIds Fun Run (12 years and Under) * Located in Field B, event activities will be conducted in age groups. 

1215 Team Fitness Challenge *Event is held in Field A, Park Trail Routes Will Be Used For This Event.

Registration Includes:

  • Event entry
  • Official event free giveaway T-Shirt (NOTE: Tshirt is not guaranteed for registrations after October 31st).
  • Finisher Medal (Walk/Run) 
  • Event Patch (Ruck)
  • Post-race water and snack

name: Glenn Bass Run
description: The Glenn Bass Run has been celebrated for over a decade, and is in honor of Sonora's long-time cross country and track coach, Glenn Bass. This 5k and 1 mile race are on Sonora High School's Wildcat Ranch in East Sonora, running along the same course that's used by the high school cross country leagues. The course is set along rolling hills surrounded by oaks and open grassland. Participants will navigate a figure-eight course and complete the second loop twice before the downhill finish. 1 mile runners will do the final loop of the 5k. Custom awards will be given to the top 3 in each age group in each race. The registration fee is $25 + online fee for 5k and $15 + online fee for the 1 mile. T-Shirt included for first 100 participants to sign up. All proceeds will go to the Sonora High cross country team. Come out and support Sonora High School and have some fun running on the course!

name: Grapes of Wrath Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the Grapes of Wrath triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Finishers meal
+ Rosa Brother's Chocolate Milk
+ Free Race Photos


The Grapes of Wrath Triathlon is a fast and fun race in the central valley located east of Delano, CA. This event features a lake swim in Lake Woollomes, a fast and flat road bike course, and a run which is part trail and part paved finishes the race. Each athlete registered for the Grapes of Wrath Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

About the venue:

Three miles southeast of Delano, CA, nestled in the vinyards and orchards of the Central San Joaquin Valley is Lake Woollomes, a 300-acre reservoir with 4 miles of shoreline, making it a cozy location for water recreation.

Swimming is allowed here, making this destination perfect for hot summer days. There’s also a boat dock and a launch ramp for those wishing to take to the water. But, the use is restricted to non-powered boats, so only sailboats, SUPs, and kayaks can be used on the lake.  

This fast, flat course is the perfect place to get your next PR.

Note:
A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

Each athlete registered for the Grapes of Wrath Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

This fast, flat course is the perfect place to get your next PR.

name: Grateful Run 5K/10K
description:
Grateful Run 5K & 10K
Walk. Run. Show up. Together, let's log grateful miles.

Celebrate the Thanksgiving season one mile at a time at the Grateful Run 5K & 10K. Whether you run, walk, or simply show up, this event is a reminder to slow down, appreciate the journey, and share meaningful moments with the people around you.

Bring your family and friends and be part of a welcoming community where every step is a celebration of gratitude.

Cross the finish line and receive an exclusive Grateful Run Finisher Medal and Grateful Bracelet to remember the day.

Bracelet provided by Instagram: @_harmonybracelets

Registration Includes
🍂 5K or 10K Race Entry
🏅 Exclusive Grateful Run Finisher Medal
🧡 Exclusive Grateful Bracelet
⏱️ This is a fun, community event and is not chip timed. The race clock begins at the official start, and finish times are recorded manually. 
📸 Free Race Photos
🎉 Finish Line Celebration

REMINDER — PLEASE USE CAUTION

The walking/running path is open to the public. Please use caution and be mindful of walkers, runners, and other park visitors.

🗺️ Grateful Run Course Information


5K
🍂 Out-and-back course
🍂 Complete the route 1 time (1X)

10K
🍂 Follow the same 5K course
🍂 Complete the route 2 times (2X)

Please follow all course signs and volunteer directions to help create a safe, smooth, and enjoyable experience for everyone.

Thank you for being part of the Grateful Run. Take a moment to enjoy the course, appreciate each mile, and remember—every step is something to be grateful for. 🧡

name: Green Valley Lake 5k/10k/& Half Marathon
description:
🌲 GREEN VALLEY LAKE 5K / 10K / HALF MARATHON
Saturday, August 7th, 2027
Green Valley Lake, CA (Between Running Springs & Big Bear in the San Bernardino Mountains)

 
🕖 START TIMES
7:00 AM: Early Start Half Marathon (for those expecting to take 3.75+ hours)
7:30 AM: Standard Half Marathon Start
8:00 AM: Mass Start for 5K & 10K
 
🏞 COURSE HIGHLIGHTS
This is a breathtaking mountain race in the heart of the San Bernardino National Forest!

Start with a scenic ¾-mile out-and-back along the lake
Climb gradually up Green Valley Lake Rd and onto a forest service road
Enjoy a 400 ft elevation gain to an overlook at the 5K turnaround
10K and Half Marathon continue along rolling terrain on FS Road 2N13, through pine forests and rocky vistas
Course is part paved (1.5 miles), then transitions to dirt roads and trail
Water & aid stations every 1.5 miles
Get ready for that fresh air, mountain-made, above-the-clouds experience!

 
📍 LOCATION
Green Valley Lake – Just 40 minutes from Redlands, located off Hwy 18 between Lake Arrowhead and Big Bear.

Post-race activities take place in the Downtown Community Garden on the main lake area on Green Valley Lake Rd.
Race HQ / Packet Pickup: Next to Black Dog Social Club, 33231 Green Valley Lake Rd. (A huge thank you to 

 
🥇 WHAT YOU GET
Custom, high-quality event t-shirt
Unique, huge finisher medal
Top 3 overall awards per race distance
Age group medals (3 deep in 5-year spans up to 80+)
Chip timing by Itz About Time
🏆 Age Groups:
10 & under, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80+
(Separate overall awards for each race distance.)

 
🏁 AWARDS CEREMONY – COMMUNITY GARDEN
9:00 AM – 5K Awards
9:20 AM – 10K Awards
9:30 AM – Half Marathon Awards
 
🧁 FOOD & FUN
Coffee ,pastries , street tacos, and more available for purchase packet pickup and race morning
Food available for purchase post-race
Live music at the Community Garden post-race
Hang out in a welcoming mountain community with big hometown vibes
 
🎽 PACKET PICKUP
Friday, August 6th 3:30 PM – 6:30PM @ Black Dog Social Club
Saturday (Race Day): 6:30 AM – 8:30 AM @ Race Site
 
🏕 STAY THE WEEKEND
Make it a full mountain getaway!

Airbnbs in Green Valley Lake
Green Valley Lake Campground (0.5 miles from race) 
Giant Oaks Lodge, Running Springs (5 miles)
Rentals available at: green-valley-lake.com
 
🌅 FRIDAY NIGHT SUNSET RUN (Optional Add-On)
Friday, August 6 at 7:15 PM – Sunset Trail 5K. Meet at Black Dog
A fun, scenic, single-track 3.1-mile warm-up trail run.
💌 Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com to sign up.

 
🌲 THIS race  GIVES BACK to the local national forest CHILDREN's FOREST on behalf of TEAM JANIECE.

Your extra donations and participation support TEAM JANIECE , formed by the CAMACHO family to commemorate the life of their daughter, Janiece , who helped build the Children's Forest trail.  This race is in honor of families and the precious years we have with each other, that can be cut short in an unfathomable blink. And for us to hold dear loss and love.  And to make life full of action and each other. In memory and in living tribute to a kind young lady that loved this mountain, but only got to live into her early twenties. Our gathering in a healthy way is in honor to you.

May you FEEL the mountains are special.  The breeze in your hair.  The sun on your face.  And the great ability to enjoy doing something actively together in a special little corner of So Cal called the San Bernardino Mountains, and a tiny mountain town called Green Valley Lake. 

We also gift donations for: The Green Valley Lake Community Garden (host of our awards),The Local Museum, providing water support on the course. Refuge Christian Church in Running Springs for their Electric bike support on the course, and sweet hospitality at the 5k water station and at the finish. 🙏 Hit the "DONATE" button at registration!  Help us help support the FOREST we get to enjoy.

name: Grievances & Gratitude Run – New Year Reset 5K 10K Half Marathon
description:
Grievances & Gratitude Run


Release. Move. Begin Again.

Skip the resolutions. Start the year with intention, movement, and joy.

Grievances & Gratitude is a feel-good New Year run designed to help you exhale, reset, and step into 2026 lighter—surrounded by community, movement, and positive energy. This is about letting go of what no longer serves you and making space for gratitude, clarity, and forward momentum.

You can write down everything you’re ready to release… or just one thing. You can take part in the experience—or simply show up and run. However you choose to participate, this event meets you exactly where you are.

Every participant receives a finisher medal, and the option to take part in our signature Let Go & Affirmation Experience—because new beginnings don’t have to be loud or rigid. Sometimes they just need movement and space to breathe.

 
How It Works
Let Go Before You Go
Before the run, write down anything you’re ready to release—grievances, frustrations, stress, or heavy thoughts. Place them into our “goodbye” containers and symbolically leave that energy behind.

Run Free
Head out on a scenic course and move your body with intention. Run or walk at your own pace, clear your mind, and let each step carry you forward.

Affirmations Await
After crossing the finish line, visit our New Year Mantra Board and select a positive affirmation to guide you into the year ahead. Leave with gratitude, purpose, and renewed energy.

This isn’t just a race—it’s a moment. A reset. A fresh start grounded in movement and community.

 
Why CaliFlow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, high-energy, community-driven events that celebrate you. Our races are accessible, joyful, and thoughtfully designed to support physical and emotional well-being—without pressure, pretension, or upsells.

✨ Professionally chip-timed
✨ USATF-certified courses
✨ Free race-day photos
✨ No forced shirts. No gimmicks. Just good vibes.

 
Who Can Participate?
Everyone is welcome.
Runners • Walkers • Strollers • First-timers • Seasoned athletes
This event is for anyone ready to move into the new year with intention.

 
Course Information
Our courses are open, meaning you’ll share the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path at all times.

✔️ Clearly marked course
✔️ 3 on-course water stations
✔️ Restrooms available along the route
✔️ Friendly staff and volunteers throughout

 
Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

 
Start Location
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd
Long Beach, CA 90803

 
Parking Information
• Free street parking available
• Metered parking: $2.00 per hour

 
Awards
🏅 Top 3 men and women in each distance receive awards
🎤 Podium ceremony at 9:00 AM

 
Start 2026 grounded, grateful, and moving forward—together.
Come for the run. Stay for the release. Leave lighter.

name: Griffith Park Resolution Run
description:
Celebrate The New Year With Us! Join us for 2027 and help us make it even better! We're giving out some goodies to the first couple registrations so don't miss out and register now! 

Our Half Marathon course is roughly 90% on a trail with the remaining 10% on asphalt. Below is a quick overview of the course.

The start of the course is at Shane's Inspiration in Griffith Park.
Mile 1: Upper Old Zoo Trail
Mile 2: Bill Eckert Trail (Hills with beautiful views!)
Miles 3-5: Mainly downhill on asphalt
Miles 6-8: Rolling Hills (Tetris)
Mile 9: All downhill
Miles 10-13: Quick flat trail to the finish!

Our 12K shares the same start line as the Half Marathon.
Miles 1-3: You will pass through the old Griffith Park Zoo and zoom through some hills
Mile 4: All downhill
Miles 5-7+: Quick flat trail to the finish!

Our 5K is a nice and quick route around the golf course.

15K Relay
Create a team of 3 and each run a 5K loop. Compete in any of our 3 divisions for the relay!
Coed, Male, Female

name: Griffith Park Run
description: Run GPR is almost here, mark your calendar! Open to runners and walkers of all levels, from elite athletes to first-timers. This is the only half marathon that covers all the major trails of Griffith Park, with a special reward for the first male and female runners to conquer the final peak. Prefer shorter? Our 5K is flat, shaded, and incredibly scenic. Stick around for food trucks, an event expo, and the REI experience. Every participant receives a commemorative die-cast medal, premium t-shirt, and access to sampling booths. Run GPR is unlike any other event in Griffith Park. Proudly in partnership with the LA Parks Foundation and featuring one of the largest prize purses in the region.

name: Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K
description:
Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K, an unforgettable race experience celebrated as one of Runner’s World magazine’s 10 Best Races You’ve Never Heard Of in 2024! This iconic event is the perfect opportunity to push yourself, bond with friends, and take in the breathtaking beauty of Griffith Park. With a combination of scenic trails and challenging terrain, you’ll be in for the ride of your life. Whether you’re a seasoned runner or just starting out, join us for a solo run or bring a team for a relay. And with fully-stocked aid stations and an energetic volunteer crew, you’ll have everything you need to crush it. So come on, grab your running shoes, and let’s make this a moment to remember! Register now for a day of adventure, camaraderie, and lasting memories.
One of the largest urban parks in the country, Griffith Park is a 4,300-plus acre slice of runner heaven. The grounds include famous sites like the Abandoned Los Angeles Zoo, the Observatory, and the Hollywood Sign. There’s more than 30 trails totaling around 50 miles for runners and hikers. Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Relay Marathon and get a taste of what the second largest city park has to offer.
  • All participants will receive a premium short sleeve women's or men's cut t-shirt. (Guaranteed shirt size if you register by May 17!)
  • Relay run is chip timed for fast & accurate results.
  • $1500 in Cash prizes for the Open division (Relay only)
  • Trophy/Plaque for the top 3 teams in each recreational division
  • Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Limited Edition Badges (Relay Only)
  • 3 well supported aid stations with medical staff (2 on course, 1 at start/finish)
  • Food and refreshments at the start/finish area.
  • Music from multiple live DJs
  • Multiple Food Trucks
  • Access to the exclusive GPTMR packet pickup sale and raffle at Fleet Feet Burbank

name: Halloween Leftovers – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Happy Halloweekend! Halloween may be technically over, but we’re not ready to pack away the costumes or give up the treats just yet. Join us for one more lap of spooky season while the candy-fueled fun keeps rolling.

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1-3pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post event)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Fountain Valley, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Halloween Trick or Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎃 👻 Trick or Trot! 👻 🎃
Run in our annual Halloween Run, where healthy fitness meets frightful fun! We'll even give you some free Halloween candy after your run! Find a friend, set a goal, and join this unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.

Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.

Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.

name: Hansen Dam Splash 'n' Dash 1K/5K
description:
Get ready to kick off summer at the 2nd Annual Hansen Dam Splash & Dash 5K — a one-of-a-kind community race set against the scenic backdrop of Hansen Dam Recreation Area, home to one of the largest aquatic facilities in the country. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, walking with family and friends, or simply looking for a fun morning outdoors, this event is designed for runners of all ages and experience levels.

The day starts with a scenic run through Hansen Dam followed by an all-day pool party and community celebration featuring music, aquatic activities, vendors, raffles, and free access to the Hansen Dam Aquatic Center.

🌞 EVENT SCHEDULE

🕢 7:30 AM — Registration & Check-In Opens
Arrive early, grab your bib, explore vendor booths, and get warmed up for the morning ahead.

🎧 8:00 AM — DJ & Music Begins
Energy goes up as our DJs get runners and spectators hyped at the starting line and throughout the event.

🎤 8:45 AM — Opening Remarks & National Anthem
Join us at the main stage as we officially kick off the inaugural Splash & Dash.

🏃 9:00 AM — 1K Fun Run Starts
Perfect for youth, families, and first-time runners.

🏅 9:30 AM — 5K Race Starts
Hit the course for the main event through Hansen Dam Recreation Area.

💦 10:00 AM — Pool Party & Aquatic Activities Open
The race turns into a summer celebration with free pool access and activities throughout the Aquatic Center.

❤️ 10:30 AM — Hands-On CPR Demonstrations
Learn valuable water safety and emergency response skills.

🚣 10:30 AM — Learn to Kayak & Surf
Try beginner-friendly aquatic recreation activities led by instructors.

🤽 10:30 AM — Splash Ball Tournament
Jump into the action in the Zero-Entry Zone.

🎟️ 1:30 PM — Closing Celebration & Raffles
Stick around for giveaways, prizes, and a fun sendoff to cap off the day.

More than just a race, the Splash & Dash supports Citywide Aquatics programs that help provide affordable swim lessons, water safety education, and expanded access to aquatic recreation for youth and families across Los Angeles. By participating, you’re helping ensure more Angelenos can safely enjoy pools, lakes, and beaches throughout the summer season.

Hosted by the Los Angeles Parks Foundation in partnership with the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks, the Hansen Dam Splash 'n' Dash aims to become a new annual tradition celebrating movement, wellness, and the power of public spaces to bring communities together. Thank you to our generous sponsors for making this race happen!

name: Harvest Hustle – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
It's the Harvest Hustle, let's boogie! Welcome to our beautiful course at Hansen Dam Recreational Area!

Details

Start Location: Hansen Dam Recreation Area Ranger Station, 11770 Foothill Blvd., Lake View Terrace, CA
Parking: There are multiple free parking lots near the start

Event Schedule

6:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Course

5k & 10k – this 5k route is used for the 5k (done once), 10k (done twice)
Half Marathon – this 4.4-mile route is used for the half marathon (done 3 times)

More About the Course: This is an out and back course. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations along the way.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Email us at events@hightideruns.com

name: Hauntington Park 5K 2026
description:
Huntington Park Run Club is thrilled to announce that registration is now open for our 3rd Annual Hauntington Park 5K/1K!

Join us on Wednesday, October 28th, 2026 for a 5K/1K costume run through the haunted streets of Huntington Park. Start/finish is at Salt Lake Park (3401 E. Florence Ave. Huntington Park, CA 90255). Post-race festivities at Art Space HP!

Kids 1K: FREE for kids 12 and under. Must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. All kids ages 6-12 must be registered with adult. After the 1K run, kids and parents/guardians will be safely escorted to Art Space HP across the street (3382 E Florence Ave, Huntington Park, CA 90255) for spooky evening of arts, crafts, movie, popcorn, candy, and more! 

5K: $25 donation for big kids 13 and over. Includes shirt and medal! Students 13-17 need parental permission to register and must run with adult pacer. All runners must sign liability waiver.

Same day bib pick-up starts at 5:30pm (early bib pick-up information will be sent via e-mail)
Kids 1K starts at 6:00pm
5K run starts at 6:30pm

Please register by Sunday, October 18, 2026 at 11:59pm (PST).

Costumes are highly encouraged. Best costume that is bright, visible, and well-lit gets a GRAND PRIZE! Please note: Race will not be timed and there will be no official street closures. Runners will run on sidewalks and obey all traffic laws.

name: Healthy Kids Running Series Fall 2026 - South Orange County, CA
description:
Who We Are: Healthy Kids Running Series is a five (5) week running program in the spring and fall for kids Pre-K through 8th grade. Each HKRS Series takes place once a week and offers age-appropriate running events including the 50 & 75 yard dashes, the 1/4 mile, the 1/2 mile and the 1 mile run. Kids will earn points for each race they complete based on their finish.

Pricing: The registration fee covers the entire five (5) weeks of the Series which includes race bibs for each week, a runner shirt, a finisher medal and any sponsor giveaways. Registration is non-refundable and non-transferable. Online Early Bird registration increases three weeks prior to the first race event. 

High School: We also welcome our high school runners! Our high school students will be running a 2 mile race. 

Challenger: This Series offers a Challenger Division which is an adaptive 75 yard race for children with disabilities and/or special needs. This allows for parents, siblings, and friends to be on the course with runners to provide support as well as bringing their own supportive devices such as crutches, braces, wheelchairs, etc. to be used by runners. 

Makeup Date Information: 11/22/2026

Single Day Racing: Single day registration opens 1 hour before each race and must be completed onsite. The fee covers one race only. Single day participants are not eligible for series scoring, overall results, or an event T-shirt. Participants may upgrade to the full series to receive scoring and a T-shirt for races after the upgrade. Upgrade instructions can be found HERE.

Awards: All participants receive a medal on Week 5! Trophies will be awarded to the overall top finishers in each of the divisions listed below (broken out by boys and girls respectively): 

Pre-K 50 Yard Dash

Pre-K 75 Yard Dash  

Kindergarten & 1st Grade

2nd & 3rd Grade   

4th & 5th Grade  

6th to 8th Grade    

High School 

Challenger

Share your running photos with our community! Find us on Facebook @HealthyKidsRunning or Instagram @healthykidsrs! 

#GetUpandGo

description:
❤️ Heart & Sole 5K • 10K • Half Marathon

Saturday, February 7, 2027
5400 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, California

Celebrate movement, community, and love for the run at the Heart & Sole Run, set along the stunning Long Beach coastline. This Valentine’s-themed event is about more than romance—it’s about loving your body, your miles, and the community that shows up beside you.

Whether you’re running solo, with friends, or alongside your favorite people, choose from a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon on a flat, fast, and scenic coastal course with ocean views and nonstop good vibes.

🕕 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times


Registration Opens:
6:00 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:

Half Marathon: 7:00 AM


5K & 10K: 8:00 AM

 

🏁 What You Get
Professional chip timing
Heart & Sole–themed finisher medal for every participant
Free race-day photos
Live DJ & finish-line festival atmosphere
Overall & age-group awards
On-course water stations
Clearly marked course & experienced race staff
Stroller-friendly & walker-friendly event


This is a high-energy race experience designed to feel welcoming, fun, and well-run—whether it’s your first race or your fiftieth.

❤️ Finish With Heart
Heart & Sole is about starting your day with intention, finishing strong, and leaving with your heart full and your sole proud.

Join us and run with heart.

name: Heart of Cool Trail Run
description:
Are you looking for a fun run for a great cause? If so, HoC 5k, 10k and half marathon is just what you are looking for!  Net proceeds from this race support programs funded through Georgetown Divide Ready by 21, Inc. (GDRB21).  It is a nonprofit organization that brings together committed partners who understand youth development and are moving forward to support the youth in our community. We work with many partners throughout the Georgetown Divide and El Dorado county. In addition, a percentage of the funds will also be used to scholarship a child to attend Camp Taylor, a camp specifically designed for youth with heart disease. 

55 shirts on hand for registrants.  Some sizes are sold out, but we still have some available.  All half marathon participants receive a custom HoC pair of socks!  

This is a family friendly event and we highly encourage you to bring the whole family!  We offer a family discount package for immediate family members for the 5k and 10k distance!  If you want to participate in the event without your child, take advantage of our $8 per child - child care for children ages 3 and up!  We will have a post race pancake breakfast. 

The Heart of Cool Trail Run traverses some of the best trails Cool, CA and the Sierra Foothills have to offer.  Run on the same trails as many of the famous local (and world renowned) events such as Western States 100 Mile, Way too Cool 50k, Rio Del Lago 100 Mile, and many more!

To reduce waste and the possibility of littering our trails, this will be a cup free event.  Be sure to bring a cup or water bottle that can be refilled at aid stations.

Packet and bib pick up will be on Race Day.

Registration will be available online until the start of each event!

We can always use volunteers for this event. If you are able to lend a hand during the race, or the day before, please click on the Volunteer tab.

name: Her Fall Forward 5K
description: The Her Fall Forward 5K Run is more than just a race. It’s a chance to come together and support women and girls in our community. HerVoiceDoesMatter is partnering with Skedaddle to host this event to raise awareness, hope, and remind every woman and girl that their voice matters. HerVoiceDoesMatter is a nonprofit student-led organization that empowers women and girls through support, education, and community programs. A portion of the money raised from this event will be donated to local women and children's shelters to help provide safe housing, food, clothing, and other important resources for families in need. By signing up and participating, you're helping make a real difference and showing support for those who need it most.

HearAid Foundation presents our 6th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 15th on the water front, behind the aquarium, in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. All participants who register by July 25th are guaranteed to receive a t-shirt, and ALL participants are guaranteed to have lots of fun!

Join us for an exhilarating run through the marina and along the shore with views of the Queen Mary in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the shoreline.

Event Details:

Location: Shoreline Aquatic Park, 200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

Race Day Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8:00 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Parking Available a short walk away at the multi-level aquarium parking lot. Fees in the lot are by the hour, click this link for more details.


Course Map: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6274860286/

Course Description:

The race starts and ends behind the aquarium, next to Pierpont Landing.

5k runners will follow the scenic path around along the marina, through Shoreline Village and out along the jetty where you will have a majestic view of the Queen Mary before heading back to the start.

Water station will be at the entrance to the jetty and you can stop here twice during the run/walk if you need to.

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff.

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 12 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!
We look forward to seeing you in Long Beach for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: HIKE SANTA MARGARITA TRAIL
description:
Escape Into Nature This October! 

Join us for an unforgettable fall adventure on the Santa Margarita Trail in San Diego!

Experience one of Southern California's scenic hikes as we wander through beautiful oak groves, cross the Santa Margarita River, and enjoy crisp October weather. This 5.3-mile hike is considered easy to moderate and is good for beginners too.

name: Hike: Potato Chip Rock
description:
7.5 miles out and back | Hard Difficulty | Elevation Gain 2,130 feet | City of Poway, CA

Start the year with a climb and a view! Join us for a 7-mile challenging scenic hike up Mount Woodson to the iconic Potato Chip Rock — one of San Diego’s most famous photo spots. We’ll take in stunning lake and mountain views, get some fresh air, and snap a few fun photos at the top. 

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone. 

pick up locations are below: please register by the day before and we will contact you with further instructions . 

QZONE NAB LIBERTY CENTER NAVAL Amphibious BASE: 3632 Tulagi Rd bldg 337, Coronado, CA 92118  at 930AM

VADM MARTIN LIBERTY CENTER NASNI BASE : 1507 Rogers Rd, Coronado, CA 92118 at 950AM

name: Hollywood Sign Run | Hike - 8M | 8K | 5K | Kid
description:
Experience the thrill of the Hollywood Sign Run/Hike in Griffith Park—now featuring a scenic out-and-back course to the Hollywood Sign Viewpoint! Take in sweeping views of Downtown Los Angeles, the Griffith Observatory, and a stunning close-up of the world-famous Hollywood Sign.
Whether you're a seasoned trail runner or a hiking enthusiast, this event offers an unforgettable adventure for all levels. Traverse iconic trails, soak in the natural beauty of the park, and connect with fellow outdoor lovers along the way.
Challenge yourself, take in the views, and be part of an inspiring day in one of L.A.’s most legendary landscapes.
 
All participants receive the following items and perks:
  • Picturesque, scenic, and well marked out and back courses
  • Panoramic views of the Observatory, Downtown Los Angeles, and an up close view of the Hollywood Sign (8M Only)
  • Stunning views of Glendale, DreamWorks Campus, and the Los Angeles River
  • Ultra-soft, ultra-comfy premium short sleeve t-shirt*
  • Unique Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Special award for Overall and Age Grade Division Winners
  • Prize from our sponsors for overall winners
  • Free Photos (w/ Mt. Lee and the Hollywood Sign, the Observatory, and DTLA, 8M Only)
  • Fast and accurate chip time results
  • Course Aid Stations (1-4) with medical staff
  • Volunteer Support
  • Gear check
  • Finish Line Fruit, Snacks, and Refreshments
  • Music, DJ and MC
  • Flexible deferral and transfer options
 
*Guaranteed T-Shirt Size Deadline is January 5th, Men or Women's cut
