name: Hop Skip and Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk
description:
Hop, Skip & Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk

Making Waves for Water Safety in Orange County

Join us on Sunday, October 25, 2026, for the 4th annual Hop, Skip & Splash 5K — a fun, family-friendly beachside fundraiser benefiting swim lessons and water safety education for children throughout Orange County and beyond.

Last year we welcomed 200 participants and raised $30,000 to expand access for local families! 

Your $50 registration covers swim lessons for one child. This is the average cost of 4-8 classes at a local city or county pool. Whether you run, walk, or skip across the finish line, your participation helps save lives by supporting families who lack access to these life-saving resources!

Stay Up to Date and Follow Along

@hopskipsplash5k

Race Details: 

  • Location: Beach parking lot at PCH and Huntington Street
  • Check-in opens at 8:00am (Free coffee provided!)
  • Race starts at 9:00am
  • Scenic coastal course with ocean views

What to Expect:

  • Event T-shirt included with registration 
  • Register by October 4 to guarantee your T-Shirt size
  • Stroller-friendly course
  • Dogs welcome on the boardwalk (not on the sand)
  • This is not a timed race, but 1st-3rd place finishers will receive a prize! 

Post Race Activities:

  • Free pancake breakfast from Huntington Beach Firefighters
  • Live music from Crew-52, our local HB Lifeguard Band
  • Fun activities for kids
  • Raffles
  • Vendor Village
  • Meet real Olympians!

Team Registration: Get $10 off when you grab your friends, family and/or coworkers- it's more fun together! 

  • Teams include 2 or more participants
  • Create or join a team during registration
  • The first team member to register will be reimbursed once another member joins
  • Great for schools, businesses and community groups! 

Virtual Runners: Can't make it in person? You can still be part of the impact! 

  • Complete your 5k wherever you are
  • Optional event T-shirt with shipping available
  • Run, Walk or skip on your own time while supporting water safety!
  • Take a photo and tag us on Instagram @hopskipsplash5k

Parking Information:

  • Enter via PCH and Beach Blvd
  • Parking available on-site in the city lot next to the event ($10-$15)

Sponsorship Opportunities Available
Interested in supporting the event or promoting your organization?
Email info@jasperray.org for details

This event is proudly presented by the Jasper Ray Foundation in partnership with the Orange County Drowning Prevention Coalition.
Together, we’re working to ensure every child in Orange County and beyond has access to life-saving swim lessons and water safety education.

Questions?
Contact us at info@jasperray.org

Jasper Ray Foundation

  • Fun activities for kids
  • Raffles
  • Vendor Village
  • Meet real Olympians!

name: Hope in Every Step 5k
description:
Join us for the Hope in Every Step 5K Run/Walk, a community-driven event dedicated to spreading hope, resilience, and support for those in need. Whether you're a seasoned runner or taking your first steps toward a healthier lifestyle, this event is for everyone!

 

Set against the beautiful trails of East La Loma, participants will run or walk a 3.1-mile course filled with encouragement, camaraderie, and a spirit of togetherness. Every step taken represents strength, perseverance, and the collective power of hope.

 

Proceeds from the event will benefit Sole Support. Gather your friends and family, lace up your running shoes, and be part of a movement that turns every stride into a symbol of hope!

name: Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K
description:
Join us for our 9th Doggie Dash - the Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K! Run (or walk) with your pup to help LA Frontrunners raise funds for Patrick's Pet Pantry & Angel City Pit Bulls!  All the details are below.  Pets are such a vital part of so many of our lives, so come race your heart out or take a stroll, and help us support two organizations whose missions are to care for pets in need and to make sure those who are struggling are able to care for and have their pets in their lives.

Location & Date
The Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K takes place on Saturday, October 31, in Griffith Park. Doggie Dash 5K starts at 8:30.  The start/finish area is the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park. The 5K is one loop around the golf course and is trail/packed dirt and flat.

Course & Race Info
The start/finish area for Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K is in the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park (diagonally across from the Griffith Park Visitor Center/Ranger Station). Look for us on the corner before the tennis courts.  This is also the standard Saturday meet-up location for LA Frontrunners.The 5K is one loop around the golf course. If this is your first 5K, 5 kilometers = 3.1 miles. The path is packed dirt and flat.

Start time is 8:30 AM - Pups & Human 5K: The main event is a 5K for pups (on leash) with their human. No solo humans allowed! But one lucky pup can be registered with more than one human. Our race limit is 100 entries and there is no raceday registration. You can fly as fast as your pup pulls you or leisurely stroll the 5K around the golf course. There will be a water stop (for both you and your pup) about halfway through the 5K.

Doggie Howl-o-ween Costume Contest
Of course there's a costume contest! With prizes!

Beneficiaries
Patrick's Little Free Pet Pantry: A free pet pantry to ease the stress of those struggling to feed their beloved pets 🩷.  Click HERE for Patrick's Pet Pantry.

Angel City Pit Bulls:  Angel City Pit Bulls takes in dogs (mainly from our local shelters) that fall under the generic term pit bull who demonstrate people-soft, responsive qualities and solid temperaments. Their adorableness and gushy love of people make them fantastic family dogs. We have a wide range of energy levels, so whether you are looking for a running partner or a potential “therapy dog”, we will typically have a dog that will fit the bill.  Click HERE for angelcitypits.org.

Pups & Human 5K Awards
Overall awards to the top 3 by gender of the human: female/pup, male/pup, nb/pup.  "Age Group" categories are determined by the weight of the pup. Awards will be given to the top 3 overall pups across all divisions. Division awards are top 3 in the following categories: TOY: up to 12 lbs., SMALL: 13 to 25 lbs., MEDIUM: 26 to 50 lbs., LARGE: 51 to 75 lbs., XL: 75+ lbs.

Race Day Registration & Packet Pick-Up
There is NO RACEDAY REGISTRATION. Online registration will close at sell-out. Packet pick up will be race morning starting at 7:30 AM. 

Past Results & Free Past Pix
For past results/info, please click HERE.  For free pix, please click HERE.

About LA Frontrunners
Los Angeles Frontrunners (501c3) is a running and walking club for members and friends of the LGBTQ+ community.  In addition to running, walking, more running (and lots of eating), LAFR raises funds and collects goods to donate to local charities. Past beneficiaries include; The Rescue Train, Westside Food Bank, SRLA, PAWS/LA, Life Worth Saving, Friends of Griffith Park, InsideOut Community Arts, Friends of Project 10, Angel City Pit Bulls, The Breakfast Club at St. Thomas the Apostle, and the Don Thompson Scholarship at the USC Film School.

name: Howlin' Moon 2026
description:
CLAIRE LILIENTHAL SCHOOL
ANNUAL 5K • 2K • 1K FUN RUN
Saturday Oct 24 • Little Marina Green • San Francisco


The Howlin’ Moon is one of Claire Lilienthal’s favorite traditions—a morning when students, families, teachers, friends, and neighbors come together to run, walk, cheer, and celebrate our school community.

Whether you’re racing for a medal, jogging alongside your child, or joining the 1K just for fun, there’s a race for everyone.

Come for the run and stay for the fun! We’ll kick off the morning with a group warm-up, music, festivites and finish with snacks, celebrations, and our Howlin’ Moon awards ceremony.

RACE DAY SCHEDULE
8:30 AM • Check-in opens
9:30 AM • Group warm-up
10:00 AM • Races begin
11:15 AM-ish • Awards ceremony

CHOOSE YOUR RACE

🏃 1K FUN RUN • ALL AGES
Run, walk, skip, or stroll! The untimed 1K is all about getting outside, moving, and having fun together.
Open to all ages
Untimed and noncompetitive
Every finisher is celebrated!

🎖️ 2K TIMED RACE • STUDENTS K–8
Ready for a little friendly competition? The timed 2K gives Claire Lilienthal students the chance to race against their grade-level peers.Open to students in grades K–8
Medals awarded by grade
Parents and caregivers are welcome to run alongside their child but are not eligible for awards

🏅 5K TIMED RACE • ALL AGES
Take on the full 5K! Whether you’re chasing a personal best or simply looking for a beautiful run along the waterfront, this race is open to runners of all ages.
Open to students and adults
Student medals awarded by grade
Adult medals awarded by age group
_______________________________________________________________________________________

YOUR REGISTRATION INCLUDES

🌙 Entry into the race of your choice

👕 A limited-edition Howlin’ Moon T-shirt featuring artwork by Claire Lilienthal student and contest winner

🎗️ A participation ribbon for every runner

🏅 A chance to earn a medal for top finishers in the timed 2K and 5K races

Most importantly, your registration means being part of a Claire Lilienthal tradition that brings our community together for a morning of school spirit, movement, friendly competition, and fun.

READY TO RUN?
Register today and join us at Little Marina Green for the Howlin’ Moon! 🌙🏃

name: Huffin for the Stuffin- Turkey Trot  5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
🦃 3rd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’


5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash
📅 Saturday, November 14, 2026
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
🥧 Every Turkey Trot deserves a head start!

 

 
🏃‍♀️ Race Overview
Get ready to gobble, wobble, and trot your way down the scenic Long Beach shoreline!
The 2nd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’ is the perfect way to earn your pie early. Choose from the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and enjoy the ocean views, holiday tunes, and feel-good vibes that’ll have you running with gratitude (and maybe a little gravy).

Whether you’re chasing a PR, trotting with your flock, or just here for the snacks — this race is for every pace, every age, and every turkey-loving runner in between.

 
🎁 What You Get
🏅 Finisher Medal (because you cranberry-lieve you did it!)
📸 Free Race Day Photos
🎶 DJ + Finish Line Festival
🍪 Post-Race Snacks & Treats
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations
⏱ Chip Timing on a USATF-Certified Course
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards

 
🎭 Costume Contest – Bring the Holiday Heat!
Dress to impress the turkeys out of us!


Prize Categories:

Most Creative Costume
Best Group / Family Theme
Funniest Turkey-Inspired Look
Whether you’re rocking a full bird suit, a pilgrim hat, or just festive socks — come strut your stuffin’!

 
🕒 Race Day Schedule
Bib Pick-Up/Runner Check In: 6:00 AM – 8:00AM
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

 
🚗 Parking & Amenities
🅿️ Free Street Parking
💵 Beach Lot: $2/hour (via Passport app or pay station)
🚻 Restrooms Near Start Line
🚰 Water Stations Every 2 Miles
👶 Stroller & Walker Friendly
🏁 Fully Marked Scenic Course

 
☀️ Weather & Safety
This event is rain or shine — because turkeys don’t quit!
(We’ll only postpone for tsunamis, tidal waves, or a zombie turkey uprising 🧟‍♀️🦃 — you’ll get an email if that happens.)

 
🎉 Join the Flock!
Bring your crew, bring your feathers, and join us for a morning of miles, medals, and major gobbles!
Let’s make this the most festive trot on the coast.

🦃💨 Come Huff for the Stuff and Run for the Pie!

💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs. 🌊 We are not affiliated with any of them.


If you’re looking for an exceptional race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, well-organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow vibe, make sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.


If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an "average"race.. ❤️

📸 Free Race Day Photos
🎶 DJ + Finish Line Festival
🍪 Post-Race Snacks & Treats
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations
⏱ Chip Timing on a USATF-Certified Course
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards

 
🎭 Costume Contest – Bring the Holiday Heat!
Dress to impress the turkeys out of us!


Prize Categories:

Most Creative Costume
Best Group / Family Theme
Funniest Turkey-Inspired Look
Whether you’re rocking a full bird suit, a pilgrim hat, or just festive socks — come strut your stuffin’!

 
🕒 Race Day Schedule
Bib Pick-Up/Runner Check In: 6:00 AM – 8:00AM
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

 
🚗 Parking & Amenities
🅿️ Free Street Parking
💵 Beach Lot: $2/hour (via Passport app or pay station)
🚻 Restrooms Near Start Line

☀️ Weather & Safety
This event is rain or shine — because turkeys don’t quit!
(We’ll only postpone for tsunamis, tidal waves, or a zombie turkey uprising 🧟‍♀️🦃 — you’ll get an email if that happens.)

 
🎉 Join the Flock!
Bring your crew, bring your feathers, and join us for a morning of miles, medals, and major gobbles!
Let’s make this the most festive trot on the coast.

🦃💨 Come Huff for the Stuff and Run for the Pie!

💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs. 🌊 We are not affiliated with any of them.


If you’re looking for an exceptional race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, well-organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow vibe, make sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.


If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an "average"race.. ❤️

name: Hungry Dog Dash 2027
description:
Whether you are a serious distance runner or a casual weekend warrior, come join us for the 14th annual Hungry Dog Dash 5K run/walk on Sunday, February 7, 2027 at 8:30 a.m. The course will be fast, flat and beautiful as you run along one of San Diego’s most spectacular waterways in Liberty Station, Point Loma.

We look forward to once again hosting runners and walkers of all skill levels and ages at our USAT&F certified course and sanctioned event.

This race is very DOG FRIENDLY! Feel free to bring your leashed, four-legged running buddy to enjoy the run with you.

All proceeds from The Hungry Dog Dash fundraiser go to the Point Loma High School Cross Country Team.  The event also helps raise awareness with younger students in the community about the PLHS running program. We hope you will join us for this community and family event promoting fitness and healthy lifestyles! Finish line activities will include live music, food, drinks, a local business vendor village and fun for everyone.

Please note: The deadline for us to order t-shirts is JANUARY 25, 2027. After that date we cannot guarantee shirts &/or sizes.

Thank you for your support!

PACKET PICK UP INFORMATION  Race packet pick-up is on Saturday, February 6th from 11:00am-2:00pm.  Packet pick up will be at Road Runner Sports located at 5553 Copley Drive, San Diego CA 92111. Each Packet picked up at Road Runner Sports earns PLHS $1.50!

https://stores.roadrunnersports.com/ca/sandiego/running-shoe-store-101.html

We strongly encourage participants to pick up bibs on Saturday to avoid long lines on race day.  If you registered after the guaranteed t-shirt deadline on 1/25, you have a better chance of getting a shirt on Saturday. 

If picking up your packet on race day, please give yourself ample time.

name: Hunter's Heart Foundation - A World Beyond Wheels 5K Walk, Run, Ride 2026
description:
HUNTER’S HEART FOUNDATION - A WORLD BEYOND WHEELS 5K

Join us for a fun and meaningful 5k run/walk as we raise critical funds to fight Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD).  DMD is a debilitating genetic disorder that weakens muscles over time. Children with DMD face a daily battle, and research for a cure is ongoing.  This 5k is your chance to make a difference! Portion of the proceeds from the race will benefit CureDuchenne, a non-profit organization dedicated to research and finding a cure for DMD

WHEN: Saturday, September 19, 2026, 10:00 am-1:00 pm

WHERE: Whittier Narrow Recreation Center, 750 S. Santa Anita Ave., South El Monte, CA 91733

How you can support: 

·       Register for the walk 

·       Create your own Champion peer-to- peer group and invite 5 or more people to raise $100 each.  

·       Donate to make a difference

·       Sponsorship available

You will receive Team/Sponsorship recognition showcasing participation on Hunter's Heart Foundation and CureDuchenne website and social media platforms.

Here's why you should participate: It's a great way to get active and have fun! Whether you're a seasoned runner or a casual walker, this event is for everyone.

You'll be making a real difference in the lives of children with DMD. Your participation will help fund critical research and program support.  It's a family-friendly event! Bring your whole crew to cheer you on and enjoy the festivities.  Register today and help us run towards a cure for DMD!!!!

REGISTRATION: 9:00AM

RACE STARTS:   10:00AM

Visit our website at www.hhdmd.org for additional information.

name: Huntington Lake Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the Huntington Lake triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Pancake breakfast
+ Rosa Brother's Chocolate Milk
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Complimentary Race Photos

The Huntington Lake Triathlon is a fun and challenging race in an incredible location in Lakeshore, CA near the China Peak Resort. This event features a lake swim in Huntington Lake, a challenging road bike course, and a ‘high altitude’ run, which is part trail and part paved, finishes the race. Each athlete registered for the Huntington Lake Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

Note: A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

Parking: There is a $10 vehicle entrance fee.  We recommend car pooling if possible.

Volunteer: Earn a future discounted multisport or free run! Transferable and never expires.

name: Indio Veterans Day 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
This Veteran's Day 5K & 10K Run/Walk is to honor and support the brave men and women who served our country. This family-friendly event is great for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities, offering a course through an area of the Empire Polo. Come join us in this event as we celebrate veterans' service and sacrifice. 

Participants will receive a commemorative t-shirt and a portion of the proceeds will benefit Hunter Lopez Memorial Foundation. This event will also feature a pre-race celebration with refreshments, music, and a special ceremony to honor our veterans. name: Infinite Challenge Run
description:
A special running festival is coming to LA, featuring the beloved members of Korea’s iconic variety show, Infinite Challenge. As the first global expansion of Infinite Challenge RUN, following successful events in Seoul and Busan, participants can choose between a 5K Fun Run and a 10K Race through the San Pedro waterfront.

Centered around West Harbor, the festival offers interactive activities along the course, a vibrant waterfront atmosphere, and a post-race concert featuring Infinite Challenge members and K-pop artists.

Join us in celebrating the 250th anniversary of the United States and the 50th anniversary of the Korean Bell of Friendship for a day of running, laughter, and unforgettable memories.

name: Inland Valley Turkey Trot
description:

  • 10-K

name: Intermediate Sailing: November 14/15
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 5 hours of sail time is required post beginner sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The course will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

name: Intermediate Sailing: October 10/11
description:

description:

name: Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
description:
Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
Thursday, November 26th, 2026
Thanksgiving Day
Irvine Valley College

THERE IS AN AWESOME CUSTOM CAST FINISHER MEDAL awaiting ALL you!  Choices of designs when you finish. A great race bib.  And the perfect Turkey designed, fun event shirt. 

7:30 am Turkey Feast Combo 1 Mile and 5k

8:00 am 5k Turkey Trot Race   

9:10 am Kids Gobble Wobble Races Start

(DO NOT MISS THESE START TIMES! Plan to arrive early as it takes time to park.

You MUST pass under the start arch by 8:12 .  

Two New Race Choices!  Choose the best race for you and earn a custom finishers medal and slice of fresh pumpkin pie!
Run fast, jog, trot, walk, or enjoy a nice stroll on this flat scenic course.  A scrumptious SLICE OF PIE awaits you at the finish. Along with So Cal's best custom cast finisher medal, you get an awesome shirt and CHIP TIMED.  Get your friends and family together and kick off the holidays together!   Guaranteed to be a picture perfect way to start celebrating THANKSGIVING DAY!

Run up a mini appetite with our family friendly 1 Mile or kick it up a notch with our 5k.  For those who plan to really indulge your can double down and enter our Turkey Feast Combo and run the 1 Mile and the 5k back to back!  This flat, friendly course is walker friendly and stroller ready.  Come out and see why it's become a holiday tradition for thousands of people !

We'll DECK out your Thanksgiving trimmings with:

*. Awesome Custom Cast Medals.
*. Soft Comfy event shirts for all.
*. Tasty pumpkin pie at the finish.
*. Custom Race bibs.
*  Chip timing by Itz About Time. 
*. Division awards for top three male and female in each age division. 5 year age spans from 10 & under to 80 & over!
*. Trophies for top three overall finishers male and female.
*. Holiday Expo to jump start your shopping.

1 Mile Turkey Dash:  7:30am Start.  This division is a fun run/ walk and non timed event.  This is great start for those who want a shorter distance to keep their whole tribe together.  It’s and out and back course so you’ll see everyone both directions!   If you skip ogot to skip out quick then come on out for this one and earn some fast bling with a fantastic medal for everyone who finishes.  ALL ONE MILERS MUST WEAR ONLY the 1 Mile bib while running the 1 Mile.  DO NOT WEAR the 5K BIB. 

IRVINE/OC 5k Turkey TROT:  8:00am Start.  This is open to all ages and takes place around the perimeter of the college campus.  It's a speedy course that swings by citrus grove tree's and some pumpkin patches!  it starts and finishes in the same spot so you won't miss seeing your friends somewhere along the way!  

Turkey Feast Combo:  7:30am Start.  This is for the those who like extra helpings at Thanksgiving!  We love this challenge!  Each participant will start at 7:30 with the 1 mile race.  You'll need to complete the 1 mile in 30 minutes so you'll have time to line up for your second race, the 5k at 8am.  You’ll receive 1 shirt and two medals if you complete both races!  Rally up!  You may pick up your 1 mile medal after your 5k race so you don't have to run with it!

Gobble Wobble Kids Event:  These kids races offer shorter distances if they don't want to do the 5k.

 9:15 A.M:  Diaper Dash - 50 yards (3 and under)
9:20 A.M:  Tot Trot  - 100 yards (4 to 5 years old)
9:25 A.M: Youth Race -1/4 Mile (6 to 10 years old)
9:28 A.M: Youth Race - Half Mile (11 to 12 years old) 

 Adults, you may run along with your child.

Kid's Gobble Wobble Race Details

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. They can turn early if they want with no penalty if they think it's too far.  One adult per child can run with their participant and the parent does not have to register but will not receive the shirt, medal, bib or pie. 

If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling! 

Costume Awards will be given for Best Dressed so come decked out and you may take home a prize! Win as an individual or a group (6 people max)!

Early Packet Pick Up: Optional

Packet Pick up will be held on Wednesday, November 25th from 12 pm to 4pm at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills.
24291 Avenida De La Carlota; Suite P-5; Laguna Hills, CA 92653  (plan on this day to being a heavy traffic day, give extra time to arrive)

Pick up your bib and shirt  at packet pick up or on race morning at the race from 6:30am to 7:30am
One person can pick up for others.  No confirmation required.  Just know the last and first name they signed up under. 
Walk up registration accepted at early packet pick and on race day morning.
Shirts and Shirts sizes are not guaranteed for race day late registration.

Race Day Pick Up:

You may pick up your race bib and t-shirt on race day from 6:15 am to 7:30 am. In the quad, in front of the performance arts theater. That's the big two story orange building on the Irvine Valley College campus.

Parking:  Cost is $5.  Entrance is off of Irvine Center and  allowed on Jeffrey .Entrance closed on Irvine Center Drive at 7:55am. It's part of the course).  Only the entrances on Jeffrey stay open during the run . If parking in the solar lot, you will not be able to leave the lot until 9am. You will need to exit off Lasar Way and wait until directed to cross the race course as stragglers will still be coming in.

YOU MUST purchase a  PARKING PASS.  PUT ON YOUR DASH.  THIS CAN BE DONE ONLINE, AT PACKET PICK UP, OR b y buying at the PARKING PASS BOTH at registration on RACE MORNING.  THE CAMPUS PD charge  for every vehicle and look for the passes.  ( This parking fee is required on entering and parking at any local college).

Takes place wind, rain, or shine.

FAQ's
 Are dogs allowed? Due to college's policy, dogs are not allowed on the run course.

IRVINE/OC 5k Turkey TROT:  8:00am Start.  This is open to all ages and takes place around the perimeter of the college campus.  It's a speedy course that swings by citrus grove tree's and some pumpkin patches!  it starts and finishes in the same spot so you won't miss seeing your friends somewhere along the way!  

Turkey Feast Combo:  7:30am Start.  This is for the those who like extra helpings at Thanksgiving!  We love this challenge!  Each participant will start at 7:30 with the 1 mile race.  You'll need to complete the 1 mile in 30 minutes so you'll have time to line up for your second race, the 5k at 8am.  You’ll receive 1 shirt and two medals if you complete both races!  Rally up!  You may pick up your 1 mile medal after your 5k race so you don't have to run with it!

Gobble Wobble Kids Event:  These kids races offer shorter distances if they don't want to do the 5k.

 9:15 A.M:  Diaper Dash - 50 yards (3 and under)
9:20 A.M:  Tot Trot  - 100 yards (4 to 5 years old)
9:25 A.M: Youth Race -1/4 Mile (6 to 10 years old)
9:28 A.M: Youth Race - Half Mile (11 to 12 years old) 

 Adults, you may run along with your child.

Kid's Gobble Wobble Race Details

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling! 

Costume Awards will be given for Best Dressed so come decked out and you may take home a prize! Win as an individual or a group (6 people max)!

Early Packet Pick Up: Optional

Packet Pick up will be held on Wednesday, November 25th from 12 pm to 4pm at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills.
24291 Avenida De La Carlota; Suite P-5; Laguna Hills, CA 92653  (plan on this day to being a heavy traffic day, give extra time to arrive)

Pick up your bib and shirt  at packet pick up or on race morning at the race from 6:30am to 7:30am
One person can pick up for others.  No confirmation required.  Just know the last and first name they signed up under. 
Walk up registration accepted at early packet pick and on race day morning.
Shirts and Shirts sizes are not guaranteed for race day late registration.

Race Day Pick Up:

You may pick up your race bib and t-shirt on race day from 6:15 am to 7:30 am. In the quad, in front of the performance arts theater. That's the big two story orange building on the Irvine Valley College campus.

Parking:  Cost is $5.  Entrance is off of Irvine Center and  allowed on Jeffrey .Entrance closed on Irvine Center Drive at 7:55am. It's part of the course).  Only the entrances on Jeffrey stay open during the run . If parking in the solar lot, you will not be able to leave the lot until 9am. You will need to exit off Lasar Way and wait until directed to cross the race course as stragglers will still be coming in.

YOU MUST purchase a  PARKING PASS.  PUT ON YOUR DASH.  THIS CAN BE DONE ONLINE, AT PACKET PICK UP, OR b y buying at the PARKING PASS BOTH at registration on RACE MORNING.  THE CAMPUS PD charge  for every vehicle and look for the passes.  ( This parking fee is required on entering and parking at any local college).

Takes place wind, rain, or shine.

 Are dogs allowed? Due to college's policy, dogs are not allowed on the run course.

name: Isnt She Lovely Lowrider Run
description:
Event Description


We are back San Diego! We invite you to join us for our Isn't She Lovely Lowrider Run. Cruise along the lake, feel the cool ocean breeze, and soak in the scenery as you run, jog, or walk with our community. This is more than a race—it’s a celebration of movement, connection, and good vibes.

🏁 Isn't She Lovely Lowrider Run/Walk 5K / 10K / 1 Mile Walk
📍 De Anza Cove Park
3000 N Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

This event brings together community. Friends and families are encouraged to come out and enjoy the day—everyone is welcome!

Come cruise the course and celebrate in-style.🔥 Lowrider fans—this one’s for you! Cross the finish line strong. We cant wait to see you.

Packet Includes 💖

Registration Entree / 2D Medal

🗓️ Event Details

⏰ 6:20 AM – Registration Opens

🏃‍♂️ 7:10 AM – 10K Starts
🏃‍♀️ 8:10 AM – 5K Starts

🏃‍♀️ 8:20 AM - 1 Mile Walk 

( 🏆   First place medals for First,Second,Third F/M Per Distance )

⏱️ 10:00 AM – Event Closes

🗺️ Course Instructions                

5K:

Out-and-back course
• Complete the route 1 time (1X)

10K:

• Follows the same 5K route
• Complete the course 2 times (2X)

1 Mile : Out and Back 1 X 

REMINDER — PLEASE USE CAUTION:

The walking/running path is open to the public. Please use caution and be mindful of walkers, runners, and other park visitors.

Thank you for your cooperation!

Please follow all course signage and volunteer directions for a safe and smooth race experience.

⏱️📸 Timing, Results & Photos

• This event is gun-timed ( Race bib needs to be visible in the front ) 
• Race bibs are not chip-timed

Results will be uploaded by  6 PM 

Photos will be uploaded Same Day by 7 PM 

 

LEGACY RUNNER

Here’s how it works:

🏁 2027 LOWRIDER CHALLENGE IS HERE FOR ANYONE THAT WANTS TO BE A LEGACY RUNNER ! 🏁

🏃🏽‍♀️ Register and participate in 3 out of 4 Lowrider events throughout 2027.

🏅 Once you complete your 3rd event, you’ll receive an additional surprise Lowrider Challenge Medal, custom-made exclusively for participants who complete 3 events and officially become a Legacy Runner for 2027.

✨ On your 3rd event you will receive 2 Medals this special medal will be separate from your regular event finisher medal and will only be awarded to those who complete 3 out of the 4 events.

name: Jakes & Del Mar Lifeguard Association Fun Run/Walk
description: Bring the family to the beach in front of Jakes and enjoy an easy 5K run /walk. Prizes for 1st place Female, Male, Youngest, Oldest and Stroller finishers. All finishers will enjoy a light lunch and beverages and will receive a  Commemorative Tee Shirt for their efforts. Bring some cash to participate in the 50/50 raffle. All proceeds to benefit the Del Mar Lifeguard Association ( a 501 (C) (3) nonprofit ) in their efforts to promote beach and ocean safety through outreach, education and training.

name: Jed & Ted’s Bill & Ted’s Excellent Race 5K & 10K
description:
Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races.

Be excellent to each other...and then race!

Join us for a most triumphant 5K and 10K inspired by one of the Valley’s most excellent adventures. Expect a fast, flat course along the Los Angeles River, totally bodacious throwback music, themed signs, costumes, custom finisher medals, and plenty of opportunities to party on.

name: Jessie’s 45th Bday 5k Run/Walk
description:
🎉🏃‍♀️ JESSIE’S 45TH BIRTHDAY 5K RUN / WALK 🏃‍♂️🎉

Come celebrate my 45th birthday with me the best way possible — with a fun 5K Run / Walk with friends and family! ❤️

📅 Saturday, January 9, 2027
⏰ 9:00 AM
📍 Alameda — Bay Farm Ferry to Bay Farm Bridge
🏃‍♀️ 5K Run / Walk

name: Jingle Bell Jog – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Jingle Bell, Jingle Bell, Jingle Bell Jog!

Join us at Alamitos Beach this December for the Jingle Bell Jog, a holly jolly celebration of festive vibes, ocean views, and merry miles. Whether you’re racing to sleigh your PR or just dashing through the sand with bells on, this cheerful coastal run is the perfect way to wrap up your year with some holiday sparkle.

It's the holiday season so dress with flair! We love to see the festive apparel you wear!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the local lots is usually $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free but limited.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: This route is used for the half marathon – 5m route (twice), 5k route (once)

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: JINGLE PAWS 5K & ELF DASH
description:
A Holiday Tradition, Revamped & Better Than Ever!


Get ready for a bigger, better Jingle Paws 5K! This beloved holiday tradition is getting a fresh new experience at Ruth Hardy Park in
Palm Springs, with more activities, more family fun, and even more ways to celebrate while supporting the life-changing mission of Guide Dogs of the Desert.

Whether you run, walk, stroll, or bring your four-legged friend along, Jingle Paws is a festive morning for the entire community. Enjoy a 5K run/walk, holiday cheer, activities for kids, opportunities to meet our team and dogs, and plenty of reasons to jingle all the way!

Each registered 5K participant will receive a commemorative Jingle Paws race shirt, and participants can purchase a Santa suit through our event store for an extra dose of holiday spirit.

More to Experience This Year! 🐕‍🦺
Jingle Paws is more than a race! Stick around after crossing the finish line and enjoy everything our revamped event has to offer:

🏅 Awards for top runners
👕 Commemorative race shirts
🎄 Puppy Play Kids Zone
🐾 Meet our puppy trainers
🦮 Meet a real Guide Dog in Training and learn about the training journey
🐶 Dog-friendly festivities
✨ Holiday fun for the whole family

Something for Every Age! 🎅
Children under 4 participate FREE, making it even easier to bring the whole family along for the holiday fun!

name: Jolly10K
description: At the Jolly10k you'll take a 10K or a 5K run or walk, through stunning Los Gatos mountain trails and arrive back at the finish line to enjoy fun, food and fellowship. We have informational booths, a variety of resource tables, CPR training by the Los Gatos Fire Dept. We definitely have fun, but the reason we gather for the Jolly10k is to create a safe environment to have the difficult conversations about addiction and the deadly epidemic of Fentanyl that has flooded our country and stolen far too many young lives. Together, we remember our loved ones and share life-saving information on how to prevent the next life lost from being someone in your family.

name: Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run
description:
Get ready to join the fun as we roll out the Second Annual Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run - a fun and scenic adventure along the empty Kaweah Lake Bottom! After an incredible sold-out inaugural race (two weeks early!), we're thrilled to welcome back our runners for another unforgettable day on the trails.

Enjoy breathtaking views, perfect fall weather (God willing), and a friendly community atmosphere as you take on either the 5K or 10K course. Whether you're chasing a new PR or just out to enjoy nature with friends, this event is all about having fun, great company, and a little bit of post-race celebration!

Delicious post-race food, music, and fellowship await at the finish line - all while supporting a good cause. Spots will be limited again this year, so mark your calendar. This year will be even better than last year.

Proceeds to benefit St. Anthony Retreat & Conference Center. St. Anthony is a peaceful and naturally beautiful setting for individual and group retreats, as well as both religious and secular conferences and gatherings. St. Anthony Retreat Center provides meeting space, dining and overnight accommodations for up to 100 guests. St. Anthony Retreat Center is located adjacent to the newly built Santa Teresita Youth Conference Center. For more information about St. Anthony's and Santa Teresita Youth and Conference Centers please visit their website at stanthonyretreat.org  

Parking is limited so try to CARPOOL if possible.

All Finishers Receive: 

  • Lake Bottom Finisher Hoodie
  • Custom Wood Medal 
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Finish Line Snacks 
  • Chip timing with live results

name: Kendra's Race Triathlon and 5k
description:
Our Story

In 2006, after the death of their teammate and friend, Kendra Payne, the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) Triathlon Team changed the name of their annual triathlon to Kendra’s Race. The race has been held every year since then and each year the UCSB triathlon team generously donates a portion of the entrance fees to the Kendra Chiota Payne Memorial Fund.

The 2026 Kendra's Race consists of a Collegiate Sprint Race, Age Group Sprint, 5k Fun Run, and Triathlon Relay.

About the course:

*Course maps are at the bottom menu of this page*

The swim will start at Campus Point. Athletes will swim out 200m, take a left, swim for another 400m, take another left, and swim 200m back in to shore. They will then head up a flight of wooden steps to the transition area on Anacapa Lawn.

The bike will consist of two laps of a circuit consisting of some relatively technical sections of bike path followed by more open sections on Los Carneros, Hollister, and Fairview. Athletes will head out on Lagoon Road before making a left turn into campus and zig-zagging their way through on the bike path. They will then take a left onto the bike path parallel to Los Carneros Road before taking another left turn onto Hollister Avenue which will lead to a left turn onto Fairview Avenue. Racers will then make a series of left turns back onto the Obern Bike path before continuing straight back into campus to begin lap 2. At the end of lap 2, racers will make a left turn back onto Lagoon Road before heading into transition 2.

The run course consists of a 1 loop run over a rolling 5k course. It follows the UCSB lagoon and consists of paved and hard-packed trails. Racers will leave transition and run down to the lagoon. They will run on the trail system on the bluffs before dropping down to the lagoon where they will pass an aid station. Runners will continue along the lagoon to the turn around point. After turning around, runners will follow nearly the same route back before sprinting to the finish in lot 6.

Race Weekend Schedule:

Saturday:

1-6 pm: packet pickup at Goleta Trek - 320 S Kellogg Ave, Goleta, CA 93117, United States

Sunday:

6:15 am: Transition area and race-day packet pickup/same day registration opens (Anacapa Lawn)

7:30 am: Same day registration and packet pickup close

*Please make sure to bring a valid photo ID and have your USAT Membership number ready*

7:45 am: Transition area closes

8:00 am: Men's Collegiate Race Start

8:10 am: Women's Collegiate Race Start

8:20 am: Open Sprint Race Start & Sprint Relay Race Start

8:40 am: 5k Fun Run Start

10:30 am: Award Ceremony

10:45 am: Transition area opens for equipment retrieval

Race Contact Information:

If you have any questions about this race, please contact our race directors at kendrasracecommittee@gmail.com

Kendra Chiota Payne Foundation:

To learn more about the foundation and its mission to promote youth participation in sports, feel free to visit kendrachiotapayne.com

Donations to the foundation can also be made here

name: Kerman Almond Festival Scholarship Fun Run/Walk
description:
The event kicks off with a 5K Run/Walk at 9 am, funds raised go towards an Agriculture Scholarship. All family members are invited to join the fun! Following the Run/Walk, the Festival will begin at 11:00 am. Enjoy live entertainment, a variety of food vendors, an Almond Baking contest, Kids zone with bounce houses, an Agricultural-Related Photo Competition, Wine Tasting, Arts & Crafts, Car Show and much more!

The Kerman Almond Festival Fun Run/Walk is a family event with a Kids run for 12 and under and a 5K Walk or Run for participants 13 and older.

name: Keyesville Classic 2027
description:
Keyesville Classic MTB Weekend

One Bike. Two Disciplines. Choose Your Challenge.

The Keyesville Classic is a two-day mountain bike festival in California's Southern Sierra that combines Cross Country and SuperD Downhill into the All-Mountain Stage Race (AMSR).

Whether you're chasing an overall championship, racing a single event, or simply looking for an unforgettable weekend on one of California's most historic mountain bike courses, there's a race for every rider.

📅 Saturday

Sprint Lap
3-Mile Individual Time Trial

Start your weekend with a fast, exciting Sprint Lap.

  • Individual rider starts
  • One lap
  • Opening stage of both AMSR Classic and AMSR Lite

 🚴SuperD Downhill

AMSR Riders
Race Stage 1
Stage 1 counts toward your AMSR overall score

SuperD Enduro Riders
Race Stage 1 & Stage 2
Fastest combined elapsed time wins

🏆 SuperD Enduro Awards will be presented Saturday afternoon.

After racing, enjoy the venue, practice the trails, visit vendors, camp with friends, and join us Saturday evening for our community fundraising dinner.

🌄 Sunday

5K Trail Run
9:00 AM

Kick off Sunday morning with a scenic trail run through the beautiful Keyesville Recreation Area.

🚴 Cross Country Racing
10:15 AM

Choose the course that fits your riding style.

Keyesville Classic XC
16 Miles

  • Two laps of the legendary 8-mile Classic Loop
  • Technical singletrack
  • Punchy climbs
  • Fast, rewarding descents
  • The original Keyesville experience

Keyesville Lite XC
6 Miles

  • Two laps of the 3-mile Lite Loop
  • Perfect for newer racers, juniors, and riders wanting a shorter challenge

🏆 All-Mountain Stage Race (AMSR)

AMSR Classic
One Bike. Three Stages.

Includes:

  • Sprint Lap
  • SuperD Stage 1
  • Classic XC (16 Miles)

Overall standings are determined using a 25-point scoring system based on finishing position in each stage.

Classes

  • Open / Expert Men
  • Open / Expert Women
  • Sport Men
  • Sport Women
  • Vintage Class
  • E-Bike Open Men
  • E-Bike Open Women

AMSR Lite
Experience the excitement of the stage race in a more approachable format.

Includes:

  • Sprint Lap
  • SuperD Stage 1
  • Lite XC (6 Miles)

Overall standings are determined using

Classes
Men 17U
Women 17U
Men 18+
Women 18+
Vintage Men
 
🚵 Cross Country Classes
Classic XC
Open / Expert Men
Open / Expert Women
Sport Men
Sport Women
Vintage Class
E-Bike Open Men
E-Bike Open Women
Lite XC
Men 17U
Women 17U
Men 18+
Women 18+
 
📊 AMSR Scoring
Each stage awards points using a 25-point scale.

Points are earned in:

Sprint Lap
SuperD Stage 1
Cross Country
The rider with the highest combined point total is crowned AMSR Champion.

Tie Breaker
Big Ring Drag Race

 
❤️ Why Race Keyesville?
Since 1988, the Keyesville Classic has been one of California's original mountain bike destinations.

Enjoy:

Legendary trails
Friendly competition
Free camping
Saturday night fundraising dinner
Vendors and community atmosphere
Racing for every skill level
Whether you're competing for an AMSR title, racing Vintage, riding an E-Bike, tackling your first XC event, or simply spending the weekend outdoors, the Keyesville Classic offers something for everyone.

One Bike. Three Stages. One Champion.
See you at the Keyesville Classic.

name: KID-FIT Family Fun Run 5K & 1K - All Ages
description: The KID-FIT Family Fun Run 5K offers fun for the entire family.  Competitive runners will enjoy the USATF certified and sanctioned 5K flat course. Those who want a leisurely stroll can enjoy the trail too.  All ages of students from area towns can participate in order to reap one of the cash prizes awarded to each of the youth age groups and fastest team. Little children will enjoy the 1K and get their very own real medal!  Check out the pictures of last year's race in the photos section (click on MORE tab) to see how much fun everyone had!

name: King City 5K Run
description:
KING CITY 5K

Saturday, October 24, 2026 | San Lorenzo Park | King City, California San Lorenzo County Park

Start: 9:30 AM 

ALL GENDERS

Registration:

$45 per participant

$55 after October 17th 

Welcome to the King City 5K, where running, community, and tradition come together!

We invite former King City High School students, alumni athletes, families, friends, and running enthusiasts to join us for a special morning celebrating the rich history of running in King City.

 For generations, San Lorenzo Park has been more than just a local park. It has been a place where friendships were formed, personal records were broken, and countless memories were made. From early morning practices to unforgettable races, these trails hold a special place in the history of King City running.

What Does Your Registration Include?

Custom Finisher Medal: 

Official Event Shirt: 

Commemorative Tote bag: 

Bib and 5k experience: 

We encourage participants to arrive early to allow sufficient time for parking, packet pickup, and preparation.

Early Packet Pickup
Saturday, October 17, 2026

Location: King City High School — Broadway Parking Lot

Time: 7:00 AM–1:30 PM

If you are unable to attend, race-day pickup will also be available before the event.

name: Kings County Turkey Trot
description:
Welcome to the 2026 Thanksgiving Day, Kings County Turkey Trot!

 

7:30AM - KIDS RACES

8:00AM - 5K & 3K START

LOCATION: ON DOUTY, IN FRONT OF SUPERIOR DAIRY

 

**KIDS THAT RUN IN THE "KIDS RACE" CAN ALSO WALK THE 3K, OR RUN/WALK THE 5K WITH FAMILY**

What:  The Turkey Trot is back (organized by Champions Recovery Alternative Services), and we can’t wait to see you! Come join the fun on Thanksgiving morning in beautiful downtown Hanford.  

When:  Thursday, November 26, 2026 at 8 AM. (Kids Races will start at 7:30am) - Rain or Shine.   

Where: Start/Finish Line, 325 N Douty Street (Between Superior Dairy & Civic Center Park), in Hanford.  Same 5K Route, just a BIGGER Race Finish Line Venue to Cheer, Support, Meet Up, and Hang Out with your family and friends!

This course is scenic, and will take you around downtown; before the 5K splits and does an out-an-back on Douty Street, and the 3K Walkers return to the Finish Line!

Medals:  Medals will be awarded to our Top 20 Male & Top 20 Female 5K Finishers, must be registered in the 5K chip timed race!

Kids Races: 1/4 Mile Fun Race, and 1/2 Mile Fun Race. 

Biggest Flock Award: Create your team/group, have your family & friends (maybe your entire work) join it....Win the BIGGEST FLOCK AWARD! Tie-Breaker - Best Dressed!  

Best Dressed Turkey Award:  Come out in your best outfit and strut your stuffing to win this years "Best Dressed Turkey Award"

Packet Pick-Up:  
Tuesday, November 24th & Wednesday, November 25th from 9 AM to 6 PM, at 311 N Douty Street (Champions Corporate Office). 

On Thanksgiving Morning, we will open at 6:30 AM. To avoid long lines and a late start the day of the race, please pick up your packet early!  

Race Benefits: Champions Recovery Alternative Programs, Inc., a local Non Profit community-based organization dedicated to nurturing a healthier Kings County.

name: Kiwanis El Segundo PTA Run for Education 5K|10K
description:
Register before price increase at midnight April 12, 2027 

Pre-Race Day Packet Pickup: Thursday April 22rd 5-8pm, Friday April 23rd 11am-7pm 

Online Registration Closes at 8pm on Friday, April 23rd.  
Race Morning Packet Pick Up and In-Person registration will open at 6:30am on April 24th.
  • 5K Run/Walk is an easy-to-moderate hill course loop through local neighborhoods on closed streets. The 10K Run essentially runs the 5K loop twice.
  • 1K Fun Run for kids ages 6 to 10. 1/2K Fun Run for kids ages 2 to 5. All youth, 10 and under, registered for the 5K receive a free Fun Run entry.
  • Event includes large Post Race Finish Line Expo.
  • USA Track and Field (USATF) Sanctioned Event (26-33-160500) with Certified Courses (CA21007TEB and CA21021TEB).
  • Chip timing. Mile markers. Multiple water stations.
  • This event is a USATF Southern California Association (SCA) 2027 Road Running Grand Prix Series Event.
  • Proceeds benefit the El Segundo Unified Schools, supporting students pre-K-12th grade.

name: Konocti Climb 5K
description:
Please join Lake County Parks and Recreation AND Rotary Club of Lakeport for the 2nd Annual Konocti Climb 5K on November 14th. A true uphill challenge with some of the best views in the county waiting at the finish — this race takes you from the base of Mt. Konocti all the way up to Wright Peak.

Registration is $59.30 (incl. $4.30 fee) - Registration will CLOSE on November 11th or after 250 people register (whichever comes first). Every runner gets a race shirt, timed bib, and lunch post-race, with KOM and QOM awards at the summit. 

Race starts at 10:05am, participants line up at 10:00am

Carpooling is encouraged, shuttles will be provided from parking lots up to the start line. More information can be found on our website konocticlimb.com as well as an email post-registration.

If you're interested in becoming a sponsor or volunteer contact corallee.alexander@lakecountyca.gov

name: La Jolla Half Marathon, 10K, & 5K
description:
Imagine miles of sun-drenched coast, an inviting ocean, and perfect weather pretty much anytime of the year, and you’ll understand why the La Jolla Half Marathon, our San Diego 10K, and La Jolla Shores 5K are some of San Diego California’s most picturesque running races. 

From start to finish these races offer runners a chance to experience the coast like never before. Discover the views from the summit of Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve as you listen to the sound of the ocean lapping the shore to help you keep pace.

Whether you want to run your first half marathon, step up from our 5K to our 10K, or run your first 5K, no matter which race you choose, you’ll have gorgeous views from Del Mar to the La Jolla Shores.

Packet Pickup

FRIDAY, MAY 14, 2027: 9:00AM - 7:00PM

LOCATION: Scripps Park in La Jolla Cove across the street from La Jolla Cove Suites hotel

Refer A Friend... Earn Money

We love our runners and we love our runners that talk about our race! We want to reward runners that get their friends and family to register. Refer 4 friends and earn a $20 refund back from your 5K registration. Refer 4 friends and earn a $30 refund back from your 10K registration. Refer 4 friends and earn a $40 refund back from your half marathon registration. Keep referring friends and run for free! You'll receive a referral link to share after registration. If you've already registered, you should have received an email with your code or it's in your registration confirmation!

name: La Llorona Run 5K 10K Half by Califlow Runs
description:
💀 LA LLORONA RUN

Sunday, May 16, 2027
5K • 10K • Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA

🕕 Check-In & Registration: 6:00 AM
🏁 Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
🏁 5K & 10K: 8:00 AM

💀 About the Event
They say if you hear her cry near the water… don’t look back.

Welcome to the La Llorona Run, a SummerWeen race inspired by one of the most haunting legends in Mexican and Latin American folklore.

According to legend, La Llorona—the Weeping Woman—wanders near the water searching for her lost children, her cries carrying along rivers and shorelines.

On Sunday, May 16, we're bringing the legend to the Long Beach waterfront for a 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.

You'll race along a flat, fast beach path with the Pacific Ocean beside you and the legend of La Llorona following close behind.

Come chase a PR. Come for the medal. Come dressed for the legend.

Just don't follow the crying toward the water. 👻🌊

Costumes are encouraged—La Llorona, ghostly whites, spirits, folklore creatures and all things SummerWeen.

🌊 What to Expect
✔️ Flat, fast beach path course
✔️ Professional chip timing ⏱️
✔️ Instant ChronoTrack results
✔️ Free race-day photos — no upsells, ever 📸
✔️ Finisher medal for every participant 🏅
✔️ Overall & age group awards
✔️ Multiple on-course water stations 💧
✔️ DJ & finish-line party 🎶
✔️ Costume contest 👻
✔️ Runners, walkers and all paces welcome

🧿 The Vibe — The Weeping Woman
This isn't just another beach run.

🌊 The ocean is beside you.
👻 The legend is following you.
💀 SummerWeen has arrived.
🏃 And there's only one thing to do…

RUN.

No pressure. No judgment. Just movement, folklore, and a race you won't forget.

✨ Hear the cry. Run the legend.
LA LLORONA RUN — MAY 16, 2027

name: La Vida Sucia Animal Series: Raccoon Run 5K • 10K • Kids Run
description:
Welcome to the Raccoon Run

Join Los Mugrosos 4x4 for the inaugural event of the La Vida Sucia Animal Series as we kick off the series with the Raccoon Run at the beautiful Whittier Narrows Nature Center in South El Monte, California.

More than just a race, the Animal Series is a celebration of the outdoors, community, adventure, and the spirit of La Vida Sucia. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, tackling your first trail race, enjoying a morning walk with friends, or cheering on your kids, the Raccoon Run welcomes participants of all experience levels.

🏃 10K Trail Run (6.2 Miles)

🏃 5K Trail Run (3.1 Miles)🦝 Kids Run

A fun, family-friendly race created especially for our youngest adventurers. Every child gets the chance to cross the finish line and be part of the Animal Series.

Every Registration Includes

• Official Raccoon Run race bib
• Exclusive Animal Series finisher medal
• Professional race organization
• Access to the beautiful Whittier Narrows Nature Center trails
• Finish line celebration

Whether you’re here to compete, explore, or simply spend a memorable morning outdoors with family and friends, you’ll become part of a growing community that believes adventure is for everyone.

Run. Ride. Explore.

Welcome to La Vida Sucia.

Hosted by Los Mugrosos 4x4

name: La Vida Sucia Animal Series: Raccoon Run 5K • 10K • Kids Run
description:
Welcome to the Raccoon Run

Join Los Mugrosos 4x4 for the inaugural event of the La Vida Sucia Animal Series as we kick off the series with the Raccoon Run at the beautiful Whittier Narrows Nature Center in South El Monte, California.

More than just a race, the Animal Series is a celebration of the outdoors, community, adventure, and the spirit of La Vida Sucia. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, tackling your first trail race, enjoying a morning walk with friends, or cheering on your kids, the Raccoon Run welcomes participants of all experience levels.

🏃 10K Trail Run (6.2 Miles)

🏃 5K Trail Run (3.1 Miles)🦝 Kids Run

A fun, family-friendly race created especially for our youngest adventurers. Every child gets the chance to cross the finish line and be part of the Animal Series.

Every Registration Includes

• Official Raccoon Run race bib
• Exclusive Animal Series finisher medal
• Professional race organization
• Access to the beautiful Whittier Narrows Nature Center trails
• Finish line celebration

Whether you’re here to compete, explore, or simply spend a memorable morning outdoors with family and friends, you’ll become part of a growing community that believes adventure is for everyone.

Run. Ride. Explore.

Welcome to La Vida Sucia.

Hosted by Los Mugrosos 4x4

name: Lafayette Res Run for Education
description:
About the Lafayette Res Run for Education

The Lafayette Chamber and the City of Lafayette are co-sponsors of the Lafayette Res Run for Education which is traditionally held the third Sunday in October. 

 

The 2026 Lafayette Res Run for Education will be held Sunday, October 18. 5k: 8am, 10k: 8:15am, 2 mile: 8:45am in downtown Lafayette, CA.

 

Back by popular demand, from its introduction in 2020, you can register for the Reservoir Challenge – the virtual race which “runs” around the 2.7-mile paved trail of the Lafayette Reservoir October 10-17. Please note, the Reservoir Challenge is not an option on Sunday, October 18 as the Reservoir will be closed for the 10K runners. The Reservoir Challenge is great opportunity to safely walk or run the Reservoir on your own, perhaps beating your time from last year. 

 

Beneficiaries of the event are the local schools and the services and programs of the Chamber. See below for what we gave back to our schools last year! 

 

The Run is the city’s most popular “family affair”, involving kids, parents, grandparents, and hundreds of serious runners from throughout the Bay Area. Join us in 2025 for the 10k, 5k, the 2 mile run/walk for fun or the Reservoir Challenge! Sprinters, walkers, the “stroller brigade” and many of Lafayette’s top four legged residents are welcome to join in the fun. 

 

The first 100 students to register from each school will receive a voucher for a free 1/4 pound of bulk candy from Zoonie's during packet pickup! 

 

Packet Pickup
Race packets that include our traditional long sleeve t-shirt (while supplies last) and race bib will be available for pickup at the Lafayette Chamber Office, 251 Lafayette Circle, Lafayette, CA [map it] on the following dates/times (subject to change):

Tuesday, October 13, 9am-5pm
Wednesday, October 14,10am-6pm
Thursday, October 15, 9am-5pm
Friday, October 16, 9am-1pm
Sunday, October 18, 7:15am-8:45am Mt. Diablo Blvd, just east of Lafayette Circle

 

Support your school. Sign up now! 

**Parking and fees are not included in registration price.

 

Giving Back to Our Local Schools

In 2025, the race gave back a total of $37,611.32!

Burton Valley Elementary -  $7,549.87 (Contest Winner, Most Registrations!)
Happy Valley Elementary - $ 6,902.93 (Contest Winner, Most Improved!)
Lafayette Elementary - $6,709.01
Springhill Elementary - $5,753.97
Stanley Middle School - $7,113.28
Acalanes High School - $1,493.30
Campolindo High School - $890.54
Miramonte High School - $256.51
Acalanes Center for Independent Study - $176.75
Las Lomas High School - $247.66
Diablo Valley Montessori School - $25.50
Orinda Academy - $43.00
St. Perpetua School - $449.00 

Thank you to everyone who contributed in making this such a successful event.

name: Lake Evans Triathlon, 5K & 10K
description:
Swim. Bike. Run. Race Lake Evans!

Join us at beautiful Lake Evans at the Buena Vista Aquatic Recreation Area in Bakersfield for a full morning of racing, competition, and fun.

Whether you're an experienced triathlete chasing a fast time, taking on your first triathlon, racing with friends as a relay team, or simply looking for a great 5K or 10K, Lake Evans has an event for you.

Super Sprint Triathlon
Thinking about trying a triathlon but aren't ready for a full Sprint? This is your race!

Our Super Sprint Triathlon is designed to make multisport racing approachable and fun:

400-Yard Swim • 5.77-Mile Bike • 1.5-Mile Run

It's a great introduction to triathlon with shorter, manageable distances while still giving you the complete swim-bike-run experience.

More Than Just a Finish Line
Crossing the finish line is only part of the experience. Participants can look forward to:

🏅 Custom Finisher Medal
👕 Event Shirt
🏆 Age-Group Awards
🍽️ Post-Race Meal
🎵 Music & Race-Day Atmosphere
👥 Team Competition
🌊 A beautiful lakeside race venue

Bring your family and friends, cheer on fellow athletes, and spend the morning with us at Lake Evans.

First Triathlon? You Belong Here. You don't have to be an experienced triathlete to participate. The Super Sprint and Sprint distances provide excellent opportunities to get started, and our goal is to create a welcoming race environment for athletes of all abilities.

Already an experienced racer? Take on the Olympic distance, race for an age-group award, or see how fast you can go on the Lake Evans course.

Make Lake Evans Your Next Finish Line. One venue. Multiple distances. Swim, bike, run—or choose the event that's right for you.

Race with us at Lake Evans and experience one of Bakersfield's great multisport race days.

Pick your event. Start training. We'll see you at the finish line!

Our Super Sprint Triathlon is designed to make multisport racing approachable and fun:

400-Yard Swim • 5.77-Mile Bike • 1.5-Mile Run

It's a great introduction to triathlon with shorter, manageable distances while still giving you the complete swim-bike-run experience.

More Than Just a Finish Line
Crossing the finish line is only part of the experience. Participants can look forward to:

🏅 Custom Finisher Medal
👕 Event Shirt
🏆 Age-Group Awards
🍽️ Post-Race Meal
🎵 Music & Race-Day Atmosphere
👥 Team Competition
🌊 A beautiful lakeside race venue

Bring your family and friends, cheer on fellow athletes, and spend the morning with us at Lake Evans.

First Triathlon? You Belong Here. You don't have to be an experienced triathlete to participate. The Super Sprint and Sprint distances provide excellent opportunities to get started, and our goal is to create a welcoming race environment for athletes of all abilities.

Already an experienced racer? Take on the Olympic distance, race for an age-group award, or see how fast you can go on the Lake Evans course.

Make Lake Evans Your Next Finish Line. One venue. Multiple distances. Swim, bike, run—or choose the event that's right for you.

Race with us at Lake Evans and experience one of Bakersfield's great multisport race days.

Pick your event. Start training. We'll see you at the finish line!

description:

name: Lakewood Run
description:
Join us for the exhilarating Lakewood Run “Powered By Heart, Fueled By Community” 5K Walk/Run, 5K Ruck, and 10K Run! The Lakewood Run returns on Saturday, March 7, 2026!  This event is a celebration of physical fitness, community spirit, and personal determination. Whether you are a seasoned runner, a passionate walker, or a dedicated rucker, there’s something for everyone in this inclusive event. 

There will be delicious food, refreshments, live music, and race results, including a medal ceremony. Also, stick around and visit all our amazing vendors for a chance to participate in an opportunity drawing with great prizes! The Lakewood Run brings together runners, walkers, ruckers, and neighbors for a morning that’s more than just miles—it’s about heart.

 The Lakewood Run is presented by the Lakewood Sheriff’s Station and Soroptimist Int’l of Lakewood/Long Beach. Proceeds from the race benefit both charity organizations.

name: LASAA Mug Run - LASD Carson Station
description:
LASAA’s mission is to provide athletic events for our members, comprised of Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department employees and law enforcement personnel, to promote health, fitness, and camaraderie. 
The Mug Run series started in 1993. The primary participants were law enforcement personnel with an average of 10 runners.  Since then, the Mug Run series opened its participation to the general public. Today, participation has grown to over 300 runners.  
 
The race provides outside friendly competition and positive interaction between law enforcement and the community. 
Race day pricing increases to $40 so make sure to sign up early.

LASAA’s mission is to provide athletic events for our members, comprised of Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department employees and law enforcement personnel, to promote health, fitness, and camaraderie. 

The Mug Run series started in 1993. The primary participants were law enforcement personnel with an average of 10 runners.  Since then, the Mug Run series opened its participation to the general public. Today, participation has grown to over 300 runners.  
 
The race provides outside friendly competition and positive interaction between law enforcement and the community. 

Race day pricing increases to $40 so make sure to sign up early.  

Each runner will receive a T-shirt on race day.

name: LASD Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Join Us for the Exciting Turkey Trot 5K at Bonelli Park!

Get ready to kick off the holiday season with a bang at the annual Turkey Trot 5K on Saturday, November 14, 2026! Nestled in the beautiful Bonelli Park, this is more than just a run—it's a celebration of community, fitness, and fun!

Why You Should Join Us:

Stunning Location: Experience the breathtaking views of Bonelli Park as you trot through nature’s beauty.


Free for LASAA Members: If you're a member of LASAA, registration is on us! Non-LASAA members and the public can join the fun for just $30.


Day-of Registration: Forgot to register? No problem! Sign up on the day for $10 (LASAA) or $40 (non-members).


Swag Galore: Every participant walks away with a stylish T-shirt and a dazzling finisher medal, so you can show off your accomplishment!


Exciting Raffle Prizes: Enter for a chance to win incredible prizes, including a brand-new e-bike! You won't want to miss out on this!


This event is perfect for families, friends, and anyone looking to embrace the spirit of gratitude while getting active. Gather your crew, challenge yourself, and celebrate together as we trot toward a healthier lifestyle!

Don't wait—mark your calendars, lace up those sneakers, and join us for a memorable day of fun and fitness! Let’s make this Turkey Trot an unforgettable experience! 🦃🏃‍♂️✨

name: Liberty Bell 5k Fun Run
description:
Welcome to the 4th annual Liberty High School Band 5k.  The Liberty High School Band is excited to host this event as it will directly benefit the marching band, jazz band, concert programs, winter percussion and winter guard programs.

IN PERSON 
The race will begin at Veterans Park and participants will run on the Marsh Creek Trail through Creekside Park and beyond for an out and back.  The 5k race will commence at 7:30am and the Kids Fun Run will begin at 8am.  Medals will be handed out at the finish line.  All participants will receive a 2027 t-shirt and medal for participating!

Packet pick up is scheduled for FRIDAY, July 2nd from 3:00-7:00pm at Fleet Feet, located at 6061 Lone Tree Way in Brentwood. 

The event will take place rain or shine. Once registered, there are no refunds for inclement weather, personal emergencies, injuries, illnesses, change of plans, etc. Those participating with strollers will be asked to enter the start area at the back.

This race is open to any and all who want to participate, as long as they are human.  For the safety of all participants, NO ANIMALS are allowed on the course.  Strollers are welcome when pushed by an adult.  Bring the family, young and old and run or walk with us! We can't wait to see you out there.

Race Fees:
Children ages 3 and under are welcome to participate, no registration necessary.

Family 4-Pack Registration SPECIAL

Open to ages 2-99

$139

IMPORTANT: ALL FOUR INDIVIDUALS MUST BE REGISTERED AT THE TIME OF CHECKOUT. YOU CANNOT GO BACK AND ADD OR CHANGE PARTICIPANTS LATER. Limited number of entries available for the 4-pack special. Event will take place rain or shine. Once registered, there are no refunds for inclement weather, personal emergencies, injuries, illnesses, change of plans, etc. Those participating with strollers or pets will be asked to enter the start area at the back.

Charity 5k Run/Walk Entry

This "admit one" entry includes a $55 donation to Liberty High School Band. It also includes a special long-sleeve tech t-shirt with Band and race branding. 

5k - $45

Kids One Mile - $20


If you register on or after June 1st, you WILL NOT be asked for a t-shirt size.  You will be able to select a t-shirt from a variety of sizes at packet pick-up or on race day.  
Course Information: For the safety of our runners DOGS ARE NOT ALLOWED ON THE COURSE. Strollers are allowed on the course if they are pushed by an adult.

name: Lights for Life 5K
description:
The team at Project 99 invites you to join us for the Lights for Life 5K, our signature mental health and suicide awareness campaign. This year’s event continues our mission to shine a light on suicide prevention and bring the conversation "out of the dark." Your participation helps us spread hope, raise awareness, and ensure that no one feels alone in their struggles.
By running, walking, or supporting this 5K, you are directly contributing to our efforts to educate local students and the broader community about mental health and suicide prevention. Project 99 Play for Life, Inc., is so grateful for the generous support that allows us to make an impact today and grow our mission for the future. All additional donations are tax-deductible and will help us expand our educational outreach, keeping students engaged and encouraging them to "stay in the game" and play for life.
In addition to participating in the race, we encourage youth to get involved behind the scenes, with opportunities to volunteer in event planning, preparation, and execution. Click on the volunteer link at the top of our website for volunteer tasks, dates, and times.
Together, we can continue to build a community where mental health is prioritized, and no one is left in the dark. Let's bring hope, awareness, and prevention into the light.

name: Linda Fireman's Association Halloween Fun Run
description:
All proceeds benefit the Linda Firemans Association

The Linda Fireman's Association was formed in January of 1951.  The Association has grown from a social club to a strong local charitable organization.  The Association's stated objective is the promotion and protection of the best interests of the firefighters and their families, the Yuba-Sutter community and the Linda Fire Protection District.  Association membership is composed of active members of the Linda Fire Protection District, retired LFPD members and the Fire Commissioners.

name: Little Legends Fitness Competition
description:
💪 Get ready for the Little Legends Fitness Competition, presented by SLO Runners & Kamfitness! This exciting event gives young athletes the opportunity to test their speed, strength, endurance, and determination in a fun and supportive environment.

📅 Sunday, December 6 at 2:00 PM
📍 630 Spring St., Paso Robles, California

Athletes will compete within one of three age divisions:

🔵 Junior Division: Ages 6–8
🔴 Intermediate Division: Ages 9–11
🟡 Senior Division: Ages 12–14

Each competitor will race against the clock to complete our 5-Event Fitness Challenge:

🏃 200-meter run
📦 20 Box jumps — 18 to 22 inches
🏐 20 wall-ball sit-ups — 10 pounds
🏋️ 20 thrusters — 8 to 12 pounds
🔥 10 burpees

The athletes with the fastest times in each age group will take home the top awards! 🏆 Trophies will be presented to first, second, and third place in every age division.

🎖️ Every child who takes on the challenge will receive a Little Legends finisher ribbon, because completing the competition is something to be proud of!
