name: New Year's Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎉 Start Your Year on the Right Foot! 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️
Join the New Year's Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!
Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals for the New Year!

 
Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 
Smaller Races, Warm Memories, Always Ready for You

name: Next Mile Pacegiving 2026
description:
Welcome to Next Mile Pacegiving 2026, a community holiday run on the beautiful Miner’s Ravine Trail in Roseville! We are coming together to log some great morning miles and make a massive local impact for the local food bank and Make-A-Wish Northeastern & Central California.

This is a casual, grassroots, un-timed community event. Bring your GPS watches, Garmins, or phones to track your own personal pace and mileage!

Distance Options:
5K Out-and-Back
10K Out-and-Back

Event Timeline:
7:30 AM: Check-in and donation drop-off opens
8:00 AM: Run kicks off
9:30 AM: Staging area concludes

Staging & Parking Location:
The event will stage out of the trailhead access point located at the back of the CinemaWest Roseville parking lot (520 N Sunrise Ave, Roseville, CA 95661). Please park in the back of the theater lot.

Entry Requirement:
Participation requires a mandatory entry fee of two non-perishable food items brought to the starting line on race morning. Everything collected goes directly to our local food bank to feed families in need.

Swag Upgrade - $45:Want the official event gear? You can upgrade your registration to receive a Limited Edition Next Mile Performance Race Shirt and a custom Finisher Medal manufactured by DS3design. Best of all, $5.00 from each upgrade goes straight to Make-A-Wish Northeastern & Central California to grant wishes for local children. The Swag Upgrade window closes firmly on Friday, October 23, 2026, and is capped at 100 upgrades.

Don't Want to Run? You Can Still Make a Difference:
Community supporters who do not wish to run are highly welcome to participate. You can drop off your non-perishable food donations for families in need right at our CinemaWest parking lot staging area between 7:30 AM and 9:00 AM on race morning.

DS3design 1-of-a-kind Giveaway:
Our official event sponsor, DS3design, has generously donated a 1-of-a-kind special gift for this event. Your basic entry requirement (bringing 2 non-perishable food items) earns you 1 automatic raffle ticket. To supercharge our food drive, you can earn 1 extra raffle ticket for every additional non-perishable item you bring!

name: NIGHT NATION RUN - SACRAMENTO
description:
The Night Nation Run is the World’s first Running Music Festival the ultimate blend of a Music Festival and a Fun Run. Experience a music filled course with Live DJs, Bubble Zones, Light Shows, Neon, and Black Lights! Cross the finish line into an Epic Main Stage After Party featuring Top Headliner DJs!

To date, over 2 MILLION people across the World have become a member of the Night Nation™!

The Night Nation Run is proud to support Stand Up To Cancer (SU2C) as their official charity. Stand Up To Cancer (SU2C) is a groundbreaking initiative created to accelerate innovative cancer research that will get new therapies to patients quickly and save lives now.

Celebrate Life. Celebrate friends and family. Celebrate Music. Run with the Night Nation™!

REGISTRATION INCLUDES:

  • Night Nation T-shirt (Premium & VIP Registration)
  • Race Bib
  • Glow Necklace
  • Free Giveaways
  • Pre and Post Race Concerts
  • Admission into the Night Nation after party
  • The best night of your life!

name: Night of the Living Runners – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email.

Event Schedule

Friday, October 16th
4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email race week)


Saturday, October 17th
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route & 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race menda. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and will be available earlier on this page. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question?
Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email race week)


Saturday, October 17th
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route & 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race menda. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and will be available earlier on this page. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question?
Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Night of the Running Dead 5K, 10K, 1 Miler, Half Marathon SummerWeen Series by Califlow Runs
description:
🧟‍♂️ Night of the Running Dead
5K • 10K • 1 Miler • Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA
📅 Saturday Night • August 28
🕓 Check-In & Registration: 4:00 PM
🏁 Start Times | Half: 5:00 PM | 5K & 10K: 6:30 PM | 1 Miler: 6:45 PM

 
💀 About the Event
When the sun goes down… they rise.

Welcome to Night of the Running Dead—a pulse-pounding, after-dark race where the beach path transforms into a haunting playground of glowing lights, eerie energy, and undead vibes.

Whether you’re running for time, running for fun, or just trying to survive the night… this is one event you won’t forget.

Costumes are highly encouraged—zombies, survivors, or anything straight out of your favorite horror scene.

 
🌊 What to Expect
✔️ Flat, fast beach path course
✔️ Professional chip timing ⏱️
✔️ Instant ChronoTrack results (within minutes)
✔️ Free race-day photos — no upsells, ever 📸
✔️ Finisher medals for all participants 🏅
✔️ Overall & age group awards
✔️ Multiple on-course water stations 💧
✔️ DJ, lights & eerie after-dark atmosphere 🎶
✔️ Costume contest — zombies, creepers & creatures 🧟‍♀️
✔️ Runners, walkers, and all survival paces welcome

 
  🧿 The Vibe – After Dark Survival Mode
At CaliFlow Runs, we don’t do ordinary races…

This is where:
🧟 The undead roam
🔥 The music pulses
🌙 The night comes alive
👟 And you run straight through it

No pressure. No judgment. Just adrenaline, community, and a little chaos under the stars.

 
✨ Run the night. Join the undead. Survive the course.

name: Nitro Turkey
description:
Thanksgiving day races at Point Pinole! 10K, 5K & Little Turkeys Thanksgiving Day Run

There will be a 5K and 10K, as well as the Little Turkeys Race: a run for the kids (roughly 100 yards) against the Nitro Turkey. Children (10 and under) attending with 5K/10K runners will receive free entry into Little Turkeys and receive special medals and a goodie bag.

Nitro Turkey is also hosting a food drive for the Food Bank of Contra Costa & Solano and encourages every little turkey to bring at least one canned good on race morning.

Thanksgiving-themed costumes (for children and adults) are highly encouraged! Walkers and families are welcome!

name: No Foolin' Foot Race
description:
NOTE: Pre-registration for the kids race is now closed. Children may sign up on race morning, though shirts and medals are not guaranteed. 

Race morning registration closes at 9 promptly.

Explore San Carlos' outstanding trail system as a runner in the fourth annual No Foolin' Foot Race! There's something for everyone with four challenging events through Big Canyon, Eaton and Pulgas Ridge. 

  • 1K (~350ft of climbing) - Perfect for adventurous kids age 5-10

  • 5k (~530ft of climbing)

  • 10k (~1,500ft of climbing)

  • Long Course NEW this year! (15K with ~2,300ft of climbing)

Consider yourself warned: This race is no joke! Our courses are technical, grueling and loads of fun.

We will be hosting course previews on Sunday, March 8 (5K and 10K routes) and Saturday, March 28 (5K and 15K routes) in partnership with A Runner's Mind and Brooks. RSVP on Strava, and join our Strava Club for updates.

Start and Finish Festival at Crestview Park. Professional timing; Tech-Ts and free runner photos for all participants; Awards in multiple categories. 

All proceeds benefit maintenance and improvement of San Carlos open space trails. 

Presented by Kaiser Permanente in partnership with the Parks and Recreation Foundation of San Carlos and the City of San Carlos.

Start Times

  • 15k - 8:30a Runners have 2.5 hours to complete the course.
  • 10k - 9a Runners have 2.5 hours to complete the course.
  • 5k - 9:30a Runners have 1 hour to complete the course.
  • Kids K - 9:35a Children have 30min to complete the course.

Bib Pick Up

  • Race Morning: Saturday April 18 7:30a-9a at Crestview Park

Parking

  • Street parking is available along Brittan Ave. and Crestview Drive. ABSOLUTELY NO participant parking available at Crestview Park. Carpooling is strongly encouraged.

name: Northgate Market 5K
description:
It’s Back — The Annual Northgate Market 5K!
We’re thrilled to welcome you to this beloved community tradition, benefiting the Familia González Reynoso Foundation. This incredible organization supports higher education, human services, schools, orphanages, scholarships, and grants that change lives.

Come join the fun at Angel Stadium, where you’ll get the unforgettable chance to run on the field and see yourself on the Jumbo-Tron — all while enjoying a vibrant Día de los Muertos theme.

Every race entry includes:

  • Commemorative race shirt
  • Finisher medal
  • Finish line photos & video
  • Access to the post-race expo

Come run, celebrate, and make a difference — together, we can support those in need while creating memories that last a lifetime!

Register before September 30th (at 12:00am) to guarantee your race-shirt size!

name: NURSES ROCK Run/Walk
description:
We are so grateful for the incredible support, energy, and love shared at this year’s event. Thank you for helping us bring our community together in celebration of nurses — we look forward to seeing everyone again on May 15, 2027!

Join the Nurses Rock Run-Walk 5K/10K & BONNIE CHALLENGE and help support the next generation of nurses!

Nurses care for us during some of life’s most important moments, and now it’s our turn to give back. Join Bonnie Fang Foundation in supporting aspiring nurses through scholarships, community support, and awareness for the ongoing nursing shortage that impacts us all.

Whether you participate in person or virtually, you’ll be part of an inspiring community coming together to celebrate, honor, and support nurses and future healthcare heroes.

Whether you run or walk — solo, with friends, family, coworkers, or a team — every step helps make a meaningful impact for the future of nursing.

Your participation and support help us continue empowering nursing students while shining a constant spotlight on the importance of nurses in our communities every single day.

They are our heroes… and by joining us, you become part of theirs.

Register today and help us continue making a lasting impact for future nurses! 💜


*START GETTING YOUR GROUPS TOGETHER! AWARDS FOR OUR TOP 3 LARGEST GROUPS!

name: Oakland Hills Trail Run
description:
A hidden redwood forest lies in the hills just a few miles over the ridge from downtown Oakland. The forest’s peaceful groves give little evidence of the park’s bustling past – in the mid-1800s the area was the scene of extensive logging to supply building materials for the San Francisco Bay Area. The logging era has long since passed, and a stately forest of 150-foot coast redwoods (Sequoia sempervirens) has replaced those cut down.

In addition to a great forest of coast redwoods, the park’s 1,830 acres also contain other evergreens, chaparral, and grasslands. Wildlife within the park includes rare species such as the golden eagle and Alameda striped racer. Deer, raccoons, rabbits, and squirrels are often seen.

name: Oakland Tech 5km/1 mile Race/Run/Walk Fundraiser
description:
Support Oakland Tech Students and Programs
Join us for a 5K trail race or 1-mile fun run/walk in beautiful Joaquin Miller Park on November 1, 2026 (end of Daylight savings time.) The course winds through towering redwoods and offers both a scenic stroll for casual participants and a challenging route for competitive runners.

This event is a fundraiser for the Oakland Tech PTSA, which provides invaluable funding for student programs and activities. Every dollar makes a difference for our students. The PTSA supports the Oakland Tech Cross Country team by covering costs for meet entry fees, training equipment, nutrition, and travel — all essential for helping our runners perform at their best.

Oakland Tech Cross Country athletes have a proud tradition of success, with varsity cross country teams winning the Oakland League Championship for three of the past four years. Your participation helps continue this tradition of excellence.

Sign up for the race or make a tax-deductible donation to show your support for Oakland Tech students.

Bib pick-up: Sunday, November 1rd, 8:30am @Joaquin Miller Meadow

Date: November 1, 2026

  • 1 mile Fun Run/Walk Race Start: 9:00 am
  • 5 km Trail Race Start: 9:30 am

Can't run but want to support us? Donations are tax-deductible. Tax ID: 94-6174624

name: Oceanside Pier Swim  - 2027
description:
The 97th Annual Oceanside Pier Swim is set to take place on September 6, 2027, continuing a cherished tradition that began in 1929. Swimmers of all ages are invited to participate in this one-mile swim around the iconic Oceanside Pier, the longest wooden pier on the West Coast. 

Hosted by local organization, Oceanside Masters Swim Club, the club hopes to grow Oceanside Aquatics and community from youth to adulthood. Proceeds from the swim will benefit youth swim programs, high school swim teams, adult swim teams and our local first responders.

description:
Join us for the 3rd annual Old Zoo Half Marathon! This event starts and ends at the iconic Old Los Angeles Zoo in Griffith Park. From there, its all scenic, fast and relatively flat miles. Perfect for a PR, a first timer or anyone looking for a fun Half Marathon or 12K wild adventure. 
 
This year's commemorative animal medal will be a Tiger. Join us and collect your unique finisher medal!

We SOLD OUT last year, so we're are opening the doors super early to give you the best prices and a guaranteed spot. Spots are limited and will go fast. Grab your friends, your family, your run crew and lock in a spot!

name: On Track Running Turkey Trot
description:
🦃 The On Track Running Turkey Trot 5K is back!

Kick off Thanksgiving morning with us for the 3rd Annual On Track Running Turkey Trot 5K in Simi Valley!

Whether you’re racing for a new PR, getting some miles in before the feast, or bringing the whole family out for a Thanksgiving morning tradition, we’d love to have you at the starting line.

📅 Thursday, November 26, 2026
⏰ 8:00 AM Start
📍 Race Start & Finish: 4593 Ish Drive, Suite 340, Simi Valley

The course is flat, fast and chip-timed, taking runners from Ish Drive onto the bike path alongside the wash for an out-and-back course before returning to the finish.

🎽 Race Perks
• Free race shirt + finisher medal for the first 200 registered runners
• Chip-timed 5K
• Age group awards for top finishers
• A fun Thanksgiving morning with the Simi Valley running community

Packet Pickup & Registration
Wednesday, November 25 | 1:00–5:00 PM
📍 **On Track Running | **2764 Cochran Street, Simi Valley, CA 93065

Race Day Registration
6:30–7:15 AM
📍 Race Site | 4593 Ish Drive, Suite 340

Bring your family, grab your running buddies and come start Thanksgiving with us. Run it fast, jog it easy, or make it part of your family’s Turkey Day tradition.

Follow @OTRunning on Instagram and join the On Track Running crew on Strava for race updates and more.

See you at the starting line! 🦃

name: Orange County Superhero 5K Run Walk Health & Safety Expo
description:
This event is a fun-family event with a 5K Run/Walk, Health & Safety Expo, Food & Entertainment, and fund-raising opportunity to help support programs and direct services at the Crime Survivors Resource Center. Awareness. Prevention. Advocacy. Healing. 

Awards

Top 3 Male/Female in the following age group. 12&Under, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, and 80&Over.

Contact: info@superherorunwalk.org | (844) 853-HOPE | (949) 872-7895 | www.superherorunwalk.org

Photos from previous years event: Click Here

WHAT IS A VIRTUAL RACE REGISTRATION? A virtual race is a race that can be run (or walked) from any location you choose. You can run, jog, or walk on the road, on the trail, on the treadmill, at the gym or on the track (or even at another race). You get to run your own race, at your own pace, and time it yourself. Run on your own, or with friends! Your race bib, shirt and medal will be shipped directly to you. And your registration fee and fundraising efforts will go directly to help support victims of crime through our survivors hope fund. Register Today!

Event Fee

$40.00 Pre Registration | $50.00 Day of Registration -- Includes Shirt, Medal, Goody Bag to First 500 Pre Registered, Food ,Drinks, and Entertainment  

Race Schedule

7 am - 11 am: Health & Safety Expo
7:00 am - Registration Opens
8:15 am - Warm Up
8:30 am - Special Guest Presentations
8:45 am - Survivors Dove Release
9:00 am - 5k Run/Walk Starts ( You can run, walk or jog).

Vendor Form

Submit Vendor Form Online - Click Here to Submit 2026 Form

Other Event:

Los Angeles Superhero 5K Run/Walk - Sign Up Here

NO REFUNDS — RAIN OR SHINE
(all registrations are donations to support crime survivors)

name: Over the Hill Track Club Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
description:
The Over the Hill Track Club Turkey Trot 5K run/walk returns for 2025!  Register and donate here, or at the event on race day.
Come on out and start your Thanksgiving right!  Run before your feast!  Work off that Turkey dinner before you eat.

When: Thursday, November 27, 2025 (Thanksgiving Day). Registration: 7:30 am, come early.  Race start: 8:30 am.
Where: Cerro Coso College Gym Parking Lot,  3000 S College Heights Blvd., Ridgecrest, CA

No fee; $5 Donations Suggested.  All proceeds to benefit Burroughs (Ridgecrest) High School Boys and Girls Cross Country Programs.

The traditional turkey-themed awards will be awarded to the top male and female Runners!  New this year, the first 50 finishers will receive medals! As usual, there will be raffle items donated by local merchants.

New this year! A kids' 400 meter fun run will be offered before the main race.

Water will be available at the finish, along with possibly some donated snacks.

name: Paiute Meadows Trail Run
description: Join Lassen Land and Trails Trust as we showcase the region's premiere trail system with the 31st Annual Paiute Meadows Trail Run! The 4.5-mile course is the traditional cornerstone of all four distances as it twists and turns through towering pines, beautiful meadows and challenging climbs. The 50K, 50K Relay, 30K, and half-marathon (13.7) courses rival any true trail race in the region, with challenging climbs, water crossings, and a variety of terrain. Almost exclusively on single-track trails, runners experience breathtaking views as they run through a variety of beautiful landscapes. This is a MUST-DO race for trail runners around the entire region. For teams wishing to do the 50K relay, Leg 1 follows the 30K course and is 18.6 miles. Leg 2 resumes the course at the start/finish line area in the main parking lot and follows the second loop of the 50K course which is approximately 13.1 miles. Don't forget the FREE 1-Mile Kids' trail race for kids 12 and under and Lassen College's Special Olympians, as well! Please visit our website for more information: https://bizzrunningcompany.com/paiutemeadowstrailrun/

name: Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Expo
description:
The Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Festival has now become one of the largest events of its kind in Southern California and follows a spectacularly beautiful path in and around Ruth Hardy Park with picture perfect views of the San Jacinto Mountain Range. Hot, hip and fun is how describe the desert oasis of Palm Springs.

This USA Track and Field certified 10K and 5K event has caught the attention of serious runners and nationally recognized health and wellness speakers.

The Expo has grown substantially since its inception and now has over 80 vendors showcasing the latest in nutrition and exercise techniques, LifeStream Blood Bank Drive, and rock climbing wall.

Not only is the event a way for health conscious individuals and families to come together, but it has now become a major fundraiser.

The Expo has grown substantially since its inception and now has over 80 vendors showcasing the latest in nutrition and exercise techniques, LifeStream Blood Bank Drive, and rock climbing wall.

Not only is the event a way for health conscious individuals and families to come together, but it has now become a major fundraiser.

name: Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk
description:
Kick off Palm Springs Pride Weekend with the Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk, a vibrant celebration of movement, visibility, and community. All ages and abilities are welcome from seasoned runners to joyful strollers. Hosted by Palm Springs Front Runners & Walkers, this event fuels vital support for local LGBTQ+ organizations. Every step you take helps us raise more for our beneficiaries and strengthen the community we love.

Registration is approaching capacity

Palm Springs Front Runners and Walkers are incredibly grateful for the overwhelming support the Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk has received. Participation has grown steadily over the years, and this year's response has exceeded our expectations.

Registration is limited to 1,200 participants, and once capacity is reached, registration will close with no additional entries accepted. We encourage you to register soon, as available spots are limited.

name: Palm Springs Tram Road Challenge
description: Take on the Challenge! At the Palm Springs Tram Road Challenge, you'll climb almost 2,000 feet from the desert to the mountains in just 3.7 miles! You'll start at the intersection of Tram Way and Highway 111, with stunning views of the San Jacinto Mountains in front of you and the Coachella Valley behind. Choose to run your way up or take it easy for a nice uphill walk. No matter how you get there, when you reach the finish line, you'll enjoy a post-race festival with food, drink, booths, entertainment and awards for the winners. All participants receive a stylish finisher medal, cool race t-shirt, tasty post-race food and drink, and a bus ride back down the hill!! Awards for the top three in each age group will be given out to those registered in the Awards Eligible category, but everyone will be professionally timed! Sign up today and get ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime!

name: Palm Springs WILD TURKEY TROT 5K
description:
Make room for that extra piece of pie by completing the Palm Springs Wild Turkey Trot in iconic Palm Springs, California on Thanksgiving morning. name: Patagonia Salmon Run 5K
description:
Patagonia is excited to announce the 30th Annual Salmon Run, to be held November 15, 2026.

This year, proceeds will support Santa Barbara Channelkeeper, a local environmental nonprofit dedicated to protecting and restoring the Santa Barbara Channel and its watersheds. For over 25 years, Channelkeeper has worked to ensure clean water, healthy habitats, and thriving communities from Point Conception to the Ventura River, from the Santa Ynez Mountains to the Northern Channel Islands. Through science-based advocacy, education, fieldwork, enforcement, and community engagement, Channelkeeper defends our community’s right to clean water and informs, inspires, and empowers people to speak and act for our waterways.

Channelkeeper leads a range of impactful programs, including water quality monitoring, marine protected area stewardship, pollution prevention, and watershed advocacy initiatives. Through hands-on volunteer programs, public outreach efforts, and collaborative policy solutions, Channelkeeper engages the community as active stewards of our coast and waterways.

Channelkeeper’s work is actively addressing some of our region’s most pressing environmental challenges. Channelkeeper has taken a lead role in protecting the region from the impacts of offshore oil drilling through strategic advocacy and legal action, including challenging the restart of Sable’s oil development operations along the Gaviota Coast. Channelkeeper is also working to safeguard public trust resources in the Ventura River watershed, advancing solutions that protect water flows for the benefit of wildlife and our communities. Learn how to get involved and support their work by visiting www.sbck.org.

Additionally, we want the Salmon Run to be a Zero-Waste-Event to mitigate sending anything to the waste stream that doesn't have to. We will send out details on how to prepare for this closer to the day of the race, but plan to bring your own water bottle and coffee mug.

As a reminder, this race tends to fill up quick and has limited sign up space!

Please note: 

For race participants, the Patagonia Store located at:

235 W. Santa Clara St

Ventura, CA 93001 

Is excited to offer a 25% off discount if racers bring their bib into the store.  This is a onetime use offer on full priced Patagonia items only and valid from 11/15/2026 through 11/22/2026.

 

Packet pickup will begin at 6:30AM on Sunday, November 15

THERE WILL NOT BE DAY-OF REGISTRATION FOR THE SALMON RUN. ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST REGISTER ONLINE, WHICH CLOSES AT NOON ON MONDAY, NOVEMBER 10th OR WHEN THE RACE SELLS OUT

name: PB&J Fuel Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Smooth vibes. Sweet energy. Bold moves. 🥜🍓


PB&J Fuel Run is all about a combo that just works. Mix your pace, spread the fun, and stick with it all the way to the finish. No stress, no expectations, just miles that feel good and a finish that feels even better. Run it your way, enjoy every step, and fuel your finish with good energy and great company. Let’s make this run unforgettable. 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️✨

 
Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.

name: Peacock Gap Trail Run
description:
Once a thriving Chinese settlement subsisting off of shrimp fishing, China Camp is now a popular state park for boaters, runners/hikers, and mountain bikers. An extensive trail network will greet you with views of Mt. Tam, San Pablo Bay, and San Francisco Bay as you traverse twisting single-track trails, climbing up and over the peak. The courses wind along thick forests and descend out into open trails on the San Pablo Bay side of the park. Each race is relatively fast, with a nice punch of a climb beginning 1.5 miles into the course, leaving plenty of room to push it or just hike and enjoy the wild turkeys and sounds of the woods around you. China camp is a rare locale for a running race, so be sure not to miss this special event.

Park Information: China Camp, Harry Barbier Memorial Park

Start Times:
30K & Half – 8:30 AM
10K – 9:00 AM

name: Penn Valley Daffodil Race
description:
The Daffodil race has been a staple for the Nevada County community for many, many years. Offering a 5K and a 10K, the routes travel through the quaint little town of Penn Valley and across the green rolling hills on country roads. The 5K travels along the edge of Western Gateway Park, past the dog park, and finally to the park and ride for a quick turnaround for a return to the finish. The 10K begins the same as the 5K, but will take a detour through the park before heading to the park and ride. During the return, the 10K turns right and weaves through the rural countryside of Penn Valley before racing back to the finish. 

Penn Valley is known for its daffodils and green grass, and if the timing is right, runners will get to see both. April lends towards cooler temps, so runners can experience energy from the springtime air and community. How could anyone say no? 

The Penn Valley Chamber will be serving a pancake breakfast for a small cost and the Penn Valley Lions will be the course marshals on the road. Sierra TrailBlazers are organizing and handling entries, bibs, t-shirts, and awards for the day. A wonderful community project to help all of you get out to have a wonderful spring running experience. 

ENTRIES CLOSE APRIL 8, Thursday, AT 9 P.M.  IF YOU WANT TO PARTICIPATE GET YOUR ENTRIES DONE TODAY!

name: Phoenix 5K/10K
description:
In honor of the CampFire, that devastated The Ridge, this 5K walk/run and 10K run is a commemorative event created as a tribute to the resilience of the residents who have overcome. 
 

The 6th Annual Phoenix 5K/10K is more than just another running event… It's a living tribute to the strength and resilience of the Ridge community after the devastation of the 2018 CampFire. Symbolized by the Phoenix, this commemorative event honors how residents have risen from tragedy to rebuild and thrive.

The route guides participants along the Memorial Trail and through meaningful landmarks; new homes and empty lots, rebuilt schools, murals, handprint wall and the Hope Plaza, while also passing the police and fire departments to recognize the heroes who protected the town. Each step on this course tells a story of remembrance, gratitude, and hope for what continues to rise on the Ridge.
 

The event includes a 5K walk/run, and a 10K run and a free pancake breakfast for the entire community.

name: Pi Day Run
description:
The goal of our events is to get people outside, moving and having fun.  Running, Math and Pie enthusiasts come together at the Pi Day Run featuring run/walk distances of 2Mi, Pi (3.14) Miles, and 2Pi (6.28) Miles.  We invite Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math students or clubs to have a booth/display to be voted on by the participants.  Cash prizes will be awarded to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place booths as voted for by our participants.   • Fruit Pi (several flavors)

name: Pie Pursuit
description:
Pie Pursuit 5K — Run for a Cause, Stay for the Fun
Join the 746 Sports Foundation for our inaugural Pie Pursuit 5K, a community-centered fun run with a festive twist! Participants are encouraged to dress in their favorite costumes — from turkeys to pilgrims — and take part in a lighthearted 5K that features family-friendly pie-toss zones along the course.

This unique event is more than just fun and games — it's a fundraiser with purpose. All proceeds directly support local youth through scholarships, free sports events, and community programs organized by the 746 Sports Foundation.

 

Participants will enjoy:

  • Official timed results for those wanting to track their pace

  • Custom Pie Pursuit race shirts and finisher medals

  • Prizes awarded for best costumes, fastest finishers, and most pie-covered runners


Whether you run, walk, or get covered in whipped cream, your participation helps empower the next generation right here in Shafter.

 

Because every pie thrown is a step toward stronger community roots.

name: Pink on Parade
description:
JOIN US for Pink on Parade on Saturday, October 24!


What is Pink on Parade?


Pink on Parade is Riverside's 14th annual Breast Cancer Awareness walk, a family-friendly (and pet-friendly!) walk with two routes. Choose to walk Mt. Rubidoux, a 5k endeavor representing the cancer journey, or the Family Fun walk, a 1.7k route that encircles the park. Prepare for a day filled with joy and laughter with your friends, family, co-workers as we celebrate our survivors, honor those we have lost, and support our local cancer resource center, The Pink Ribbon Place.

Event Details

Saturday, October 24, 2024 | 7:30am -12:00pm

5000 Tequesquite Ave Riverside, CA 92506

Activities

Expo/Family Activities 

Enjoy a perfect day filled with fun family activities! Be sure to experience the vendor expo, kids zone and assortment of food and drink options. Consider packing a picnic blanket for lunch at the park!

Survivor Pavilion 

An exclusive pavilion curated for cancer survivors with activities designed to promote wellness and self-care.

Classic Car Show

A throwback experience! See import and domestic
classic cars from the 1940s to the 1980s.

Stretch & Warm Up 

Get pumped up and ready to walk from head to toe!

Team Prizes Announcements

You worked hard to build your team, fundraise, and raise awareness— now it’s time for the official count! Join us as we congratulate this year’s outstanding winners of the Most Money Raised and the Team Spirit Awards.

Follow us on Instagram at @thepinkribbonplace for more details

100% of the proceeds from our walk goes towards the programs of The Pink Ribbon Place, a program of Riverside Community Health Foundation a 501(c)(3) charity, tax ID 23-7276444. Now that is something to be proud of!

name: Pleasanton Rotary Halloween Spirit Run
description:
Join us on Sunday, October 25 for this year's event! 

 

Start and finish in Downtown Pleasanton on Main Street. Wear a costume if you would like! 

5K/10K starts at 8:30 a.m.  5K and 10K events are timed; awards will be presented to overall winners as well as to top finishers in each age group. Kids Challenge (1/4 mile for older kids, plus a 100 yard dash) starts at 10:00 am. Kids ages 12 and under are welcome to participate. 

DryBlend long sleeved t-sleeve shirts for 5K-10K participants. Participants may opt out of t-shirt if they wish. 

To celebrate our 33rd running of this event, finisher medals will be awarded to all 5K, 10K, and Kid's Race participants.

Proceeds

Proceeds support scholarships for Pleasanton students and community & international projects of The Rotary Club of Pleasanton.

Leashed Dogs

Well-behaved dogs are permitted in the 5K or 10K; all dogs must start in the back of the pack at the starting line, be on a non-retractable leash, and be cleaned up after by their human. Dogs attending the event should be comfortable in crowds as well as around other dogs. 

Strollers

Strollers are allowed in both the 5K and 10K; we ask that you start towards the back. 

Packet Pick Up

Pre-race Packet Pick Up will be held  on Saturday, October 24, 2026 - at Fleet Feet Pleasanton (234 Main Street) from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm.   Participants may also pick up their bib and tshirt on race morning (10/25) near the start/finish line starting at 7 am and continuing through 8:15 am (through 9:45 am for Kids Challenge entrants).

Photo ID is not required to pick up packets and you may pick up for friends or family. Please bring your QR code from your confirmation email to check in.

In-Person Registration

Participants may register in-person at Packet Pick Up or on race morning (Sunday, October 25, 7:00 am to 8:20 am at the start/finish area adjacent to Workbench Hardware - 652 Main Street, Pleasanton). Those registering in-person may present payment in the forms of debit/credit card or cash. Personal checks are not accepted.

Awards & Age Groups

Custom medals will be presented to the top three male and female finishers in the 5K and 10K in each age group. Overall winners will also receive a prize. Age groups are: 10K / 13 and Under, 14-18 yrs., 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+. 5K age groups are: 9 and under, 10-13 yrs., 14-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+.

Race Results

Past Race Results: 2025  2024   2023   2022   2021  2019

DryBlend long sleeved t-sleeve shirts for 5K-10K participants. Participants may opt out of t-shirt if they wish. 

To celebrate our 33rd running of this event, finisher medals will be awarded to all 5K, 10K, and Kid's Race participants.

Proceeds

Proceeds support scholarships for Pleasanton students and community & international projects of The Rotary Club of Pleasanton.

Leashed Dogs

Well-behaved dogs are permitted in the 5K or 10K; all dogs must start in the back of the pack at the starting line, be on a non-retractable leash, and be cleaned up after by their human. Dogs attending the event should be comfortable in crowds as well as around other dogs. 

Strollers

Strollers are allowed in both the 5K and 10K; we ask that you start towards the back. 

Packet Pick Up

Pre-race Packet Pick Up will be held  on Saturday, October 24, 2026 - at Fleet Feet Pleasanton (234 Main Street) from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm.   Participants may also pick up their bib and tshirt on race morning (10/25) near the start/finish line starting at 7 am and continuing through 8:15 am (through 9:45 am for Kids Challenge entrants).

Photo ID is not required to pick up packets and you may pick up for friends or family. Please bring your QR code from your confirmation email to check in.

In-Person Registration

Participants may register in-person at Packet Pick Up or on race morning (Sunday, October 25, 7:00 am to 8:20 am at the start/finish area adjacent to Workbench Hardware - 652 Main Street, Pleasanton). Those registering in-person may present payment in the forms of debit/credit card or cash. Personal checks are not accepted.

Awards & Age Groups

Custom medals will be presented to the top three male and female finishers in the 5K and 10K in each age group. Overall winners will also receive a prize. Age groups are: 10K / 13 and Under, 14-18 yrs., 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+. 5K age groups are: 9 and under, 10-13 yrs., 14-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+.

name: Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

 PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options on Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race, check out the bib pick up tab for the latest.

RACE DAY SCHEDULE - Subject to change, please check the event website in November for final details
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: POMONA 5K & 10K
description:
Join us for the 10th Annual Pomona 5K & 10K on Saturday, October 17, 2026

The Pomona 5K/10K celebrates its 10th anniversary on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Take the chance to be a part of this historic milestone. With an average of 1,000 running participants and over 800 spectators in Downtown Pomona to cheer on all the runners, this event is a premier community event in the City of Pomona with a broad reach.


Visit the Health & Wellness Resource Fair from 8:00am through 12:00pm

In conjunction with the Pomona 5K & 10K, we are also hosting the Health & Wellness Resource Fair at Shaun Diamond Plaza throughout the race and after. If you are not participating in the race, or if you finish early, please visit the booths at our Health & Wellness Resource Fair. We  created this complimentary event to highlight our community partners, provide accessible health services and promote wellness for resident of all ages. Visit the Health & Wellness Fair for information on what's happening in the community, free health screenings, wellness education, and direct connections to valuable healthcare and support services.


Our Background

The Pomona 5K was born in 2016, with the vision of creating a community-driven running event in the heart of Downtown Pomona. The Pomona 5K is a partnership between Pomona Valley Runners, a local running group, and various community organizations including God’s Pantry, a community-based nonprofit organization. This event has been coordinated by a core group of dedicated community leaders from Pomona who volunteer their time to put on this event from the ground up.

 

SCHEDULE

FRIDAY, October 16, 2026 | Location TBD
  • 6:00 PM- 8:00 PM             |           Registration & Packet Pick Up / Check-In


SATURDAY, October 17, 2026 - RACE DAY | Shaun Diamond Plaza
  • 6:00 AM                             |          Registration
  • 7:00 AM                             |          Welcome 
  • 7:10 AM                             |          Toddler Trot
  • 7:20 AM                             |          Warm-up
  • 7:30 AM                             |          5K START (Combo runners will start with and complete their 5K distance prior to the 10K start.  You will                                                                           then start with and complete your 10K distance.)
  • 8:30 AM                             |          10K START
  • 10:00 AM                           |          Division Winners
  • 8:00AM - 12:00PM            |          Health & Wellness Fair

name: Port of San Diego Game Day 5K Run/Walk
description:
🏈 Holiday Bowl 5K Run/Walk
Monday, December 28, 2026 • San Diego, California
Run the waterfront. Race in front of 100,000 spectators. Kick off the nationally televised Port of San Diego Holiday Bowl Parade!

Start your Holiday Bowl celebration with one of San Diego's most exciting 5Ks!

The Holiday Bowl 5K Run/Walk takes you along a flat, fast and scenic course on San Diego's beautiful waterfront before the streets come alive for the Port of San Diego Holiday Bowl Parade.

The best part? You'll help kick off the parade and run past approximately 100,000 spectators lining the route!

Whether you're racing for a fast 5K, walking with friends and family, or simply looking for an unforgettable way to experience Holiday Bowl festivities, this is a San Diego tradition you won't want to miss.

🎉 Your Holiday Bowl 5K Experience
Your registration includes:

🏅 Finisher Medal for all participants

👕 Colorful Long-Sleeve Technical T-Shirt with adult and youth sizes available

🌊 Flat, Fast & Scenic Waterfront Course

🎺 Run Past 100,000 Parade Spectators

📺 Kick Off the Nationally Televised Port of San Diego Holiday Bowl Parade

🏆 Age-Division Awards for the top 3 male and female 5K finishers in each age division

🎶 Post-Race Party with live music

🍌 Finish-Line Refreshments, Fresh Fruit & Munchies

🎈 Stay and Watch the Parade after you finish!

🎈 Fun at the Finish
Don't rush home after you cross the finish line—the celebration is just getting started!

Join us for the post-race party near Tuna Harbor Park, featuring live music, refreshments, fresh fruit, snacks and plenty of Holiday Bowl fun.

Then find a great spot and enjoy the remainder of the Port of San Diego Holiday Bowl Parade, featuring colorful floats, marching bands and huge inflatable characters traveling along San Diego's waterfront.

Run the 5K, celebrate at the finish and stay for the parade!

🏆 Age Divisions & Awards
Awards will be presented to the top 3 male and female 5K finishers in each age division:

• 12 & Under
• 13–17
• 18–24
• 25–29
• 30–34
• 35–39
• 40–44
• 45–49
• 50–54
• 55–59
• 60–64
• 65–69
• 70–74
• 75–79
• 80+
• Military – Current & Former
• Clydesdale/Athena – Males 220 lbs+ / Females 165 lbs+
• 40+ Clydesdale/Athena – Males 220 lbs+ / Females 165 lbs+

📍 Race Day Registration & Bib Pickup
Monday, December 28, 2026

Race-day registration and bib pickup begin at 6:00 AM in front of the Wyndham San Diego Bayside, near the corner of Harbor Drive and Ash Street.

Location:
1355 N. Harbor Drive
San Diego, CA 92101

Registration and bib pickup close at 7:30 AM.

Please allow plenty of time for parking, registration/bib pickup and getting to the start area.

👕 T-Shirt Pickup
Race shirts will be distributed at the finish line.

🏃 Run. Walk. Celebrate San Diego.
From the waterfront course and thousands of cheering spectators to your finisher medal and the spectacular Holiday Bowl Parade, this is much more than a 5K.

Make the Holiday Bowl 5K Run/Walk part of your 2026 Holiday Bowl celebration!

Questions?
Email info@kozevents.com

name: Pre Reg 2027 Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
This is the registration page for 2027 - if you are looking for info on the Aug 16th 2026- please go to 

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/FountainValley/Heroes4Hearing

 

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

HearAid Foundation presents our 6th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 15th, 2027 in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. 

Join us for an exhilarating run along the marina and water front in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the sea.

Event Details:

Bib Pickup: The day before at Sports Basement in Long Beach or on race day starting at 7 am

Race Start Times:
5k: 8 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Course Description:

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results & photos will be posted on this website.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff .

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!

We look forward to seeing you adjacent to the aquarium for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.

Beach to City Challenge

Want to nab an additional medal? Take part in the Beach to City Challenge with the Greta Garbo medal!

Greta Garbo, the cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor, called Culver City home, so we celebrate her with a special medal. If you run both the BRA Run and Screenland 5k (in Culver City) back-to-back, you can claim this bonus bling!

If you ran Screenland 5k 2028 and BRA Run 2028, you can claim your medal at BRA Run 2028
If you run BRA Run 2027 and Screenland 5k 2028, you can claim your medal at Screenland 5k 2028

You can only claim the bonus medal once a year.

Sign up for Screenland 5k 2028 to ensure your Greta Garbo medal. If you register for Screenland 5k at the BRA Run finish line, you'll get a discount on registration.

A list of those who qualify for the medal will be published on the BRA Run website in August before the event. Check to make sure your name is on it!

Thank you so much to ©Harriet Brown Inc. for working with us to bring you the iconic images of the great Greta Garbo that are used in our challenge medals.

name: Pre Registration 2027 - Beverly Hills Run of the Stars
description:
This is the page for the 2027 event! (If you are looking for the event held on Oct 18th, 2026, please click here https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/BeverlyHills/STARS5K) 

 

Lace up and run through the flat, scenic streets of Beverly Hills at this year’s 5K on October 17th, 2027!

 

Run or Walk on your own or on a team!

Can’t make it in person? Join our Virtual Challenge and complete your 5K from anywhere in the world.

We’re also hosting a 1K “Stars of Tomorrow” Kids Race held at the same location right after the 5K- perfect for young runners ready to shine! (Note: All ages are welcome to participate in the 5k but only those under-10 can registers for the 1k.)

 

This event supports NOT TODAY CANCER and their mission to find a CURE for devastating childhood cancers. 
 
Despite childhood cancer rates being on the rise, a desperately small amount of US Federal Funding for Cancer Research goes to children. 
 
When Mason was 9 years old he was diagnosed with T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).  His cancer was treated with chemotherapies that have been in use for decades, because there is a devastating lack of funding for new treatments with better outcomes!  
For two years, Mason and his family used the slogan “Not Today Cancer'“ as their mantra and when he died from the disease, the journey continued and this local non-profit was founded in Mason's honor. Scientists are close to a cure to help children like Mason and you can help! 
 
NOT TODAY CANCER 

 

Packet Pick Up, where you can get your shirt and bib, on Saturday, the day before the race. Time and Location TBD. 

If you are having someone else pick up your bib, shirt, and bag, they will need two things. A printed copy of your ID and a printed signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver here.  No bibs will be given out without this. The lawyers and our insurance company require us to be strict on this, sorry for the inconvenience.

If you are unable to join us the day before, you can pick up your bib and shirt on race day in the festival area but get there early and be prepared to wait in line on race day.
*Reminder: Please wear your bib on the front of your clothes so that your photos can be tagged and so we know you are with the event.*

DAY OF RACE INFO: https://www.nottodaycancer.care/ntc-run

RACE PARKING:  TBD

Race Day Schedule:

TBD

name: Pre-Registration 2027 Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Please visit https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun to sign up for the 2026 Plymouth Rock n Run or to view results or photos. This site is only for 2027 early registration. 

All information on this page and in your confirmation email are subject to change. Do not assume this is correct. Check the event website at https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun the week of the event and then again the day before the event to confirm the details. You will also get an email with event details that week. Check your junk folder if you don't see it. That email and the website supersede what is written here and supersedes what you get in your confirmation email. 

Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details that we have at the moment:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options are planned for the Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race day. Check out the bib pick up tab for the latest details as they are confirmed and follow us on social media for the fastest updates.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

PRELIMINARY RACE DAY SCHEDULE - SUBJECT TO CHANGE
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: Pre-Registration 2027 Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Please visit https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun to sign up for the 2026 Plymouth Rock n Run or to view results or photos. This site is only for 2027 early registration. 

All information on this page and in your confirmation email are subject to change. Do not assume this is correct. Check the event website at https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun the week of the event and then again the day before the event to confirm the details. You will also get an email with event details that week. Check your junk folder if you don't see it. That email and the website supersede what is written here and supersedes what you get in your confirmation email. 

Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details that we have at the moment:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options are planned for the Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race day. Check out the bib pick up tab for the latest details as they are confirmed and follow us on social media for the fastest updates.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

PRELIMINARY RACE DAY SCHEDULE - SUBJECT TO CHANGE
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: Pre-Registration Screenland 5K 2028
description:
This is only the Early Registration page for the 2028 event, please go to

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/CulverCity/Screenland5K  or https://www.screenland5k.com for more information about our event on February 28, 2027 and to sign up.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our start studded Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.

All participants will receive commemorative bib, official time, medal and shirt and on course support and entertainment, entrance into the post race party and free downloadable event photos among many other perks.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the 5K at Screenland and then either the 5K or the 13K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run in August at Dockweiler Beach .  If you missed Screenland in the spring, you can start the challenge at BRA Run in August and finish it at Screenland the following year.

We update the list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K  at www.BRArunLA.com.

description:
Well, here we go again! Another Great idea to continue to advocate for rare families. We are putting on another event! The "Rare Stair Challenge 2" at Central Park in Santa Clarita. Start time is 8 am! Come out and see how many flights of stairs you can do to raise awareness for rare diseases! Registration is just $20!
You can donate or pledge at the event, too!
  Location: Central Park, Santa Clarita
  Start Time: 8:00 AM
  Entry Fee: $20
Whether you take on one flight or challenge yourself to climb higher, every step makes a difference. Let’s come together as a community, have some fun, and support a heartfelt cause!
 Get a sponsor to make even more of a difference!
 Spread the word, bring your friends, and let’s make it an event to remember!

name: Project Youth OC - 2027 OC Marathon
description:
Join Team Project Youth OC!

Since 2004, Project Youth OC has proudly partnered with the OC Marathon as an official Charity Partner. In 2026, our runners, walkers, donors, sponsors, and supporters helped us surpass an incredible milestone: more than $1 million raised for Orange County youth and families.

In 2027, we are building on that momentum with We Run On Community - a celebration of the people who come together year after year to make a lasting difference.

The OC Marathon offers something for everyone:

5K Walk/Run: Saturday, May 1, 2027, at the OC Fairgrounds
Marathon & Half Marathon: Sunday, May 2, 2027, beginning at Fashion Island and finishing at the OC Fairgrounds

Whether you run, walk, fundraise, donate, or cheer from the sidelines, you are part of the community that moves our mission forward.

Every dollar raised through Team Project Youth OC helps us meet young people at pivotal turning points and provide the guidance, education, and family-centered support they need to build a path toward success. Together, we serve more than 1,500 youth and family members each year throughout Orange County.

Because when our community comes together, young people move forward.

Join Team Project Youth OC and help us make every mile matter. We Run On Community - and we hope you’ll run with us.

name: PSYKO FIT Halloween HYROX WEEKEND
description:
PSYKO FIT HYROX WEEKEND

Take a step into the HYROX arena with Psyko Fit Club—the first Hyrox affiliated gym in Sacramento.

Join us October 31st for our Halloween themed Full Hyrox Simulation.

🏆 Best Overall Costume — the top costume of the event
😂 Funniest Costume — biggest laughs
🎨 Most Creative — most original idea or execution
👯 Best Duo/Team Costume — perfect for HYROX Doubles
🤯 Most Outrageous — the costume that makes everyone say, “What the hell are you wearing?”

**Do you HAVE to race in a costume to participate? No, of course not...but you will not get any tricks or treats 😃 

Full HYROX Simulation

Race the full HYROX simulation using official equipment including CENTR wall balls, sandbags, and sleds. Practice your race strategy and experience the electric energy. Sign up solo or with a doubles partner.

The FULL HYROX SIM Workout:

*1,000 Meter Run before each station

  • Ski Erg – 1000 Meters
  • Sled Push - 50 Meters
  • Sled Pull – 50 Meters
  • Burpee Broad Jump - 80 Meters
  • Rower – 1000 Meters
  • Farmer Carry – 200 Meters
  • Sandbag Lunges – 100 Meters
  • Wall Balls – 100 reps

 

Event Details

Wave Start Format:

  • Choose your start time during registration
  • Arrive at least 30 minutes early for course walkthrough and warm-up
  • Athletes released in waves at scheduled times
  • Late arrivals placed in the next available wave
  • Wave sizes are limited—early registration strongly encouraged

What to Expect:

  • Clearly marked stations and smooth transitions
  • Coaches and volunteers at every station
  • On-site water and electrolytes
  • Supportive community and electric energy

Why Participate

  • Celebrate your training in a fun, safe, and structured environment
  • Build confidence for your next HYROX or competitive event
  • Create a performance you'll be proud of

Spots are limited!

THIS EVENT WILL SELLOUT!

name: Pulp Fiction: Royale with Speed 5K, 10K & 13.1
description:
December 12, 2026 | 7:00 AM Start | Canoga Park, CA | In-Person & Virtual Options

Say what again? Join us for a Tarantino-inspired race experience that brings cult-classic energy to the streets of Canoga Park. Whether you're running for redemption, milkshakes, or the Gold Watch, this is your chance to bring your cinematic swagger to the start line.

Run solo, with your Wolfpack, or in costume (highly encouraged). Each registration includes a themed race bib, medal, and downloadable finisher photos.

  • The Ezekiel 5K 🏃‍♂️ For those who walk the righteous path… but still want brunch after.
  • Jack Rabbit Slim’s 10K 🕺You’ll be dancing like Uma by mile 4.
  • The Quarter Pounder 13.1 🍔 You earned that $5 milkshake.
  • The Gold Watch Multiverse Challenge (Virtual) ⌚️Run anywhere, anytime, with a nod to Butch’s fateful heirloom.

All finishers will receive:

  • Custom race bib
  • Signature themed medal
  • Free downloadable finisher photos

name: Quarry Turkey
description:
The rarely seen Quarry Turkey will make his appearance two days after the big feast, fueled-up and ready to take on all the little turkeys! Come start a new Thanksgiving weekend tradition with a fast, mostly-flat half marathon, 10K or 5K!

Little Turkeys Race (about 100 yards or so) is free to all children brought with race participants.

Once again, we are also holding a food drive benefiting Alameda County Food Bank and are encouraging all participants (including little turkeys) to bring at least one canned good on race morning.

Want to make your Thanksgiving Epic? Sign up for the Double Turkey Challenge!
