    • Packet pick-up is optional, so if you cannot make it- don't worry. Packets can be picked up on race day starting at 7 am in LOT 25. The gates to the STATE PARK open at 7am.

Write a New Year resolution on the back of your bib and RUN, JOG, or WALK it into the new year. 

The course is the flat and fast, paved, wide State Park path, watching and listening to the surf.! Whether an avid runner, jogger, first-timer, or walker, we are the something for every BODY & EVERYBODY best-themed race! Bring family and friends, or just yourself and shoes! Let's get 2024 off and  RUNNING. 

  Entry comes with a Run In The New Year CUSTOM 5K/10K T-Shirt

  Special LONG SLEEVE DESIGN T-shirt for Half Marathon Finishers

  And, a huge CUSTOM CAST finisher medal to all! HUGE!!

Make it a Post-race 5K/10K resolution party ( New Year's Beanies will be for sale at the t-shirt table.)

GEAR CHECK is available, if needed, at the Caren Ware Events BOOTH.  Put your bib number on a tag and pin to your gear.  

Professionally CHIP timed event by ITZ ABOUT TIME. Age division awards galore!

Entrance to Bolsa Chica State Park.

The event is in the farthest western lot- Lot 25, closest to Warner & PCH, but to enter the park use the following address: 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy.

Race Day Schedule:

  • 6:00 am: Gates Open
  • 7:00 am: Race Day Packet Pick-Up Begins (Lot 25)
  • 8:00 am Half Marathon Start for those that will take more than 3 hours and 45 minutes to finish
  • 8:30 am: Half Marathon Start (Must cross the starting arch by 8:05 am)
  • 8:40 am: Kid’s Dash
  • 9:00am: 5K/10K Mass Start (Must cross the starting arch by 9:05 am)
  • 9:40am: 5K Awards Ceremony begins.
  • 10:00 am 10K awards
  • 10:30 announcing of overall Half marathon awards

8:30 am start for HALF MARATHON.  You have until 8:35 to pass under the arch.  9:00am start for 5k/10K.  You have until 9:05 am to pass under the arch.  All 5k/10K must start before the lead half marathoner finishes.   YOUR START TIME does not start until you cross under the arch. Fastest runners in the front, and those looking to place in their age group division. Wear your bib on the front.  Make sure you run the distance on your bib or exchange it for the correct one of your choice at the Solutions/Late registration table if you decide to change races.

SPECIAL PANCAKE BREAKFAST!!!! You can add pancakes to your registration on the last page...

Visit the Speciality Coffee Booth, Fresh baked cookies (GALLETINAS BOOTH),  fresh cut fruits,  and street tacos and tamales will be there.

Awards:

There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5 year age spans: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84 and 85 & over.

Course

Flat and fast, or slow and easy, make it the pace you want it. This 5K/10K course runs along the beach bike path at Bolsa Chica, Huntington Beach State Beach. Families can bring strollers but agree to use at their own risk.  Half Marathon Course: Flat, fast, perfect for PRs or training for your next marathon.  It is (2)Two loops of the 10k so you get plenty of aid stations, entertainment, and spectator friendly!! Aid Station Every 1.5 Miles

  • Water/Gatorade
  • Chargel/ Bananas  

FLAT!!! Great for first-time Half Marathoners or those wanting to PR!
Half Marathon Spectators - you can be at the finish line to see runners start then walk about 50 ft towards the runners to see them go on their second loop.

Restrooms:

Restrooms on RACE DAY: are located at each end of the parking lot.  A set by Sea Legs (east) and a set near  Warner Blvd on the west end of the parking lot.

name: Run Juneteenth Day 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
On Juneteenth, we remember resilience, honor progress, and run toward a brighter future.
Join the Juneteenth Day Run — an event that celebrates freedom, community, and the unbreakable human spirit.
Let’s make every mile matter.

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:00 AM
Wave B: 7:30 AM
Wave C: 8:00 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.

name: Run Like It's Recess 5K
description:
16th Annual Run Like It's Recess 5K Run/Walk, 1K, and Toddler Run

5K Start Time: 9:00 a.m.

1K Start Time: 10:15 a.m.

Toddler Run Start Time: 10:45 a.m.

This annual event is hosted by Newcomb Academy PTSA, which serves Newcomb Academy (Grades K–8), a public school in the Long Beach Unified School District.

A school fundraiser and a way to promote health and fitness to the entire area. This family-friendly event is open to all ages and fitness levels. Stroller and wheelchair friendly.

Medals will be given to all finishers with awards for the top three 5K finishers in each age group. FREE shirt and goody bag guaranteed if registered by January 10th, 2027 at 11:59 pm PT, after that date your shirt may not be available.

The Course

Flat, fast, and scenic. It takes place at El Dorado Park East in Long Beach, near the train and playground area. If you're looking to set a personal record or if you just want to take it easy and take in the scenery, this is the perfect course.

description:
Run Rudolph Run is the Monterey Peninsula's most treasured holiday run. Join us to raise awareness of and help defeat arthritis. name: Run the Robie (100 Mile relay )
description:
Run With Us (Open to Everyone)

We're bringing Run the Robie back with an exciting new format and this year, you get to choose how you race!

Solo Division : Run the legendary Robie mile on your own.

Duo Division : Grab a friend! Each runner completes one mile, and your combined time determines your final result.

Team Division : Build a team of four. Each runner tackles one mile, and the fastest combined time wins.

Whether you're chasing a personal best, challenging your friends, representing your run club, or simply looking for an unforgettable day on the trails, there's a division for everyone.

  • Awards for Solo, Duo, and Team divisions
  • Most Creative Team
  • Best Costume

Expect an incredible day with music, food, local vendors, great vibes, and one of Auburn's most iconic trail miles.

Come solo. Bring your best friend. Or rally your whole crew.

Run Fast… or Pretend Like You Are.

We'll see you at Robie!

Be part of Auburn history.

 

 
Choose Your Challenge

Option 1: Official 100-Mile Relay
Be one of the official relay runners carrying the baton for one mile on Auburn trails.

Includes:


Relay experience
Commemorative shirt ACG SPECIAL SURPRISE
Community celebration
A chance to be part of the official record attempt

Spots available:  * must run a mile under 15 minutes , the route is 70% up hill with 130 ft of elevation ( plese be honest)


Not one of the 100 relay runners?

 

100 Miles in 25 Days Challenge
Open to everyone. Any pace. Anywhere.

Run, walk, or hike 100 miles in 25 days and earn your finish.

Includes:


100-mile finisher buckle
Community challenge experience
Your name as part of the movement


Register for the 25-Day Challenge

 
Who Can Join?

Fast runners.
Slow runners.
Walkers.
Hikers.
Legends.
Beginners.
People pretending like they’re fast.

This is for everyone who wants to show up.

 
The Mission


This is more than a relay.

It’s 100 miles of community, grit, laughter, history, and Auburn trail magic.

Run Fast… or Pretend Like You Are.
 
 
 * Pick up your buckle at the finish like of the relay ( join the party and run the last mile with us )

name: Run Through Redlands
description:
The Run Through Redlands is broken down into three separate races: a 5k, a 10k and a half marathon. All of the courses wind through beautiful Redlands tree lined streets, pass historic home and provide breathtaking views of the San Bernardino mountains. That is if you have any breath left!

The 5k course is almost entirely flat which makes this a perfect race if you are wanting a PR! The 10k course features fewer climbs and will include running through historic Smiley Heights. The half marathon course will have less elevation gain than previous years and will include running through Prospect Park, the Redlands Country Club area, Redlands Community Hospital and Smiley Heights on the way back to downtown Redlands and the finish at the Redlands Bowl.


COURSES
5K:  Almost entirely flat.  Great course to grab a P.R. or first-time runners.  2 Aid Stations - Course Map
10K:  Flat with a few gentle climbs.  You’ll run through historic Smiley Heights.  4 Aid Stations - Course Map
HALF MARATHON:  You’ll run through Prospect Park, Redlands Country Club area, through Smiley Heights on the way back to downtown Redlands and finishing at the Redlands Bowl. 7 Aid Stations - Course Map

name: Run With All Your Heart 5k- Los Angeles
description:
Get ready to lace up and make a difference! Join Curing Kids Cancer for the Run With All Your Heart 5K Fun Run, a high-energy, family-friendly event organized by our Future Leaders in Medicine. An incredible team spearheads this inspiring run: UCLA resident and founder Brandon Gettleman, alongside UCLA Geffen School of Medicine's Amanda Perrotta and Sumin Jeong (LA Event Co-Directors)

Saturday, May 1st | Griffith Park, Los Angeles, CA
Registration: 8:00 AM | Race Start: 9:00 AM

Whether you're a seasoned runner or just in it for fun, this event is for all ages and fitness levels! With every step you take, the proceeds directly support a local, multidisciplinary, multi-institutional sarcoma project led by the region’s top specialists in the greater Los Angeles area. Let’s run, have fun, and give kids battling cancer the future they deserve. Sign up today and be a part of something bigger!

***Chip Timing will be provided for the run by SVE Timing***

We can’t wait to see you there!

name: Run With Los Muertos 5K & Block Party
description:
Come to Old Town Coachella on Saturday, November 7th for a Día de Los Muertos celebration like no other. Now in its 13th year, Run with Los Muertos continues to be one of the most unique, inspiring, art-filled, and entertaining 5k night runs in the nation. From the pre, during, and post 5k art viewing opportunities, the live music, neon lights, burning candles, painted faces, on course entertainment, to the Los Muertos procession, the 13th Annual Run with Los Muertos promises to be a fun and fulfilling Saturday night. In honor of a passed loved one, join hundreds of runners and thousands of spectators from throughout the country at this unique health and culture event held during Southern California's perfect fall weather.

Who will you run for? Fee includes bib, t-shirt, and glow necklace. Awards for top 3 overall, each age group, and team category.

Registration opens at 4pm
Race begins at 6pm
Art and Music from 4pm-12am
Beer Garden open from 5pm -12am

For the safety of all of our patrons, please abide by the following rules and regulations: 
Only certified service dogs are allowed at the event/on the race route.
No weapons, including firearms, knives or mace. 
5K participants are not permitted to run with flags, signs, etc. 
No bicycles, scooters, skateboards, rollerblades or like vehicles of any kind are permitted on race route, children in strollers are OK.
Participants must stay within course boundaries, as designated by barriers, traffic cones, delineation, and/or other markings, at all times.
Anyone on the course without a bib/or without permission from the Run with Los Muertos team will be immediately asked to exit the course.

All sales final. Registration can only be rolled over to the following year in case of injury. Deadline to roll over your registration is October 5, 2026.

*T-shirt size not guaranteed if registered after October 5, 2026*

**Must register by November 2, 2026 to be eligible for pre packet pick up. Packet Pick Up Dates TBA.**

***Registration on or after Tuesday, November 3, 2026 could lead to a delay of receiving event T-shirt up to 4 weeks after event night.***

For questions and vendor or sponsorship opportunities please email: info@runwithlosmuertos.com

name: Run Your Heart Out – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: Junipero Beach, 1 Junipero Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (four laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Run, Fiesta, Repeat - Cinco de Mayo 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
🎉 Get ready to celebrate Cinco de Mayo with a fiesta like no other! Join us on Saturday, May 1, 2027, in beautiful Long Beach for a high-energy race experience filled with ocean views, music, community, and nonstop good vibes. Whether you’re taking on the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon, this event is designed for runners and walkers of all levels.

🌴 Come Run the Vibe — Long Beach Style!

📍 Start Line: 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA
(Click the address above in registration to open Google Maps.)

📅 Date: Saturday, May 1, 2027

Get ready to experience Long Beach like never before. Run, Fiesta, Repeat isn’t just a race — it’s a celebration of movement, culture, sunshine, and the CaliFlow community.

This scenic beachfront course takes you along the Long Beach beach path with gorgeous ocean views, palm trees, fresh air, and a fun high-vibe atmosphere from start to finish. Whether you’re chasing a PR or simply soaking in the experience, this race is all about enjoying the miles.

🌟 WHAT’S INCLUDED WITH REGISTRATION:
✔ USATF Certified Course
✔ Professional Chip Timing
✔ Live Results Within Minutes
✔ Finisher Medal
✔ Overall & Age Group Awards
✔ Race Bib
✔ Free Race Day Photos
✔ Live DJ & Finish Line Party
✔ Vendors & Giveaways
✔ Water & Electrolyte Stations
✔ Scenic Coastal Beachfront Course
✔ Stroller & Walker Friendly
✔ Fully Marked Course

⏰ Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:

📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent near the start line

HALF MARATHON
🕠 Bib Pick-Up: 5:30 AM – 6:15 AM
🏁 Start Time: 6:15 AM
✨ Early Start Option at 6:00 AM available by request
🎯 Course closes at 9:30 AM

10K & 5K
🕠 Regitration Open 6:00 AM
🏁 Start Time:

7:00 AM Half Marathon

8:00 AM 5K 10K

✔ Restrooms available near the start
✔ Aid stations at turnaround points
✔ Friendly on-course staff and volunteers

🚗 Parking Info – Easy & Close to the Start!

Public parking is available throughout the area near the beach path and marina lots. We recommend arriving early for the closest parking options.

☀️ Safety, Weather & Vibes:
✔ Low morning foot traffic
✔ Smooth beachfront running path
✔ Professional race staff on course
✔ Rain or shine event
✔ High vibes only

🏁 Let’s Run, Fiesta & Repeat Together!
Whether you’re showing up for a fast finish, beachside fun, or simply the love of running, this race is your excuse to celebrate movement and community in true CaliFlow style.

Come run Long Beach with us and experience the energy that makes CaliFlow Runs different. 🌊✨

name: Run4Recovery 5K Run/Walk
description:
Run4Recovery 5K Run/Walk raises awareness and funding to support recovering alcoholics and addicts by providing Sober Living Scholarships—offering shelter, stability, and nourishment to those most vulnerable to relapse.

Through the Puente House Foundation (a 501(c)(3) non-profit), we provide safe housing for individuals who may be dealing with homelessness or are escaping environments filled with drug use and violence.

For many, this scholarship is the difference between life and death. It offers a path to reunite with family, rejoin society, and embrace a pro-recovery lifestyle.

name: runCHINO
description: This page is for Run/Walk events in the Chino, California area.

name: Runnin' To The Rig
description:
Embrace the BHS Legacy and Join us for our 2nd Runnin' To The Rig 5k Run/Walk!

Saturday, February 20th - Shot Gun Start at 8:30am and Check-in at 7:30am

Runners Start on Morrow Field / Walkers Start on Griffith Field Stadium / Embrace the Legacy Tour meets at the Water Tower near the concessions stand at Griffith Field.

Day of Race Registration 7am - 8am at Check-In Desk at Table on Morrow Field.  Cost is $40/pp

We invite you to participate with us in this FUNdraising endeavor to build community and raise funds. Our 5k course is designed as a nostalgic run/walk throughout our historic campus ending near the famous football tunnel in Griffith Stadium.   Our 2K walk will meander around campus and even through some of the buildings.  The Walk will start after the Run.  Medals given to all finishers!          

Race T-shirts can be purchased during registration for an extra fee if you pre-register  by February 4th.

Plan to hang around after the race for pictures and selfies on historic Griffith Field. 

Don't wait, come join the fun! We are grateful for your support of Bakersfield High School. Go Blue! Once a Driller, Always a Driller!

 

Bib & T-shirt Pickup

You can pick up your race packet and t-shirt at the stadium parking lot near Griffith Stadium.

Fri. Feb. 19,  3:30-6 pm
Sat. Feb. 20,  7-8 am

name: Running For Warriors
description:
Join us for the Second Annual Running For Warriors 5K, presented by Veterans Freedom Shows and Events

Veterans Freedom Shows and Events is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting veteran-focused causes.

Our mission is simple but impactful: To provide financial assistance to organizations that honor and serve our nation’s veterans, including Central Valley Honor Flight and Wreaths Across America. We also host our own veteran-focused events, including WXO (Warrior Expeditions Off-Road). Veterans interested in participating should contact Veterans Freedom Shows and Events for pricing information. www.VeteransFreedomShowsAndEvents.com

After the race, you can go over to Clovis Veterans Memorial District for a Pancake breakfast from 0700-1100, Live Band and Car Show 0900-1400, Faces of our Veterans Exhibit 0900-1400, Veteran Documentaries 0900-1400, tour the Community Heritage Center 0900-1400, and the Patriotic Concert begins at 1100. For more information on these events, go to https://cvmdistrict.ca.gov/veteransday

name: Running Is For The Birds - 5K, 10K, Kids Run & Walk - Earth Day Celebration
description:
Amigos De Bolsa Chica, in conjunction with Bolsa Chica State Beach is hosting a run/walk/beach cleanup for Earth Day! 
🌎 Run for the Birds, Run for the Planet, Run for Earth Day
Join us on Saturday, April 24, 2027, at Bolsa Chica State Beach — where every step makes a difference.
Run and walk along the beach on a flat, fast, and paved course with stunning ocean views.
🎉 FREE BEACH PARKING before 8:00 AM — races start sharp!
Race Day Schedule:
  • Same Day Registration/Runner Check-In: Opens 7:00 AM
  • Warm-Up & Announcements: 7:50 AM
  • 5K, 10K Start: 8:00 AM
  • Kids Dash: 9:00 AM
  • Overall and Age Group Awards: 9:15 AM
     
    🏃‍♀️ Race Options:
    Plover Dash 5K
    Brown Pelican 10K
    Fuzzy Feathers Fun Run (for the kiddos)
    5K Plogging (picking up litter while jogging)
    10K Plogging
    Beach Clean Up with State Beach staff
     
    🧢 What You Get:
    All registered participants in the 5K, 10K, and Plogging events receive:
🏅 Custom Commemorative Medal – designed exclusively for this Earth Day event
👕 Limited-Edition Race Shirt – beautifully designed by a local artist and featuring a different Bolsa Chica bird each year. These collectible commemorative shirts are more than swag — they’re wearable art that celebrates the spirit of the wetlands.
📸 Free Race Day Photos – downloadable & shareable with no hidden costs
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
⏱️ Professional Chip Timing – results synced to Athlinks
🎪 Finish Line Festival – vendors, product samples, music & local community vibes
 
✅ FREE Beach Parking (arrive early!)
🚲 Bike Valet available near the start line
🎒 Gear Check Available
Fuzzy Feathers Kids Run participants receive commemorative medals & special prizes.
 
✨ Bonus Highlights:
🌿 Environmental Impact – Proceeds benefit the Amigos de Bolsa Chica's environmental education & leadership programs that raise aware and protect California’s biodiversity. The Amigos is a 501c3 non-profit, tax ID #33-0752003.
♻️ Plogging Categories – Run and help clean the beach as you go!
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Community Connection – Family-friendly, walker-welcoming, and volunteer-powered
🔬 Interactive Expo – Explore Bolsa Chica wetlands up close with microscopes, wildlife exhibits, and hands-on learning hosted by the Amigos.
 
Celebrate Earth Day with purpose — and make your miles matter.
🌎💚 Sign up today, lock in your shirt size, and let’s run wild for a better planet.

name: Running with the Wildcats
description:
Ojai in the Fall. Crisp, cool weather. Perfect for a hot chocolate and a chance to be Running with the Wildcats..

Cross country season is coming to a close, and while only qualifiers are running at the state's season finale, you can join us for an unforgettable romp through the Villanova campus. Whether you're a seasoned trail runner or just looking for a novel course, you'll enjoy the challenge of our unique course.

Our scenic 3 mile XC course winds through the campus on 90% dirt, starting and finishing on the track. You'll run through Shady Glen then venture out to Archery Site where you dip into the Valley. Running past Deer Hallow will carry you through the valley to the challenging Resurrection Hill. The race concludes with a rolling 3rd mile to the finish on the track. No dogs or strollers will be allowed on the course for safety reasons.

Registration includes electronic timing, commemorative finisher medal and  t-shirt, and refreshing after race snacks. For an added fee you can become part of the history by adding your name ($50) or the name of your business ($100) to the back of our commemorative t-shirt.

name: San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon
description:
The San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon is an award-winning loop course along some of the best of San Diego’s coastline. Experience beautiful beaches to picturesque bays, you’ll run past SeaWorld, Belmont Park, Mission Beach, Pacific Beach, and Sail Bay — the best of San Diego in one unforgettable course.

With only 165 feet of total elevation gain, this is one of California’s flattest and fastest half marathons — perfect for chasing a PR or enjoying the ultimate destination race in San Diego.

Register today and join us on April 10, 2027.

name: San Diego Holiday Half Marathon & 5K
description: The San Diego Holiday Half Marathon is a fast 13.1-mile course that starts on Penasquitos Drive in front of the Hotel Karlan (formerly, the Doubletree Golf Resort) then travels SW along Carmel Mountain Rd (your only ‘real’ hill at mile 1.5), along the 56 bike path and finishes at the beautiful Torrey Pines State Beach (pictured above!). The race includes a 711-foot net elevation drop along the “rolling” downhill bike path, which also makes it a personal best candidate. This popular winter half has been a sell-out event every year. Get your end-of-the-year PR!!!

name: San Diego International Triathlon & Waterfront 5.6K
description:
🏊‍♂️🚴‍♀️🏃‍♂️ 45TH ANNUAL SAN DIEGO INTERNATIONAL TRIATHLON
CELEBRATING 45 YEARS OF TRIATHLON HISTORY!

📅 Sunday, June 27, 2027
📍 San Diego, California — Downtown Waterfront

For 45 years, athletes have been coming to San Diego to swim, bike, run, compete, celebrate, and become part of an incredible triathlon tradition.

In 2027, we celebrate the 45th Annual San Diego International Triathlon (SDIT) — a milestone edition of one of the oldest triathlons in the world!

Whether you're an experienced triathlete chasing a fast race, taking on your first multisport event, joining a relay team, or coming with friends and family for the Waterfront 5.6K, this is your chance to become part of 45 years of San Diego triathlon history.

And for our 45th anniversary, we're bringing back some very special SDIT traditions!

🎁 45TH ANNIVERSARY RACE SWAG & PERKS
👕 Long-Sleeve Tech Race Shirt

🏅 Wearable Finisher Belt Buckle — a special SDIT tradition is back! Wear it as your finisher medal or put it on a belt and keep using it long after race day.

🍺 Modern Times & Ashland Seltzer Beer Garden

🥂 Mimosas

💆‍♀️ Massage Therapists at the Finish

🎶 Live Music & Finish-Line Celebration

🥐☕ Snacks & Coffee in the Transition Area

⏱ Chip Timing with Lap Splits

📊 Online Results

🏆 San Diego Triathlon Series Points

✅ USA Triathlon Sanctioned Event

 
🌊 RACE THROUGH SAN DIEGO
This isn't a race tucked away on the outskirts of town. SDIT puts you right in the middle of San Diego.

Start your morning on the waterfront at San Diego Bay and race through a course filled with some of the city's most recognizable scenery and historic landmarks.

🏊 SWIM — SAN DIEGO BAY
Begin your race with an open-water swim in the waters of beautiful San Diego Bay.

🚴 BIKE — POINT LOMA
Ride through Point Loma past incredible San Diego landmarks, including Cabrillo National Monument, the historic Point Loma Lighthouse, and Fort Rosecrans National Cemetery.

🏃 RUN — SAN DIEGO WATERFRONT
Finish with a spectacular waterfront run past San Diego icons including the Star of India and USS Midway, before racing toward your downtown San Diego finish line.

There aren't many triathlons where the course itself feels like a tour of the city.

 
🏁 CHOOSE YOUR RACE
You don't have to do the full triathlon to be part of SDIT. Choose the challenge that's right for you.

SPRINT TRIATHLON
🏊 500M Swim (0.31 Miles) • 🚴 20K Bike (12.4 Miles) • 🏃 5.6K Run (3.5 Miles)

INTERNATIONAL TRIATHLON
🏊 1K Swim (0.62 Miles) • 🚴 30K Bike (18.6 Miles) • 🏃 10K Run (6.2 Miles)

INTERNATIONAL RELAY TRIATHLON
🏊 1K Swim (0.62 Miles) • 🚴 30K Bike (18.6 Miles) • 🏃 10K Run (6.2 Miles)
Teams of 2–3 athletes

INTERNATIONAL AQUABIKE — SWIM + BIKE
🏊 1K Swim (0.62 Miles) • 🚴 30K Bike (18.6 Miles)

SPRINT DUATHLON — RUN + BIKE + RUN
🏃 1 Mile Run • 🚴 20K Bike (12.4 Miles) • 🏃 5.6K Run (3.5 Miles)

SPRINT AQUABIKE — SWIM + BIKE
🏊 500M Swim (0.31 Miles) • 🚴 20K Bike (12.4 Miles)

SPRINT AQUATHLON — SWIM + RUN
🏊 500M Swim (0.31 Miles) • 🏃 5.6K Run (3.5 Miles)

5.6K WATERFRONT RUN
🏃 5.6K Run (3.5 Miles)

 
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 BRING YOUR FAMILY & FRIENDS — THEY CAN RACE TOO!
Coming to watch someone race the triathlon? Don't just spectate — join the fun!

The 5.6K Waterfront Run (3.5 Miles) is a great way for family members, friends, runners, and walkers to be part of the SDIT experience.

Your family and friends can experience race morning with you, take on the beautiful San Diego waterfront course, and meet you at the downtown finish-line celebration.

It's 5K+ — because we couldn't stop the fun at exactly 5K. It's actually 5.6K / 3.5 miles!

 
🍺 CELEBRATE AT THE FINISH — AND SUPPORT A 45-YEAR TRADITION
Crossing the finish line is only the beginning of the celebration.

Stick around for live music, our race expo, massages, mimosas, and the Modern Times & Ashland Seltzer Beer Garden on the San Diego waterfront.

And there's an important reason the Beer Garden has been part of SDIT for so many years.

❤️ All proceeds from the Beer Garden benefit Father Joe's Villages.

Supporting Father Joe's Villages has been an SDIT tradition for 45 years, making giving back to the San Diego community part of this race from the very beginning.

So when you raise a glass after crossing the finish line, you're not only celebrating your accomplishment — you're helping carry on a 45-year tradition of athletes supporting Father Joe's Villages and our San Diego community.

45 YEARS OF RACING. 45 YEARS OF TRADITION. 45 YEARS OF GIVING BACK.
 
⭐ BE PART OF THE 45TH
Bring your friends. Bring your family. Make a weekend of it in San Diego.

Whether this will be your first San Diego International Triathlon or you've been racing with us for years, the 45th anniversary is one you won't want to miss.

🏊 Swim San Diego Bay.
🚴 Ride historic Point Loma.
🏃 Run the San Diego waterfront.
🏅 Earn your 45th Anniversary finisher belt buckle.

name: San Diego MLK 5K Walk / Fun Run
description:
RESULTS:  Timed Race Results

Walk, jog or run!  Join us on Harbor Dr. to celebrate MLK weekend in a healthy fashion with a scenic Embarcadero experience!  This 5K Walk / Fun Run celebrates the legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and his dream to improve the equal participation of all in healthcare, education and workforce development.  We're inspired to help move our community toward a more healthy way of living.  What better way to do that than with the objective of completing a 5k.  Bring your family and friends (human and furry) to the Embarcadero and get moving with us!  See you at the starting line! 

 

We hope to inspire those who have never taken part in a 5K walk / run, to participate.  This event promotes health, fitness, and a general sense of well-being through a fun and engaging manner.

 

"School" option with age based pricing intended to be free for school age kids is active.  

 

We encourage you to post your photos on Social Media with #SDMLK5k.  

 

Registration includes the following. 

  • Official 5K walk / fun run Shirt.
  • Medal
  • Runners Bib
  • Chip race timing

 

5K details:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 3.1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village continuing along the harbor coastline and looping around back to the start.  
  • Timing offered.

 

1 Mile Cruiser Walk / Run:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village to loop around back to the start.

name: San Diego-North County Turkey Trot
description:
Get ready for the 3rd Annual San Diego–North County Turkey Trot! 🦃🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

Kick off your Thanksgiving with a fun, active morning filled with community, movement, and holiday spirit!

Whether you’re chasing a personal best, walking with family and friends, or cheering on the little ones, there’s something for everyone:

🕖 7:15 AM — 10K Start
🕢 7:30 AM — 5K Start
🏅 8:30 AM — 5K Awards
🧒 8:45 AM — Kids 1K Fun Run
🏆 9:00 AM — 10K Awards & Costume Contest

The Turkey Trot is more than just a race — it’s a chance to get moving, connect with your neighbors, and start Thanksgiving on a positive note. Even better, all proceeds benefit Active Kids Alliance, an organization that provides sports scholarships to children and families in need.

Active Kids Alliance has already helped more than 116 families, and with your support, they can continue giving even more kids the opportunity to experience the joy, confidence, and connection that come from participating in sports. ❤️

Every participant will receive:
• A participation shirt
• A finisher medal
• A swag bag
• Entry into the raffle
• A chance to earn awards in each age division

So grab your family, round up your friends, put on your best turkey-themed costume, and join us bright and early on Thanksgiving morning! 🍂🦃

Come for the race, stay for the fun, and start your Thanksgiving making a difference. We can’t wait to see you at the starting line!

name: San Joaquin River Trail 10k/25k/50k
description:
Come out and run some of the best trails in the valley along Millerton Lake and the San Joaquin River. 

More info at: www.SanJoaquinRunning.com

Start/Finish: At the S. Finegold Pinic Area, located at the end of Sky Harbour Road in Friant, CA. Sky Harbor Road is located on the West side of Table Mountain Casino off of Millerton Rd. in Friant, Ca. Take Sky Harbor Rd North for approx. 6 miles and it will dead end at the South Finegold Picnic Area where parking is located. 

Start times: 50k – 0630am  •  25k – 0700am  •  10k – 0730am 

Packet Pickup/Check in: Race day at the Start/Finish area. Please arrive arrive early to get your bib, check in and hit the bathroom. NO RACE DAY ENTRIES.

Race Day Check In: 0540-0620am for 50k runners  •  0600-0655am for 25k runners •  0640-0725am for 25k runners <br /><br />

Pacers: Allowed for the 50k at Mile 16 (SJR Gorge/Aid Station #3&4)

Official cutoff for the Finish line will be 5:30pm 

Lodging: If you're traveling from out of town the nearest places to stay will be in Clovis, CA and Fresno, CA.

Camping: Camping is available on the North side of Millerton Lake and also near the 50k turnaround at the San Joaquin River Gorge Mgmt area, each is about a 30 min drive from the Start/Finish. No camping is available at the Start/Finish.

Refunds/Transfer: No refunds after 09/01/2024. Bib transfers are allowed until 10/01/2024.

Crew access: Crew access at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area near the Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground-Mile 14.5 for 50k 

Aid Stations: Aid stations will be almost every 5 miles along the course. They will have water, sports drink, gels, fruit, snacks and basic first aid. 

Drop Bags: Need to be marked "Drop bags" with bib# conspicuously written on it. They will be at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area, Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground.

(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: Santa Beer Run & Kids Elf Run
description:
SANTA BEER RUN (Race Starts at 10:00am)

Run. Sip. Give back. Join us Saturday, December 29th in Exeter for the Santa Beer Run! Costumes encouraged – good times guaranteed!

How It Works:

The race begins with drinking a 12-oz beer (provided by The Stag Saloon) at the start line.

- Lap 1: Run ¼ mile around Downtown Exeter.
- Lap 2: Drink a 12-oz beer at Bell Craft Brew Co., then run another ¼ mile.
- Lap 3: Drink a 12-oz beer at The Rock Yard Tavern, then run another ¼ mile.
- Lap 4: Finish with a 12-oz beer at Bell Craft Brew Co., then run the final ¼ mile.

After the fourth beer and fourth lap, cross the finish line to complete the beer mile and earn ultimate holiday bragging rights!

Race Options:

- Individual Beer Mile: One runner completes all four beers and all four laps.
- Relay Beer Mile (4 person relay): Divide the beers and laps among teammates. Each teammate drinks one beer and runs one lap before tagging the next runner.

Prizes:

The top three individual men and women, as well as the fastest four-person relay team will recieive an one-of-a-kind trophy! Also, prizes will be awarded to the "Best Dressed Participant" and "Best Dressed Relay Team"!

Participants MUST be 21+ years of age to participate in the Beer Run

name: Santa Clarita Trail Race
description:
EPIC RACE IN THE GOLDEN HILLS OF SANTA CLARITA, CA

R

Step into the golden trails of California and join us for the Santa Clarita Trail Race—an unforgettable trail running experience for all levels, brought to you by New Global Adventures, creators of the popular VALENCIA Trail Race and SPACEROCK Trail Race.

Set in the historic Placerita Canyon, where gold was first discovered in 1842, this race takes you through some of the most stunning and diverse landscapes in Santa Clarita, CA. From challenging hills and winding trails to breathtaking panoramic views on our epic course, you’ll experience why Southern California is home to some of the best trail running in the country.

Whether you’re aiming for a 5K to 15K, or looking for an elevated challenge of 30K or 60K, or getting as many miles in 6 to 12-hours, or race with friends in our team relay options, the Santa Clarita Trail Race offers the perfect race for your goals.

  • Beginner Friendly > 5K–15K options
  • Serious Challenge > 30K–60K
  • Elevate Endurance > 6–12 hours
  • Run With Friends > Relay teams
  • Festival > Camping Experience

AWESOME TRAILS
Run along flowing singletrack trails that wind through East Walker Ranch Open Space with a few killer hills to climb and a blissfully long downhill as you journey through the sun-kissed golden hills of Santa Clarita.

360 VIEWS
Conquer the heart-pounding climbs to reach the sweet ridgelines and be rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views stretching across the stunning Santa Clarita Valley.

NATURE
Leave the concrete jungle behind and immerse yourself in nature’s beauty and reconnect with the peaceful, healing landscapes to recharge the body, mind, and spirit.

CAMPING
Camping at the race adds to the overall race experience for relay teams and ultra runners. Giving you a home base for the perfect setup to push your limits with confidence.

NOTE: Relay team registrations are available on the official race website. 

Learn more and see full race details at SantaClaritaTrailRace.com

name: Santa Claus For A Cause 5K/10K
description:
Santa Claus with a Cause 5K/10K
📅 Saturday, December 12th, 2026
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25, Huntington Beach, CA

Get ready for the ultimate Santa celebration at Bolsa Chica State Beach!
This isn’t just a race, it’s a full-blown Christmas experience.

You’ll run along the beach surrounded by falling snow, live carolers, festive music, and holiday cheer. Every runner receives their choice of a full Santa suit, cozy Santa beanie, or custom-designed race shirt, plus one of the biggest, most festive finisher Santa medal designed to double as a Christmas ornament.

And the best part? This race GIVES BACK. Proceeds from the event help gift staple goods, schooling, and hope to villages in Africa and Nepal, as well as supporting local health initiatives.

 
🎄 Race Day Fun & Schedule
Arrive early and soak up the holiday spirit. There’s so much happening before the race even starts!

6:30 – 8:15 AM: Registration and bib pick-up open at Lot 25. Walk-up registrations are welcome, so bring your friends!

7:00 – 9:00 AM: The REAL Santa 🎅 will be on-site for festive selfie photos (use hashtag #carenwareevents or tag us caren.ware.events). Lil Dickens Carolers will be singing, and snow will be falling to set the perfect holiday mood.

8:00 AM: Kids take center stage with the Ho Ho Ho Dashes (200m, 400m, ½ mile, and 1 mile). Cheer on the little elves as they dash through the holiday magic!

8:15 AM Holiday Costume Contest

8:20 AM: Warm up with the Penguin Macarena! Everyone is invited to join in. Best Costume and Best Christmas Spirit awards are given out here, so come dressed to impress.

8:30 AM: MASS START for the 5K & 10K! Your official time begins when you cross under the start arch, but you must cross by 8:40 AM to be officially timed.

9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony

9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony

11:00 AM - Expo Festivities End

 
🎁 What’s Included
Your registration comes packed with holiday cheer! Every participant receives chip-timed results for the 5K or 10K, so you can track your performance. You’ll also get to choose your festive swag, whether you want to run in a full Santa suit, stay cozy in a Santa beanie, or sport a custom-designed Santa race shirt.

When you cross the finish line, you’ll receive one of the biggest custom Santa-at-the-beach medal that doubles as a Christmas ornament to hang proudly on your tree.

Throughout the morning, enjoy a lively holiday atmosphere with falling snow, live carolers, games, and photo ops with the REAL Santa. Prizes will be awarded for Best Christmas Spirit, Best Costume, and even Best Dressed Doggie, so bring your creativity and holiday cheer.

And don’t leave hungry, we’ll have food vendors on-site serving tamales, tacos, specialty coffee, cookies, fresh fruit and more. Plan on enjoying breakfast by the beach with us after your run!

And for the competitors, we have three-deep age division awards in five-year increments — from ages 1-10 all the way through 85+.

 
📅 Early Packet Pick-Up- Optional
Race Day Pick-Up: 6:30 – 8:15 AM at Lot 25
Early Pick-Up: TBD
(No ID required, and you may pick up for others.)
 
🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Bolsa Chica State Beach Lot 25 parking is $15 per vehicle (cash or state park pass recommended). The main gate opens at 6:00 AM — use the main entrance only.

Drop-off is available at the corner of Warner & PCH. Free public parking is also available in Sunset Beach (behind Jack in the Box) if you’d like to walk in.

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

name: Santa Claus For A Cause 5K/10K
description:
Santa Claus with a Cause 5K/10K
📅 Saturday, December 12th, 2026
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25, Huntington Beach, CA

Get ready for the ultimate Santa celebration at Bolsa Chica State Beach!
This isn’t just a race, it’s a full-blown Christmas experience.

You’ll run along the beach surrounded by falling snow, live carolers, festive music, and holiday cheer. Every runner receives their choice of a full Santa suit, cozy Santa beanie, or custom-designed race shirt, plus one of the biggest, most festive finisher Santa medal designed to double as a Christmas ornament.

And the best part? This race GIVES BACK. Proceeds from the event help gift staple goods, schooling, and hope to villages in Africa and Nepal, as well as supporting local health initiatives.

 
🎄 Race Day Fun & Schedule
Arrive early and soak up the holiday spirit. There’s so much happening before the race even starts!

6:30 – 8:15 AM: Registration and bib pick-up open at Lot 25. Walk-up registrations are welcome, so bring your friends!

7:00 – 9:00 AM: The REAL Santa 🎅 will be on-site for festive selfie photos (use hashtag #carenwareevents or tag us caren.ware.events). Lil Dickens Carolers will be singing, and snow will be falling to set the perfect holiday mood.

8:00 AM: Kids take center stage with the Ho Ho Ho Dashes (200m, 400m, ½ mile, and 1 mile). Cheer on the little elves as they dash through the holiday magic!

8:15 AM Holiday Costume Contest

8:20 AM: Warm up with the Penguin Macarena! Everyone is invited to join in. Best Costume and Best Christmas Spirit awards are given out here, so come dressed to impress.

8:30 AM: MASS START for the 5K & 10K! Your official time begins when you cross under the start arch, but you must cross by 8:40 AM to be officially timed.

9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony

9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony

11:00 AM - Expo Festivities End

 
🎁 What’s Included
Your registration comes packed with holiday cheer! Every participant receives chip-timed results for the 5K or 10K, so you can track your performance. You’ll also get to choose your festive swag, whether you want to run in a full Santa suit, stay cozy in a Santa beanie, or sport a custom-designed Santa race shirt.

When you cross the finish line, you’ll receive one of the biggest custom Santa-at-the-beach medal that doubles as a Christmas ornament to hang proudly on your tree.

Throughout the morning, enjoy a lively holiday atmosphere with falling snow, live carolers, games, and photo ops with the REAL Santa. Prizes will be awarded for Best Christmas Spirit, Best Costume, and even Best Dressed Doggie, so bring your creativity and holiday cheer.

And don’t leave hungry, we’ll have food vendors on-site serving tamales, tacos, specialty coffee, cookies, fresh fruit and more. Plan on enjoying breakfast by the beach with us after your run!

And for the competitors, we have three-deep age division awards in five-year increments — from ages 1-10 all the way through 85+.

 
📅 Early Packet Pick-Up- Optional
Race Day Pick-Up: 6:30 – 8:15 AM at Lot 25
Early Pick-Up: TBD
(No ID required, and you may pick up for others.)
 
🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Bolsa Chica State Beach Lot 25 parking is $15 per vehicle (cash or state park pass recommended). The main gate opens at 6:00 AM — use the main entrance only.

Drop-off is available at the corner of Warner & PCH. Free public parking is also available in Sunset Beach (behind Jack in the Box) if you’d like to walk in.

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on

Everyone is welcome—runners, walkers, strollers, and dogs—for a morning filled with holiday cheer and plenty of Ho! Ho! Ho's!

name: Santa To The Sea 1/2 Marathon, 1/4 Marathon & 5K
description:
Santa to the Sea is a nonprofit event born out of a desire to give back to the community. What started in 2003 as a toy drive to celebrate the relocation of the world’s largest Santa Claus from Carpinteria to Oxnard, has grown into a robust running event, toy drive, and community fundraiser. Santa to the Sea includes a half marathon, a Quarter Marathon plus a 5K run and 1K kids fun run. The Santa to the Sea Scholarship Fund partners with Gene Haas and Oxnard College Foundation to award $500 scholarships to local high school students and adults continuing their education at Oxnard College. 

Santa to the Sea offers families not only a weekend of fun, but also an opportunity to give back to those in need, just in time for the holiday season. The nonprofit event helps collect toys for underprivileged children throughout Ventura County while raising scholarship money for students at Oxnard College.

The Half Marathon gets underway at the giant Santa located along the Interstate Highway 101 (2801 Ventura Boulevard) and continues through the strawberry fields of Oxnard before heading to historic downtown Oxnard (where the Quarter Marathon starts) and ending at Marine Emporium Landing (where the 5k and kids 1k start and finish) in picturesque Channel Islands Harbor. There, visitors can enjoy the Finish Line Festival filled with a full day of activities including kids play area, a Santa’s Village, costume contests, food booths and live entertainment.

The Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, Quarter Marathon and 5k, is based in the coastal com­mu­nity of Oxnard, CA., and just 40 min­utes north of Los Angeles. Combine your athletic pursuits with a seaside weekend getaway during the annual Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, 1/4 marathon, 5K run and 1k kids fun run taking place the second Sunday every December.

name: Santa to the Sea Half Marathon Expo
description:
The 2 day Santa to the Sea Half Expo is where thousands of motivated, health-minded runners — along with their families and friends — gather before race day to pick up bibs, shop, sample products, and connect with brands they trust.

Set adjacent to the beautiful Channel Islands Harbor, Santa to the Sea attracts runners from across the region who are serious about performance, recovery, lifestyle — and supporting businesses that help them feel and perform their best.

As a vendor, you’ll be front-and-center with a captive, energized audience that is actively browsing, asking questions, and ready to purchase.

NON PROFIT RATES AVAILABLE- EMAILS US AT -santatotheseavendors@gmail.com

Why Vendors Love This Expo

High-intent audience
Comprised of multiple demographics including endurance athletes, first-timers, and active families
Strong interest in nutrition, recovery tools, apparel, shoes, wellness, tech, travel, and experiences
Built-in traffic

Every participant must pass through the expo to pick up race packets
Consistent foot traffic throughout the day — not just short rush periods
Meaningful engagement
Time for conversation, demos, sampling, and education
Opportunity to collect emails, give coupons, and drive repeat business
Brand visibility beyond race weekend
Integration opportunities in athlete communications
Social amplification and content opportunities
Word-of-mouth inside a deeply loyal running community


What Vendors Can Expect

A professional, well-organized layout with easy access and set-up
Support from an experienced event team who understands vendor needs
Space options to fit everything from boutique displays to full activation setups
A positive, festival-style atmosphere that makes conversations easy and fun

This is more than a race expo — it’s a chance to connect with an audience that values quality, performance, community, and authentic brands.

If your product helps people move better, feel better, recover smarter, eat well, celebrate, or live an active lifestyle… they’ll be excited to meet you at Santa to the Sea.

 

For more info, email us santatotheseavendors@gmail.com

name: Santa's Toy Trot – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
Happy Holidays! It's time to jingle along from the start to the finish line! Bring a unwrapped new toy as a gift for our toy drive!

Race Details

Start Location: Tongva Park, Santa Monica
Parking: There is limited street parking on Ocean Ave. There are several public lots in short walking distance, the closest is the Civic Center Parking Lot. The E Line has a station nearby as well.

Event Schedule

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at Tongva Park
6:55am – Cross street to the starting arch at Palisades Park
7:00am – Half Marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps)
Half: This 4.37-mile route is run 3 times

More about the Course

The path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the paved side of the pat

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

🎅🏃‍♀️ 3rd Annual Santa Reindeer Run 🦌✨
Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25
Sunday, December 20, 2026 

Get ready to jingle all the way at the 2nd Annual Santa Reindeer Run! Join us at beautiful Bolsa Chica State Beach for a festive morning of holiday vibes, ocean views, and Santa Claus himself! Whether you’re here to race, stroll, or rock your favorite holiday outfit, this is the perfect way to kick off the season.

All finishers receive a festive medal,  free race-day photos, and yummy finish-line treats. Plus, dress up for our Holiday Costume Contest for a chance to win extra prizes and epic bragging rights! 🎄🎁

 
🎅 Special Appearance by Santa!
Santa will be waiting at the start and finish lines for photos, hugs, and high-fives. Be sure to grab your holiday photo with Santa! 📸

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
📍 Location: Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25

6:45 AM — Bib Pick-Up & Same-Day Registration Opens
7:30 AM — Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM — 5K & 10K Start

9:00 AM - Family 1- Miler

9:30 AM- Kids 200 yard Dash

9:45 AM - Santa PAWS Doggie Parade
 
 
⏱️ Timing & Awards
✔️ Chip-Timed Race with live results
🏅 Finisher Medals for All Participants
📸 Free Race-Day Photos
🥇 Overall & Age Group Awards for the top 3 men & women in each distance

Awards Ceremony Times:


🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Parking Fee: $15 per vehicle — State Park accepts card only
Main Entrance: 17851 Pacific Coast Highway, Huntington Beach, CA 92649 (gate opens at 6:00 AM)
Drive west after entering the main gate until you reach Lot 25 — the last lot on the right, near Warner Avenue & PCH
Drop-Off Option: Get dropped off at Warner & PCH, just steps from Lot 25
Free Public Parking: Available in Sunset Beach behind Jack in the Box (17243 Pacific Coast Highway)
Tip: Carpooling highly encouraged!
 

 ✨ Join the Holiday Magic!
Lace up, grab your Santa hat, and jingle through the miles at Bolsa Chica State Beach! The Santa Reindeer Run is the ultimate way to celebrate the season with friends, family, and festive fun.

🔗 Register today at CaliFlowRuns.com

name: Saratoga Education Foundation 5K Fun Run
description:
SEF 5K Fun Run 2026

Sunday November 1, 2026 - 5K race start at 9am (Kids Dash race start at 10:15am)

The Saratoga Education Foundation is excited to announce our fifth annual 5K Fun Run and Walk. Lace up your sneakers on Sunday, November 1, 2026, and join us for a morning of fitness and fun, all while supporting a great cause! 

Race your friends and family through neighborhood streets then stay for post-race activities, including food trucks, awards, raffles, games, and a special Kids Dash for children 5 and under. 

Parking is available at West Valley College, Parking Lot 3. West Valley College is across the street from Redwood Middle School. Please use cross walks when crossing from West Valley College to the race starting line at Redwood Middle School. There will not be parking available at Redwood Middle School due to the race route.

WHAT IS SEF? 

It’s all of us! Saratoga Education Foundation (SEF) is district families that work together to provide our children with enrichments that make their education more valuable and competitive.

We are all fortunate to be a part of a district that spends wisely and provides the best teachers, small class sizes, and quality campuses. SEF was founded to expand funding to also provide enrichments our community values. SEF has a board of directors that do the heavy lifting of coordinating donations and turning them into opportunities for our children but everyone that makes a donation is an equal member. We have several meetings throughout the year and two surveys where you can give input and gather information.

SEF provides enrichments to all district students each year with family contributions. For the 2026-2027 school year, SEF is collecting $600,000 to cover all grade-level school field trips and transportation for the 3 elementary schools and Redwood Middle School.  The 5th Grade Science Camp for all 3 elementary schools, will also be sponsored by SEF.  Additionally, SEF will fund Elementary Makerspace, Elementary Science Labs, seminars for Redwood Middle School students, and workshops targeted to parents and guardians of SUSD students.

name: Sasquatch Trail Run
description:
There is noises coming from the Dry Creek Preserve...Just before summer Sasquatch makes an appearance for just one day in the month of May. Are you ready to race through the Dry Creek Preserve and come face to face with Sasquatch? This Premier 5k has high end Swag and is a family friendly event. Bring your camera and let's hope you aren't the slowest runner

This is a Live Race and on Private Property

All Finisher's Receive:

  • Sasquatch Finisher T-Shirt (Size not guaranteed after 5/6/26
  • Custom Medal for all Adult Participants
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Bananas and Muffins
  • Music
  • Chip Timed with Live Results

Age Groups: 5-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Kids Race (Age 12 and under)

  • Sasquatch T-shirt
  • Sasquatch Kids Finisher Medal
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Kid Snacks

Who we Support

A large portion of proceeds will be donated to Dry Creek Preserve in Woodlake, CA. The property is 152 Acres and is free to the public.

Sequoia Riverlands Trust is a nonprofit organization that owns and manages six nature preserves including Dry Creek Preserve. It is our mission to keep these beautiful places open for the public. Accordingly, there is no fee to visit our preserves. However, we do ask that you donate to help us keep these spaces available for generations to come.

Event organized by Sierra Cascades Muiltisport Productions

name: SCAD Research Inc. - Donation
description:
Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (SCAD) is a little-known and often misunderstood cause of heart attacks. Most patients are young, healthy, active women who have none of the typical risk factors for heart disease. Although less common, SCAD can affect men as well. It can recur—and it can be fatal. More research is urgently needed to identify the causes and determine the most effective treatments.

SCAD is the #1 cause of heart attacks in women under age 50, including pregnant women and new mothers.

This holiday season, we invite you to support this vital work. Your contribution helps fund research that brings us closer to answers, improved treatments, and lives saved.

Be part of our Giving Tuesday campaign!
SCAD Research, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Your donation is tax-deductible.

name: Scarecrow 2.0
description:
🎃 Join Us for Exeter’s 6th Annual Scarecrow 2.0! 🏃‍♀️🍂

What better way to welcome the cooler weather than with a fun run through beautiful Exeter? Starting at Exeter City Park, the course winds through our charming downtown—right alongside the scarecrows!

Bring the whole family and enjoy a morning of running, free food, live music, and small-town fun. Races take place Saturday, October 10, 2026—you won’t want to miss it!

🥐 Svenhards for the whole family!
Each finisher will receive a Svenhard's danish! Did you know Svenhard's is based in Exeter, CA?

Amenities:

Finisher Medal
FREE Race Photos
FREE Svenhards Danish
Scarecrow 2.0 T-Shirt
Chip Timing and Finisher Certificate
FREE drinks
Costume Contest
Age Group Awards
All male and female finishers will receive an award. Ages: 0-12, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Who We Support
The Exeter Fall Festival because it brings the Exeter community together and strengthens small-town spirit. This annual event, held each October, features a parade along Pine Street with floats, music, and participation from local schools. After the parade, families and community members gather at Exeter City Park for activities like a classic car show, live music, community celebrations, and local vendors

Our Major Sponsor: Thrasher Masonry

name: SCREAMER RUN 2026
description:
AdaptiSport, Bakersfield's first and only fully accessible wellness center for adults with disabilities set to open in late 2026/early 2027, is thrilled to announce our second annual SCREAMER RUN on the evening of Saturday, October 17, 2026. All are encouraged to join us for this fright-filled event on the main campus of CSU Bakersfield. Help us bring awareness to AdaptiSport and raise critical funds to bring this project to fruition and ensure a bright, healthy future for ALL members of our beloved community! A small portion of proceeds will go to the CSUB Students with Disabilities program. 

Join us at sundown on Saturday, October 17th and be prepared to RUN FOR YOUR LIFE in our 5K or Kids Trick or Treat Run (approximately 1 mile). Whether you are a competitive runner or just down for a scary good time, you don't want to miss out on this one-of-a-kind experience. Our second annual SCREAMER RUN will feature fright-filled race routes, competitive awards, music, food, raffle prizes, vendor fair, event swag, a special kids' zone, a TEAM COMPETITION, and more. 

This event will be held at California State University of Bakersfield 9001 Stockdale Hwy, Bakersfield Ca 93309.  Start/finish will be at alumni park located in Don Hart East Dr. in between Stockdale Hwy and Kroll Way.

name: Screenland 5K
description:
5k Starts at 9:00 am.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our star-studded 11th Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.  This year's costume contest theme is "Love and Romance."

All participants will receive a commemorative bib, official time, medal, shirt, on-course support and entertainment, entrance into the post-race party, and free downloadable event photos.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the Screenland 5K and then either the 5K or the 15K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run on August 24, 2025 at Dockweiler Beach.  If you missed Screenland in 2024, you can start the challenge at Screenland in March and finish it at BRA Run in August.

We will be publishing a list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K in 2025, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K at www.BRArunLA.com.

name: SD HipHop 5k
description:
SD HipHop 5K Run/Walk

October 18, 2026

Gather the family to come out and celebrate a fun and festive run/walk at the 7th Annual SD HipHop 5k. And we our proud to announce that we are also offering a virtual challenge.You can run, cycle, walk, swim or roll a certain distance in one day or a couple of days to equal  3.1 miles. Anyone of any ability can participate and it can be completed at any location, at your own pace. Please note that the Virtual Challenge event will not be an officially timed event.

name: Shadow of the Giants 50k & 20k Run
description:
Event Information:

37th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k-June 5th,2027
Experience the Magic of the Sierra National Forest
Join us for the 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k, an unforgettable race through the scenic and historic trails of the Sierra National Forest. 

Time Limit for 50k: 8 hours - 9hours with an Early Start

Important Notice: Pets are not allowed on the trail, so please leave your furry friends at home.

No Transfers or deferrals after May 1st, 2027 No exceptions.

Pre-Race Accommodations and Dinner
For those interested, we are offering the option to stay onsite the night before the race on Friday, June 4th at Camp Green Meadows in the dorms. Additionally, join us for our traditional pre-race lasagna dinner on Friday, June 4th at approximately 5:45 PM in the Green Meadows Dining Hall.

Race Day Schedule
50k Start Time: 7:00 AM
20k Start Time: 7:15 AM
Early Starts Available: 6:00 AM (Early starters are not eligible for overall awards, they are eligible for Age Group Awards)

Course Information
Detailed course maps and updates will be provided, closer to the race day

Aid Stations: Located roughly 5-7 miles apart, our aid stations will be well-stocked with food, Gels, Electrolyte drink, water, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, and a variety of sweet and salty snacks.

Guidelines:

No pacers.
No dogs.

Poles are permitted.
Fun and smiles are mandatory!

Post-Race Celebration
After the race, you’re invited to hang out at Green Meadows to cheer on fellow runners. Post-race food and beverages will be provided in the Dining Hall. Bring a chair, a pop-up tent or umbrella, and enjoy the camaraderie.

BIB Pickup

When: Friday, June 4th
Time: 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Where: Camp Green Meadows Outdoor School in Fish Camp, CA, in the Cafeteria
Race Day Bib Pick-Up:

When: Saturday, June 5th
Time: 5:40 AM - 6:45 AM
Where: Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadow Outdoor School
Note: No pets or dogs are allowed on the Green Meadows Campus, except for service animals.

Staying at Camp Green Meadows
Arrival: Do not arrive before 1:15 PM on Friday, June 4th
Check-In: Begins at 1:30 PM in the Cafeteria. Bunks are first-come, first-served. No check-ins after 8:00 PM.
What to Bring: Bedding, pillow, sleeping bag/blankets
Shared Space Etiquette: Respect others and keep noise levels down. Quiet time starts at 9:00 PM.
Facilities: Showers and restrooms available onsite.
Trash: All trash must be removed before departure.
Camping: Tent camping is not allowed on campus. There is dispersed camping in the area. 
Parking: Large or oversized vehicles like RVs are not permitted on campus. You may park on nearby Forest Service Roads.

Pre-Race Dinner
If you’ve purchased a ticket for our pre-race dinner, it will start around 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM in the Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadows. The dinner will include lasagna, salad, bread, and drinks. No additional tickets will be sold as meals are prepared based on pre-orders.

Parking Guidelines
Do Not Block Roadways: Ensure clear access in and out of Green Meadows.
Parking Locations: Once the parking lot at Green Meadows is full, you may park on the shoulder of the camp entrance or on the dirt road shoulder just before the camp entrance. Do not block roadways.
Alternative Parking: You may park off Jackson Road near the final turn down onto the single track that leads to the finish line. It’s a pleasant half-mile walk from there with no parking issues.
Changing Distances
You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

Course Cutoff
The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

Start Times for Saturday, June 5th, 2027
50k & 20k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

Shadow of the Giants 50k is operated under special use permit with the Sierra National Forest.

San Joaquin Running events are open to all participants. We are committed to providing an inclusive environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability.

name: Shark Attack 5K & 1 Mile Run
description:
Get ready for an exhilarating race that combines the excitement of a 5k or 1-mile run with the support of a vibrant community! Whether you're a seasoned racer or a first-timer, get set to experience an electrifying event in a stunning setting, surrounded by an awesome crowd of fellow runners!

 

Race Details

 

Arrival

  • CHECK IN:  6:00 a.m. Registration will remain open on race day from 6:00 a.m. through 7:00 a.m.
  • OPENING CEREMONY: 7:15 a.m.

 

Parking

  • FREE PARKING located inside Green River Golf course (1 Main entrance to Golf Course)
  • Please park in the upper parking lot section (See address below)

 

Course Description

Experience the picturesque landscapes of the Green River Golf Course at the Shark Attack 5k! This flat, fast course features conditions ideal for pushing your limits and setting personal records.

 

MILE 1 -Start off with a fast first mile on a mostly paved pathway running parallel to pristine fairways. 

MILE 2 -The second mile offers a mixture of both paved roads and dirt trails. 

MILE 3 -The final stretch is near and will certainly allow you to finish your strongest. 

FINISH LINE - As you cross the finish line you’ll be welcomed into a grand celebration area where you’ll receive your medal and be greeted by fans, fellow participants, and a live DJ! Then enjoy a lively post-race atmosphere with music, snacks, and vendor booths. 

 

What to Expect on Race Day

 
  • All Finishers Will Receive Medals
  • Fun Community Event
  • Abundant High-fives and cheering as Santiago's Cross Country Superstars cheer you on along the course.
  • Scenic, flat, and fast route
  • Receive a Dri- FIT shirt if registration is received by 10/15

 

Have a Team or Group?


Representing your school, work, church, running group, etc.? Register as a group to get a discount. Here's how it works:

Minimum of 10 participants required to receive $5 off discount per participant. Once 10th person registered, everyone will be issued a $5 refund.

Register under a team or group: https://runsignup.com/RaceGroups/135500
