name: Sharsheret West Coast Dash
description:
On Sunday, October 25, 2026, Sharsheret will gather hundreds of thrivers, caregivers, friends and supporters on the beach for our 5th Annual West Coast Dash in support of our breast and ovarian cancer work. Our run/walk will include a 5K Race, 10K Race, Family Fun Race, Virtual Race and Event Festival. Contributions excluding the value of race entry tickets are tax-deductible.
Schedule for Race Day, Sunday, October 25 (schedule subject to change)
6:00am – Parking Lots Open – First 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13. Please have cash available to expedite process.
7:00am – Registration and Festival Opens (Recommended 5K/10K arrival time)   
7:20am – Minyan 
8:00am – Welcome and Opening ceremony. 
8:20am - Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for 5K/10K
8:30am - 10K Start (Recommended Family Fun Race arrival time)
- 10K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202657963/ 
- 5K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202686184 
8:40am - 5K Start
9:25am – Family Fun Race Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for Family Fun Race
9:35am - Family Fun Race Start
- 1K Family Fun Race Course Map https://www.strava.com/routes/3401592517811740622  
10:00am – Awards Ceremony
BEACH CLEAN UPHelp us leave Dockweiler Beach cleaner than we found it! Join Shemesh Farms for a group beach clean up directly following the Dash.
Directions12000 Vista Del MarDockweiler BeachPlaya Del Rey, CA 90293
Waze and Apple Maps may misdirect you. Please follow the instructions below.Freeway Route from 405N and 405S: Take the 105 Imperial Hwy past LAX towards the beach. Beach entry is at the end of Imperial Hwy where it passes Vista Del Mar.City Streets from North: Take Pershing Drive south (NOTE ** Vista Del Mar will be closed North of Imperial Highway on race morning) until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a right into the beach entry.City Streets from South: Take Vista Del Mar north until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a left into the beach entry.
ParkingFree parking: The first 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13 per car. Please have cash available to expedite process.When you arrive: Please let the parking attendant know that you are with the event and be prepared with cash. The line to pay and park will get backed up so please arrive early.Lots for parking: After you pay turn right and follow the road. There are three parking lots. We recommend parking in the 2nd lot. The 2nd lot is a 5 minute walk to the race start line and festival.There is very limited parking in the 3rd lot and it is reserved for volunteers and those who require wheelchairs or other special needs. All race distances end in the 3rd and last lot. There is no exit from the 3rd lot while the event is going on. Anyone parked in the third lot will have to wait to leave until all races are complete. No vehicles will be able to leave the third lot before 10am._________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Celebrate our Race Grand Marshals! 
Healthcare Hero
Dr. Debra Mund is a Diagnostic Radiologist and Breast Imaging Specialist at Providence Saint John’s Health Center, where she has practiced since 2005, and serves as adjunct faculty at the Saint John’s Cancer Institute. She and her husband, Scott, live in Beverlywood and are the proud parents of four children and grandparents to three grandchildren. A longtime supporter of Sharsheret, Dr. Mund joined the West Region Advisory Committee in 2022 after many years of speaking in educational roles, and she also serves on the Board of Trustees for Genesis, an educational foundation. She is dedicated to combining her passion for health, education, and community service in her professional and volunteer work.
Community Heroes
Lisa and Josh Hofheimer will be recognized on race day for their inspiring efforts on behalf of the Sharsheret, cancer, and Los Angeles communities.
Lisa is a private foundation consultant and serves as Executive Director of the Lee Liberman Foundation, which supports nonprofits working to bolster social cohesion and counter polarization. She previously served as Finance Director of the Rosenthal Charitable Trust in Los Angeles and began her career in investment banking, executing private placements for institutions investing in emerging markets.
Josh is a partner in Sidley Austin LLP’s Technology and Life Sciences Transactions practice, a member of the firm’s Global Life Sciences Leadership Council, and co-leader of Sidley’s Global Agribusiness and Food industry group. Previously, Josh served as CEO and Managing Director of Hexima Limited (ASX:HXL), Australia’s first publicly listed ag-biotech company, and throughout his career has been an advocate for women’s rights and women’s health.
Diagnosed with breast cancer as a young mom of two in 2002, Lisa met Sharsheret’s founder, Rochelle Shoretz A”H, in the first year of the organization and volunteered as one of the first peer supporters for other women who were diagnosed. Lisa served as the founding Co-Chair of Sharsheret’s California Community Advisory Committee when Sharsheret opened on the West Coast in 2016. Drawing from their own experience as a survivor and caregiver, Lisa and Josh have served as innovative leaders and trusted advisors for Sharsheret locally and nationally over the past 24 years.
Young Leaders Award
Close friends Adena Frenkel and Nessia Gottlieb are passionate community builders and longtime supporters of Sharsheret. Through their creativity and dedication, they have brought generations together to educate and raise awareness by co-chairing Sharsheret events such as Family Fun Days, Pink Parties, tie-dye kit fun, and babka baking experiences.
In addition to their work with Sharsheret, Adena works as a celebrity stylist and personal shopper and Nessia as an attorney. Their shared passion for service led them to previously serve as PTA Presidents at Gindi Maimonides Academy. Their reach extends across a wide span of local causes, including involvement in various local nonprofits and in their respective synagogues.
Their commitment to connection and impact makes them fitting recipients of the inaugural Sharsheret West Young Leader Award.
Race Entry
Run or walk on this fully paved course at Dockweiler Beach, just steps from the ocean with a cool morning breeze and incredible coastal views. Join us at the race festival with food, refreshments, entertainment and more, while helping to raise funds for those facing breast cancer, ovarian cancer, or at elevated genetic risk. 
5K / 10K  - Race entry tickets include a race t-shirt and finisher’s medal. Both races will be chip timed. Recommended for elementary school-age and above. 
Family Fun Race (1K) - Race Entry tickets are for ages 1 and up and include a race t-shirt and medal. This race is open to people of all abilities and generations of families running or walking together. This race will not be chip timed. Get ready for the photo opportunity!!
Virtual Race - Join us from anywhere around the country. Race tickets purchased by October 7th will receive a race t-shirt by mail.
Become a Team Captain for your family, friends, school, synagogue or company. Win awesome prizes and make your miles meaningful. 
All ages, abilities and strollers welcome.
Visit Sharsheret.org/westcoast for more information.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Early Bird Packet Pickup Details
Thursday, October 22 from 4 - 7pm
Stay tuned for details about our LA Metro and Valley pickups!

name: She Runs Long Beach - National Women's Day Run  5K • 10K • Half Marathon
description:
She Runs Long Beach
National Women's Day Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon
Sunday, March 7, 2027
📍 Alamitos Beach • 780 Shoreline Drive, Long Beach, CA

Celebrate National Women's Day with a morning dedicated to strength, movement, community, and the incredible women who inspire us every day.

Join us along the beautiful Long Beach waterfront for a race experience designed to welcome everyone—from first-time participants to seasoned runners. Whether you're running, jogging, walking, pushing a stroller, or bringing your four-legged best friend, you'll be part of a supportive and uplifting community that believes every finish line deserves to be celebrated.

Enjoy a scenic course featuring stunning views of the waterfront and the iconic Queen Mary, creating the perfect backdrop for unforgettable race-day photos. After the event, gather with friends and family and continue the celebration at Shoreline Village, just steps from the finish line.

Event Day Schedule:

Registration/Runner Check In Opens : 6:00 AM

Half Marathoners Kick Off: 7:00 AM ( 3:30 Course Time Limit)

5K 10K Kicks Off: 8:00 AM

9:20 AM : Overall Awards Ceremony

10:30 AM : Finish Line Closes

 

Your Registration Includes:
✨ Professional Chip Timing
✨ Free Race Photos
✨ Custom Finisher Medal
✨ Overall & Age Group Awards
✨ Flat & Fast Waterfront Course
✨ Stroller Friendly
✨ Dog Friendly
✨ Beginner Friendly Atmosphere
✨ Health & Wellness Expo
✨ Finish Line Festival
✨ Beautiful Waterfront Views

National Women's Day is a celebration of achievement, resilience, and empowerment. Whether you're setting a new personal record, completing your first 5K, or simply enjoying a morning outdoors with friends, this event is about coming together to celebrate the strength found in every stride.

Move Together. Rise Together. Celebrate Together.

Join us March 7, 2027, at Alamitos Beach and be part of a race that honors women, wellness, and community in the heart of Long Beach. 🌸🤍✨

name: Signal Hill Rotary Mutt Run 1K & 5K
description:
FINDING HOMES - ONE DOG AT A TIME

2026 Event Photos

5K Course

1K Course

Run or walk at your pace with or without your dog.  The event starts at the Granada Launch Ramp (Rosie's Dog Beach) at 5000 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 and the course follows along the scenic Long Beach shoreline.

Race packet pick up is at the starting line on race day.  Please arrive by 7:30 am to allow sufficient time before the race.

EVENTS

  • 5K Runner-only (humans only) race starts at 8:30 am
  • 5K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:30 am
  • 1K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:45 am

DOGGIE DO'S and DON'T'S

  • All breeds of dogs welcome, not just mutts
  • Dogs must be leashed and stay on the pedestrian path at all times
  • Dogs must be non-aggressive with people and dogs

FUN INCLUSIONS AND POST-RACE EVENTS

  • Adoption event by the Long Beach Animal Care Services at the finish line and post-race festival
  • High quality race t-shirt for 1K and 5K participants
  • Finisher medal for all participants
  • Awards for top three 5K finishers

WHY WE RUN

  • 70% of proceeds will support the Long Beach Animal Care Services
  • 30% of the proceeds will go toward the community project fund at Signal Hill Rotary

name: Silicon Valley Santa Run
description:
Join us for the 15th Annual Silicon Valley Santa Run, benefiting Christmas in the Park! 

This 5K Run/Walk is holiday fun for the whole family. You can dress up as your favorite holiday character or tradition, then make your way through San Jose for a festive afternoon celebrating the most wonderful time of the year! The flat, fast course begins on Santa Clara St. and concludes at Christmas in the Park, where you can enjoy the decorations and booths with your friends and family.

Silicon Valley Santa Run offers a 5K run/walk or a Kids Reindeer Dash. Both events are available in person or virtually. All 5K participants will receive our holiday-themed long sleeve tech shirt, ornament-style finisher medal, and race bib with timing chip. Kids Reindeer Dash participants will receive a festive short-sleeved t-shirt, an ornament-style finisher medal, a race bib, and milk and cookies at the finish line.

name: Silver Moon Race: Kings River
description:
The Silver Moon Race is where runners of all levels come to chase big goals and have an unforgettable adventure chasing miles under the full moon and stars. Elevate your running and endurance on a gorgeous course through Central California’s orchards and vineyards along the Kings River. Your challenge, your pace, your night.

Whether you’re stepping up from half marathons or diving into the world of ultras, or going for your first 100-mile buckle, this race gives you the perfect environment to push your endurance and discover what you’re capable of.

Timed on the weekend closest to the full moon, the race begins at sunset and carries you through a night lit by moonlight and stars into the sunrise on the horizon. It’s a uniquely magical experience that keeps runners coming back year after year.

  • Beginner Friendly > 12K, 20K, or 40K
  • Ultra Challenges > 6, 12, 24-Hours, or 100-Miles
  • Run with Friends > Relay Teams
  • Worry Free > Fully supported overnight experience
  • Full Moon > Camping Experience

RACES

Choose the challenge that fits your journey—12K, 20K, 40K distances, or 6, 12, 24-hour time categories, or go for the ultimate endurance challenge of 100 miles in 30-hours, run it solo or with friends in a 2, 3, or 4‑person team relay. Running through a beautiful farm setting along the Kings River on a fast, scenic 2.5‑mile loop designed for flow, comfort, and confidence.

Whether you’re a first-time runner, a seasoned ultra runner, or just looking to have a great time outdoors with awesome people, the Silver Moon Race has something to match your fitness level and goals. Prepare for a one-of-a-kind race experience!

FIND YOUR RACE
 

RELAY EXPERIENCE

Take on the challenge solo or team up with your crew for a relay race that turns into a full‑blown adventure. Teams of 2, 3, or 4 rotate through laps and chase a shared goal—whether you’re chasing a set distance or stacking as many laps as you can before the clock hits zero. It’s the perfect blend of teamwork, strategy, and unforgettable race‑day vibes with good friends.

Camp, Cheer, Repeat

When you’re not on the course, you’re right in the heart of the action at your camp. Set up your home base on the course, cheer on your teammates, grab food, relax, and cheer on runners. The off‑course moments become part of the fun—laughing with friends, swapping stories, and gearing up for your next lap. 

Why Teams Love It
  • Shared accomplishment > every lap adds to something bigger.
  • Built‑in hype squad > your friends are right there to lift you up.
  • Festival atmosphere > music, camping, community, and epic vibes under the full moon and stars.
  • A race day you’ll talk about for years > because nothing bonds people like chasing miles together.

DISOCVER THE EXPERIENCE

This is running reimagined into a magical full moon running experience. Designed by runners, for runners, in a fully supported lap race built so you can go as long as you want, with easy access to your homebase camp and a fully stocked checkpoint every time you loop through. 

Every detail is meticulously planned, ensuring seamless race flow, an epic mega aid station, and passionate volunteers cheering you on deep into the night. When you cross that finish line, you’ll earn creative medals that celebrate your grit and make this race one you’ll never forget.

Get ready to have the Silver Moon Race become one of your favorite running experiences. Visit our official website for more details and register today to reserve your spot!

Learn more at SilverMoonRace.com

name: Sloth Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🦥🏃‍♂️ The Sloth Run – Slow Is the New Fast! 🏃‍♀️🦥
Sloths will get there!
Tired of high-speed races and intense competition? Us too!
Welcome to the Sloth Run, where the pace is slow, the vibes are chill, and everyone's a winner (eventually).

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: SMFA 5K Toy Run
description:
The San Miguel Firefighter Association is excited to announce our First Annual 5K Toy Run!

Join us for a fun and memorable 3.1-mile run through the heart of San Miguel. The course will start and finish at the historic Rios-Caledonia Adobe and will take participants past the San Miguel Fire Department, through Lillian Larsen Elementary School, and, most notably, through the beautiful Mission San Miguel Arcángel.

Registration:

Early Bird Registration: $35
Regular Registration: $45
Children 10 & Under: FREE
All registered participants will receive a race shirt, with awards presented to the top three overall male and female finishers. After the race, stick around and enjoy a complimentary post-run meal—you won't leave hungry!

Supporting a Great Cause

All proceeds from the event will go directly toward purchasing Christmas toys for local children through the San Miguel Firefighter Association Christmas Parade. Each year, this beloved community event welcomes approximately 300 children to the fire station for a visit with Santa Claus, holiday festivities, and a special Christmas gift for every child.

While registration helps support this cause, new, unwrapped toy donations are also greatly appreciated and may be brought to the event. Every toy helps us make the holidays a little brighter for children in our community.

Whether you're racing for a personal best, walking with family, or simply supporting a meaningful cause, we look forward to seeing you at the starting line!

name: SOCAL River Marathon - 26.2 - 13.1 - 10K - 5K
description:
The SOCAL River Marathon has four distances. Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K and 5K. 

This is a fun course in Southern California. This course runs on the Santa Ana River Trail from Yorba Linda to Huntington Beach State Park. This route truly spans Southern California from the dryer desert land to areas near Disneyland to the Beach. The course is primarily flat and straight but has a gradual downhill slant following the river to the ocean. This route is two years ago was cleaned up from homeless tents and is not fenced in nightly.

name: SoCal's Sunset Trick or Trot 5k/10K - Halloween Race
description:
SoCal's Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K

Saturday, October 24th, 2026 | 5:00 PM

Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25

Featuring a Trunk-or-Treat Expo beginning at 3:00 PM

Back for Year 2 as an Evening Tradition! Formerly the morning Fit Fall Halloween Harvest, our sunset run was such a hit last year that we're doing it again. Get ready to run (or trot!) into the sunset with beach views, Halloween fun, and festive activities for the whole family.

What to Expect

  • 5K & 10K Sunset Run
  • Trunk-or-Treat Expo
  • Selfie Stations, Games & Giveaways
  • Custom Reversible Finisher Medal
  • Fall-Themed Event Shirt
  • Costume Contests & Awards
  • Street Tacos, Aguas Frescas, Specialty Coffee, Cookies & More

Packet Pickup

All bibs, shirts, and trick-or-treat bags will be available starting at 3:00 PM at the Trunk-or-Treat Expo. No early-day pickup.

Race Day Schedule

  • 2:00 PM – Trunk-or-Treat Car Setup
  • 3:00 PM – Registration & Packet Pickup Opens
  • 4:30 PM – Kids Races Begin
  • 5:00 PM – Mass Start for 5K & 10K
  • 5:45 PM – 5K Awards Ceremony
  • 6:00 PM – 10K Awards Ceremony

Trunk-or-Treat Expo

Want to be part of the Halloween magic? Decorate your trunk and hand out goodies! Trunkers receive 2 free race entries for a Caren Ware Event Race. Participation on best decorative trunk competition. Look at our 2025 trunk photos below for inspiration.

Fill out 2026 TRUNK-OR-TREAT FORM.

Race Registration Includes

  • RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time
  • Fall-Themed Custom Shirt
  • Unique Reversible Finisher Medal
  • Trick-or-Treat Bag
  • Entry into Costume & Team Contests
  • Eligibility for Age Group & Overall Awards

Awards & Divisions

  • Top 3 in each 5-year age division (ages 1–80+)
  • Top 3 Overall Male & Female Finishers
  • Best Halloween Costume
  • Best Uniform-Themed Costume
  • Awards for Oldest & Youngest Finishers

Pet & Stroller Friendly

  • Leashed pets welcome (max 5 ft leash)
  • Strollers allowed — please start near the back

Only registered participants with a bib receive medals.

The Course

  • Flat, fast, paved, and scenic
  • Ocean views all the way
  • Start/Finish: Lot 25 – Bolsa Chica State Beach

Parking Options

  • Paid Parking available at state Beach with its new park and pay system. Limited free parking available in Sunset Beach and walk in

name: SoCal's Tiki Beach 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
🌺 Welcome to SO CAL's BIGGEST & BEST POLYNESIAN PARTY RACE! 🌺

Since 2014,  Tiki Beach 5K/10K has been a vibrant tradition on the beach, a chance to run, celebrate, and enjoy island-inspired music, food, and community. It's your end of the summer BEACH PARTY RUN!

🏖️ Experience the energy of the beach with live Polynesian drummers and dancers, bringing authentic rhythm and movement to your run. This isn’t just a race, t’s a festive send-off to summer! Coconuts, palm trees, grass skirts, and the TAPUA PRODUCTION drummers and dancers make this the BEST BEACH BASH, healthy RUNNER's Party!

🎽 Every participant receives a custom Polynesian-style race shirt and one of our signature Tiki finisher medals, a collectible highlight for your race journey. Have enough shirts?  Choose a custom beach towel while supplies last, or add to your collection by getting BOTH for only an additional $20.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos, fresh baked cookies, Pineapple flavor soft serve, fresh fruit, and whole coconuts while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers.

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — State Park Parking fee (Park and Pay New system)
Free limited Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

Since 2014,  Tiki Beach 5K/10K has been a vibrant tradition on the beach, a chance to run, celebrate, and enjoy island-inspired music, food, and community. It's your end of the summer BEACH PARTY RUN!

🏖️ Experience the energy of the beach with live Polynesian drummers and dancers, bringing authentic rhythm and movement to your run. This isn’t just a race, t’s a festive send-off to summer! Coconuts, palm trees, grass skirts, and the TAPUA PRODUCTION drummers and dancers make this the BEST BEACH BASH, healthy RUNNER's Party!

🎽 Every participant receives a custom Polynesian-style race shirt and one of our signature Tiki finisher medals, a collectible highlight for your race journey. Have enough shirts?  Choose a custom beach towel while supplies last, or add to your collection by getting BOTH for only an additional $20.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos, fresh baked cookies, Pineapple flavor soft serve, fresh fruit, and whole coconuts while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers.

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — State Park Parking fee (Park and Pay New system)
Free limited Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

name: Solana Beach Triathlon & Duathlon and Solana Beach 5K
description:
Mark your calendar for July 25, 2027, and get ready for an unforgettable day of racing along the beautiful Solana Beach coastline. Whether you’re a first-time triathlete or a seasoned racer, this event has it all—an exhilarating ocean swim, a scenic bike ride, and a thrilling coastal run to the finish line.


Why You Should Join:
Prime Beach Location: Race in one of Southern California’s most picturesque beach towns
All Levels Welcome: From first-timers to pros, this triathlon is designed for everyone
Exclusive Finisher Medal & Swag: Walk away with a fantastic tech tee and a finisher’s medal
Support a Cause: This race benefits the Life Sports Foundation, helping foster children and at-risk youth live healthier lives through sports and fitness

Sprint Triathlon
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Duathlon
1 mile run - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Aquabike
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike

Sprint Aquathlon
1/4 mile swim - 5K run

Solana Beach 5K

🏊 Ocean Swim with a Twist: Dive into the excitement with our surf-entry ocean swim. Safeguarded by dedicated lifeguards and supportive swim buddies, you'll experience the thrill of the Pacific in a safe and encouraging environment.

🚴 Cycle the Legendary Pacific Coast Highway: Pedal your way along the world-famous Pacific Coast Highway. With its breathtaking views and smooth terrain, the bike course promises both challenge and charm, perfect for setting personal records or simply enjoying the ride.
 
🏃 Run with the Ocean Breeze

🎉 A Finish Line Like No Other: As you cross the finish line, be prepared for a tunnel of high-fives, a cascade of cheers, and an atmosphere brimming with excitement. This is more than just the end of the race; it's a moment of triumph, a celebration of your achievement. Come Celebrate in the 🍺Modern Times and Ashland Seltzer Garden!

Whether you're a seasoned triathlete, a duathlon enthusiast, or an aquabike aficionado, the Solana Beach event is tailored to offer a memorable experience. Embrace the challenge, bask in the coastal splendor, and make memories that will last a lifetime.

Join us for an event that’s more than a race — it's a coastal festival of sport, spirit, and community. Register now to be a part of this unforgettable adventure! 🌟

name: Solano Turkey Trot 2026
description:
Solano Turkey Trot is a public benefit charity race in Solano County, California, comprised of 501(c)(3) partner organizations serving high risk children, families and seniors. We believe in a collective impact model with the goal of raising public awareness and education by holding fundraising and community events such as the Solano Turkey Trot. This annual event began on Thanksgiving Day 2009, with the vision of bringing a family-friendly 10K Run/5KRun/Walk to the local area. This event helps raise much needed funds to support the Solano Hearts United partner organizations in serving local families in need.

The two partner nonprofits include Meals on Wheels of Solano County and Suisun City Salvation Army KROC Center. The event is held in Suisun Valley in Solano County, with the main venue and start/finish line at Solano Community College. Our Race Director, Carol Gilpin, has been with us since our first race. Carol is the owner of Fleet Feet Sports in Vacaville and has been active through running, walking and triathlons for more than 35 years.

We are blessed to have this opportunity to “Give Thanks ♥ Give Back” to Solano County high risk children, families and seniors living in Solano County. Hope to see you bright and early on Thanksgiving morning!

For more information about Solano Turkey Trot, please contact us at solanoheartsunited@yahoo.com.

Refund Policy:
All entries are non-refundable and non-transferrable.

Sorry, No Refunds.

name: SPACEROCK Trail Race
description:
OUT-OF-THIS-WORLD TRAIL RUNNING


SPACEROCK: the final trail running frontier.
These are the voyages of trail runners around the world.
Your mission: to explore strange new trails, to seek out new life and new experiences, to boldly run where no one has run before.


Experience the exotic trails and sights of the world-famous Vasquez Rocks Natural Park in Southern California. Known as the backdrop from popular TV shows and movies including Star Trek, The Flintstones, Battlestar Galactica, Planet of the Apes, and many of our favorite classic westerns films. Now get a spectacular experience running the trails at the SPACEROCK Trail Race!

Learn more at and register at: SPACEROCKTrailRace.com

name: Spell Your City
description:
Event Description
🏃‍♀️ Welcome to Spell Your City! Turn your movement into a lasting celebration of hometown pride and personal achievement. Spell Your City is an innovative, multi-year virtual challenge series spanning 25 iconic cities nationwide.

This January, we’re switching things up: instead of a single race distance, this is an all-out monthly mileage challenge. Whether you are stepping into your very first running shoes or you are a seasoned marathon veteran, your mission is simple: log as many miles as you possibly can between January 1 and January 31. Make this January your strongest month yet and kick off the new year with an unforgettable finish. Whether you run through neighborhood streets, hit scenic trails, or rack up distance on the treadmill, every mile brings you closer to your goals.

🏅 The Multi-Year Journey & Year One Medals

Rome wasn't built in a day, and your city won't be spelled in one either! This challenge is designed as an exciting multi-year journey. When you register now, you are signing up for Year One of the series to claim your inaugural letter(s).

Over the coming years, you will return to complete subsequent legs and collect the remaining letters to complete your city’s full name. Medal designs vary by location, and select cities even feature special sets with two medals in Year One to jumpstart your collection.

🎯 How It Works
Log Your January Miles

From January 1 through January 31, run, jog, or walk as much as you can. Set your personal goal, tally your cumulative miles across the entire month, and make every step count toward your Year One milestone.
Register & Bundle to Save Big

Choose your destination from our 25 featured cities and commit to the journey. Taking on multiple cities or building out your collection early comes with massive stacked savings:

2 Challenges: 5% off
3 Challenges: 10% off
4 Challenges: 15% off
5 Challenges: 20% off
6 Challenges: 25% off
7 Challenges: 30% off
Because these tiered savings stack as you add cities, committing to all 7 earns you a total discount of $36.75—more than the $35 entry of a single event, effectively giving you an entire challenge entry for free!
Receive Your Challenge Kit

Packages begin shipping in December and continue through January. Participants registering after December 1st will receive their package approximately two weeks after registering. Your exclusive Year One kit arrives right at your doorstep in a custom branded box containing:

Custom Event Performance T-Shirt
Commemorative Year One Collectible Letter Medal (or two-letter set, depending on city selection)
Exclusive Event Finisher Sticker
Earn the Reveal

No peeking! We challenge every participant to keep their package sealed until they wrap up their final January workout. Knowing you conquered an entire month of miles makes unboxing your finisher gear and hanging that first letter on your medal rack that much sweeter.
🏁 Challenge Window: January 1 – January 31, 2027

Log your distance all month long and start the new year with a great finish!

name: Spooky Shuffle – 5k, 10k, Half Marathon
description:
It's Halloween! Let's celebrate together, dress up in costume, and eat candy!

Race Details
Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave


Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Courses
5k route: Runners do one loop – route here
10k route: Runners do two loops - route here
Half Marathon: Runners do two loops plus the 10k route – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the park. The 5k loops the lake and returns. The 10k and half head to the other side of the park, going under the bridge, and then journey back along a different path.

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

name: Sri Chinmoy 6-Hour Race San Diego
description:
Challenge yourself and enjoy a beautiful morning run (or walk) on a 5-mile loop course around a serene lake.

Whether you're training for a Fall/Winter marathon or just want to test your endurance, this 6-hour race is an ideal choice. And it's a perfect distance for those seeking to go beyond the marathon distance.

In addition to the fuel and encouragement you'll get at the aid stations, you'll be able to leave your own gear/nutrition in a secure area so you can reach for it each lap or as needed.

Laps and mileage are counted via chip. Splits are given every 5 miles (one loop of the course). There are permanent markers at every 1/4 mile. In the last 30 minutes, participants get credit for additional mileage if they reach one of the remote aid stations. 

All paces welcome--see what you can do in 6 hours! Race is limited to 75 participants. 

All participants receive a t-shirt, medal and a Certificate of Completion. Awards are given to top runners in M/W Open, M/W 50-59, and M/W 60/Over. 

Parking is off-site but within easy walking distance.

name: St. Helena Hometown Harvest Festival 5K Race and 1mi Fun Run/Walk
description:
Please join Core Community Fitness along with St. Helena Parks and Recreation to start off the St. Helena Harvest Festival outside and moving! Join us for the 5k Race or the 1mi Fun Run/Walk on the morning of October 17, 2026!

5K Race winner packages for the top male and female winners!

We are offering family packages so you can all run together. We want to encourage ALL of you to get out, move and have fun with your family and your community! Up to 6 family members can run for just $80. 

Post race all bib runners for both races will receive fun swag, medals, hydration drinks and more! If you register before the end of September a Harvest Festival Race Shirt will be included in with your registration!

This year we are asking for donations for the Damian Maldonado Memorial Foundation.  Damian is a Napa Valley local passed away suddenly at the age of 17. In his memory, the Damian Maldonado Memorial Scholarship Fund has been established. Damian was a dynamic young man on his way to college. The scholarship will be funded to help students in Napa Valley fulfill their college dreams.

Damian was loyal to his family and friends, honored his heritage, and performed service to his community. Therefore, the scholarship committee will look to award scholarships to those similar in nature. This scholarship is open to all who qualify and it is not based on ethnicity, race or gender. 100% of donations will go to this wonderful local non-profit 501(c)3.

name: St. Paddy's Day Lucky Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🍀 St. Paddy's Day Run: Luck, Laughs, and Laces! 🍀
Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with a fun and festive run that’s as much about the spirit of the holiday as it is about the finish line! Whether you're running, walking, or just along for the ride, this 5K/10K/13.1 is the perfect way to enjoy the day with friends, family, and fellow revelers.
Dress up in your favorite green gear—shamrocks, leprechaun hats, and everything in between—and join us for a race full of fun and good cheer!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

name: Step Up for Accreta - Virtual Step Challenge & Fundraiser
description:
"Step Up for Accreta" is a 10-day step challenge event and fundraiser for National Accreta Foundation during the month of October - Accreta Awareness Month! Can you make it to 72,000?

Track your steps with your smart watch, smartphone or pedometer. Sign in at the end of the week and log your steps!

The event focuses attention on placenta accreta spectrum, one of the fastest growing life-threatening complications of pregnancy.

During Accreta Awareness Month, National Accreta Foundation encourages patients, survivors, medical professionals and public health advocates to spread the word about increased rates and risk factors associated with placenta accreta, including cesarean overuse. Funds raised during the month of October will support National Accreta Foundation's programs and efforts in these areas.

Placenta accreta currently affects as many as 1 in 272 births, putting the mom at risk of severe blood loss, preterm birth, hysterectomy, and other complications. Every mom deserves risk-appropriate obstetric care. Making this a reality requires increasing awareness of accreta, supporting and advocating for moms and babies, and connecting patients and providers with resources to help improve quality of care.

 
Join us:
Your first step is to Register.

Those who wish to fundraise and not count steps, you must register  but you do not have to log steps.  

Step with a purpose this October! See if you can get 72,000 steps in! That's 7,200 a day. 
Over 10 days, every step you take helps raise awareness of placenta accreta and supports the life-saving programs of the National Accreta Foundation. Whether you’ve experienced accreta firsthand, cared for someone through it, or are passionate about supporting families affected, your participation makes a difference. Together, we’ll walk, connect, and move with purpose—each step symbolizing strength, advocacy, and hope for the accreta community. Register, set a goal for yourself or your team, and share the reason why you step up for accreta awareness!

Registration INCLUDES:

  • Your Donation to National Accreta Foundation (registration)
  • Fundraising page to share your story and why accreta awareness matters to you
  • A digital bib
  • NAF logo wristlet registration gift (U.S. residents only)

Top fundraiser at the end of the month will be crowned our 2026 Accreta Awareness Champion and receive accreta swag and a special certificate for their efforts!

Other Fundraising Level Prizes: 

  • $500 will receive their choice of a NAF Tote  or  NAF Embroidered Blanket
  • $750 will receive the choice of a NAF Engraved Hydroflask Tumbler
  • $1,000 will receive a new NAF Logo Crossbody Tumbler Sling Bag

Make it fun:

  • Wear your accreta gear and take a photo while you participate and send it to us or tag us on social! 
  • Choose a location to get some extra steps and take a walk with your family, friends and/or local accreta sisters
  • Record a short video on why you are "Stepping Up for Accreta!" and use our #AccretaAwareness hashtag

name: Stockton Santa Dash! 5K & 10K
description:
It's the MERRIEST race in Northern California! 🎅

The Stockton Santa Dash is an annual 5K and 10K run/walk event that takes place in San Joaquin Delta College in Stockton, CA. name: Sugar Daddy Race
description:
WELCOME TO THE SUGAR DADDY RACE!

An Epic Run With A sweet finish. Start your Father’s Day weekend with an unforgettable race through the beautiful Santa Clarita Valley. Choose your challenge—Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or Kids Race—and enjoy a scenic, fast, almost‑flat course along the paved paseo trails.

Designed to bring runners together, the Sugar Daddy Race delivers a feel‑good, high‑energy experience from start to finish. You’ll fly across the historic Iron Horse Bridge, cross the finish line to earn your epic Sugar Daddy bling, and cool down with free Ben & Jerry’s ice cream—the sweetest reward for an awesome run.

Learn more below or register today to secure your spot at the start line!

FAST COURSE
Runners get to enjoy the best of Santa Clarita's awesome paths and paseos, taking runners on a spectacular tour around the Santa Clarita Valley on a very fast course. 
 
HISTORIC BRIDGE
All runners get to make the final push into the finish line to run across the historic 130-year-old Iron Horse bridge, making for a landmark race finish.
 
FAMILY FUN
The Sugar Daddy Race is for everyone, runners, walkers, hikers, there is even a Kids Fun Run for the little ones to get active and healthy to experience a race.
 
SWEET FINISH
In addition to earning an awesome medal, Sugar Daddy finishers will get a special ice cream treat to help cool them off after finishing the race.

Learn more at >> SugarDaddyRace.com

Get ready to soak up the sunshine and celebrate summer with Summertime in the LBC, a vibrant race along the beautiful Long Beach waterfront! Whether you’re running the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon, this event captures the iconic energy of Long Beach, combining stunning coastal views with CaliFlow’s unbeatable race vibes.

June 26, 2027

 
📍 Start Location:
5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

🏃‍♂️ Race Day Schedule:
Bib Pick-Up/Registration Opens: 6:00 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

🚫 No late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!

 
🚗 Parking Information:
Street Parking: Free along Ocean Blvd.
Beach Lot Parking: $2.00 per hour. Pay at the machine (credit card and coin payments accepted).
Lot Location: 5500 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
 
🌟 Race Perks:
🏅 Finisher Medal for all participants.
📸 Free Race Photos – Capture your summer memories.
🏆 Chip-Timed Results – Accurate, instant, and ready at the finish.
🥇 Overall & Age Group Awards – Top 3 male and female finishers in each distance.
🚰 Water and Aid Stations – Located every 2 miles.
🚻 Restrooms – Conveniently located near the start line.
👶 Stroller & Walker-Friendly – All are welcome.
🌊 Course: Fully marked and staffed, showcasing the best of Long Beach’s scenic coastline.
 
☀️ Weather & Safety:
This is a RAIN or SHINE event.
In the rare case of severe weather (tsunami, tidal wave, or zombie apocalypse), updates will be sent via email and posted on our social media channels.

 
📸 Join the Community:
Tag us in your race photos using #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!

🔥 Don’t miss #FreeEntryFriday – answer our question on social media for a chance to win a free race!

 
🌴 Why Run with CaliFlow?
We host over 60 races per year, making big race experiences accessible without the big price tag. It’s all about good vibes, great views, and bringing the community together.

👉 Register now and feel the summer vibes at Summertime in the LBC! 🌊☀️🏃‍♂️

name: Summit Rock
description:
Come join us in the beautiful redwood groves of the Santa Cruz Mountains! Tucked away just outside Silicon Valley, Sanborn County Park features miles of single-track trails dappled with filtered light through lush canopy.

Half Marathon and 10K runners will ascend to peaks offering spectacular views and all distances will include breathtaking single track trails.

While experienced runners will enjoy the challenge and exploration of new territory, those new to the trails will also discover a whole new world of running where it is perfectly normal (and highly recommended!) to walk the hills and save your energy for the flat and downhill sections.

All courses include a mix of fire roads, single track and very small sections of paved trail. The half marathon and 10K include a climb up to the top of Sanborn Park. Smart runners will walk the hills and save their energy for the flats and downhills!

name: Sundae Funday - Ice Cream Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🍦 Sundae Funday – Ice Cream Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon 🍦
Get ready to race, chill, and indulge! Sundae Funday is your chance to chase sweet miles and even sweeter treats along the scenic Long Beach waterfront.

Whether you’re sprinting the 5K, pushing through the 10K, or conquering the Half Marathon, one thing’s for sure—you’re finishing with a custom-made sundae in hand.

 
📍 Race Details:
Location: 5400 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach CA 90803

Date: Sunday, August 8, 2026

🏃‍♂️ Race Day Schedule:
Registration Opens: 6:00 AM
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

Kids Dash 1K: 9:00 AM


🚗 Parking Information:
Free Street Parking: Available along Ocean Blvd.
Beach Lot Parking: $2.00 per hour (pay at the machine).
 
🍨 Event Perks:
🍦 Ice Cream at the Finish Line! 
🏅 Ice CreamThemed Finisher Medals
📸 Free Race Photos: Capture your Sundae Smile.
🏆 Chip-Timed Results & Age Group Awards: Top 3 Male & Female in each distance.
🚰 Water and Aid Stations: 3 on Course
🌊 Beachside Views & Good Vibes: Run alongside the iconic Long Beach coastline.
 
🌞 Why Sundae Funday?
This isn’t just a race—it’s a celebration. We believe in running for joy, finishing with a smile, and treating yourself to something sweet. Whether you’re here to crush your personal best or simply enjoy a sunny stroll with friends, you’re part of the CaliFlow family.

💫 Dress Up for Extra Fun:
Come in your brightest, sweetest, or most sundae-inspired outfit! Tutus, sprinkles, and waffle cone hats are highly encouraged.

 
🎟 Register Now:
Secure your spot in the sweetest race of the year. Don’t just run—treat yourself!

 

 
🌐 Social Media Tags:
#SundaeFundayRun #CaliFlowRuns #SweetMiles #RunForIceCream #FinishWithASmile

name: Sunrise Marathon 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Chase the Sun, Crushing your Goals! 🏃‍♀️💨

Welcome to the 2027 Sunrise Marathon 5K/10K/13.1! There is no better way to start your day than stepping up to the starting line just as the world wakes up.

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 
Smaller Races, Warm Memories, Always Ready for You

name: Support Blue Fresno
description:
Run. Walk. Support.

Join us for our annual Support Blue Run — a powerful community event uniting the Central Valley in visible support of the men and women in law enforcement.

When you participate, you’re doing more than running a race. You’re investing in the mission of the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy — committed to being First to Serve, providing spiritual and emotional support to first responders and the community during crisis, tragedy, and critical incidents.

Why Support Blue Matters

The Support Blue campaign exists to:
🤝 Strengthen trust and connection between law enforcement and the community
💙 Provide a meaningful way for families, businesses, and individuals to visibly show their support
👮‍♂️ Create positive engagement opportunities between the community and officers
🙏 Fund the programs and resources that allow the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy to respond when the call comes

Every registration helps ensure chaplains can show up at hospitals, death notifications, critical incidents, and community crises throughout the year.

Event Details

🏃 10K Run    🏃 5K Run    🚶 2-Mile Walk
Whether you're a competitive runner, walking with family, or representing your department or business, there is a place for you at the start line.

More Than a Race

Support Blue Run is a celebration of community:

  • First responder displays
  • Family-friendly atmosphere
  • Vendor booths
  • Finisher medals
  • Coffee, donuts, and connection

It’s a day where Fresno stands together.

Be Part of Something Bigger

When you run Support Blue, you help the Chaplaincy continue to be present in the hardest moments — supporting officers, firefighters, victims, and families across our Valley.

We invite you to lace up, show up, and stand with those who serve.

name: Support Blue Fresno
description:
Run. Walk. Support.

Join us for our annual Support Blue Run — a powerful community event uniting the Central Valley in visible support of the men and women in law enforcement.

When you participate, you’re doing more than running a race. You’re investing in the mission of the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy — committed to being First to Serve, providing spiritual and emotional support to first responders and the community during crisis, tragedy, and critical incidents.

Why Support Blue Matters

The Support Blue campaign exists to:
🤝 Strengthen trust and connection between law enforcement and the community
💙 Provide a meaningful way for families, businesses, and individuals to visibly show their support
👮‍♂️ Create positive engagement opportunities between the community and officers
🙏 Fund the programs and resources that allow the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy to respond when the call comes

Every registration helps ensure chaplains can show up at hospitals, death notifications, critical incidents, and community crises throughout the year.

Event Details

🏃 10K Run    🏃 5K Run    🚶 2-Mile Walk
Whether you're a competitive runner, walking with family, or representing your department or business, there is a place for you at the start line.

More Than a Race

Support Blue Run is a celebration of community:

  • First responder displays
  • Family-friendly atmosphere
  • Vendor booths
  • Finisher medals
  • Coffee, donuts, and connection

It’s a day where Fresno stands together.

Be Part of Something Bigger

When you run Support Blue, you help the Chaplaincy continue to be present in the hardest moments — supporting officers, firefighters, victims, and families across our Valley.

We invite you to lace up, show up, and stand with those who serve.

name: Suzie Smith Memorial Run
description: Join us for the first Suzie Smith 5k Memorial Run. This event is to honor and remember Suzie Smith's dedication and service to our community. For 35 years Suzie served as a flight nurse meeting and serving people in some of their most difficult moments. Please join us as we honor Suzie and her commitment to God, her family, and her community. All proceeds from this event will be given to Suzie's foundation "Our Angel that Flies."

name: SVLG Foundation
description:
We are the Silicon Valley Leadership Group Foundation. We improve quality of life across the Silicon Valley by bringing people and companies together to support local communities. Through large-scale community events, we inspire people to get involved, connect with one another, and give back.

We partner with leading Silicon Valley companies and direct funds to nonprofit organizations working in health, education, food security, housing, and youth wellness. Everything we do is rooted in a simple belief: when people come together, real impact happens.

name: Team Up For Women
description:
Team Up for Women 5K Fun Run & Walk

Join us for the Team Up for Women 5K Fun Run & Walk, a morning dedicated to movement, community, and making a difference for women.

On Saturday, October 10, 2026, runners and walkers will come together at the Dry Creek Trail at the northeast corner of Clovis & Nees in Clovis, California. The 5K begins at 8:00 AM and welcomes participants of all abilities—whether you're racing for a fast time, walking with friends and family, or simply coming out to support an important cause.

Every Step Furthers Her

This event benefits the Mary Kay Ash Foundation®, whose work focuses on two critical issues affecting women: advancing research for cancers affecting women and helping end domestic violence.

Your participation is about more than reaching the finish line. It's an opportunity to stand together, support women, and help create a brighter future.

Race participants receive:

  • Professionally timed 5K by Central Valley Timing
  • Race bib
  • Event T-shirt
  • Fun, welcoming run/walk experience
  • An opportunity to support the Mary Kay Ash Foundation®

Bring your friends, family, coworkers, and teammates and make it a morning to remember. Run it. Walk it. Do it together.

Women Supporting Women. Stronger Together.

name: Thankful Paws Turkey Trot
description:
2nd Annual Thankful Paws Turkey Trot 5K/10K
Join us for the 2nd Annual Thankful Paws Turkey Trot 5K/10K on Thanksgiving morning at beautiful Rohr Park in Bonita, located in Chula Vista.

This special Thanksgiving tradition celebrates the pets who have filled our lives with love, loyalty, companionship, and unforgettable memories. Whether you're honoring a current furry family member or remembering a beloved pet who has crossed the rainbow bridge, this event is a meaningful way to start your holiday.

Enjoy a scenic and fast course winding through the park and alongside the golf course, offering an ideal setting for runners of all abilities. Whether you're chasing a personal best, walking with friends and family, or enjoying a fun holiday outing with your dog, there's an event for everyone.

Race Events
10K Run
5K Run/Walk
Kids' Mile
Doggy Mile
Bring the entire family—including your four-legged companions—and make Thanksgiving morning an active, memorable, and heartwarming experience.

Supporting a Great Cause
A portion of event proceeds will benefit Kane's K9s & Animal Rescue, a local nonprofit organization dedicated to rescuing abandoned, neglected, and at-risk animals and helping them find loving forever homes.

Every registration helps support their lifesaving mission. When you participate, you're not only investing in your health and community—you’re helping provide food, medical care, shelter, and second chances for animals in need.

Come run, walk, wag, and give thanks with us this Thanksgiving. Together, we can celebrate our pets while making a meaningful impact on the lives of animals still searching for their forever families.

Every step helps save a paw.

 
FAQ
Bib Pickup

TBD

Doggy Mile Rules
For participants in the Doggy Mile, the dog must cross the finish line ahead of its owner or handler to receive an official race result. All dogs must remain on a leash at all times and be comfortable around people and other dogs.

Beneficiary
Proceeds from the 1 mile event will benefit Kane's K9s & Animal Rescue, a local nonprofit rescue organization serving animals throughout the community.

name: Thanksgiving Gobble Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Get Ready to Wobble Before You Gobble! 🦃

Join us for the annual Thanksgiving Gobble Trot! Before you dive into the turkey and stuffing, enjoy the holiday with your family, friends, and fellow runners. 🏃‍♂️💨

It’s the perfect way to burn calories and make lasting memories to balance out the big feast, before and after!
Don’t wait—spots fill up faster than the Thanksgiving table! 🍽️✨

 
Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 
Smaller Races, Warm Memories, Always Ready for You

name: The Bagel Run – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Let's run and brunch together!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email.

Event Schedule

Friday
4-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located along the course The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: The Big Lebowski Dude Dash 5K & 10K
description:
Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races.

The Dude abides... and, the Dude runs.

Join us for The Big Lebowski Dude Dash, a 5K & 10K celebrating bowling, White Russians, nihilism, and one very important rug.

name: The Captain’s Runaround
description:
It's time for The Captain's Runaround!

For those not familiar with Captain’s, it is a timed race. Runners compete in 4-, 6-, or 8, or new for this year, 2 hour events to see how many miles they can complete.

This year, we are back at Jacob Myers Park in Riverbank.  While the loop is just shy of 1 mile, it is a fantastic place to spend the day. 

Embrace the short days of fall and take on Captain’s Runaround. You’ll be glad you did.

name: The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon
description:
Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Strike first. Strike hard. No mercy.

Join us for The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon, an 80s-inspired martial arts throwback run along the LA River Path!

Whether you’re running for Miyagi-Do honor or Cobra Kai glory, this is your shot to earn a finisher’s medal with dojo-level pride.

Choose your challenge:

  • The 5Kai – Awaken your inner warrior.
  • The 10Kai – Twice the distance, double the badassery.
  • The Half Miyagithon – Go the distance. Channel the balance. Defeat your limits.
  • The Multiverse Dojo Dash (Virtual) – For anyone who can’t make it to our timeline but still wants to join the fight. Run from your own dimension and earn the same medal as the in-person warriors.

Expect high-energy music, 80s and 90s throwbacks, and plenty of martial arts-inspired fun. Costumes welcome. Finish line crane kicks encouraged.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of heart.

Sign up now. Mercy is for the weak.

R is for Running that makes cookie even better!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!
