name: The Giving Turkey Trot - 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
description:
🦃 "The Giving Turkey" Trot - VIRTUAL 5K, 10K & Half Marathon 🦃

Trot to Stop Hunger - This Thanksgiving, your miles mean more.
Join us for the 2nd Annual Giving Turkey Trot—a virtual 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon where every step helps put food on the table for those in need. Whether you run, walk, or hike, you’re not just moving your body… you’re making a real impact.
Because no one should go hungry—especially on Thanksgiving.
 
WHY VIRTUAL?
No travel, no crowds, just pure HOLIDAY FUN for a great cause! Whether you’re participating solo or with your whole flock, all ages and fitness levels are encourage to get out there and strut your feathers!

 

🏃‍♂️ Event Details:
Start Date: November 26, 2026 (Thanksgiving morning)
Completion Deadline: November 29, 2026
Location: This is a Virtual Race! Complete it on your own schedule - whether it's in your neighborhood, on your favorite trail, or even on a treadmill
 
🏃‍♀️ Choose Your Distance:
- 5K – 3.1 miles - A perfect quick trot before the feast
- 10K – 6.2 miles - Double the distance, double the pie
- Half Marathon – 13.1 miles - Go the full drumstick and earn every bite at the buffet. This one’s for the true basters out there
 
🎁 Exclusive Swag & Perks Included:
​- 2-Sided WOOD Finisher's Medal
- TURKEY TROT Beanie 
- Waterproof Bib Number & Safety Pins
- RaceJoy App: Sync activities & track progress on the live leaderboard
- Live Leaderboard: See how you stack up against other trotters
- Free Shipping (USA only)
- Donation to "Feeding America" - the nation's leading hunger-relief charity!
 
**You will receive your Race Packet with all the goods before Thanksgiving Day! 
**For the Tiny Trotters, you may opt in to get a Thanksgiving Coloring Book (50 pgs) - beautiful, high quality pages/images!

​

HOW IT WORKS:
On Thanksgiving morning, the Live Leaderboard will officially open for 4 days. The Live Leaderboard allows participants and spectators to view real-time race results for each division - 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.  The leaderboard is ranked based on fastest finishing time. Each distance division must be completed at one time - you cannot complete in segments over the weekend.

name: The Great American Race
description:
Celebrating 250 Years of America!

Join California Classic Events as we celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the United States of America at the 6th Annual Great American Race!

This isn't just another Fourth of July run; it's a once-in-a-generation celebration honoring America's Semiquincentennial, marking 250 years since the signing of the Declaration of Independence.

Gather your friends, family, and running crew and kick off Independence Day the Classic way with a patriotic 5K, 10K, Kids Race, and Costume Contest at Visalia's beautiful Riverway Sports Park.

Experience an American flag-lined course, festive race-day atmosphere, patriotic music, and a community united in celebration, movement, and freedom.

We are one when we run.

name: The HEART RUN Half Marathon & 5K/10K
description:
❤️ The HEART RUN Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, & Kid’s Dash  Saturday, February 13th, Valentine's DAY, 2027
Celebrate Valentine’s Day in a healthy, heart-filled way! Whether you're running for a personal best, walking with a sweetheart, or bringing the whole family, this is Southern California’s premier February race. Enjoy a flat, fast course at beautiful Bolsa Chica State Beach and stay for the festival!

🏃‍♀️ Packet Pick-Up Options
Skip the lines on race morning and grab your gear early!

Option 1: Pre-Race Packet Pick-Up (Optional)

  • Date: Thursday, February 11
    Time: 3:30PM – 6:30PM
    Location: Road Runner Sports in Newport Beach
    Address: 1835 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA 92627

Option 2: Race Day Pick-Up

  • If you can't make it Thursday, don't worry! You can pick up your bib and shirt on race morning starting at 6:30 AM in LOT 25. (State Park gates open at 6:00 AM).

🚗 High Traffic Alert & Parking Info
Please Plan Ahead: The State Park entrance gate no longer accepts cash.  Have a credit card handy, or quickly waive a parking pass.  We are working to get them to provide hourly parking and NO GATE FEE for races, but that is not in the works for approval until possibly 2027. 

  • Arrive Early: We kindly ask that you plan to arrive early to ensure you are parked and ready.
  • Carpooling: We highly encourage carpooling! It saves you money and helps everyone get into the park faster.
  • Entrance Fee: The State Park charges $15 per car. Please have a credit card or your State Parking Pass ready to keep the line moving.
  • Free Parking Option: Free LIMITED parking is available in Sunset Beach for those willing to arrive extra early and walk into the park. (No car entrance at the far corner of Lot 25; use the Main Gate in the mid-section).

📅 Race Day Schedule (Saturday, Feb 14)
6:30 AM: Race Day Check-In Begins (Lot 25)
7:00 AM – 11:00 AM: February Festival Expo & Valentine Card Station
8:00 AM: Half Marathon Start
8:15 AM: Kid’s Dash (Tot Trot & Youth)
8:30 AM: 5K & 10K Mass Start
9:10 AM: 5K Overall & Division Awards
9:30 AM: 10K Awards Ceremony
9:45 AM: Half Marathon Awards Ceremony
 
🎁 Caren Ware Event's have SO CAL's BEST BLING!  Participant Swag
for The Heart Run includes:

  • Custom Apparel: A high-quality 5K/10K race shirt or a premium Long-Sleeve "Finisher" Hoodie (exclusive to Half Marathon participants).
  • The Medal: BEST DESIGNED and HUGE Custom finisher medal with a distance-specific neck ribbon.
  • Access to our "Full of Heart" section, including a complimentary DIY Valentine’s card-making station, free POPCORN, a scrumptious food court, and a chance to decorate your own heart cookie. Bring some spare cash.  

🍪 February Festival Expo & Treats
Fuel up and have fun! Add a $6 Food Voucher to your registration to use at any booth, including:

  • Galletina’s Specialty Cookies: Delicious heart-themed treats.
  • Tacos & Tamales: Authentic post-race fuel.
  • Fresh Fruit & Whole Coconuts: A refreshing tropical recovery.
  • Specialty Coffee: To kickstart your morning.
  • New for 2026: Visit our "Decorate Your Own Cookie" experience booth!
  •  
  • AWARDS:
    There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5-year age spans:
    1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79 and 80-84, 85 & plus.
     

📍 Essential Logistics
Location: Bolsa Chica State Beach, LOT 25 (Corner of Warner & PCH).
Parking: Entry is via the Main State Park Gate only (mid-section of the beach). Parking is $15 (Credit Card or State Pass required).

Pro Tip:

  • Free LIMITED parking is available in Sunset Beach for those arrive early and willing to walk into the park.
  • Finisher Medals: Collect your medal at the designated table under the finish arch (Left for Half, Middle for 10K, Right for 5K).
  • Family & Pet Friendly: Strollers are welcome! Pets are allowed but must be kept on a leash with responsible clean-up.

Run for a Cause: Proceeds support the Ware in the World Foundation, providing medical supplies and schooling in Nepal and supporting Miss Pam’s Ranch for troubled youth, working with local food banks.  Each race reaches a special need Caren has RUN into , running around the world and into things to support locally.

name: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival
description:
The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival is Orange County's premier race weekend, held annually during the first weekend in May. Whether you're tackling your first 5K, Half Marathon, or Marathon, there's an event for every runner.

The weekend of running begins at the OC Fair and Event Center on Saturday morning with the award winning Hoag Kids Run the OC when nearly 7,000 kids from over 150 Orange County schools participate. Later in the day on Saturday, the Hoag OC 5K takes place with a fun, flat tour of the OC Fairgrounds and nearby Orange Coast College followed by the Celebrate OC Finish Festival.

Sunday morning begins early in Newport Beach, at the iconic Fashion Island. The exceptional Hoag OC Marathon & Half Marathon course is a blend of chic coastal scenery, tranquil nature and sophisticated arts and shopping which equal the best of OC. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and cruise down historic PCH through the seaside village of Corona del Mar. Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival is Orange County's premier race weekend, held annually during the first weekend in May. Whether you're tackling your first 5K, Half Marathon, or Marathon, there's an event for every runner.

The weekend of running begins at the OC Fair and Event Center on Saturday morning with the award winning Hoag Kids Run the OC when nearly 7,000 kids from over 150 Orange County schools participate. Later in the day on Saturday, the Hoag OC 5K takes place with a fun, flat tour of the OC Fairgrounds and nearby Orange Coast College followed by the Celebrate OC Finish Festival.

Sunday morning begins early in Newport Beach, at the iconic Fashion Island. The exceptional Hoag OC Marathon & Half Marathon course is a blend of chic coastal scenery, tranquil nature and sophisticated arts and shopping which equal the best of OC. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and cruise down historic PCH through the seaside village of Corona del Mar. Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

name: The Improve Every Day Half Marathon
description:
The Improve Every Day Half Marathon is built around one idea: every mile out there is proof of what you're capable of. This December 12th in San Diego, we're bringing that to life on a looped course where every lap shows you how far you've come.

Half marathon runners will complete just over 3 laps. Each time you come back around you'll feel the crowd, feed off the energy, and find out what you're truly capable of. The loop format means you're never alone out there and the support never stops.

Whether you're running your first half or chasing a new PR, you're out there with people who get it. People who showed up for themselves the same way you did.

Field is capped at 1,000 runners. Price goes up as spots fill:

Spots 1–250:      $45
Spots 251–500:     $55
Spots 501–750:     $65
Spots 751–1,000:   $75

 

What's included:

- lùth finisher shirt

- Hydrations Stations on course

- Loop-style race

- Post-race hang out

                                                                                                                                                                                              

Register now and see how much you are capable of improving!

name: The Iron Office Health And Fitness Expo
description:
Welcome to The Iron Office Health and Fitness Expo at The Two Cities Marathon! This year's Expo will be held on Friday, October 30th, from 2:00PM to 6:00pm AND Saturday, October 31st, from 9AM-2PM at The Well Community Church(325 Nees Ave, Clovis, CA 93611)

The 2026 Iron Office Health and Fitness Expo will host thousands of health and fitness enthusiasts. Exhibitor booths are an inexpensive marketing method of getting your product and services to an active and fitness minded community.  All booths are 10' x 10' and complete with pipe and drape, which includes one 8' table with table cloth and 2 chairs.  Multiple booths are discounted and are available on a first come basis. We will try to accommodate you with the booth space you choose.

OUTSIDE BOOTHS DO NOT INCLUDE TABLES, CHAIRS, OR CANOPIES. VENDORS MUST PROVIDE THEIR OWN.



The Two Cities Marathon reserves the right to refuse a vendor a booth for any reason including for selling or promoting alcohol, tobacco or other drug or related paraphernalia.  All booth sales will be reviewed and if not approved will be refunded, less processing fee.

 

Vendor Schedule:

Friday 10/30 10AM-1PM- Vendor Load-In  

Friday 10/30 2PM-6PM Expo

Saturday 10/31 9AM-2PM Expo

Saturday 10/31 2PM-4PM Vendor Load-Out

name: The Jingle Bell Dash Kids Dash, 1 Miler, 5K, 10K and Half Marathon & Santa Paws Doggie Run
description:
The Jingle Bell Run – A Holiday Race by the Beach!
📍 5000 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 December 20, 2026
🏃 5K | 10K | Half Marathon|  Kids Dash| 

Get ready to dash into the holiday season with the Jingle Bell Dash! Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Granada Beach- Long Beach, this festive race brings holiday cheer, coastal vibes, and plenty of jingle bells to go around! Whether you're here to race, celebrate, or just enjoy the holiday magic, this event is guaranteed to fill your spirit with joy!

 
🎄 What’s Included?
✅ Festive Finisher Medal – A custom-designed holiday medal for all participants!
✅ Chip-Timed Event – Accurate timing for all runners.
✅ Age Division Awards – Celebrate your race-day victory!
✅ Top 3 Overall Male & Female Awards – For each race distance.

✅ Free Downloadable Race Photos

✅ Finish Line Festival with DJ

✅ Pictures with Santa Clause

 
🎅 More Than Just a Race – Holiday Fun for All!


🎭 Costume Contest – Show Off Your Holiday Spirit!
Dress up as Santa, an elf, a reindeer, or even the Grinch! The most creative and festive costumes will win special prizes!

🔔 Jingle Bell Dash Challenge!
Every runner will receive jingle bells for their shoes! The challenge? Be the jolliest runner on the course! The runner who jingles the loudest wins a prize!

📸 Santa’s Photo Booth & Holiday Fun Zone!
Snap a picture with Santa, enjoy festive treats, and soak in the holiday magic at our post-race Holiday Fun Zone!

🎶 Live DJ Playing Holiday Jams!
Stay after the race for a coastal holiday party with music, games, and fun for the whole family!

 
🎟 Same Day Registration & Packet Pick-Up


Registration/Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 
🏁  Half Marathon Start 7:00 AM
🏃‍♂️ 5K & 10K Start: 8:30 AM

 

🚨 Important: No late starts. Arrive early to ensure you’re ready to run!

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ Street Parking is FREE - Beach Lot os $2.00 per hour

 
🎅 Weather & Safety
❄️ Rain or Shine Event!
☀️ Expect cool coastal breezes – perfect for a winter run!
🌀 In case of extreme weather (Santa getting stuck in the sandstorm, a gingerbread house collapse, or a rogue reindeer invasion), updates will be sent via email & social media.

 
🎁 Spread the Cheer!
📲 Tag us with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!
🎟 Tune in on Fridays for #FreeEntryFriday—answer fun questions to win a free race entry!

 
Don’t miss out on the most festive beachside run of the season! Sign up today and jingle all the way to the finish line! 🎅🏃‍♀️🎄

name: The Kayla Bernardi BEE Positive Fun Run Walk
description:
The Kayla Bernardi Bee Positive Foundation was started after Kayla lost her battle to leukemia in 2015. As a family we choose to stay focused on the positive and make a difference in our community. Kayla's nickname was Busy Bee and so it was a natural name to attach to her foundation. We raise money to spread throughout the community in her foundations name. We hope that attaching a "Bee Positive" message inspired people beyond the monetary donation. Losing Kayla continues to pain us in a way that is indescribable, raising funds in her name inspires us to continue her legacy and "Bee Positive" even on the hardest of days. Kayla’s birthday was January 31st, so every year we do a 5K Fun Run Walk to honor her legacy and raise money to spread throughout many communities.

Come out and have a GREAT time participating in a fun run/walk that will embrace the spirit of Kayla. After the run, we will keep the BEE Positive vibe going with the POST RUN BEE POSITIVE PARTY AT DUST BOWL BREWERY.
Please join us in Dust Bowl’s Turlock Beer Garden on January 25th, 2025 from 11am-2pm for music, corn hole, and a BEE Positive Vibe. The first 250 participants 21 and older with a bib from the 2025 Fun Run/Walk will get one complimentary beer or seltzer. Participants under 21 can enjoy a free soda or hop water. The food trailer, and outdoor bar will also be open for the occasion. Partake in a special edition Bizzy BEE beer brewed especially for this event!

name: The Kayla Bernardi BEE Positive Fun Run Walk
description:

name: The Krew Runner's 3rd Annual Santa Con Run
description:
Join us for The Krew Runners 3rd Annual Santa Con Run

Saturday, December 13, 2026

7:00 am at Mershops Northridge Mall  (Hobby Lobby area)

Santa Con is back for YEAR THREE! 🎅🏃‍♂️✨

Join The Krew Runners at Northridge Mall for our 3rd Annual Santa Con, a festive community run bringing runners, walkers, families, and our Salinas community together to kick off the holiday season with movement, giving, and plenty of holiday cheer.

Santa Con has become one of our favorite Krew traditions, and this year we're ready to make it even bigger. Whether you're chasing a PR, walking with your family, bringing the kids out for some fun, or simply looking for a way to celebrate the season with your community, everyone is welcome.

 

👟 THIS YEAR, WE’RE RUNNING FOR SHOES.
Our goal is to raise $10,000 to provide running shoes to local students who may not own a proper pair or have access to one.

As runners, we know how important the right pair of shoes can be. But for a young person, a pair of running shoes can represent so much more than footwear.

They can be an invitation to move.
An opportunity to participate.
A chance to join a team.
A reason to try something new.
And sometimes, the confidence to take that very first step.

We believe every child deserves the opportunity to experience movement without their circumstances being the reason they have to sit on the sidelines.

Through Santa Con, we're asking our community to help us put shoes on feet and opportunities in front of kids.

🎯 OUR GOAL: $10,000
Race registrations, donations, sponsorships, and community support will help us work toward our $10,000 fundraising goal to purchase running shoes for students in need.

Every registration matters. Every donation matters. Every step matters.

Date: Sunday, December 13, 2026 

Start Time: 7:00 am

Start/Finish Line: Hobby Lobby Parking Area

 

Course Map: Coming soon!

*Registration: We encourage you to PRE-REGISTER. In person registration will be from 6:00am - 6:30am ONLY. NO EXCEPTIONS.*

The Krew's Santa Con Run is open to all members of the community. All ages are welcome to participate (under 18 with a guardian). There is no age limit for participating. Participants with strollers are welcome; however, strollers must be in the last leg of the race for safety. Unfortunately, dogs are not allowed at the race, with the exception of Service Animals. Please register by Wednesday, Dec. 9, 2026. (Note: For your convenience, all registration is handled exclusively through this Run Sign Up platform.)

Registration fees:

5k participants: $49.50 (plus processing fee) until October 31, 2026; price increases to $59.50 (plus processing fee) after October 31, 2026

10k participants: $59.50 (plus processing fee) until October 31, 2026; price increases to $69.50 (plus processing fee) after October 31, 2026

1 mile children's run: $25.50 (plus processing fee) until October 31, 2026; price increases to $35.50 (plus processing fee) after October 31, 2026 (ONLY FOR CHILDREN UNDER 10 YRS OLD)

All participants: (WAIVERS REQUIRED FOR ALL PARTICIPANTS). UNDER 18 PARTICIPANTS WILL NEED PARENT OR GUARDIAN TO SIGN WAIVER

Registration includes:

  • Race bib
  • Race medal
  • Race T-Shirt 
  • Post-race refreshments
  • A festive Santa Con Run
  • Giveaways and surprises
  • Music and holiday vibes
  • Holiday photo opportunities 
  • Festive costumes and Santa Gear
  • Fun for all!

Race Medals will be handed to ALL finishers 

We will have awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers OVERALL for men and women.

Come dressed in your best Santa suit, ugly Christmas sweater, reindeer ears, elf outfit, holiday pajamas—or whatever brings the holiday spirit!

Entry fees are nonrefundable and nontransferable. There are no refunds if the event is canceled due to a force major event.

We are committed to providing a fair and equitable experience for all participants. This includes ensuring all participants are registered and receive a bib and t-shirt. Please note that t-shirt sizes are subject to availability and are distributed on a first-come basis; while we do our best to fulfill requests, specific sizes cannot be guaranteed once inventory runs out. If you do not pick up your bib and t-shirt during bib pick-up or on race day, participants will forfeit their t-shirts, bibs, and medals. This ensures that all participants have a fair chance to receive these items and reduce waste.

Bib Pick Up:

Bib pick-up will be held on Friday, Dec. 11th from 4pm - 8pm in Northridge Mall and morning of event in Hobby Lobby parking lot

Please bring a Photo ID. All participants must sign an event waiver online in advance.

Race Day:

Please arrive early for the race. We recommend 30 to 45 minutes prior to the 7:00 am start time. (As parking may be an issue - parking will be in Macys parking lot)

KREW x Santa Con Run Prep:

Interested in training for the 5K or 10K? We invite you all to join us every Tuesday at 6:30pm for 3 - 5 miles. More information on IG: @THEKREWRUNNERS

Parking:

Parking will be in the Macy's parking lot facing Ulta and Five Below

The course will be cleared by 11am. After 11am, participants will be asked to continue towards Hobby Lobby area to join us for the Holiday after event.

Driving Directions (day of event):

Enter through N. Main entrance by Bank of America. Please follow these directions as road closures in the race area will be in effect after 6:30am. 

Volunteer With Us:

Santa Con Run relies on volunteers to make the race possible. Volunteer opportunities are open to ALL high school students, faculty, staff, and community members. Duties may include bib pick-up, bag check, course set-up and take-down, water and aid stations, race course, and finish line support.

Please email: Mario Reyes mareyes008@gmail.com for more information or questions.

All volunteers are required to complete and sign a Liability Waiver prior to volunteering and participating in any volunteer activities. Liability Waiver must be signed for each volunteer opportunity.

Volunteer assignments will occur from 6:00 a.m. to 12 pm on Sunday, Dec. 13th and will be communicated the week of Dec. 9th (Some shifts will begin earlier than 6:00 a.m. based on assigned area)

Accessibility:

THE KREW works to make events accessible to all. To request special accommodations, or for more information, please contact Marlene Garcia, Director of Operations of The Krew, at g.marlene25@icloud.com or (831) 676-6533

*Please note that minor participants/attendees must remain under the supervision of their parent, legal guardian or authorized chaperone during the course of this event. The Krew Runners, Salinas PAL and Mershop Northridge staff, students, and guests will not be held responsible or liable for the supervision of any minor participant/attendee during the event.

name: The Krew Runner's 3rd Annual Santa Con Run
description:

7:00 am at Mershops Northridge Mall  (Hobby Lobby area)

Santa Con is back for YEAR THREE! 🎅🏃‍♂️✨

Join The Krew Runners at Northridge Mall for our 3rd Annual Santa Con, a festive community run bringing runners, walkers, families, and our Salinas community together to kick off the holiday season with movement, giving, and plenty of holiday cheer.

Santa Con has become one of our favorite Krew traditions, and this year we're ready to make it even bigger. Whether you're chasing a PR, walking with your family, bringing the kids out for some fun, or simply looking for a way to celebrate the season with your community, everyone is welcome.

 

👟 THIS YEAR, WE’RE RUNNING FOR SHOES.
Our goal is to raise $10,000 to provide running shoes to local students who may not own a proper pair or have access to one.

As runners, we know how important the right pair of shoes can be. But for a young person, a pair of running shoes can represent so much more than footwear.

They can be an invitation to move.
An opportunity to participate.
A chance to join a team.
A reason to try something new.
And sometimes, the confidence to take that very first step.

We believe every child deserves the opportunity to experience movement without their circumstances being the reason they have to sit on the sidelines.

Through Santa Con, we're asking our community to help us put shoes on feet and opportunities in front of kids.

name: The Long Beach Halloween Run 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🎃 The Long Beach Halloween Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash

📍 Start/Finish: Granada Beach 5000 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA

Get ready for a hauntingly good run along the Long Beach shoreline.

The Long Beach Halloween Run brings spooky-season energy to one of the most iconic coastal courses in Southern California. As you race along the waterfront, the Queen Mary looms in the background — rich with history, mystery, and more than a few ghost stories of her own. 👻⚓️

Costumes are encouraged, vibes are high, and the miles are unforgettable. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running for fun, or just here to show off your costume, this is Halloween done the CaliFlow way.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
6:00 AM – Runner Check-In & Bib Pickup Opens
7:30 AM – Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM – 5K & 10K Start (All Ages Welcome)
9:15 AM – NEW! Kids Dash (200-yard dash for kids 10 & under) 🎃🧒

 
🕸️ Why You’ll Love This Race
✅ Iconic Course: Flat, fast waterfront miles at Alamitos Beach
✅ Professional Chip Timing: Accurate results for every runner
✅ Incredible Photo Ops: Queen Mary, harbor views & skyline
✅ Finish Line Festival: Music, energy, and CaliFlow vibes
✅ Free Race-Day Photos: Memories included
✅ Kids Dash Medals: Every little ghoul earns one
✅ Beginner-, walker-, stroller-, and dog-friendly 🐾

 
🧡 Run the Coast. Feel the Spirit.
CaliFlow Runs brings together community, creativity, and unforgettable race-day experiences. Whether you’re dressed spooky, silly, or somewhere in between, the Long Beach Halloween Run is a celebration of movement, fun, and a little October magic by the sea.

Come for the run.
Stay for the vibes.
Leave with candy, medals, and memories. 🎃

name: The Long Beach Leprechaun Run - Kids Dash, 1 Miler, 5k, 10K, & Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
Get ready to feel the luck of the Irish at Shamrocks by the Shore in beautiful Long Beach on Sunday, March 14th!

This is a Chip Timed Race

This festive St. Patrick’s Day run invites runners of all levels to a fun-filled 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon along the scenic waterfront.

Put on your best green gear and join the fun with Irish-themed cheer zones, a costume contest, and the chance to find golden coins hidden along the course for special prizes!

Celebrate your achievement at the finish line with a one-of-a-kind medal, festive refreshments, and photo ops with pots of gold and rainbows.

Bring the whole family—kids can join the Little Leprechaun Dash or explore the Shamrock Treasure Hunt for even more fun!

Don’t miss this lively celebration of fitness and Irish spirit—register today!

Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up Begins: 6:00 AM –  (Race Ready Athletics Tent)


Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

1 Miler - 9:00AM

Kids Dash - 9:30 AM
Important: There are no late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!
 

Start Location:
5100  E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Granada Beach - Rosies Dog Beach 

Parking Information:


Free street parking is available.
Metered parking is $2.00 per hour (credit card and coin payments accepted).

Additional Race Day Info:


Restrooms are located near the start line.
Water and aid stations every 2 miles.
Stroller and walker-friendly event.
Course is fully marked.

 

Weather & Safety:
This is a RAIN or SHINE Event

In case of severe weather, (Like tsunamis, titlewave, or zombie apocalypse),  updates will be provided via email and our social media channels.

Join the Community:
Tag us on social media with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured! Tune in on Fridays for a chance to win a free race by answering our #FreeEntryFriday questions.

name: The Love Run – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Love is in the air! Let's run and show the love!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: The Lumpia Run (presented by CVAORN)
description:
"Every Step Counts!!"

Come join the very first 5K that has lumpia at the finish line! Created by Skedaddle and the Central Valley Association of PeriOperative Registered Nurses (CVAORN), this fun run/walk is
to raise funds for nurse’s education and community outreach projects.

See you there!

On behalf of the Association of periOperative Registered Nurses (AORN), Central Valley Chapter 0520—a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit—we’re thrilled to share an exciting opportunity to support nursing education and promote safe, high-quality surgical care with this run/walk! We’re proud to announce our inaugural Make Every Step Count Run/Walk 5K, happening on Saturday, February 20, 2026, at Michaels Faklis Park in Stockton, CA. This vibrant community event will unite healthcare professionals, educators, students, local leaders and members of our community to raise vital funds that enhance patient safety across our healthcare system including;

● Nursing scholarships

● Certification and continuing education programs

● Monthly chapter lectures and seminars

● Chapter delegates attending the AORN National Surgical Expo

● Educational events for perioperative nurses and surgical technologists

● Community outreach and patient safety initiatives

We would be honored to partner with you as a sponsor for this meaningful cause. Your support will not only showcase your commitment to healthcare excellence—it will also show your connection to the community.

name: The Master's University Winter 5K
description:
RACE DAY NEED TO KNOW:

Check-In and Packet Pickup: Begins at 7AM at TMU's North Campus, and ends at the start of your race. You will receive your Race Number, Timing Chip, and T-Shirt (sizes subject to availability for participants who registered after 12/15/26)

The Master's University, North Campus Address: 24736 Quigley Canyon Rd, Santa Clarita, CA 91321

Parking: Arrive early to find parking. Parking is NOT available at North Campus (P3). Free parking is available in any of TMU's lots apart from P3. CLICK HERE for a campus map. (Available lots: P1, P2A, P2B, P2C, P4. Additional parking is available at TMU's Centennial lot). Carpool recommended. 

 

Since 2011, The Master’s University Winter 5K has been a favorite among local runners thanks to the welcoming atmosphere, scenic course, and community partnerships. This year we are continuing 2025's new features; the Kids 1K, and a more competitive 5K race – the 5K Challenge. The 5K Challenge will be limited to participants whose goal is to complete the race in around 35 minutes. Our traditional 5K Run/Walk will take place immediately following the 5K Challenge.
 
This year's course will replicate the 2025 course. The race will start on TMU’s north campus, wind through Placerita Canyon and Quigley Canyon Open Space, and will finish at the starting point on north campus. The Master's University Winter 5K boasts a scenic and entirely flat course with varying terrain, perfect for participants of all ages and abilities. Come experience what local runners have called their “favorite way to start off the new year!”

 

2026-27 REGISTRATION SCHEDULE

 

Kids K:

JUL 1 -- Early Registration ($10)

SEP 1 -- General Registration ($15)

DEC 15 -- Last day to register and guarantee souvenir T-shirt

JAN 23 -- Race Day Registration ($20): Online or In-Person (Credit, Check or Cash Available)

 

5K Challenge & 5K Run/Walk:

JUL 1 -- Early Registration ($30)

SEP 1 -- Priority Registration ($35)

NOV 1 -- General Registration ($40)

DEC 15 -- Last day to register and guarantee souvenir T-shirt

JAN 9 -- Late Registration ($45)

JAN 23 -- Race Day Registration ($50): Online or In-Person (Credit, Check or Cash Available)
 

 
AWARDS
Participants in the Kids K, 5K Challenge and 5K Run/Walk will all receive event t-shirts (exact size not guaranteed for late registrants) and medallions.
 
Prizes for the overall male and female winners, will be awarded per age group of the 5K Challenge race.

The 5K Challenge will be limited to participants whose goal is to complete the race in around 35 minutes. Our traditional 5K Run/Walk will take place immediately following the 5K Challenge.
 
This year's course will replicate the 2025 course. The race will start on TMU’s north campus, wind through Placerita Canyon and Quigley Canyon Open Space, and will finish at the starting point on north campus. The Master's University Winter 5K boasts a scenic and entirely flat course with varying terrain, perfect for participants of all ages and abilities. Come experience what local runners have called their “favorite way to start off the new year!”

Participants in the Kids K, 5K Challenge and 5K Run/Walk will all receive event t-shirts (exact size not guaranteed for late registrants) and medallions.
 
Prizes for the overall male and female winners, will be awarded per age group of the 5K Challenge race.

name: The Praise Run 2026
description:
What Is The Praise Run?
A community movement with eternal impact — and your brand at the center of it.
The Praise Run is more than a race. It’s a purpose-driven event that fuses faith, fitness, and philanthropy drawing hundreds of runners, families, churches, and community leaders together to worship through movement and support a life-changing cause.

Join us for a powerful morning of movement, worship, and gratitude at The Praise Run — a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon run to celebrate the goodness of God and raise support for the Parkker Hope Program.

Whether you're walking, jogging, or running, every step is an act of praise. Write what you're praising God for on your race bib. It could be healing, breakthrough, salvation, restoration, or simply the breath in your lungs.

This isn't just a run.
It's a declaration.

🎶 Live worship music along the race route
🙏 Opening inspiration from Paul McClain: Leveling Up Your Life
🇺🇸 Prayer and national anthem by Pastor Branamier & God’s House Worship
📖 Stories of praise worn on bibs — turning the course into a testimony
💛 Support for the Parkker Hope Program, which offers spiritual, mental, and physical healing support for kids fighting cancer

Why We Run: The Parkker Hope Program

On May 30th, 2023, 11-year-old Parkker McClain was diagnosed with stage 4B Hodgkin's Lymphoma. She began a very intense chemo protocol that would have a massive impact on her little body. The McClain's began to use hyperbaric, red light, and molecular hydrogen treatment to give her body a significantly higher chance to win the war in her body. On August 9th, Parkker's PET Scan came back clear!

The war was won, and we are standing in faith that your child will win the war.

The Parkker Hope Program allows any child under the age of 18 diagnosed with cancer to receive the following services for FREE:
Use of the Leveled Up Health Center (Body)

Daily Disciplines Parkker completed (Mind)

Scriptures and Songs (Spirit)

Click the DONATE Button above to contribute

name: The Red Tulip Run
description:
Red Tulip Run — Danville 10K for Parkinson's
Saturday, October 17, 2026 · 7:00 AM
655 Old Orchard Dr, Danville, CA

The Red Tulip Run is a 10K through Danville, CA, organized to raise money for Parkinson's research. My grandad lived with Parkinson’s for several years before we lost him earlier this year. Over those years, we watched as the disease gradually took away something most of us never think twice about—the freedom to move the way you want to move.I run cross country. Running is what I'm best at, and it's what he lost. So I'm putting on a race.

The red tulip is the worldwide symbol of Parkinson's disease. All proceeds will be donated to the local non-profit Danville d’Elegance.

Chip-timed 10K. Course support and aid stations along the route. Runners, joggers, and walkers all welcome.

Registration: $35
Donations welcome at checkout.

Come run six miles with us.

name: THE RESET  HYBRID 5K CHALLENGE
description:
🔥 THE RESET — HYBRID 5K CHALLENGE


Sunday, January 3, 2027 | Long Beach, CA

Start the new year with something harder than a resolution.

THE RESET Hybrid 5K Challenge combines a 5K run with four fitness challenges designed to test your strength, endurance, and determination. Run your 5K, enter the Hybrid Zone, complete all four challenges, then earn your way across the finish line.

📍 Location: 5400 E. Ocean Blvd., Long Beach, CA 90803
⏰ Event Start: 8:00 AM

🏃 THE CHALLENGE
Complete the 5K run first, then enter the Hybrid Zone:

JUMP — 80m Burpee Broad Jumps
Chest to the ground. Get up. Broad jump forward. Repeat for 80 meters.

LUNGE — 100m Walking Lunges
Keep moving forward through the entire marked 100-meter zone.

CARRY — 100m Sandbag Carry
Pick it up and carry it through the complete 100-meter course.

SQUAT — 100 Bodyweight Squats
No equipment. Just you and 100 squats between you and the finish.

Then you're released to the FINISH LINE. 🏁

5K. FOUR CHALLENGES. ONE FINISH.
You don't have to be an elite athlete. You don't have to be the fastest runner. You just have to be willing to work.

Run. Jump. Lunge. Carry. Squat. Finish.

THE RESET starts January 3. 🔥

name: The Rocky Hill Triathlon
description:
The Rocky Hill Triathlon returns for the 13th year in Exeter, California! We are the best kept secret in the Central Valley with a course that is challenging and showcases the foothills of the Sierra Nevada mountain range. Our fun course will help push you to new limits and you can earn some of the best swag to prove it! We will be offering two different distances on race day. The Short Course will have a 400 yard swim, 12.5 mile bike & 3.1 mile run. The Long Course will have an 800 yard swim, 24.8 mile bike & 6.2 mile run. New this year is the 10k course which is challenging with two climbs over Rocky Hill. Or choose the 5k which is less challenging

We are USAT sanctioned

Events

-Short Course
-Long Course
-10k
-5k


Why the Rocky Hill Triathlon?

  • Scenic Ride and Run into the foothills

  • FREE Race Photos

  • FREE Beer Ticket to Bell Craft Brew Co

  • Rocky Hill Trucker Hat (Triathlon)

  • All Finishers get a Pullover Hoodie

  • Towel (Triathlon)

  • Polar Cycling Water Bottle (Triathlon)

  • Finisher Medal

  • Epic Finish with Music

Age Group Awards

10 Year Age Group Awards for Male and Female short distance, long distance, 5k, and 10k 

Artletic Apparel Kits Available

Artletic has designed custom kits available during registration. A portion of sales will be donated to the Rocky Hill Triathlon
Artletic Store: https://runsignup.com/Race/Store/CA/Exeter/RockyHillTriathlon2023

Who we Support

The Rocky Hill Triathlon has invested more funds back into the Exeter community than any event. Since day one the board and race director have elected to volunteer their services unpaid. A large portion of your registration will used to benefit a park or project in the city of Exeter

name: The Run for Education
description:
Come for the Run, Stay for the Fun

Join the San Ramon Valley Education Foundation’s 43rd Run for Education on Sunday, October 11, 2026. Walk or run with friends, family, neighbors, teammates, and colleagues in support of our schools. Come for The Run and stay for the fun: more than 50 exhibitors will offer information on local businesses and programs, free samples and giveaways, and interactive activities. Kids activities include games, face painting, crafts, and more. A fire truck and patrol car will be there, as well as an Oakland Ballers player signing autographs!

California High Marching Ensemble, Diablo Vista Middle School Jazz Band, and Stone Valley Middle School Jazz Band will also be on the 5K/10K course to keep us moving and grooving from start to finish.

The Run for Education is a community tradition in the San Ramon Valley spanning more than 40 years. By participating, you are helping fund STEAM grants and innovative programs across our 35 San Ramon Valley Unified School District (SRVUSD) public schools representing the communities of Alamo, Danville, and San Ramon. The Run for Education is the largest run that supports education in Northern California.

name: The Sports Spectacular 5K/10K WILL be now in May, 2027.
description:
SPORT SPECTACULAR 5K & 10K
Bolsa Chica State Beach – Huntington Beach, CA

LOT25
17851 Pacific Coast Hwy
Huntington Beach, CA US 92649

The SPORT SPECTACULAR 5K & 10K celebrates how running helps every sport and every sport helps running. IT's SOON to be an OLYMPIC YEAR.  Let's RACE TOWARD that. 

Whether you're a runner, soccer player, basketball lover, volleyball athlete, or part of any sports community, this event brings athletes of all backgrounds together for a fun and energetic morning at the beach.

Running builds endurance, strength, and mental focus. Qualities that benefit every sport. At the same time, cross-training through other sports can make us stronger, faster, and healthier runners.

This event is designed to celebrate that connection while encouraging everyone to stay active, try new sports, and build community through movement.

EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES
🏅 Custom themed cast finisher medal
👕 Themed Sport Spectacular race shirt
🏆 Chance to win Age Division Awards
⏱ Professional RFID chip timing by Itz About Time
🎵 Music, refreshments, and a fun community atmosphere

Caren Ware Events are designed for Every BODY and EVERYBODY — welcoming runners, walkers, families, and athletes of all abilities.

Expect great energy, creative themes, and one of the BEST themed race experiences around!

 
SPORTS EXPO
A Sports & Fitness Expo will be open race morning featuring:

• Youth and adult sports programs
• Local clubs and teams

name: The Storybook Stride – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
This weekend we run in honor of Read Across America Week, which kicks off on Monday! Bring a book to donate!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: The Terminator 2 Trot: 5K & 10K
description:
Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races.

Relive one of the most legendary action sequences in film history as you race along the Los Angeles River, the iconic chase scene location from Terminator 2: Judgment Day! Kicking off near Canoga Park High School, this event features 5K and 10K distances on a fast, flat course through the heart of the Valley.

As the sequel to our inaugural race, Beyond the Streets, it’s only fitting that we pay homage to one of the Valley’s greatest sequels of all time. Just like T2, this race is bigger, bolder, and totally unstoppable.

Whether you're here to run, jog, or outrun the T-1000, this race is your chance to be part of the fun. Hasta la vista, baby...see you at the start line!

Choose your challenge:

  • The Hasta La Vista 5K
  • The Judgment Day 10K
  • The Multiverse Judgment Dash (Virtual)

Expect high-energy music, 80s and 90s throwbacks, and plenty of T2-inspired fun. Costumes welcome.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of heart.

 

Parody Note
This event is a fan-made parody inspired by classic pop culture. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official rights holders. It’s all for fun and good vibes.

Relive one of the most legendary action sequences in film history as you race along the Los Angeles River, the iconic chase scene location from Terminator 2: Judgment Day! Kicking off near Canoga Park High School, this event features 5K and 10K distances on a fast, flat course through the heart of the Valley.

As the sequel to our inaugural race, Beyond the Streets, it’s only fitting that we pay homage to one of the Valley’s greatest sequels of all time. Just like T2, this race is bigger, bolder, and totally unstoppable.

Whether you're here to run, jog, or outrun the T-1000, this race is your chance to be part of the fun. Hasta la vista, baby...see you at the start line!

Choose your challenge:

  • The Hasta La Vista 5K
  • The Judgment Day 10K
  • The Multiverse Judgment Dash (Virtual)

Expect high-energy music, 80s and 90s throwbacks, and plenty of T2-inspired fun. Costumes welcome.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of heart.

 

Parody Note
This event is a fan-made parody inspired by classic pop culture. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official rights holders. It’s all for fun and good vibes.

name: The TRON Night Run: Neon Grid 5K & 10K
description:
Glow hard or go home.

Join us for The TRON Night Run, a neon-lit night race inspired by digital dreams and grid-style glory. Runners will blaze through a looped nighttime course along the L.A. River, lit up with LED vibes and TRON-inspired energy. Whether you're taking on the 5K or 10K, come dressed to impress in your brightest gear and light up the grid!

✨ Glow swag
🏅 Custom finisher medals
📸 Epic photo ops

Distances:

  • TRON 5K
  • TRON 10K


Start Time:
All distances begin together at 8:00 PM.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🌀 Multiverse Option (Virtual Runners Welcome)
Can’t make it to the Grid? Log in from your timeline.

Our TRON Run: Neon Grid race is open to all warriors of the digital frontier—wherever you’re plugged in. Whether you’re pounding the pavement in Tokyo, biking the lightcycle trail in Boise, or navigating a treadmill in your garage, the mainframe still counts your steps.

Choose the Multiverse Option during registration and select your distance (5K or 10K or even Half Marathon).

Run anytime between August 16–18
Track your run on any device or app (Strava, Garmin, smartwatch, or just a well-timed selfie—we’re cool)
Submit your proof and shipping info
We’ll transmit your finisher’s medal straight from the Grid
You don’t need to be in Canoga Park to feel the pulse of the neon.

 

 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🚨 Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event created with love by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the original creators, studios, or rights holders referenced in our race themes. All names, references, and characters are used for humorous and transformative purposes under fair use. We're just fans… who like to run in costume.

name: The Ultimate Wine Escape Tour
description:
Embark on a memorable day of wine, history and indulgence. Be delighted by an outstanding vintage motorcycle museum, premium wine tastings at scenic vineyards and artisan chocolate pairing. Unwind, socialize, and savor every bit of this mini getaway on a gorgeous Saturday afternoon in Temecula wine country. 

Meet us at the NASNI Visitor Lot for departure at 10 AM.

name: The Wascally Wabbit Trail Race
description:
Formerly known as the Wascally Wabbit Half Mawothon, we've taken this race to the trails, on the Finegold Creek Preserve, operated and managed by the Sierra Foothill Conservancy. 

Feel the sense of satisfaction when you complete this race knowing that you've also helped a great cause. All race proceeds go to Kids Kasa Foster Care to help college-bound former foster children & Sierra Foothill Conservancy. With your support we have helped many former foster children attend higher education at a community college, four year university, or trade school.

Kids Kasa Foster Care Inc. was started in 2004 and is a non-profit 501-(c)-3 which has always worked toward helping children reunify with their families.  

About the Venue

The Austin and Mary Ewell Preserve at Fine Gold Creek was acquired by SFC in 2008. It protects 718 acres of land and one and one half miles of lower Fine Gold Creek starting where it flows into Millerton Lake. Like most foothill streams Fine Gold does not flow in the summer, but it does maintain several large pools of water even in the hottest months.

History
The Preserve was established with funding from Mr. Ben Ewell and family, the Pacific Gas and Electric Company, the Bureau of Reclamation, and the Wildlife Conservation Board (part of the California Department of Fish and Game).

Habitat
In addition to the riparian vegetation along the creek, the Fine Gold Preserve protects Valley Elderberry Longhorn Beetles, Western Pond Turtles, and one of the few southern Sierra populations of the Dutchman’s Pipe Vine Swallowtail butterfly.

Directions to the Austin and Mary Ewell Preserve at Fine Gold Creek
From Fresno, take Highway 41 north. 11 miles from the Friant on-ramp turn right on Highway 145. Go 3.3 miles to the first stop sign; keep going straight as Highway 145 becomes Road 211. Go 3.7 miles from stop sign; turn right onto Road 210. Go 2.5 miles; stay to the right on the  paved road, which becomes Road 216. Go .5 miles; you will see  a double-wide gate on the left. You will arrive at the race venue. Driving time is about 25 minutes from the Friant/Highway 41 on-ramp.

name: The Wild Turkey
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️🌳 Join us for a Heartwarming Thanksgiving Trail Race 🌳🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️

Gather your loved ones and lace up your running shoes because this Thanksgiving morning is about to get even more special! We invite your entire family to come together for a memorable experience at the WILD TURKEY 5k & 10k Trail Race. It's a chance to embrace the spirit of gratitude while supporting a wonderful cause that uplifts our community.

🗓️ Date: Thanksgiving Day, November 26, 2026
🕖 Time: Race starts at 9:00 AM for the 10k, and 9:15am for the 5k
📍 Location: Beals Point

🌟 What to Expect 🌟

🍂 Breathtaking Trails: Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature as you traverse through Folsom Lake's picturesque trails. The crisp air and stunning scenery will make this a race to remember.

🏅 Distances for All: Whether you're a seasoned runner aiming for a personal best or a family looking to enjoy a leisurely walk, we have options for everyone. Choose between the 5k and 10k distances and conquer the trail at your own pace.

Free 1k Kids Run - Registration for this is 100% fee, you can pay for a tshirt, but it is not necessary. Kids fun run begins at 10:30am.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Fun: Thanksgiving is all about togetherness, and what better way to celebrate than by sharing this experience with your family? From little ones to grandparents, everyone is welcome to participate. Strollers (5k) and furry friends on leashes are also invited!

🎉 Post-Race Celebration: After you've crossed the finish line, enjoy a heartwarming post-race celebration with refreshments, music, and the company of fellow participants. It's a chance to share stories, relish the achievements, and reflect on the true meaning of Thanksgiving.

🎉 Register Today! 🎉

Whether you're a seasoned runner or simply looking for a delightful family activity, the Wild Turkey 5k & 10k Trail Race on Thanksgiving morning is the perfect way to kick off your day of gratitude. We can't wait to see you there, ready to run, walk, and make a positive impact together! 🦃🍂🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

name: Third Annual SCTC 5K Turkey Trot
description:
Thanksgivings Day Turkey Trot! 5K run! 

 

Please join us 11/26/2026 8:45 AM for the third annual Santa Clarita Track Club's Turkey Trot. 

The Santa Clarita Track Club invites community members of all ages to run, walk, or jog in our third annual Thanksgiving Day ‘Turkey Trot’ event benefiting the club’s Cross Country and Track & Field programs.

At the event, participants will run a 5k cross country course through the Santa Clarita Central Park through the hills overlooking the Santa Clarita Valley, 

We've added a 10 & Under 1K run around fields 9 & 10,  (8:15 am) 

The 1K event begins at 8:15 a.m. on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026
The 5K event begins at 8:30 a.m. on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

Registration takes here online place or at the race start, (An entry fee of $35.00 per runner.)

For more information about the third annual Thanksgiving Day ‘Turkey Trot’ event please contact coach Elaine Bingham at (661) 373-6897 Email coachelaine@runstorm.org

name: Thrive San Diego Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The Kaiser Permanente Thrive Half Marathon & 5K returns for its 10th year!

We’re excited to THRIVE with you on Saturday, November 14, 2026! More than just a race, it’s an invitation for the entire San Diego community to “Thrive” together—staying active, eating healthy, living well, and giving back. All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

name: Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 10th Annual Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot
                                            Benefiting The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation


                                                            www.hamannfoundation.org


                              Giving A Hand Up To Patients Along Their Journey Fighting Cancer…


Since the inception of The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation in 2014, the Foundation has granted over $1.8M to patients giving a HAND UP with rent and mortgage payments, gas & groceries, medical expenses, utility payments and other needs. The form of support is direct to the patients’ needs to help make a difference along their personal journey fighting cancer. The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation continues to grow each year. This is the 10th Annual Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot and we have various fundraising events throughout the year.

name: Tokay Against Cancer 5K Fun Run
description:
Join us for the first a fun run with Tokay Against Cancer, benefiting the American Cancer Society! Everyone is welcome to and encouraged to sign up regardless of age or experience with running! The event is open to everyone who wants to sign up, not just students, and will be hosted at Tokay High school starting with check-ins at 9 AM for those who registered where runners will receive a free t-shirt! The course will be around the school grounds and food vendors and other businesses will be present with many different goods to check out! Just like hard work goes into your event training, the American Cancer Society gives it our all through things like breakthrough research, patient programs and services, and a free 24/7 cancer helpline. Together, we’ll tackle every course, rally every community, and stay absolutely relentless in the fight against cancer.

Follow us on Instagram @TokayAgainstCancer for race updates.

name: Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event Schedule

Our 15th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 29th, 2027

5:15am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

6:15am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

6:30am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:05am: Costume Contests

7:16am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

7:30am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

7:50am: 5K start

9:30am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are clear of the kids run course)

9:45am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts all week post-race!


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.


Location

12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA US 90293

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

name: Tour de Luke Charity Ride
description:
Get ready to ride for a great cause at Tour de Luke!

Hosted by the City of Lancaster, Lucky Luke Brewing, and local businesses, this community bike ride supports Resurrection Cycles—a nonprofit changing lives by getting people the wheels they need to get to work, school, and everywhere in between.

After the ride, stick around for brunch, brews, and good vibes. Every mile you pedal helps someone roll forward with freedom and possibility!

Tour de Luke cyclists will start at the Lucky Luke Brewing Pub on Lancaster Blvd, then bike to Lucky Luke Brewing in Palmdale on West Avenue O, then back to the Blvd for a 14.2 mile ride.

Participants can ride at 3 different levels:

  • Pedal Only - $10 Basic registration to participate in the event. Stick around for the after party!
  • Pedal & Pour - $30 General Ride which includes 1 beer (or non-alcoholic drink) of your choice after the event
  • VIP Rider - $60 includes 1 free beer (or non-alcoholic drink) of your choice after the event, a limited edition T-Shirt, Lucky Luke water bottle, and 20% off at all 3 Lucky Luke locations the day of the ride

All proceeds will benefit Resurrection Cylces, a local non-profit who focuses on making affordable transportation available to all. Learn more about what they do here: https://rescycles.com

The Squeaky Wheel Bike Shop is volunteering their expertise and will be assisting with bike tune ups and helping ensure rider safety. The local Team Lakays Cycling will also provide course and rider assistance. Both City of Lancaster and City of Palmdale will be assuring rider safety.

A very special thank you to our event partners who are helping make this event possible!

name: Trailquake
description:
Calling all tough mothers for a 5K, 10K, or half-marathon in Saratoga on Mother's Day!

 
The redwoods, the pines, and lots more await on these lush trails. Run, hike, or walk and enjoy the beauty of the forest in spring!  Hikers/walkers are welcome.
 
All finishers will receive custom finisher medals and custom shirts (cotton and tech shirts available).

name: Tri Santa Cruz
description:
Come race at one of the most fun and scenic multisport events on the West Coast!

Tri Santa Cruz offers something for nearly every athlete, from first-timers to experienced racers looking for a fast course and a new PR. Choose from Sprint and International (Olympic) distance triathlons, aquabike, aquathlon, duathlon, relays, open-water swims, running events, and our Super Sprint Triathlon. Clydesdale and Athena triathlon categories are also available.

New to triathlon or want to enjoy the experience alongside family and friends? Our special Family & Friends Sprint Wave is a non-competitive option that allows participants to race together regardless of age or gender.

Special youth and senior pricing is available for individual participants ages 12–17 and 70+. Contact us about discounted registration for an all-youth or all-senior relay team.

Triathlon club discounts are available. If your club does not already have a discount code, have a club officer contact us.

Tri Santa Cruz is an ideal race for both beginners and experienced athletes. The swim takes place in the protected waters of Monterey Bay, while the fast bike and run courses showcase the spectacular Santa Cruz coastline. The bike course is completely closed to vehicle traffic, giving athletes a unique opportunity to race along the coast without cars.

Not ready for a full triathlon? Join us for the 750-meter or 1.5K open-water swim, 5K or 10K run, Super Sprint Triathlon, Aquabike, Aquathlon, or Duathlon. There is truly an event for almost everyone.

Make a weekend of it! After the race, enjoy the famous Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk, visit the Santa Cruz Surfing Museum, explore the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary Exploration Center, or simply spend the day enjoying the beach and everything Santa Cruz has to offer.

Participants receive a custom race T-shirt and finisher medal, along with a post-race lunch. Awards will be presented to top overall and age-group finishers in eligible events.

Swim. Bike. Run. Play. Experience Tri Santa Cruz.

🎁 Anniversary Surprises
💜 The CaliFlow Runs Community You Know and Love!

🅿️ Free street parking along Ocean Blvd

💵 Beach lot parking available for $2/hour (pay at machine)

🎟️ Register Today!
Whether you're chasing a PR, dressing up for fun, walking with friends, or celebrating your very first finish line, there's a place for you at Trick or Trot!

This isn't just another Halloween race. It's a celebration of the miles we've shared, the friendships we've made, and the community we've built together.

🎃 Come for the run. Stay for the celebration.

Let's make this anniversary unforgettable! 💜👟

name: TriFind Race Director Summit
description:
The Future of Multisport Starts Here

The TriFind Multisport Race Director Conference brings together the industry’s most influential race directors and brand partners for an afternoon of insight, collaboration, and recognition.

With representatives from 1,600+ multisport races invited, this gathering is designed to deliver real data, actionable strategy, and meaningful connections that shape the future of endurance racing.

Who’s Invited

  • 900+ NGB races
  • 600+ Non-NGB races
  • Leading brands and sponsors seeking 2027 partnerships
  • Industry media and nonprofit leaders

Important Registration Information

This registration is intended for race directors attending the TriFind Race Director Summit.

Sponsors and brand partners are warmly invited to participate, but must register through the 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes race registration at the sponsor rate. 

This ensures sponsors receive the appropriate race weekend access, exposure, and activation opportunities, while allowing the summit sessions to remain focused on race director collaboration.

What You’ll Experience

2026 State of the Sport
A comprehensive look at participation trends, athlete behavior, and market outlook.

Actionable Research & Insights
Channel and consumer research presentations you can apply immediately to grow and strengthen your races.

Brand & Sponsor Engagement
Connect with companies actively seeking race partnerships and activation opportunities for 2027.

Race Director Awards
Honoring excellence and leadership in the industry, including:

  • Most Innovative Race
  • Most Collaborative Organization
  • Additional peer-recognized honors

Hosted & Emceed By
Bob Babbitt — Breakfast With Bob, the voice of endurance sports.

Registration & Giving Back

Introductory Registration: $100
100% of proceeds benefit the Challenged Athletes Foundation (CAF)

Your registration directly supports athletes with physical challenges, reinforcing the multisport community’s commitment to inclusion and impact.

Conference Hotel & Room Block

A limited block of hotel rooms is available at a discounted rate for attendees.

We strongly recommend booking early, as availability is limited and rooms are expected to sell out.

🔗 Reserve your discounted room here.

Exclusive Race Director Benefit

Registered race directors are invited to compete at no cost in the
 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes
 📅 November 1, 2026

The longest-running triathlon in the world operating continuously from the same venue - a chance to race, connect, and celebrate the sport alongside your peers.

Why Attend

  • Gain clarity on where the sport is headed
  • Learn what’s working and what’s next
  • Build relationships that power future races
  • Be recognized for the work you do
  • Give back to a cause that strengthens our community

Secure Your Spot

Limited capacity. Early registration recommended.

name: TSCL 5th Annual Mental Health 5K Run & Walk
description:
The Self Care Lab 5th Annual 5K Run & Walk for Mental Health Awareness In Partnership with The Claremont Unified School District 

Run for mental health. Walk for community. Every step helps expand access to healing-centered programs.

Join us for the Self Care Lab’s 5th Annual 5K Run & Walk, a community event raising awareness for mental health while supporting programs that promote healing, movement, and wellbeing for both youth and adults.

The Self Care Lab is a clinical boxing gym and wellness space focused on the connection between mental health and physical movement. Through boxing, fitness, and supportive programming, we provide tools that help people regulate stress, build resilience, and strengthen their overall wellbeing.

This year’s 5K also serves as a fundraiser to expand our programs and secure a larger facility, allowing us to serve more members of our community and provide scholarships for underserved youth.

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, casual walker, or simply looking to support a meaningful cause, we welcome participants of all ages and fitness levels.

More information to come.

 

Event Details

Location: Claremont, CA

 

Move with purpose.

Run for mental health.

Support programs that strengthen our community.

 

Learn more or donate:  The Self Care Lab
