name: Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k
description:
RUN. WALK. HAVE FUN. SUPPORT LOCAL STUDENTS!
Get ready, Tulare! The 24th Annual Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5K Run/Walk is back on Saturday, November 7, 2026!

Join the Tulare Sunrise Rotary Club for a fun morning of fitness, friendly competition, and community spirit on the Santa Fe Trail. Whether you're racing for a new personal best, walking with family and friends, or simply coming out to support a great local cause, everyone is welcome!

EVERY STEP SUPPORTS LOCAL STUDENTS
This event benefits the Tulare Sunrise Rotary Club High School Scholarship Program, helping local students continue their education and pursue their future goals.

In 2026, the program awarded scholarships to two Tulare high school seniors, including a $5,000 four-year college scholarship and a $1,500 trade school scholarship.

When you participate in the Trail-A-Thon, you're doing more than completing a 5K — you're helping create opportunities for local students.

RACE DAY DETAILS
📅 Saturday, November 7, 2026

📍 Live Oak Park — 600 North Laspina Street, Tulare

8:00–8:45 AM — Onsite Registration & Bib Pickup

9:00 AM — 5K Run/Walk Starts

The race begins and finishes at Live Oak Park and takes participants along Tulare's Santa Fe Trail.

ONLY $15 TO PARTICIPATE!
We've kept registration affordable at just $15 per participant so runners, walkers, families, students, and community members can all be part of the fun.

Your registration helps cover event expenses including finisher medals, winner awards, and professional race timing.

Additional donations to support the event and scholarship program are also welcome.

EVERY FINISHER EARNS A MEDAL!
Cross the finish line and celebrate your accomplishment!

All finishers receive:

🏅 Commemorative finisher medal and lanyard

📌 Rotary participant pin

🎉 And, of course, bragging rights for completing the Trail-A-Thon!

AGE GROUP AWARDS
Ready for a little friendly competition?

Medals will be awarded to top male and female finishers in the following age groups:

9 & Under • 10–14 • 15–19 • 20–29 • 30–39 • 40–49 • 50–59 • 60+

$100 TOP RUNNER PRIZES!
There's something extra waiting for the fastest runners of the day!

🏆 Overall Male Winner — Special Trophy + $100 Gift Card

🏆 Overall Female Winner — Special Trophy + $100 Gift Card

BRING THE WHOLE CREW!
Run it. Walk it. Bring the kids. Challenge your friends. Put together a group from work, school, church, or your neighborhood.

For 24 years, the Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon has brought the community together for fitness, fellowship, friendly competition, and a great cause.

BECOME A SPONSOR
Want to make an even bigger difference for local students?

Sponsorship opportunities are available. Contact Matthew Hamilton at matt@hamiltonmarketing.com or Petrus Tjandra at ptjandra@aol.com for more information.

BE PART OF 24 YEARS OF TRADITION!
👟 Lace up your shoes.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Bring your family and friends.

🏅 Earn your finisher medal.

🎓 Help support Tulare students.

Join us November 7 and let's fill the Santa Fe Trail with runners, walkers, families, and community spirit!

name: Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk - Bakersfield, CA
description:
What is a Tunnel To Towers Run & Walk?
The Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk Series was created to honor the heroic life and death of Stephen Siller, a New York City firefighter (FDNY) who lost his life on September 11, 2001 after strapping on his gear and running through the Brooklyn Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers. Honor all of those who lost their lives on September 11, 2001 and support our first responders and military who make extraordinary sacrifices in the line of duty! For more information on the Stephen Siller Tunnel to Towers Foundation please visit t2t.org.

This will be the inaugural Tunnels to Towers event here in Palm Coast, and we are excited to bring our community together to honor first responders, our servicemen and servicewomen, and raise funds for the Tunnel to Towers programs.


How far is a Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk?
This is a 5K (3.1 miles) to walk or run this event. Anyone can run, walk, or experience this event.


Where can I pick up my packet?
Packet Pickup will be Wednesday, 2/1/23 to Friday, 2/3/23 from 9am-6pm at:
Palm Coast Community Center 
305 Palm Coast Pkwy. NE
NE, Palm Coast, FL 32137


Can I register the day of the run?
Yes. Registration will open at 7am the morning of the run. If you wait to register, we may not have a shirt for you and we do not guarantee sizes for late registrants.


When does online registration close?
Online registration will remain open until Friday, February 3, the day before race day. If you register after packet pick-up, you may not receive your T-shirt and any other race day swag.


Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.


I am a fast runner. Can I get a front-line position?
Runners predicting a pace faster than 6 minute/mile will be encouraged to move to the front corral (arrive early).


Will there be awards for running?
Yes, additionally, this event will be timed. We keep them very simple since our mission is to honor first responders, most of our awards are based on firefighters, police or military running in gear in the same fashion that Stephen Siller did on 9/11. This event is intended to be an experience and much more than a run.


Will water be available?
Yes, a water station will be available along the route and there will be water available at the start/finish line.


What can you bring to the event? Can I run with a stroller, backpack, wheelchair, roller blades, bicycle, etc.?
Strollers and wheelchairs are permitted. Firefighter turnout gear and military backpacks are also permitted. Please leave all personal items and valuables in your vehicle. All items should be stored securely at the owner's risk. Tunnel to Towers Foundation will not be responsible for the loss of any items.


Does my registration fee count towards my fundraising goal?
Your registration fee does not count toward the fundraising goal.


Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can. They must present a copy of your registration receipt. And don't forget to thank them!


Can I still donate to a team and/or individual after the start of the race?
Yes. Donations will be accepted for 6 weeks after the event.


How can my company/organization sponsor this event?
Please send all sponsorship correspondence to PalmCoast@t2t.org with your contact information and someone will be in touch with you within 24 hours.


I would like to donate goods or services to this event. How do I do that?
You can contact us at PalmCoast@t2t.org. We make every effort to keep costs down to allow us to give the most to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation in Stephen Siller's name. Your generosity will be greatly appreciated.


As a participant, can I fundraise/encourage others to donate?
Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online. Do you want to donate cash/money? We can help you with that. Contact us at PalmCoast@t2t.org and we can walk you through the process or you can send donations directly to ATTN: Adam Santamaria - 2361 Hylan Boulevard., Staten Island, NY 10306 - please give us your information so we can add it to your fundraising page.

 
Where can I mail an OFFLINE donation (check made payable to Tunnel to Towers Foundation)?
Please mail any offline donations to:
 
Tunnel to Towers Foundation
Attn: Adam Santamaria - T2T Palm Coast 5K Run & Walk
2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306
 
 
Can I transfer my registration to another participant?
Yes. See information above OR contact us at PalmCoast@t2t.org and we will manually change it in our system.


Can I get a refund?
We do not provide refunds for the event regardless if you cannot make the date or the foundation needs to cancel the event for extenuating circumstances. Registration may be transferred to another person.


How can I volunteer?
It's simple! Email us at PalmCoast@t2t.org and we will reply within 24 hours. Volunteers are always needed for the day of festivities. Thank you!


Do registrants get receipts?
When you register online you should automatically receive a receipt. If paying by credit card or check that is your receipt. If paying in cash, receipt upon request.


Is there a medical staff available on-site?
Yes, there will be an Emergency Medical Service team available on site. There is also radio communication available on the course to help communicate with the EMS.


What safety measures are you taking regarding COVID-19?
We will be abiding by all local and state guidelines regarding masks and social distancing. Stay tuned for updates as the event gets closer.


Why is it required to answer YES or NO to the Covid-19 vaccination question?
The Tunnel to Towers Foundation has followed all protocols and guidelines implemented since COVID-19 was first declared a pandemic. Each city and state currently have their own regulations in place, and Tunnel to Towers must be prepared and collect all data for whatever new guidelines may be implemented.

IF I HAVE A BACKPACK, WHAT DO I DO WITH IT?

CAN SOMEONE ELSE PICK UP MY PACKET FOR ME?

Yes, they can. They must present a copy of your registration receipt. And don't forget to thank them!

 

CAN I STILL DONATE TO A TEAM AND/OR INDIVIDUAL AFTER THE START OF THE RACE?

Yes.  Donations will be accepted for 6 weeks after the event.

 

HOW CAN MY COMPANY/ORGANIZATION SPONSOR THIS EVENT?

Please send all sponsorship correspondence to Sacramento@t2t.org with your contact information and someone will be in touch with you within 24 hours.

 

I WOULD LIKE TO DONATE GOODS OR SERVICES TO THIS EVENT. HOW DO I DO THAT?

You can contact us at Sacramento@t2t.org .We make every effort to keep costs down to allow us to give the most to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation in Stephen Siller's name.  Your generosity will be greatly appreciated.

 

AS A PARTICIPANT, CAN I FUNDRAISE/ENCOURAGE OTHERS TO DONATE?

Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online.  Do you want to donate cash/money?  We can help you with that.  Contact us at Sacramento@t2t.org and we can walk you through the process or you can send donations directly to: Tunnel To Towers Foundation, 2361 Hylan Boulevard., Staten Island, NY 10306 - ATTN: Sacramento 5K. Please give us your information so we can add it to your fundraising page.  It's easy!

 

DOES MY REGISTRATION FEE COUNT TOWARDS MY FUNDRAISING GOAL?

Registration fees help offset some of the expenses associated with making the Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk one of the country’s greatest annual events, however your fundraising efforts enable us to continue to make a difference in the lives of so many in need.

To show our appreciation for your time, passion, and effort, we recognize each fundraising milestone that is reached with prizes branded with the Tunnel to Towers logo.

 

CAN I GET A REFUND? CAN I TRANSFER MY REGISTRATION?

We do not provide refunds for the event if you are not able to attend or if the Foundation needs to cancel the event. Registration may be transferred to another person, just contact us.


WHAT ARE THE FUNDRAISING LEVELS & PRIZES?

You can find all our fundraising incentives HERE.

🌅 Start Your Thanksgiving with Purpose


Gather your loved ones and begin your Thanksgiving morning with gratitude, movement, and meaning.
The Turkey Day Trot: Stride for Peace is an untimed, family-friendly event featuring a 5K Stride for Peace and a Family 1-Miler along the beautiful Santa Monica shoreline.

Walk, stroll, or stride—there’s no rush, just fresh ocean air, good company, and a spirit of togetherness.

 
💫 Event Highlights:


5K Stride for Peace — Scenic, peaceful, and community-centered
Family 1-Miler — Perfect for kids, grandparents, strollers, and all abilities
Coastal views and festive photo ops

Make this Thanksgiving morning more than a meal — make it a movement.
Bring your friends, your family, your pets, and your gratitude. Together, let’s stride for peace, healing, and hope.

name: Turkey Trot 5k Fun Run
description: Get ready to move at the Turkey Trot 5K & Fun Run on Saturday, November 29th at 10:00 AM! Join us at Coach B’s (2527 University Ave, San Diego) for a festive morning of fitness and fun. The run kicks off at 10 AM sharp—so lace up your running shoes and bring your best costume! Fun and creativity are highly encouraged, with prizes awarded for the best costumes. After crossing the finish line, stick around for the post-run celebration featuring fresh donuts, a live DJ, cold plunge recovery, and leg compression therapy and prizes. Whether you’re walking, jogging, or just cheering, it’s the perfect way to kick off small business Saturday with some of your favorite local small businesses!

name: Turner's Tuff Ten
description:
We put the "ish" in "ten-ish". Just think of the extra distance as a FREE bonus.

This 12.4-mile course winds through the beautiful Red Hills Recreation Area in the Sierra Foothills. Winter is an amazing time to run in Red Hills. Water-crossings and mud add difficulty to already challenging, technical terrain.

NEW THIS YEAR!! - Giving you options is what DB is all about!  This year we have added a second distance, giving you the choice between a 10ish mile or 10ish K event.  Whichever distance you pick, you will still be seeing the Swisegoods at our only aid station.

name: UCSD Score-O
description:
Trick-or-Treat can wait! 🎃

Join us for an urban Score-O orienteering adventure across one of California’s most dynamic campuses—where sun-soaked coastal bluffs meet cutting-edge research facilities, and hidden courtyards give way to modern architectural icons.

Established in 1960, UC San Diego spans over 2,178 acres in beautiful La Jolla—right by the Pacific. It’s home to distinctive landmarks such as Geisel Library, lush eucalyptus groves, and the winding “Snake Path” at the heart of campus.

Whether you’re a first-timer or a seasoned navigator, this event invites you to explore the campus like never before—map in hand, compass set, and ready for discovery. Bring your friends and find your way through this vibrant campus maze of research hubs, plazas, and hidden gems.

 

Event Team:

  • Event Director: Tad Gallistel
  • Course Setter: Chris Day
  • Visit the Volunteer page to learn how to help with the event.
    • See "Volunteer" at the top right of the page. 🔝
    • Volunteers receive up to a $20 credit toward a race registration fee.
    • Volunteer roles explained in detail

Format: Score-O 

Map:  scale  1:5000  |  5m contours

Courses: Score-O

​Starts: MASS START AT 10AM

Time Limit: One hour. All competitors must return to HQ and download by noon so we know you are safe. If you don't check in before leaving, volunteers will search the course to ensure you are not lost. Please check in before you leave.

Scoring: Electronic punching will be offered. All participants must bring, rent, or purchase one. Controls will be AIR+ enabled. 

E-Punches: Rental electronic punches will be available for $5. Alternatively, you can purchase your own e-punch at our gear store for delivery to the event (use "000000" when registering).

Clinics:  An introductory clinic will be offered at 9:45 am. An experienced orienteerer will teach you the basics.

Registration: All participants must pre-register. All standard SDO registration policies apply.

Fees:

  • $20 for adults, $10 for juniors (under 21), free for kids 11 and younger.
  • $5 early bird discount through midnight, Saturday, Oct 10th

Closes: Registration will close at 10 am on Friday, Oct 30th, or when we reach our limit

Entry Limit: This event is limited to 100 participants. See the "Find a Participant" tab to see the registration list.

 

HQ Location: Sun God Lawn: 32°52'43.3"N x 117°14'23.4"W

Parking: If driving, we recommend parking in the Scholars Parking Structure nearby. There is a north entrance off Exploration Drive and a south entrance off Muir Lane. It is free for the first 30 mins and $2.25/hr after. Walk southeast to the HQ on the Sun God Lawn.

Public Transit: Consider taking the MTS Trolley, which connects the campus to most of San Diego. From the Trolley, take the path around the Northeast side of Epstein Family Amphitheater, then walk west on Lyman Lane/Mandeville Ave until you see the Sun God statue. An extensive network of bike paths connects UCSD with La Jolla and downtown.

 

San Diego Orienteering: Home page  |  Events

name: VALENCIA Trail Race
description:
Run the VALENCIA Trail Race, run the awesome trails and killer hills with breathtaking views of the Santa Clarita Valley in a 10K, Half Marathon, or 50K Ultra race. For runners who love to run great trails and want to accomplish a good challenge. Prepare to take on the Awesome Trail Challenge in Valencia, California. Southern California features a diverse range of nature and terrain, giving runners a wide variety of spectacular trails and running experiences. Located north of Los Angeles up against the California State park boundaries is Valencia, a suburban community that is surrounded by hills and mountains featuring awesome trails to be experienced.

Registration is now open with course distances for all types of runners to offer a variety of challenges. Experience a course that takes you up challenging hills to the peaks and along the ridgelines with panoramic views, then into the canyons and valleys for a truly awesome trail challenge.  Registration is available on VALENCIATrailRace.com or on the popular Active.com running network. 

Learn more at >> VALENCIATrailRace.com

name: Valentine's Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
💘 Celebrate love and fitness this Valentine’s Day with our charming Valentine's Run! Whether you’re running solo, with a partner, or with friends, this event is all about spreading love and joy.  Let’s make this Valentine’s unforgettable! Sign up today and let the love run wild!

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double check your full U.S. mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive the Course Map and Details?
We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times  (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
 
Running Late?
Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more.
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here.
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/.
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 

Your Race | Your Journey | Your Story

Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
 

Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.

This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave so it never feels crowded and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.  Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.

What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - U.S. only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)

- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?

When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will arrive at your mailing address the week of your race.

No problem - just note that shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!

We'll send final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.

Running Late?

name: Vampire Run - Unite for Bleeding Disorders
description:
Join us as we have fun raising funds in support of the bleeding disorders community!

Featuring:

Vampire Run 5K – join us at our first ever 5K on the trails of Roseville, CA! All runners will get a special Vampire Run medal and entry into our Community Festival. We encourage capes, teeth, and costumes! Entry fees are $30 for adults and $10 for those under 14. Five and under can enter the festival for free. This is a timed run.

Food – all entrants will receive coffee from a coffee cart, juice, donuts, and other snacks! Who could pass up sno-cones and popcorn?

Games and Fun! – join us for carnival games, crafts, and face painting…all included in the race fee!

Please note - if you sign up by October 7, 2026, your shirt size is confirmed.

name: Vaquero Strong 5K
description:
Vaquero Strong 5K

Run. Walk. Rally. Be Vaquero Strong.

Lace up and join the Irvine High School community for the Vaquero Strong 5K, hosted by the Irvine High School PTSA and ASB!

On Saturday, October 24, 2026, students, families, friends, neighbors, and runners from across Southern California will come together for a fun, energetic morning celebrating the spirit of Irvine High. Whether you're chasing a personal best, walking with friends, or bringing the whole family, there's a place for you at the starting line.

Come for the 5K. Stay for the celebration!

Every participant will receive a custom race shirt and finisher medal, and 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female.

And the fun doesn't stop at the finish line. Enjoy coffee, food, and treats available for purchase before and after the race while you celebrate with the Irvine High community.

Your Run Makes a Difference

The Vaquero Strong 5K isn't just about crossing the finish line. Your participation directly supports Irvine High students and staff.

Race proceeds help fund:

  • Updates to the Mental Health Wellness Center
  • Teacher mini grants
  • Student scholarships
  • Student recognition programs, including the Spur & Heritage Awards
  • And other initiatives that make a meaningful difference on campus

Every registration helps strengthen our school community and gives back to the students and staff who make Irvine High special.

      Run for the challenge.
      Run for the community.
      Run for Irvine High.

Come Be Vaquero Strong!

Race Location

Start/Finish: Irvine High School Stadium
4321 Walnut Ave
Irvine, CA 92604

5K Registration

Early Registration — through September 30

Adults: $30
Ages 18 & under: $20
Ages 5 & under: $12

October 1 and after

Adults: $35
Ages 18 & under: $25
Ages 5 & under: $12

What You Get
🏃 5K race experience
👕 Custom race shirt
🏅 All finishers earn a race medal
🏆 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female 
Race Day Schedule
6:30 AM — Race Day Check-In
8:00 AM — 5K Start

Ready to show your Vaquero Strong? Let's hit the starting line!

name: Ventura 4th of July 5k
description:
Ventura 4th of July 5K
Celebrate Independence Day with a fun, fast, family-friendly 5K at the beach in Ventura! Whether you're chasing a new personal best, running with friends and family, or simply looking for a great way to start your 4th of July, the Ventura 4th of July 5K is the perfect way to kick off the holiday. Come run, celebrate, and help us make this event a new Ventura 4th of July tradition!

What You Get
Every registration includes:

👕Official Ventura 4th of July 5K Race T-Shirt
⏱️ Professional live chip timing
📊 Immediate post-race results displayed digitally at the finish
📱 Post-race digital results available online
🏆 Awards for the top 3 finishers in every age group
🎉 4th of July race-day atmosphere
🏪 Local vendors and community businesses
📸 Free Race Day photos and memories
🙌 A professionally organized, runner-focused race experience

🏆 Awards
We're recognizing runners throughout the field! Top 3 finishers in every age group will receive an award, giving runners of all ages something to race for. Whether you're competing for the overall win, trying to set a PR, or racing against the clock in your age group, there's a reason to push to the finish.

Start Your 4th of July the Right Way
Grab your friends, family, running group, and neighbors and join us in Ventura for a morning of running, celebration, and community. Run the 5K. Earn your shirt. Chase an award. Celebrate the 4th.

Limited to the first 500 runners!

name: Ventura Turkey Trot
description:
2026 - Event Registration 

Grab your friends and family and join us for the festive Ventura Turkey Trot 5K & Kids 1K. This loop course is fast and flat, so come out and sweat with us before you sit down for your Thanksgiving feast.

All registrants in the 5K and Kids Run will receive a custom finishers medal. Plus choose from our fun 2026 Turkey Trot Shirt or Mug.

Packet Pick Up

Wednesday of race week (the day before Thanksgiving) from 1pm - 5pm at Mile 26 Running Co (2222 E Thompson Blvd, Ventura, CA 93001)

Race Morning (Thanksgiving Morning) - At the Race (Hofer Dr just off King at the Ventura Auto Center) starting at 7:00am. 

 

Food Drive

Please bring non-perishable food items, such as canned meats, legumes, fruits, or vegetables. They will be donated to the food drive being held by the Ventura County Area Agency on Aging, which is a division of the Ventura County Human Services Agency.

 

Start Times

5K - 8:00am

Kids 1K - 9:15am

name: Veterans Day Freedom Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Celebrate this Veterans Day with our annual Freedom Run! 🏃‍♂️💨

Kick off your weekend with purpose and pride by joining our 5K, 10K, or Half-Marathon. Whether you're running for a personal best or walking with friends and family, let's move together in deep gratitude for the brave Veterans who have sacrificed so much to protect our freedom. 🎖️🗽

You can raise funds for a charity of choice (Optional). 100% of the net funds raised will go towards your cause of choice. 

 
Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 
Smaller Races, Warm Memories, Always Ready for You

Kick off your weekend with purpose and pride by joining our 5K, 10K, or Half-Marathon. Whether you're running for a personal best or walking with friends and family, let's move together in deep gratitude for the brave Veterans who have sacrificed so much to protect our freedom. 🎖️🗽

You can raise funds for a charity of choice (Optional). 100% of the net funds raised will go towards your cause of choice. 

 
Forget the massive, impersonal race-day crowds. We keep things small, personal, and local, so every run feels less like a number and more like a memory. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half-marathon, or virtual run, you'll get the warmth of a hometown event.
Overview:
Spots sell out FAST! We close each wave the moment it fills. Once a wave sells out, you can grab the virtual run option or join the waitlist.
This is a smaller, private group run with a capped field per wave - so it never feels crowded, and you're never just a bib number.
All paces and ages welcome (under 18 with a guardian) - run it, walk it, however you like!
There's no gear, no setup, no fuss - just you, the course, and our coordinators cheering you on in a relaxed, stress-free setting.
When you sign up, you're not just registering for a race - you're getting real support toward your fitness goals, plus an invite to join one of our local run clubs to keep the momentum going.
 
Timing:
Optional! Track your own time via Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, or similar, then submit it through our easy online form to get posted.
Or just ask a coordinator to help time you.
No timing chips - this is about progress, not pressure.
 
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-shirt (shipped to your address - US only)
- Finisher's medal
- Virtual Training Run (emailed to you a month before your run)
- Online results & certificate of completion
- Invitation to join a local running club
- NEW: Upgrade to a lightweight, moisture-wicking technical shirt for just $5 more
 
Packet Pickup?
Skip It. No lines, no hassle - your swag ships straight to your door. (Double-check your full US mailing address, including apartment number, when you register as your shirt is sent to this address!) Race bibs are simply handed out on race day.
 
When Will My Swag Arrive?
Your shirt will land at your mailing address the week of your race.
 
Signing Up Last Minute? (Within 2 Weeks of the Race)
No problem - just know shipping may not catch up in time, so your shirt could arrive after race day. No worries, though: wear whatever you like and come run with us anyway!
 
When Will I Receive get the Course Map and Details?
We'll send a final participant info by the Wednesday before race day with all the details and course maps.
 
Wave Times (Once you've registered, use your confirmation number to reserve a wave here.)
Wave A: 7:30 AM
Wave B: 8:00 AM
Wave C: 8:30 AM
Running late? Jump in when you arrive - our coordinators stay on-site for 3 hours after the first wave. Times may be subject to change depending on seasons, please check your participant info email!
Got more questions? Check our FAQ.
 
Virtual Run Option
Prefer to run on your own time? Our Virtual Run includes a digital training pack to keep you on track. Run it whenever, wherever, with any tracking device you like (optional) — then send your results to info@thebestraces.com to claim your medal.
 
Race Bundle
Sign up for multiple races and save with a bundle discount.
 
Sponsorships & Promoting Your Business
Want to put your business in front of our community? We'd love to feature you as a sponsor. Learn more
 
Team Glo Volunteers
Love helping people cross finish lines? Join our volunteer team and help bring these community runs to life. Sign up here
 
Be Part of the Journey
Discover our charity initiatives at https://www.thebestraces.com/runforothers/
Got a mission that helps people around the world? Let us help you fundraise at no cost to you.
 
Smaller Races, Warm Memories, Always Ready for You
